attributes.name: vee_rule_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.vee_rule_set. Business justification: Each VEE event is generated by applying a specific VEE rule set. Currently vee_event has vee_rule_code (string) which is a denormalized reference. The vee_rule_set entity is the authoritative source f

attributes.name: analyst_override_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a human analyst manually overrode the automated VEE processing result.

attributes.name: billing_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this VEE event resulted in a change to billable consumption or demand data.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes related to the VEE event, used for additional context or audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: corrected_value
attributes.description: Corrected or estimated value after VEE processing. This is the value used for billing and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the VEE event record was first created in the MDMS system.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Overall data quality score (0-100) for the read after VEE processing, used for MDMS data governance and quality monitoring.

attributes.name: estimation_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0-100) indicating the reliability of the estimated value based on the estimation method and available data quality.

attributes.name: estimation_method
attributes.description: Algorithm or method used to estimate the corrected value (e.g., regression, weather-normalized, profile-based, historical average, similar day, linear interpolation, manual). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regression|weather_normalized|profile_based|historical_average|similar_day|linear_interpolation|manual|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the read interval in minutes (e.g., 15, 30, 60) for interval data, or null for register reads.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the VEE event record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: Type of measurement affected by the VEE event (e.g., consumption, demand, voltage, power factor).

attributes.name: original_raw_value
attributes.description: Original raw meter read value before VEE processing was applied. Null if no read was received.

attributes.name: override_analyst_code
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the analyst who performed the manual override.

attributes.name: override_justification
attributes.description: Free-text justification provided by the analyst for manually overriding the automated VEE result. Required when analyst_override_flag is true.

attributes.name: override_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the analyst override was applied.

attributes.name: read_end_timestamp
attributes.description: End timestamp of the interval or register read period affected by the VEE event.

attributes.name: read_quality_code
attributes.description: Quality code assigned to the read after VEE processing, indicating the reliability level (e.g., actual, estimated, questionable, rejected).

attributes.name: read_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Start timestamp of the interval or register read period affected by the VEE event.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this VEE event must be included in regulatory reporting to PUC or FERC.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Source system that provided the original raw read data (e.g., MDMS, AMI Head End, Manual Entry, SCADA, Historian).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the read value affected by the VEE event (e.g., kWh, MWh, kW, MW, MCF, Therm). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kWh|MWh|kW|MW|MCF|Therm|kVAR|Volts — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: validation_exception_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific validation exception or data quality issue detected (e.g., spike, dropout, missing, negative, sum-check-fail, high-limit, low-limit).

attributes.name: validation_exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the validation exception or data quality issue that triggered the VEE event.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Absolute difference between the original raw value and the corrected value (corrected_value - original_raw_value).

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage variance between the original raw value and the corrected value, calculated as (variance_amount / original_raw_value) * 100.

attributes.name: vee_batch_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the VEE processing batch or job that generated this event, used for grouping and audit trail.

attributes.name: vee_event_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or reference number for the VEE event, used for audit trail and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: vee_processing_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the VEE processing was executed and the event record was created.

attributes.name: vee_rule_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the VEE rule that was applied, explaining the validation or estimation logic.

attributes.name: vee_status
attributes.description: Current status of the VEE event indicating the outcome of the validation, estimation, or editing process.

products.name: meter_event
products.description: Transactional log of operational events and alarms reported by AMI smart meters and endpoints to the head-end system. Captures event type (tamper/outage/restoration/power-quality/low-battery/reverse-flow/tilt/cover-removal/communication-loss), event timestamp, meter identifier, endpoint identifier, event severity, raw event code from the device, acknowledgment status, and downstream notification flag (e.g., forwarded to OMS for outage correlation). Supports outage detection, theft/tamper investigation, power quality monitoring, and field crew dispatch. Sourced from Itron Analytics / Oracle Utilities MDMS event stream.
products.reference: Itron Analytics Meter Event Log / Oracle Utilities MDMS Device Events

attributes.name: meter_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the meter event record. Primary key for the meter event log.

attributes.name: ami_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the AMI communication endpoint or module attached to the meter that transmitted the event to the head-end system.

attributes.name: compliance_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_event. Business justification: Meter events (tampering, sustained outages, voltage violations) can trigger regulatory compliance events (service quality violations, NERC CIP events). FK enables regulatory incident tracking, penalty

attributes.name: credit_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.credit_adjustment. Business justification: Meter events (outages, tamper, power quality) trigger billing adjustments. Credit adjustments must reference the specific event that justified the adjustment for audit trails, regulatory compliance, a

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer account associated with the service point and meter. Used for customer notification and billing impact analysis.

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the AMI or AMR meter that generated this event. Links to the physical meter asset.

attributes.name: service_point_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the service point (premise delivery location) associated with the meter that generated this event. Links event to customer location.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work order created for field investigation or corrective action. Null if no work order generated.

attributes.name: acknowledged_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or automated process that acknowledged the event. Null if unacknowledged.

attributes.name: acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the event was acknowledged. Null if the event has not been acknowledged.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the event has been acknowledged by operations staff or automatically cleared by the system. Tracks event lifecycle state.

attributes.name: battery_level_percent
attributes.description: Remaining battery charge level as a percentage for battery-powered endpoints or meters. Used for low battery event analysis and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: current_reading
attributes.description: Current measurement in amperes captured at the time of the event, if applicable. Used for tamper detection and reverse flow analysis.

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Raw event code or alarm identifier as transmitted by the meter or endpoint. Vendor-specific code that maps to the event type.

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the event, providing additional context beyond the event type and code. May include device-generated diagnostic messages.

attributes.name: event_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the investigation findings, corrective actions taken, and event resolution details. Entered by operations or field staff.

attributes.name: event_severity
attributes.description: Severity level assigned to the event based on operational impact and urgency. Used for prioritization and escalation workflows.

attributes.name: event_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the head-end system or MDMS platform that received and processed the event from the meter endpoint (e.g., Itron Analytics, Oracle Utilities MDMS).

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the event occurred at the meter or endpoint, as recorded by the device clock. This is the business event time, distinct from system receipt time.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the meter event. Indicates the nature of the operational event or alarm reported by the device. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tamper|outage|restoration|power_quality|low_battery|reverse_flow|tilt|cover_removal|communication_loss|demand_threshold|voltage_sag|voltage_swell — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: field_investigation_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this event requires field crew investigation or site visit. True if investigation required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: forwarded_to_oms_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Forwarded to OMS (Outage Management System) Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this event was forwarded to the Outage Management System for outage correlation and crew dispatch. True if forwarded, False otherwise.

attributes.name: frequency_hz
attributes.description: Electrical frequency in hertz measured at the time of the event. Used for grid stability and power quality analysis.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel used to send the event notification to the customer or operations staff. Null if no notification sent.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a customer or operations notification was sent for this event. True if notification sent, False otherwise.

attributes.name: oms_incident_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the outage incident created in the OMS as a result of this meter event. Null if not forwarded or no incident created.

attributes.name: outage_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the outage in minutes, calculated from outage event to restoration event. Used for SAIDI and SAIFI reliability index calculations.

attributes.name: power_factor
attributes.description: Power factor measurement (ratio of real power to apparent power) at the time of the event. Used for power quality monitoring and analysis.

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the event was processed and validated by the MDMS or event management system. Used for event processing latency analysis.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the event was received by the head-end system or MDMS. May differ from event_timestamp due to communication latency.

attributes.name: resolved_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or automated process that resolved and closed the event. Null if unresolved.

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the event was marked as resolved or closed. Null for open or unresolved events.

attributes.name: restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when power was restored following an outage event. Null for non-outage events or unresolved outages.

attributes.name: signal_strength_dbm
attributes.description: Communication signal strength in decibels-milliwatts at the time of the event. Used for communication loss event diagnosis and network optimization.

attributes.name: tamper_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of tamper events detected by the meter since last reset. Used for theft investigation and fraud detection.

attributes.name: voltage_reading
attributes.description: Voltage measurement in volts captured at the time of the event, if applicable. Used for power quality events such as voltage sag or swell.

products.name: read_cycle
products.description: Master reference entity defining scheduled meter reading cycles used to organize meter reads for billing and data collection. Captures cycle code, cycle name, read frequency (monthly/bi-monthly/daily/on-demand), scheduled read day-of-month, billing cycle alignment, geographic route grouping, AMI collection window start/end times, and active status. Drives the scheduling of both AMI automated collection jobs and manual meter reading routes. Referenced by register_read and interval_read to associate reads with their originating cycle. Managed within Oracle Utilities MDMS and Oracle CC&B / SAP IS-U.
products.reference: Oracle CC&B / SAP IS-U Read Cycle Configuration

attributes.name: read_cycle_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the meter reading cycle. Primary key for the read cycle entity.

attributes.name: replacement_cycle_read_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the successor reading cycle that replaced this cycle when it was retired. Used to track cycle evolution and support meter reassignment during cycle consolidation or restructuring.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDMS - Cycle Succession Management

attributes.name: vee_rule_set_id
attributes.description: FK to metering.vee_rule_set

attributes.name: ami_collection_window_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) Collection Window End Time
attributes.description: Timestamp marking the end of the automated interval data collection window for AMI smart meters. Collection jobs must complete before this time to allow VEE processing and billing cycle close.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDMS - AMI Collection Scheduling

attributes.name: ami_collection_window_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) Collection Window Start Time
attributes.description: Timestamp marking the beginning of the automated interval data collection window for AMI smart meters assigned to this cycle. Typically set to midnight or early morning hours to minimize network load.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDMS - AMI Collection Scheduling

attributes.name: billing_cycle_alignment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this read cycle is synchronized with billing cycle processing. Aligned cycles trigger billing immediately after reads; offset cycles allow time for validation; independent cycles are not tied to billing.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B - Billing and Revenue Management

attributes.name: billing_cycle_day_offset
attributes.description: Number of days between the scheduled read day and the billing cycle close date. Allows time for meter data validation, estimation, and editing (VEE) before invoices are generated. Typically 1-5 days for monthly cycles.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDMS - VEE Processing Window

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to collect meter reads for this cycle. AMI automated uses smart meter network; AMR drive-by uses mobile collection units; manual methods require field personnel.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDMS - Collection Method Configuration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this read cycle record was first created in the MDMS or CIS system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customer_class
attributes.description: Primary customer class or rate class served by this cycle. Used to segment cycles by customer type for billing, rate application, and regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: cycle_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the reading cycle used in operational systems and billing processes. Typically a short alphanumeric code (e.g., C01, CYC-A, M15) that uniquely identifies the cycle within the utility's service territory.

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the reading cycle (e.g., 'North Region Monthly Cycle', 'Downtown Daily AMI Collection', 'Residential Bi-Monthly Route 5'). Used for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reading cycle purpose. Billing cycles drive invoice generation; operational cycles support grid monitoring; on-demand cycles handle ad-hoc requests; special cycles support events like meter exchanges or audits.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDMS - Cycle Type Classification

attributes.name: demand_response_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether meters in this cycle are eligible for Demand Response (DR) programs and curtailment events. True for AMI cycles with 15-minute or hourly interval collection supporting peak shaving and load management.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222 - Distributed Energy Resource Aggregation

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this reading cycle was retired or replaced. Null for currently active cycles. Used to maintain historical cycle configurations for audit and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this reading cycle became active and available for meter assignment and read scheduling. Used to track cycle history and support regulatory reporting of billing cycle changes.

attributes.name: estimated_meter_count
attributes.description: Approximate number of meters assigned to this reading cycle. Used for workforce planning, collection job sizing, and performance monitoring. Updated periodically as meters are added or removed from the cycle.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDMS - Cycle Meter Assignment

attributes.name: geographic_zone_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic service territory, district, or region to which this cycle applies. Used to group cycles by operational area and align with distribution system topology.

attributes.name: interval_length_minutes
attributes.description: Length of each interval data collection period in minutes for AMI meters in this cycle. Common values are 15, 30, or 60 minutes. Null for cycles collecting only monthly register reads.
attributes.references: NERC - Demand Response Availability Data System (DADS)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this read cycle record. Tracks configuration changes, status updates, and cycle parameter adjustments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or comments related to this reading cycle. May include information about route changes, seasonal adjustments, or coordination with field operations.

attributes.name: read_cycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the reading cycle. Active cycles are in use for scheduling and collection; inactive cycles are temporarily disabled; suspended cycles are on hold pending review; archived cycles are retained for historical reference only.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDMS - Cycle Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: read_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which meters assigned to this cycle are read. Monthly is standard for residential billing; daily for AMI interval collection; bi-monthly for certain gas customers; on-demand for special reads. attributes.name: route_sequence_number

attributes.name: scheduled_read_day
attributes.description: Target day of the month (1-31) when meters in this cycle should be read. Used for monthly and bi-monthly cycles to schedule meter reader routes and AMI collection jobs. Null for daily or on-demand cycles.

attributes.name: service_type

attributes.name: target_read_completion_hours
attributes.description: Target number of hours within which all meters in this cycle should be read after the scheduled read day. Used to measure field workforce productivity and AMI collection performance. Typically 24-48 hours for monthly cycles.
attributes.references: Oracle WAM - Work Management Performance Metrics

attributes.name: time_of_use_enabled

attributes.name: vee_processing_required

attributes.description: Indicates whether meter reads collected in this cycle must undergo automated validation, estimation, and editing (VEE) processing before being released to billing. True for billing cycles; may be false for operational monitoring cycles.

products.name: meter_program_enrollment
products.description: Transactional record tracking a meter's enrollment in utility programs that require metering configuration changes or special data collection — including TOU (Time-of-Use), CPP (Critical Peak Pricing), NEM (Net Energy Metering), DR (Demand Response), EV charging programs, and EE (Energy Efficiency) interval monitoring programs. Captures meter identifier, program code, enrollment effective date, end date, program-specific meter configuration requirements (e.g., TOU rate schedule, demand threshold, export channel activation), enrollment status, and the triggering customer account reference. This entity owns the metering-domain impact of program enrollment — the meter configuration changes, channel activations, and data collection requirements. Customer-level program participation and billing rate application are owned by the customer and billing domains respectively. Managed within Oracle Utilities MDMS and coordinated with Oracle CC&B / SAP IS-U.
products.reference: Oracle CC&B / SAP IS-U Rate Schedule Enrollment / MDMS Program Configuration

attributes.name: meter_program_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the meter program enrollment record. Primary key for this entity. Represents a single instance of a meter being enrolled in a utility program requiring specific metering configuration or data collection.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that triggered or is associated with this meter program enrollment. Links to the customer account master in the customer domain.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Program enrollments (net metering, demand response, TOU) affect billing calculations. Invoices must reference active enrollments for accurate charge application, incentive tracking, and regulatory com

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical or logical meter asset enrolled in the program. Links to the meter inventory master record in the metering domain.

attributes.name: participant_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to market.participant_registration. Business justification: Demand response and wholesale market program enrollments require validation against RTO/ISO participant registration status for eligibility verification and settlement authorization.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to market.ppa_contract. Business justification: Customer-sited generation programs (net metering, community solar) often operate under PPA structures requiring enrollment tracking for contract compliance, incentive calculation, and regulatory repor

attributes.name: service_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service point (premise delivery location) where the enrolled meter is installed. Links to the distribution domain service point entity.

attributes.name: tariff_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.tariff_schedule. attributes.name: tou_schedule_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific TOU time-block schedule applied to this meter. Defines on-peak, mid-peak, off-peak periods and seasonal variations. Applicable only for TOU and CPP program enrollments.

attributes.name: cis_program_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier linking this metering-domain enrollment to the corresponding customer-level program participation record in the CIS (Oracle CC&B or SAP IS-U). Supports coordination between metering configuration and billing rate application.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the meter and customer are in compliance with program requirements. False indicates non-compliance issues such as missing data, configuration errors, or customer behavior violations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Represents the data ingestion event, not the business enrollment request date.

attributes.name: data_collection_requirement
attributes.description: Level of data collection required for this program enrollment. Standard indicates normal AMI interval reads; Enhanced indicates additional channels or higher frequency; Real-time indicates continuous streaming; On-demand indicates event-triggered collection.

attributes.name: demand_threshold_kw
attributes.description: Demand threshold in kilowatts (kW) that triggers program-specific actions or billing. Used in demand response and critical peak pricing programs to define curtailment or penalty thresholds.

attributes.name: enrollment_activation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the meter configuration changes were applied and the enrollment became operationally active in the MDMS (Meter Data Management System). Records the actual system activation event.

attributes.name: enrollment_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the program enrollment was approved by utility operations or automated validation. Applicable for programs requiring eligibility verification or technical feasibility review.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the enrollment was initiated. Distinguishes self-service digital enrollments from assisted or batch enrollments.

attributes.name: enrollment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the meter program enrollment becomes active and the meter configuration changes take effect. Determines when program-specific data collection and rate application begin.

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the meter program enrollment ends or is scheduled to end. Nullable for open-ended enrollments. Determines when program-specific meter configuration and data collection cease.

attributes.name: enrollment_request_date
attributes.description: Date when the program enrollment was requested or initiated. May differ from enrollment_effective_date due to processing time, approval workflows, or scheduled future start dates.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Origin or trigger of the meter program enrollment. Customer request indicates opt-in; Utility initiative indicates utility-driven enrollment; Regulatory mandate indicates compliance-driven; Automatic enrollment indicates default assignment; Pilot program indicates test/trial participation.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the meter program enrollment. Pending indicates enrollment request submitted but not yet activated; Active indicates meter is configured and collecting program data; Suspended indicates temporary hold; Terminated indicates program completion; Cancelled indicates enrollment withdrawn before activation.

attributes.name: export_channel_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the meter export channel (reverse energy flow measurement) is activated for this enrollment. True for NEM (Net Energy Metering) and DER (Distributed Energy Resource) programs where customer generation is measured.

attributes.name: incentive_payment_status
attributes.description: Status of the program incentive payment associated with this enrollment. Tracks the lifecycle of incentive disbursement from eligibility determination through payment completion.

attributes.name: interval_collection_frequency_minutes
attributes.description: Frequency in minutes at which interval meter data is collected for this program enrollment. Common values include 15, 30, or 60 minutes. Defines the granularity of energy consumption data required by the program.

attributes.name: last_compliance_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance validation check for this enrollment. Used to track periodic audits of program participation requirements and meter data quality.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was most recently modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Tracks data refresh and change propagation from source systems.

attributes.name: mdms_enrollment_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Meter Data Management System (MDMS) Enrollment Reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier for this enrollment in the source MDMS (Oracle Utilities MDMS or Itron Analytics). Enables cross-system reconciliation and audit trail back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: meter_configuration_profile
attributes.description: Identifier or description of the meter configuration profile applied for this program enrollment. Defines register mappings, channel activations, TOU bin assignments, and other meter firmware settings required by the program.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or case-specific details related to this meter program enrollment. Used by MDMS operators and field service personnel for context and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the utility program type. Examples include TOU (Time-of-Use), CPP (Critical Peak Pricing), NEM (Net Energy Metering), DR (Demand Response), EV (Electric Vehicle) charging programs, and EE (Energy Efficiency) monitoring programs.

attributes.name: program_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Monetary incentive amount in USD associated with this program enrollment. Applicable for DR, EE, and EV programs that offer enrollment bonuses, rebates, or participation payments. Null for rate-only programs.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the utility program. Provides human-readable identification of the program for reporting and customer communication purposes.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the program enrollment was terminated or cancelled. Populated only for enrollments with status terminated or cancelled. Marks the end of program-specific meter configuration and data collection.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for enrollment termination. Customer request indicates opt-out; Program ended indicates utility discontinued program; Non-compliance indicates customer failed to meet program requirements; Meter removed indicates physical meter change; Account closed or Moved out indicate service discontinuation.

attributes.name: termination_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context or details about the enrollment termination. Supplements the termination_reason_code with case-specific information.

products.name: remote_service_action
products.description: Transactional record of remote connect/disconnect and load control commands issued to AMI-capable meters via the head-end system. Captures action type (connect/disconnect/load-limit/ping/on-demand-read/firmware-update), initiating system (CIS/billing/field-ops), command timestamp, execution timestamp, result status (success/failed/pending/timeout), failure reason code, meter identifier, endpoint identifier, authorized user or automated process reference, and regulatory compliance flag (e.g., disconnection moratorium override). Supports billing collections workflows, safety disconnections, and demand response load control. Sourced from Itron Analytics / Oracle Utilities MDMS remote command log.
products.reference: Itron Analytics Remote Connect/Disconnect / Oracle Utilities MDMS Command Log

attributes.name: remote_service_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the remote service action record. Primary key for this transactional log of remote commands issued to Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) capable meters.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Remote service actions (connect/disconnect/load limit) are customer service operations initiated from account context for collections enforcement, move-in/move-out processing, and payment arrangement

attributes.name: ami_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) communication endpoint or module attached to the meter. Used by the head-end system to route commands to the specific device.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Remote disconnects and load limiting are subject to regulatory moratorium rules (winter/summer protections, medical certificate holds, payment plan protections). attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Remote connect/disconnect operations incur system and labor costs that must be allocated to cost centers for operational efficiency tracking, cost-benefit analysis of AMI investments, and rate case ju

attributes.name: demand_response_event_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the demand response event that triggered the remote service action, if applicable. Links load control actions to specific Demand Response (DR) or Demand-Side Management (DSM) program events.

attributes.name: dispatch_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to market.dispatch_award. Business justification: Remote disconnect/reconnect actions for DR resources must tie to dispatch awards for automated dispatch execution, performance verification, and settlement validation in demand response programs.

attributes.name: distribution_outage_event_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the outage event that prompted the remote service action, if applicable. Links remote connect actions to service restoration workflows managed by the Outage Management System (OMS).

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical meter device to which the remote service action was directed. Links to the meter asset inventory in the metering domain.

attributes.name: service_point_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the service delivery point (premise location) associated with the meter receiving the remote action. Links to the distribution service point entity.

attributes.name: action_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed subtype or variant of the remote action, providing additional granularity beyond the primary action type. For example, disconnect may have subtypes such as non-payment, safety, or emergency.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Type of remote service action commanded to the meter. Connect and disconnect support billing collections and safety workflows; load limit enables demand response; on-demand read supports billing validation; firmware update maintains device security and functionality. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: connect|disconnect|load_limit|ping|on_demand_read|firmware_update|time_sync|configuration_change — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Security authorization or approval code required to execute the remote service action, particularly for high-risk actions such as disconnect or firmware update. Used for audit and compliance verification.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Billing cycle identifier associated with the service point at the time the remote action was executed. Used to correlate remote actions with billing periods for revenue assurance and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: command_number
attributes.description: Business-facing reference number or tracking identifier for the remote service action command, used for customer service inquiries and audit trails.

attributes.name: command_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the remote service action command was issued by the head-end system or Meter Data Management System (MDMS) to the meter endpoint. Represents the business event time of command initiation.

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Network communication protocol used to transmit the remote service action command to the meter endpoint. Examples include RF mesh, cellular, PLC (power line carrier), or Wi-Fi.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the remote service action workflow was fully completed, including all confirmations, callbacks, and downstream system updates. Represents the end of the action lifecycle.

attributes.name: configuration_profile
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the configuration profile or parameter set applied to the meter when the action type is configuration change. Null for non-configuration actions.

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a customer notification (email, SMS, or postal mail) was sent prior to or following the remote service action, as required by regulatory or business policy. True if notification was sent.

attributes.name: execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the meter endpoint confirmed successful execution of the remote service action. Null if the action has not yet executed or failed before execution.

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for command failure, if applicable. Examples include communication failure, meter offline, command rejected by meter, invalid command parameters, or security authentication failure. Null if the action succeeded.

attributes.name: failure_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the failure reason, providing additional context beyond the failure reason code. Used for troubleshooting and customer service inquiries.

attributes.name: firmware_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the firmware package deployed to the meter when the action type is firmware update. Null for non-firmware-update actions.

attributes.name: initiating_process
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the automated business process, workflow, or batch job that triggered the remote service action. Populated when the action was system-initiated rather than user-initiated.

attributes.name: initiating_system
attributes.description: Source system or application that originated the remote service action request. Customer Information System (CIS) for account-driven actions, Outage Management System (OMS) for restoration, Demand Response Management System (DRMS) for load control, or manual for operator-initiated commands. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cis|billing|field_ops|oms|mdms|drms|manual — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: initiating_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who authorized or triggered the remote service action. Null if the action was triggered by an automated process or system rule.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the remote service action record was last modified in the source system. Used for incremental data ingestion and change data capture workflows.

attributes.name: load_limit_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration in minutes for which the load limit is to remain in effect. Null if the load limit is indefinite or the action type is not load limit.

attributes.name: load_limit_kw
attributes.description: Maximum power demand limit in kilowatts (kW) applied to the meter when the action type is load limit. Used for demand response programs and customer payment plan enforcement. Null for non-load-limit actions.

attributes.name: moratorium_override_reason
attributes.description: Justification or authorization code for overriding a disconnection moratorium or regulatory protection when executing a disconnect action. Required for audit and regulatory reporting when regulatory compliance flag is true.

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer notification was sent. Null if no notification was sent or required.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the remote service action, determining queue position and retry behavior. Critical priority is used for safety disconnections and emergency load control; high priority for billing collections; normal for routine operations.

attributes.name: rate_schedule_code
attributes.description: Rate schedule or tariff code applicable to the service point at the time of the remote action. Used to ensure compliance with rate-specific service rules, such as Time-of-Use (TOU) or Critical Peak Pricing (CPP) program requirements.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the remote service action was subject to regulatory compliance review or override, such as disconnection moratorium periods, medical baseline protections, or Public Utility Commission (PUC) mandated customer protections. True if compliance rules were applied or overridden.

attributes.name: response_time_seconds
attributes.description: Elapsed time in seconds between command transmission and receipt of acknowledgment or execution confirmation from the meter endpoint. Used to measure network and meter performance.

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the remote service action command. Success indicates the meter executed the command as requested; failed indicates the command could not be executed; pending indicates the command is queued or in progress; timeout indicates no response was received within the expected window; cancelled indicates the command was aborted before execution.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times the head-end system attempted to execute the remote service action command after initial failure. Used to track communication reliability and meter responsiveness.

attributes.name: scheduled_execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the remote action was scheduled to execute at the meter. May differ from command timestamp if the action was queued for future execution. Null if the action was intended for immediate execution.

attributes.name: signal_strength_dbm
attributes.description: Measured signal strength in decibel-milliwatts (dBm) of the communication link between the head-end system and the meter endpoint at the time of command transmission. Used to diagnose communication failures.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Primary key or unique identifier of the remote service action record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation between the lakehouse and source systems.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operational system of record that generated the remote service action log entry. Typically the Meter Data Management System (MDMS) such as Oracle Utilities MDMS or Itron Analytics.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the field work order or service order that prompted the remote action, if applicable. Used to link remote commands to physical field activities such as move-in, move-out, or service restoration.

products.name: meter_test
products.description: Transactional record of accuracy and performance tests conducted on meters — both in-field and in-laboratory settings. Captures test type (in-service/shop/acceptance/complaint-driven), test date, test location (field/lab), meter identifier, test standard applied (ANSI C12.20 accuracy class for North American deployments; IEC 62052-11/62053-series for international compliance), test result (pass/fail/adjusted), percentage error at full load and light load, power factor test result, demand register accuracy, as-found and as-left accuracy readings, technician identifier, and corrective action taken (adjusted/replaced/condemned). Supports regulatory accuracy compliance reporting to PUCs (state commissions) and drives meter replacement decisions. Sourced from Oracle WAM / IBM Maximo meter test records.
products.reference: ANSI C12.20 Meter Accuracy Standard / Oracle WAM Meter Test Module

attributes.name: meter_test_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the meter test record. Primary key for the meter test transaction.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Meter testing schedules are driven by regulatory accuracy testing obligations (state PUC meter testing rules, ANSI standards). FK enables compliance tracking, audit evidence generation, and automated

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Meter testing incurs labor, facility, and equipment costs that must be allocated to cost centers for regulatory compliance cost tracking, annual budget reconciliation, and FERC reporting of meter accu

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Test expenses must post to specific GL accounts (typically FERC 920-935 Customer Accounts/Service expenses) for financial statement preparation, regulatory reporting, and audit trail compliance. Direc

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the test bench, calibration equipment, or portable test device used to conduct the meter test. Critical for traceability and ensuring test equipment is within its own calibration validity period.

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the meter that was tested. Links to the meter asset record in the metering domain.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work order or service request that triggered the meter test. Links the test to the broader work management context, such as a meter exchange, customer complaint investigation, or preventive maintenance program.
attributes.references: Oracle WAM / IBM Maximo Work Order

attributes.name: as_found_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Percentage error of the meter at the start of the test, before any adjustments or calibration. Represents the meters accuracy in its as-installed or as-received condition. Positive values indicate the meter is reading high (over-registration); negative values indicate the meter is reading low (under-registration).

attributes.name: as_left_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Percentage error of the meter at the conclusion of the test, after any adjustments or calibration. Represents the meters accuracy in its final state before being returned to service or condemned. Positive values indicate over-registration; negative values indicate under-registration.

attributes.name: compliance_cycle_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the regulatory compliance testing cycle or program under which this test was conducted. Used to group tests for regulatory reporting to PUCs and to track compliance with mandated testing frequencies.

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: The remediation action performed as a result of the test. None indicates the meter passed without intervention; adjusted indicates the meter was recalibrated to meet standards; replaced indicates the meter was removed from service and a new meter installed; condemned indicates the meter was permanently removed from inventory; repaired indicates the meter underwent maintenance or component replacement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this meter test record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: demand_register_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Percentage error of the demand register, which measures peak kilowatt (kW) or megawatt (MW) consumption over defined intervals. Critical for commercial and industrial customers billed on demand charges.

attributes.name: full_load_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Percentage error measured at full rated load (100% of meter capacity). Critical accuracy test point for validating meter performance under maximum demand conditions.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.20 Section 3.3 Load Point Testing

attributes.name: light_load_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Percentage error measured at light load (typically 10% of meter capacity). Critical accuracy test point for validating meter performance under low consumption conditions, which is common in residential applications.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.20 Section 3.3 Load Point Testing

attributes.name: power_factor_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the power factor accuracy test for electric meters. Validates that the meter accurately measures energy under varying power factor conditions (lagging and leading). Not applicable for gas meters.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.20 Section 3.4 Power Factor Testing

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test was conducted to fulfill a regulatory compliance obligation mandated by state Public Utility Commissions (PUCs) or other governing bodies. True indicates the test is part of a regulatory compliance program; false indicates the test was conducted for operational or customer service reasons.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system from which this meter test record originated. Typically Oracle WAM, IBM Maximo, or a specialized meter testing application. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: technician_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the technician or engineer who performed the meter test. Used for quality assurance, training evaluation, and audit traceability.

attributes.name: test_current_amperes
attributes.description: Current level (in amperes) at which the electric meter test was conducted. Used to calculate load percentage relative to meter rating. Not applicable for gas meters.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the meter test was performed. Principal business event timestamp for the test transaction.

attributes.name: test_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from test start to test completion. Used for labor cost allocation, productivity analysis, and scheduling optimization.

attributes.name: test_facility_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific testing facility, laboratory, or service center where the test was conducted. Used for traceability and quality assurance.

attributes.name: test_flow_rate
attributes.description: Gas flow rate (typically in cubic feet per hour or cubic meters per hour) at which the gas meter test was conducted. Used to calculate load percentage relative to meter capacity. Not applicable for electric meters.
attributes.references: AGA Report No. 7 Section 4.2 Test Conditions

attributes.name: test_humidity_percent
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage during the test. Humidity can affect electronic meter components and is recorded to validate test conditions were within acceptable ranges.

attributes.name: test_location
attributes.description: Physical location category where the test was performed. Field tests occur at the installed service point; laboratory and shop tests occur in controlled testing facilities; customer-premise tests are conducted on-site during service calls; warehouse tests validate inventory before distribution.

attributes.name: test_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for technician observations, anomalies, special conditions, or additional context about the test. May include details about physical meter condition, environmental factors, or deviations from standard test procedures.

attributes.name: test_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the test event. Externally-known unique test reference number assigned by the testing system or laboratory.

attributes.name: test_result
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the meter test. Pass indicates the meter met all accuracy and performance criteria; fail indicates the meter did not meet standards and requires corrective action; adjusted indicates the meter was recalibrated during testing and now meets standards; conditional indicates the meter passed with minor observations or limitations.

attributes.name: test_standard_applied
attributes.description: The industry or regulatory standard used as the basis for the test procedure and acceptance criteria. Common standards include ANSI C12.20 for North American electric meter accuracy classes, IEC 62052-11 and IEC 62053-series for international electric meter compliance, and AGA Report No. 7 for gas meter accuracy.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the test transaction. Tracks the test workflow from scheduling through completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: test_temperature
attributes.description: Ambient temperature (in degrees Celsius or Fahrenheit) during the test. Temperature can affect meter accuracy and is recorded for quality assurance and to validate test conditions were within acceptable ranges.

attributes.name: test_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the meter test was conducted. Provides granular event timing for audit and sequencing purposes.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Classification of the test based on the business trigger and context. attributes.name: test_voltage
attributes.description: Voltage level (in volts) at which the electric meter test was conducted. Must match the meters rated voltage for valid test results. Not applicable for gas meters.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this meter test record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.description: The average ambient temperature in Fahrenheit for the service point location on the summary date. Used for weather normalization and load forecasting. Sourced from weather data integration.

attributes.description: The calculated baseline consumption for this meter and date, used for demand response program performance measurement. Represents expected consumption absent a DR event. Expressed in the same unit as total_consumption.

attributes.name: billing_ready_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this daily summary has passed all validation checks and is approved for use in billing calculations. True means the data is billing-ready; False means it requires review or correction.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: The type of energy commodity measured by this meter: electric or gas. Determines the applicable unit of measure and demand calculation rules.

attributes.name: data_completeness_percentage
attributes.description: The ratio of actual valid intervals to expected intervals, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Calculated as (actual_interval_count / expected_interval_count) * 100. Values below 95% typically trigger data quality alerts.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A composite data quality score (0.00 to 100.00) calculated by the MDMS based on completeness, consistency, and validation rule pass rate. Scores below 80 typically trigger manual review.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the upstream MDMS or historian system that provided the interval data for this summary (e.g., Oracle Utilities MDMS, Itron Analytics, OSIsoft PI). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: dr_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this meter participated in a demand response event on the summary date. True if a DR event occurred; False otherwise. Used to trigger load reduction calculation.

attributes.name: estimated_interval_count
attributes.description: The number of interval reads that were estimated by the VEE (Validation, Estimation, and Editing) process due to missing or invalid raw reads. Indicates data quality and estimation reliance.

attributes.name: expected_interval_count
attributes.description: The number of interval reads expected for the summary date based on the meter's configured interval length (e.g., 96 for 15-minute intervals, 24 for hourly intervals). Used to calculate data completeness percentage.

attributes.name: generation_kwh

attributes.name: load_reduction_kwh

attributes.name: meter_read_source

attributes.name: net_consumption_kwh

attributes.name: net_metering_flag

attributes.name: off_peak_consumption
attributes.description: Total consumption during off-peak hours as defined by the applicable Time-of-Use (TOU) rate schedule. Null for non-TOU meters. Expressed in the same unit as total_consumption.

attributes.name: on_peak_consumption
attributes.description: Total consumption during on-peak hours as defined by the applicable Time-of-Use (TOU) rate schedule. Null for non-TOU meters. Expressed in the same unit as total_consumption.

attributes.name: outage_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total duration in minutes of all outage events affecting this meter on the summary date. Null if outage_flag is False. Used for reliability index calculation and customer credit processing.

attributes.name: outage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an outage event was recorded for this meter on the summary date. True if an outage occurred; False otherwise. Used to correlate consumption gaps with known outage events.

attributes.name: peak_demand_kw
attributes.description: The maximum instantaneous demand in kilowatts recorded during the summary date for demand-metered accounts. Null for non-demand meters or gas meters. Used for demand billing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: peak_demand_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the peak demand occurred during the summary date. Null if peak_demand_kw is null. Used for load profile analysis and demand response event correlation.

attributes.name: power_factor
attributes.description: The average power factor (ratio of real power to apparent power) for the summary date, typically measured for commercial and industrial meters. Range 0.000 to 1.000. Used for power quality monitoring and penalty billing.

attributes.name: rate_schedule_code
attributes.description: The tariff rate schedule code applicable to this meter on the summary date. Determines TOU period definitions, demand billing rules, and pricing structure. Links to regulatory tariff schedules.

attributes.name: reactive_energy_kvarh
attributes.description: The total reactive energy in kilovolt-ampere reactive hours for the summary date. Measured for commercial and industrial meters to assess power quality and calculate reactive power charges.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this record was first inserted into the lakehouse silver layer. Represents the data platform ingestion time, distinct from aggregation_timestamp.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this record was last updated in the lakehouse silver layer. Used to track reprocessing and late-arriving data corrections.

attributes.name: summary_date

attributes.name: super_off_peak_consumption

attributes.name: temperature_adjusted_flag

attributes.name: total_consumption

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

products.name: meter_configuration
products.description: Master record capturing the active and historical programmed configurations of a meter as deployed in the field — distinct from the physical meter asset record and versioned over time as configurations change. Stores meter identifier, configuration effective date, configuration end date, number of channels, multiplier (CT/PT ratio), demand interval length (minutes), demand reset day, TOU schedule programmed into the meter, loss compensation factor, transformer-loss-corrected flag, net metering export channel flag, and configuration version. Note: individual channel definitions (type, UOM, direction, multiplier per channel) are owned by the meter_channel entity — this entity captures the meter-level configuration envelope and versioning. Each configuration change (e.g., adding NEM export channel, changing TOU schedule) creates a new version. Critical for ensuring MDMS reads are correctly scaled and interpreted for billing — the active configuration at the time of a read determines how raw pulse counts translate to engineering units. Managed within Oracle Utilities MDMS / Itron Analytics device configuration module.
products.reference: Oracle Utilities MDMS Device Configuration / ANSI C12.19 Configuration Tables

products.name: meter_channel
products.description: Master record defining each measurement channel configured on a meter — the fundamental unit of metered data collection. Each channel represents a distinct quantity being measured (e.g., delivered kWh, received kWh, reactive kVAR, demand kW, gas MCF). Captures meter identifier, channel number, channel type (energy/demand/reactive/power-factor/voltage/current), direction (delivered/received/net), unit of measure (kWh/kW/kVAR/MCF/Therm), multiplier (CT/PT ratio applied to this channel), demand interval length (for demand channels), pulse weight, register multiplier, cumulative vs interval collection mode, TOU applicability flag, and active status. Serves as the master reference for interval_read and register_read records, ensuring each read can be traced to a defined measurement channel with known UOM and scaling. Essential for net energy metering (NEM) where delivered and received channels must be tracked separately. Managed within Oracle Utilities MDMS / Itron Analytics device configuration.

attributes.description: Textual definition of the off-peak period hours and days when the lowest rates apply under this TOU schedule.

attributes.name: opt_in_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers must explicitly opt in to this TOU schedule or if it is the default schedule for the rate class.

attributes.name: peak_period_definition
attributes.description: Textual definition of the peak demand period hours and days when the highest rates apply under this TOU schedule.

attributes.name: rate_class
attributes.description: Customer rate class to which this TOU schedule applies, determining eligibility for the schedule.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority approved this TOU schedule for implementation.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the regulatory filing or approval authorizing this TOU schedule, issued by the governing public utility commission.

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the TOU schedule used in billing and rate systems. Externally-known unique code referenced in tariff documents and customer communications.

attributes.name: schedule_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the TOU schedule including its purpose, applicable customer segments, and rate structure overview.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the TOU schedule for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the TOU schedule structure indicating whether it varies by season, is year-round, or includes dynamic or critical peak pricing components.

attributes.name: season_definition
attributes.description: Textual definition of seasonal periods if the TOU schedule varies by season, including summer, winter, and transition periods with their date ranges.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of utility service for which this TOU schedule is defined, either electric or gas.

attributes.name: shoulder_period_definition
attributes.description: Textual definition of the shoulder or mid-peak period hours and days when intermediate rates apply. Null if the schedule does not include a shoulder period.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the TOU schedule indicating whether it is in use, pending approval, or has been retired.

attributes.name: tariff_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the tariff document section or schedule number where this TOU schedule is published and documented.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone in which the TOU schedule periods are defined, using standard time zone abbreviations.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this TOU schedule, incremented when the schedule is revised or updated.

attributes.name: voltage_level
attributes.description: Voltage level at which service is delivered under this TOU schedule. Applicable only for electric service.

attributes.name: weekend_treatment
attributes.description: Defines how weekends are treated in the TOU schedule, whether they follow off-peak rates, standard rates, or a custom definition.

attributes.name: superseded_tou_schedule_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on tou_schedule (superseded_tou_schedule_id)

products.name: vee_rule_set
products.description: Master reference table for vee_rule_set. Referenced by vee_rule_set_id.

attributes.name: vee_rule_set_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vee_rule_set

attributes.name: parent_rule_set_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent rule set if this rule set is a specialized variant or child of another rule set. Null for top-level rule sets.

attributes.name: applies_to_customer_class
attributes.description: Customer class this rule set applies to: residential, commercial, industrial, or all customer classes.

attributes.name: applies_to_meter_type
attributes.description: Type of utility meters this rule set applies to: electric meters, gas meters, water meters, or all meter types.

attributes.name: applies_to_rate_schedule
attributes.description: Specific rate schedule codes this rule set applies to. Null indicates the rule set applies to all rate schedules.

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed audit logging is enabled for all data modifications made by this rule set.

attributes.name: auto_correction_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule set is authorized to automatically correct meter data without manual review.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VEE rule set record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this VEE rule set is retired and no longer applied to meter data processing. Null indicates the rule set is open-ended.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this VEE rule set becomes active and begins being applied to meter data processing workflows.

attributes.name: error_code_prefix
attributes.description: Prefix used for error codes generated when this rule set identifies data quality issues.

attributes.name: estimation_method
attributes.description: Algorithm used for estimating missing or invalid meter data: linear interpolation, historical average, similar day profile, regression analysis, zero fill, or last known value.

attributes.name: execution_sequence
attributes.description: Order in which this rule set is executed within its priority level during VEE processing workflows.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this VEE rule set configuration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: lookback_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of historical data used for validation comparisons and estimation calculations.

attributes.name: manual_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether data processed by this rule set requires manual analyst review before being released to billing systems.

attributes.name: mdms_system_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this rule set in the source MDMS platform (Oracle Utilities MDMS or Itron Analytics).

attributes.name: minimum_data_quality_score
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable data quality score (0-100) for meter data processed by this rule set. Data below this threshold is flagged for review.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments about this rule set including business rationale, special handling instructions, or known limitations.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Execution priority of the rule set when multiple rule sets are applicable. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule set is required for regulatory compliance with state public utility commission or federal energy regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: rule_logic_expression
attributes.description: Technical expression or pseudocode defining the validation, estimation, or editing logic implemented by this rule set.

attributes.name: rule_set_category
attributes.description: Business category of the rule set based on the type of meter data it processes: interval consumption data, register reads, demand measurements, power quality events, outage detection, or tamper detection.

attributes.name: rule_set_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the VEE rule set used in meter data management systems and operational workflows.

attributes.name: rule_set_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the VEE rule set including its validation logic, estimation algorithms, and editing procedures.

attributes.name: rule_set_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the VEE rule set describing its purpose and application context.

attributes.name: rule_set_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rule set by its primary function: validation (data quality checks), estimation (missing data inference), editing (data correction), or composite (multiple functions).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the VEE rule set indicating whether it is actively applied to meter data processing workflows.

attributes.name: validation_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Percentage threshold for validation rules. Data variance exceeding this threshold triggers validation failure flags.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the rule set following major.minor.patch format to track rule set evolution and changes.

attributes.name: created_by
