[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transmission_lines|substations|transformers|gas_pipelines|distribution_equipment|generation_facilities|metering|protection_systems — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the inspector indicating availability for inspection assignments.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the inspector's employment or contract with the utility ended. Null for active inspectors.

attributes.name: union_membership_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inspector is a member of a labor union. True if union member, False otherwise.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inspector record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total number of years the inspector has been performing asset inspections in the utility industry.

attributes.name: lead_inspector_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on inspector (lead_inspector_id)

products.name: inspection_crew
products.description: Master reference table for inspection_crew. Referenced by inspection_crew_id.

attributes.name: inspection_crew_id
attributes.description: Primary key for inspection_crew

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary service center or operations facility where this inspection crew is based and reports for duty.

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: active_from_date
attributes.description: Date when this inspection crew was established and became available for work assignment.

attributes.name: active_until_date
attributes.description: Date when this inspection crew was or will be deactivated or disbanded. Null for currently active crews with no planned end date.

attributes.name: average_inspection_capacity_per_day
attributes.description: Average number of asset inspections this crew can complete per working day, used for work order planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Qualification level of the inspection crew indicating the complexity and criticality of assets they are authorized to inspect.

attributes.name: contractor_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the contracting company providing this inspection crew, applicable only when contractor_flag is True.

attributes.name: contractor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection crew is composed of contractor personnel (True) or internal utility employees (False).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection crew record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crew_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the inspection crew for identification in work orders, scheduling systems, and field operations.

attributes.name: crew_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the inspection crew, typically including geographic area or specialization (e.g., 'North Region T&D Inspection Team').

attributes.name: crew_size
attributes.description: Number of personnel assigned to this inspection crew, representing the team's capacity for field inspection work.

attributes.name: crew_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the inspection crew indicating availability for assignment to inspection work orders.

attributes.name: crew_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inspection crew based on the asset infrastructure type they specialize in inspecting.

attributes.name: emergency_response_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection crew is qualified and available for emergency response and storm restoration inspection work.

attributes.name: equipment_assigned
attributes.description: List of specialized inspection equipment and tools assigned to this crew (e.g., thermal cameras, ultrasonic detectors, climbing gear).

attributes.name: gis_mobile_device_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GIS-enabled mobile device identifiers assigned to this crew for field data collection and asset location verification.

attributes.name: hourly_labor_rate
attributes.description: Standard hourly labor rate for this inspection crew, used for work order costing and budget planning. Expressed in local currency.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection crew record was most recently updated in the system.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review conducted for this inspection crew.

attributes.name: last_safety_training_date
attributes.description: Date when the inspection crew last completed mandatory safety training, used to ensure compliance with safety certification requirements.

attributes.name: next_certification_renewal_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the crew's next certification renewal or recertification assessment, ensuring continued qualification for inspection work.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information about the inspection crew, including special capabilities, restrictions, or operational notes.

attributes.name: operating_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or service territory where the inspection crew primarily operates, used for work assignment and resource planning.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Most recent performance evaluation rating for this inspection crew based on inspection quality, timeliness, and safety metrics.

attributes.name: safety_incident_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of reportable safety incidents involving this inspection crew, tracked for safety performance monitoring.

attributes.name: shift_schedule
attributes.description: Standard work shift pattern for this inspection crew, determining availability windows for work order assignment.

attributes.name: specialization_tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specialized inspection capabilities or equipment expertise (e.g., 'infrared thermography, drone inspection, high voltage').

attributes.name: union_affiliation
attributes.description: Labor union or collective bargaining unit to which the inspection crew members belong, relevant for scheduling and labor relations.

attributes.name: vehicle_fleet_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle identifiers assigned to this inspection crew for field mobility and equipment transport.

attributes.name: work_order_system_user_group
attributes.description: User group or role identifier in the EAM work order system (Oracle WAM/IBM Maximo) that this crew is assigned to for work visibility and assignment.

attributes.name: parent_inspection_crew_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on inspection_crew (parent_inspection_crew_id)

products.name: facility
products.description: Master reference table for facility. Referenced by facility_id.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Primary key for facility

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.location. Business justification: Facilities are physical structures AT specific locations. The facility product has denormalized address and geospatial attributes that should be normalized to the location product. This eliminates dat

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.master. Business justification: Facility is a specialized asset type (generation plants, substations, service centers) and should link to its asset master record. The facility product has asset-like attributes (nameplate_capacity, i

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense recognized to date on the facility, calculated using regulatory-approved depreciation rates and methods.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: High-level asset classification for financial and depreciation purposes, aligning with the utility chart of accounts and capital planning categories.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the facility capacity. MW for electric generation, MVA for substations, MCF or MMBTU for gas facilities.

attributes.name: construction_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when construction was substantially completed and the facility was ready for commissioning or placed in service.

attributes.name: construction_start_date
attributes.description: Date when physical construction or major capital project work began on the facility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this facility record was first created in the enterprise data system.

attributes.name: criticality_rating
attributes.description: Risk-based classification indicating the importance of the facility to system reliability and customer service, used to prioritize maintenance and capital investment.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to calculate periodic depreciation expense for this facility, as approved by regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the facility, including its purpose, key equipment, and operational characteristics.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility requires environmental permits or regulatory approvals for operation (e.g., air quality, water discharge, hazardous materials).

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the facility, used across operational systems and regulatory reporting. Typically assigned by the enterprise asset management system.

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the facility as registered with regulatory authorities and used in operational documentation.

attributes.name: facility_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed classification providing additional granularity within the facility type (e.g., coal plant, solar farm, switching station, distribution warehouse).

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the facility based on its primary operational function within the utility infrastructure.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts classification code used for regulatory asset base reporting and depreciation schedules in rate cases.

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility was first placed into commercial operation and began serving customers or supporting utility operations.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or operational inspection performed on the facility.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this facility record was most recently updated in the enterprise data system.

attributes.name: nameplate_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum rated capacity of the facility in megawatts (MW) for generation facilities, or maximum throughput capacity for transmission and distribution facilities.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current book value of the facility after accumulated depreciation, representing the undepreciated capital investment remaining in the regulatory asset base.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required inspection based on regulatory requirements or preventive maintenance schedules.

attributes.name: operating_organization
attributes.description: Business unit or department responsible for day-to-day operations and maintenance of the facility.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the facility indicating its availability and operational readiness for utility operations.

attributes.name: original_cost
attributes.description: Total capital expenditure incurred to construct or acquire the facility, including direct costs and capitalized interest (AFUDC). Used as the basis for regulatory rate base and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Business unit or legal entity that owns the facility for financial and regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority level governing this facility for compliance and rate-making purposes.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility was permanently removed from service and retired from the asset base.

attributes.name: service_territory
attributes.description: Geographic service area or regulatory territory that this facility serves, typically aligned with state or regional boundaries.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected service life of the facility in years, used for depreciation calculations and long-term capital planning.

attributes.name: parent_facility_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on facility (parent_facility_id)

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all residential, commercial, and industrial customer identity, accounts, service agreements, and enrollment. Manages customer profiles, premise information, move-in/move-out processes, account hierarchy, customer segmentation, and contact information. Integrates with CIS platforms (Oracle CC&B / SAP IS-U) and CRM (Salesforce Energy & Utilities Cloud). Supports regulatory customer-of-record requirements for PUC reporting.

products.name: party
products.description: Master record for any legal entity (person or organization) that interacts with the utility as a customer, co-applicant, or authorized representative. Serves as the enterprise SSOT for customer identity — stores legal name, tax ID / SSN (masked), date of birth, entity type (residential individual, commercial business, industrial corporation, government), language preference, credit class, and identity verification status. Sourced from Oracle CC&B / SAP IS-U customer master and Salesforce Energy & Utilities Cloud Account object. Supports PUC customer-of-record requirements and SOX identity controls.
products.reference: CIS Customer Master / Salesforce Account

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the party entity. Primary key for the party master record. Serves as the enterprise single source of truth (SSOT) for customer identity across all utility systems including Oracle CC&B, SAP IS-U, and Salesforce Energy & Utilities Cloud.

attributes.name: business_registration_number
attributes.description: State or federal business registration number for commercial, industrial, and government entity parties. Used for business identity verification, credit checks, and regulatory reporting. May include state corporation number, DUNS number, or other official business identifiers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the party record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and SOX compliance requirements for financial reporting.

attributes.name: credit_class
attributes.description: Credit risk classification based on credit bureau scores and payment history. Determines deposit requirements, payment plan eligibility, and disconnection risk. Supports revenue assurance and bad debt forecasting. Must comply with Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) and Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA).

attributes.name: customer_class
attributes.description: Utility-specific customer classification used for rate design, load forecasting, and regulatory reporting. Aligns with tariff schedules filed with the Public Utility Commission (PUC). Determines eligibility for time-of-use (TOU) rates, critical peak pricing (CPP), and demand response programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential|small_commercial|large_commercial|industrial|agricultural|street_lighting|public_authority — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, PUC Rate Classification Standards

attributes.name: customer_since_date
attributes.description: Date when the party first became a customer of the utility. Used for customer tenure analysis, loyalty program eligibility, and customer lifetime value calculations. Supports customer segmentation and retention analytics.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth for individual parties. Used for identity verification, credit checks, and eligibility determination for low-income assistance programs and senior citizen rate discounts. Supports PUC customer protection requirements.

attributes.name: do_not_contact_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating the party has requested no marketing or non-essential communication. Utility must honor this preference except for critical safety notifications, outage alerts, and mandatory regulatory communications. Supports TCPA compliance.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number for commercial and industrial parties. Used for credit evaluation, supplier qualification, and business identity verification. Standard business identifier for Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and supply chain systems.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for electronic communication with the party. Used for billing notifications, outage alerts via Outage Management System (OMS), demand response (DR) event notifications, and customer service correspondence. Supports paperless billing initiatives and regulatory customer communication requirements.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External system identifier for the party from source systems such as Oracle CC&B customer number, SAP IS-U business partner ID, or Salesforce Account ID. Supports data integration and cross-system reconciliation. Multiple external IDs may be stored in related integration tables.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name or first name of the individual party. Applicable only to residential customers and individual representatives. Used for personalized customer communication and Customer Information System (CIS) display.

attributes.name: identity_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the party identity was last verified. Used to track verification currency and trigger re-verification workflows per utility security policies and SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: identity_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of identity verification process for the party. Verified status is required before service activation. Supports Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements, fraud prevention, and SOX identity controls. Verification may include government-issued ID check, credit bureau validation, or utility bill history.

attributes.name: industry_code
attributes.description: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for commercial and industrial parties. Used for load forecasting, rate design, economic development analysis, and regulatory reporting. Supports segmentation of commercial and industrial customer classes.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for customer communication and billing materials. Supports multilingual customer service requirements mandated by state PUC regulations. Uses ISO 639-2 three-letter language codes.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent customer service interaction with the party. Includes phone calls, emails, web portal sessions, and field visits. Used for customer engagement tracking and service quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the party record was last updated. Tracks data currency and supports change data capture (CDC) processes for downstream analytics and reporting systems.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the individual party. Applicable only to residential customers and individual representatives. Used for customer search, sorting, and identity verification in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the party as registered with government authorities. For individuals, this is the name on government-issued identification. For organizations, this is the registered business name. Required for customer-of-record reporting to Public Utility Commission (PUC) and supports Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) identity controls.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the party record. Active parties have one or more active service agreements. Inactive parties have no current service but retain historical records. Suspended parties are temporarily blocked from new service due to fraud or non-payment. Deceased status triggers estate handling procedures. Merged and duplicate statuses support master data management (MDM) consolidation.

attributes.name: low_income_assistance_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating the party is enrolled in low-income energy assistance programs such as Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) or utility-specific discount rates. Determines eligibility for reduced rates, payment plans, and disconnection protections mandated by PUC regulations.
attributes.references: LIHEAP Act 42 USC 8621, PUC Low Income Assistance Rules

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating the party has consented to receive marketing communications about energy efficiency (EE) programs, demand response (DR) enrollment, electric vehicle (EV) rates, and renewable energy options. Must comply with CAN-SPAM Act and Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) consent requirements.

attributes.name: medical_baseline_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating the party has a medical condition requiring uninterrupted electric service for life-support equipment. Medical baseline customers receive additional kilowatt-hour (kWh) allowances at lower rates and are protected from disconnection. Mandated by state PUC regulations for customer protection.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the individual party. Optional field used for complete identity verification and disambiguation of customers with similar names.

attributes.name: mobile_phone_number
attributes.description: Mobile telephone number for SMS notifications and mobile app authentication. Used for Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) alerts, demand response program enrollment, and two-factor authentication in customer portals.

attributes.name: paperless_billing_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating the party has opted for electronic billing delivery instead of paper bills. Supports utility cost reduction initiatives and environmental sustainability goals. Electronic bills are delivered via email or customer portal.

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the party entity type. Determines applicable rate schedules, regulatory reporting categories, and service agreement terms. Residential individuals receive consumer protection under PUC regulations. Commercial and industrial customers may have different tariff structures and demand response eligibility.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, NARUC Customer Classification Standards

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the party. Used for customer service calls, outage notifications, critical peak pricing (CPP) alerts, and emergency contact during service interruptions. Supports Federal Communications Commission (FCC) customer contact requirements.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number. For individuals, this is the Social Security Number (SSN) stored in masked format. For businesses, this is the Employer Identification Number (EIN). Required for credit verification, collections, and Internal Revenue Service (IRS) reporting. Supports SOX financial controls and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) compliance.

attributes.name: vip_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating the party is a VIP customer requiring special handling. VIP designation may apply to elected officials, critical infrastructure operators, medical baseline customers, or high-value commercial accounts. Triggers priority service restoration during outages and escalated customer service routing.

products.name: account
products.description: Utility service account representing the contractual relationship between a party and the utility for receiving and paying for energy services. Tracks account number (CC&B / SAP IS-U account ID), account type (residential, small commercial, large commercial, industrial, street lighting, unmetered), account status (active, inactive, pending, final, closed, written-off), credit rating, life-support/medical baseline flag, budget billing enrollment flag, paperless billing flag, auto-pay enrollment, account open date, close date, and final bill date. One party may hold multiple accounts; one account may have multiple service agreements. SSOT for account-level identity, billing eligibility, and collections status. Deposit tracking is managed by the credit_deposit product. Integrates with Oracle CC&B and Salesforce E&U Cloud Account object.
products.reference: CC&B Account / SAP IS-U Contract Account

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the utility service account. Primary key. Corresponds to the account ID in Oracle CC&B or SAP IS-U Customer Information System (CIS).
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Account Object, SAP IS-U Business Partner Account

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Utility accounts are assigned to cost centers for internal cost allocation, segment profitability analysis, and management accounting. Required for service territory P&L reporting and operational budg

attributes.name: parent_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent account in a hierarchical account structure. Used for corporate customers with multiple locations or master-metered properties with sub-accounts. Null for standalone accounts. Enables consolidated billing and reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Account Hierarchy, SAP IS-U Contract Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the party (person or organization) who is the account holder and financially responsible for the account. One party may hold multiple accounts. Links to the party master data product in the customer domain.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Person/Organization, SAP IS-U Business Partner

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the physical premise (service location) where energy is delivered under this account. Links to the premise master data product in the customer domain. One premise may have multiple accounts (e.g., separate electric and gas accounts).
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Premise, SAP IS-U Installation

attributes.name: tariff_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.tariff_schedule. Business justification: Accounts are billed under specific approved tariff schedules. rate_schedule_code is denormalized reference. Essential for billing calculation, rate application, and regulatory audit trails. Every util

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable account number assigned by the Customer Information System (CIS). Used on bills, customer correspondence, and customer service interactions. Unique across all accounts.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Account Number, SAP IS-U Contract Account Number

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account. Active: account is open and receiving service; Inactive: service temporarily suspended but account remains open; Pending: account application submitted but not yet activated; Final: final bill issued, awaiting closure; Closed: account permanently closed with zero balance; Written-off: account closed with uncollectible balance transferred to bad debt.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Account Status, SAP IS-U Account Lifecycle

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the account based on customer segment and service characteristics. Determines applicable rate schedules, billing cycles, and regulatory reporting categories. Residential serves single-family and multi-family dwellings; small commercial serves small businesses under demand thresholds; large commercial serves businesses above demand thresholds; industrial serves manufacturing and heavy industry; street lighting serves municipal and private street lighting; unmetered serves fixed-load services without metering.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, PUC Customer Class Definitions

attributes.name: auto_pay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enrolled in automatic payment (auto-pay) where bills are automatically paid from a bank account or credit card on the due date. True if enrolled; False otherwise. Reduces late payments and improves cash flow predictability.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Auto Pay, SAP IS-U Direct Debit

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing cycle (meter reading and bill generation schedule) assigned to this account. Determines the monthly meter read date, bill generation date, and payment due date. Typically organized by geographic route or customer segment.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Billing Cycle, SAP IS-U Billing Period

attributes.name: budget_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enrolled in budget billing (levelized payment plan) that spreads annual energy costs into equal monthly payments. True if enrolled; False otherwise. Reduces bill volatility for customers with seasonal usage patterns.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Budget Billing, SAP IS-U Installment Plan

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date the account was permanently closed. Null for active accounts. Populated when the customer terminates service and all final billing is complete. Used for churn analysis and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Account End Date, SAP IS-U Contract Account Valid To

attributes.name: collection_status
attributes.description: Current collections status of the account based on payment history and outstanding balance. Current: no past-due balance; Past due: balance overdue but within grace period; Collection: active collection efforts underway; Payment plan: enrolled in payment arrangement; Legal: referred to legal action or external collections; Suspended: collections suspended due to bankruptcy, dispute, or regulatory protection.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Collection Status, SAP IS-U Dunning Level

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the account record was first created in the Customer Information System (CIS). Represents the system record creation time, which may differ from account_open_date (the business effective date). Used for data lineage and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Audit Timestamp, SAP IS-U Created On

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Credit risk classification of the account holder based on payment history, credit bureau data, and utility-specific scoring models. Determines deposit requirements, payment plan eligibility, and collection strategies. Excellent: no late payments, high credit score; Good: occasional late payments, acceptable credit; Fair: frequent late payments, marginal credit; Poor: chronic delinquency, high risk; No rating: insufficient history or new customer.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), PUC Credit and Deposit Rules

attributes.name: demand_response_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enrolled in one or more Demand Response (DR) programs that provide incentives for reducing or shifting electricity usage during peak demand periods. True if enrolled; False otherwise. Supports grid reliability and peak load management.
attributes.references: FERC Order 745 Demand Response Compensation, PUC Demand Response Programs

attributes.name: disconnect_status
attributes.description: Current service disconnection status of the account. Connected: service is active; Pending disconnect: disconnection order issued but not yet executed; Disconnected: service physically disconnected for non-payment or customer request; Reconnect pending: payment received, reconnection order issued but not yet executed.
attributes.references: PUC Disconnection Rules, NARUC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: electric_vehicle_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enrolled in an Electric Vehicle (EV) rate program or has registered an EV charging installation. True if enrolled or registered; False otherwise. EV programs typically offer lower off-peak rates to encourage overnight charging.
attributes.references: PUC Electric Vehicle Rate Schedules, DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center

attributes.name: energy_efficiency_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account has participated in utility-sponsored Energy Efficiency (EE) programs such as home energy audits, appliance rebates, or weatherization assistance. True if participated; False otherwise. Supports regulatory EE portfolio standards and customer engagement tracking.
attributes.references: PUC Energy Efficiency Portfolio Standards, DOE State Energy Program

attributes.name: final_bill_date
attributes.description: Date the final bill was issued for the account. Typically precedes account_close_date. Used to track the completion of billing obligations and the transition to account closure.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Final Bill Date, SAP IS-U Final Invoice Date

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for customer communications, bills, and notices. Uses ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes. en=English, es=Spanish, zh=Chinese, vi=Vietnamese, ko=Korean, tl=Tagalog. Supports regulatory requirements for multilingual customer service in diverse service territories.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes, PUC Language Access Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the account record was last updated in the Customer Information System (CIS). Tracks the most recent change to any account attribute. Used for change data capture (CDC) and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Audit Timestamp, SAP IS-U Changed On

attributes.name: life_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is registered as having life-support or medical baseline equipment that requires uninterrupted electric service. True if life-support equipment is present; False otherwise. Accounts with this flag are subject to special disconnection protections and notification requirements under PUC regulations.
attributes.references: PUC Life Support and Medical Baseline Rules, NARUC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: low_income_assistance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enrolled in a low-income energy assistance program such as CARE (California Alternate Rates for Energy) or LIHEAP (Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program). True if enrolled; False otherwise. Provides discounted rates and additional disconnection protections.
attributes.references: PUC Low Income Assistance Programs, LIHEAP Federal Guidelines

attributes.name: medical_baseline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enrolled in a medical baseline program that provides additional energy allowances at lower rates for customers with qualifying medical conditions. True if enrolled; False otherwise. Enrollment requires physician certification and is subject to annual recertification.
attributes.references: PUC Medical Baseline Program Rules, California Public Utilities Code Section 739.1

attributes.name: net_metering_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enrolled in a Net Energy Metering (NEM) program for customers with on-site distributed energy resources (DER) such as solar photovoltaic systems. True if enrolled; False otherwise. NEM customers receive bill credits for excess generation exported to the grid.
attributes.references: PUC Net Energy Metering Tariffs, FERC Order 2222

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Date the account was first opened and activated for service. Represents the start of the contractual relationship between the customer and the utility. Used for customer tenure analysis and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Account Start Date, SAP IS-U Contract Account Valid From

attributes.name: paperless_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enrolled in paperless billing and receives electronic bills via email or online portal instead of printed bills. True if enrolled; False if paper bills are mailed. Supports utility cost reduction and environmental sustainability initiatives.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Paperless Billing, SAP IS-U Electronic Bill Presentment

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic service territory or operating division where the account is located. Used for regulatory reporting, operational planning, and cost allocation. May correspond to PUC-defined service areas or internal utility divisions.
attributes.references: FERC Service Territory Definitions, PUC Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this account record originated. CCB=Oracle CC&B, ISU=SAP IS-U, CRM=Salesforce Energy & Utilities Cloud, LEGACY=legacy CIS systems. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration scenarios.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is exempt from utility taxes and surcharges. True if tax-exempt (e.g., government entities, non-profit organizations with valid exemption certificates); False otherwise. Requires documentation of tax-exempt status.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Exempt Organizations, State Sales Tax Exemption Rules

attributes.name: third_party_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account has designated a third party (family member, social service agency, or advocate) to receive duplicate copies of disconnection notices and other critical communications. True if third-party notification is active; False otherwise. Provides additional protection for vulnerable customers.
attributes.references: PUC Third Party Notification Rules, NARUC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: time_of_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is on a Time-of-Use (TOU) rate schedule with different energy prices for peak, off-peak, and shoulder periods. True if on TOU rate; False if on flat rate. Requires interval metering (AMI) for accurate time-differentiated billing.
attributes.references: PUC Time-of-Use Rate Schedules, FERC Demand Response and Time-Based Rate Programs

products.name: premise
products.description: Physical service location (premise) where energy is delivered — the geographic and infrastructure anchor for all utility services. Stores premise address (street, city, state, ZIP), GIS coordinates (latitude/longitude from ESRI ArcGIS), premise type (residential, commercial, industrial, multi-family unit), electric service territory, gas service territory, distribution feeder ID, transformer bank ID, gas main segment ID, premise classification (single-family, multi-family, MDU unit), and premise status (serviceable, non-serviceable, demolished). SSOT for service location identity shared across metering, distribution, and billing domains.
products.reference: CC&B Premise / SAP IS-U Connection Object

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the physical service location where energy is delivered. Primary key for the premise entity. Serves as the geographic and infrastructure anchor for all utility services across metering, distribution, and billing domains.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Premises are assigned to cost centers for geographic/territorial cost tracking and service delivery cost allocation. Essential for operational budgeting, variance analysis, and regulatory cost-of-serv

attributes.name: gas_main_segment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the gas distribution main pipeline segment that serves this premise. Links premise to the gas distribution network for leak survey tracking, pipeline integrity management, pressure zone analysis, and emergency response planning. Sourced from GIS or Pipeline Management System.
attributes.references: PHMSA 49 CFR Part 192 - Gas Pipeline Safety Standards

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the premise including house number, street name, and street type. First line of the physical service location address used for service delivery, emergency response, field crew dispatch, and regulatory customer-of-record reporting to state Public Utility Commissions.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as apartment number, suite, unit, building, floor, or other location qualifier within a multi-tenant structure. Critical for accurate service delivery in multi-family dwellings and commercial complexes.

attributes.name: ami_deployment_status
attributes.description: Status of advanced metering infrastructure deployment at the premise. AMI installed indicates two-way smart meter with interval data collection; AMR installed indicates one-way automated meter reading; manual read indicates traditional meter requiring field visit; pending deployment indicates scheduled future AMI installation. Used for meter data management system (MDMS) integration, interval data availability determination, and AMI deployment project tracking.
attributes.references: NIST Framework and Roadmap for Smart Grid Interoperability Standards

attributes.name: battery_capacity_kwh
attributes.description: Energy storage capacity of installed battery system in kilowatt-hours (kWh). Represents the total energy that can be stored and discharged. Used for demand response program design, virtual power plant dispatch optimization, backup power duration calculation, and distribution grid services valuation. Sourced from DER interconnection agreements.
attributes.references: UL 9540 - Energy Storage Systems Safety Standard

attributes.name: battery_storage_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the premise has battery energy storage system (BESS) installed. True indicates battery storage; False indicates no storage. Used for demand response program enrollment, virtual power plant (VPP) aggregation, distribution grid services, and resilience analysis. Sourced from DER interconnection applications or customer enrollment data.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 - Interconnection Standards for Distributed Energy Resources

attributes.name: building_square_footage
attributes.description: Total conditioned floor area of the building at the premise in square feet. Used for energy efficiency program targeting, load forecasting normalization, rate design analysis, and benchmarking energy consumption intensity (kWh per square foot). Sourced from property tax records or customer self-reporting.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name where the premise is located. Used for geographic segmentation, regulatory jurisdiction determination, municipal franchise fee calculation, and local tax application.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Detailed structural classification of the premise building type. Single-family indicates detached residential dwelling; multi-family indicates apartment complex or condominium building; MDU (Multi-Dwelling Unit) unit indicates individual apartment within a larger structure; commercial building indicates retail or office structure; industrial facility indicates manufacturing or warehouse; mixed-use indicates combined residential and commercial. Used for load profile assignment, AMI deployment planning, and demand response program eligibility.

attributes.name: climate_zone
attributes.description: Climate zone classification for the premise location based on heating degree days (HDD) and cooling degree days (CDD). Used for weather normalization of energy consumption, load forecasting model segmentation, energy efficiency program design, and building code compliance verification. Typically follows ASHRAE or Department of Energy climate zone definitions.
attributes.references: ASHRAE 169 - Climatic Data for Building Design Standards

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year the building at the premise was originally constructed. Used for building vintage analysis, energy efficiency program targeting (older buildings typically have higher energy intensity), appliance saturation modeling, and demand-side management program design. Sourced from property tax records or building permit databases.

attributes.name: cooling_system_type
attributes.description: Type of air conditioning or cooling system installed at the premise. Central AC indicates whole-house central air conditioning; window AC indicates room air conditioners; heat pump indicates reversible heat pump system; evaporative cooler indicates swamp cooler; none indicates no cooling system. Used for peak demand forecasting, demand response program eligibility, and energy efficiency program targeting.
attributes.references: ASHRAE 62.2 - Ventilation and Acceptable Indoor Air Quality

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the premise location. Typically USA for domestic utilities; supports international operations and cross-border energy transactions for utilities with multi-national service territories.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish name where the premise is located. Used for local tax jurisdiction determination, county-level regulatory reporting, franchise agreement compliance, and emergency management coordination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the premise record was first created in the Customer Information System. Represents the initial data capture event. Used for data lineage tracking, audit trail maintenance, and data quality monitoring. System-generated field following ISO 8601 timestamp format with timezone.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format Standard

attributes.name: electric_service_territory
attributes.description: Designated electric service territory or district code where the premise is located. Determines the operating division responsible for electric distribution, applicable electric tariffs, and regulatory reporting segments. Aligns with FERC service territory definitions and state PUC jurisdictional boundaries.

attributes.name: electric_vehicle_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the premise has an electric vehicle (EV) registered or EV charging equipment installed. True indicates EV presence; False indicates no EV. Used for EV rate program enrollment, managed charging program targeting, distribution transformer load planning, and transportation electrification analysis. Sourced from customer enrollment data or AMI load shape analysis.

attributes.name: flood_zone_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the premise is located in a FEMA-designated flood hazard area. True indicates flood zone location; False indicates non-flood zone. Used for infrastructure resilience planning, emergency preparedness, undergrounding prioritization, and climate adaptation strategy development. Sourced from FEMA Flood Insurance Rate Maps (FIRM).
attributes.references: FEMA National Flood Insurance Program - Flood Zone Designations

attributes.name: gas_service_territory
attributes.description: Designated gas service territory or district code where the premise is located. Determines the operating division responsible for gas distribution, applicable gas tariffs, and regulatory reporting segments. Aligns with Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) jurisdictional requirements.

attributes.name: heating_fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel source used for space heating at the premise. Electric indicates electric resistance or heat pump; natural gas indicates gas furnace or boiler; propane indicates propane furnace; fuel oil indicates oil furnace; wood indicates wood stove or pellet stove. Critical for load forecasting, fuel switching analysis, electrification program targeting, and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions calculation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: electric|natural_gas|propane|fuel_oil|wood|other|unknown — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) - Residential Energy Consumption Survey

attributes.name: last_service_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent service activity at the premise, such as meter installation, service upgrade, or reconnection after disconnection. Used for service history tracking, field crew activity analysis, and customer service quality monitoring. Sourced from work order management system or CIS service order history.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the premise in decimal degrees format. Sourced from ESRI ArcGIS geospatial system. Used for GIS mapping, outage management system (OMS) integration, field crew routing, distribution network modeling, and spatial analysis of service territory.

attributes.name: life_support_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the premise has electrically-powered life-support equipment requiring continuous power supply. True indicates life-support equipment present; False indicates no life-support equipment. Used for critical customer notification during planned outages, priority restoration during unplanned outages, and Public Safety Power Shutoff (PSPS) exemption or advance notification. Subject to strict confidentiality and HIPAA privacy requirements.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the premise in decimal degrees format. Sourced from ESRI ArcGIS geospatial system. Used for GIS mapping, outage management system (OMS) integration, field crew routing, distribution network modeling, and spatial analysis of service territory.

attributes.name: low_income_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the premise qualifies for low-income energy assistance programs based on household income verification or participation in government assistance programs (SNAP, Medicaid, LIHEAP). True indicates low-income qualification; False indicates non-qualification. Used for California Alternate Rates for Energy (CARE), Family Electric Rate Assistance (FERA), energy efficiency program targeting, and arrearage management program eligibility. Subject to strict confidentiality requirements.
attributes.references: CPUC Low-Income Energy Assistance Programs - Eligibility Criteria

attributes.name: medical_baseline_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the premise is enrolled in medical baseline program providing additional energy allowance for customers with qualifying medical conditions requiring electrically-powered life-support or medical equipment. True indicates medical baseline enrollment; False indicates non-enrollment. Used for rate discount application, critical customer tracking during outages, and Public Safety Power Shutoff (PSPS) exemption consideration. Subject to HIPAA privacy protections.
attributes.references: CPUC Medical Baseline Program - Qualifying Conditions

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the premise record was last updated in the Customer Information System. Represents the most recent data modification event. Used for change data capture (CDC), data synchronization across systems, and audit trail maintenance. System-generated field following ISO 8601 timestamp format with timezone.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format Standard

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or nine-digit postal code (ZIP code) for the premise location. Used for geographic analysis, service territory mapping, demographic segmentation, and correlation with census data for load forecasting and demand-side management program targeting.

attributes.name: premise_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the premise, typically assigned by the utility's Customer Information System (CIS). Used for customer communication, billing correspondence, and cross-system reference. Unique across the utility's service territory.

attributes.name: premise_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the premise indicating whether utility services can be delivered. Serviceable indicates active infrastructure and ability to provide service; non-serviceable indicates no infrastructure or service restrictions; pending construction indicates planned future service; demolished indicates structure no longer exists; inactive indicates temporary service suspension.

attributes.name: premise_type
attributes.description: Classification of the premise based on primary use and customer segment. Determines applicable rate schedules, service level agreements, and regulatory reporting categories. Residential includes single-family homes; commercial includes retail and office; industrial includes manufacturing and heavy load; multi-family includes apartment complexes and condominiums; agricultural includes farms and irrigation; municipal includes government facilities.
attributes.references: NARUC Uniform System of Accounts - Customer Classification

attributes.name: rate_zone
attributes.description: Geographic rate zone or pricing area where the premise is located. Determines applicable electric and gas tariff schedules, time-of-use (TOU) rate structures, seasonal rate variations, and locational pricing adjustments. Used for billing system rate assignment and revenue forecasting. Defined in utility tariff filings approved by state Public Utility Commission.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts - Rate Schedules

attributes.name: service_establishment_date
attributes.description: Date when utility service was first established at this premise location. Represents the initial energization or gas service activation. Used for customer tenure analysis, infrastructure age tracking, and historical service continuity reporting. Sourced from Customer Information System (CIS) service order history.

attributes.name: smart_thermostat_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the premise has a smart or programmable thermostat enrolled in utility demand response or energy efficiency programs. True indicates smart thermostat participation; False indicates no enrollment. Used for demand response event dispatch, peak load reduction forecasting, and customer engagement program tracking.

attributes.name: solar_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Nameplate capacity of installed solar photovoltaic system in kilowatts (kW). Represents the maximum rated output of the solar installation under standard test conditions. Used for interconnection capacity tracking, distribution hosting capacity analysis, NEM credit calculation, and renewable portfolio standard (RPS) compliance reporting. Sourced from DER interconnection agreements.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222 - DER Participation in Wholesale Markets

attributes.name: solar_installation_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the premise has rooftop solar photovoltaic (PV) panels or other distributed energy resource (DER) generation installed. True indicates solar installation; False indicates no solar. Used for Net Energy Metering (NEM) program administration, interconnection tracking, distribution planning, and renewable energy certificate (REC) accounting. Sourced from DER interconnection applications or AMI reverse power flow detection.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 - Interconnection Standards for Distributed Energy Resources

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the premise is located. Determines regulatory jurisdiction under state Public Utility Commission authority, applicable state energy policies, Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) requirements, and state-specific tariff structures.

attributes.name: wildfire_risk_zone
attributes.description: Wildfire risk classification for the premise location based on vegetation density, topography, historical fire patterns, and climate conditions. Extreme indicates highest risk requiring enhanced fire mitigation; high indicates elevated risk; moderate indicates some risk; low indicates minimal risk; none indicates no wildfire risk. Used for Public Safety Power Shutoff (PSPS) program planning, vegetation management prioritization, and grid hardening investment decisions. Critical for California utilities under CPUC wildfire mitigation plan requirements.
attributes.references: CPUC Fire-Threat Map - High Fire-Threat Districts

products.name: customer_service_agreement
products.description: Active service agreement (SA) linking an account to a premise for a specific commodity and rate schedule — the utility's contractual obligation to deliver electric or gas service. Captures commodity type (electric, gas), rate schedule code (e.g., RS-1, GS-2, TOU-D, CPP), SA start and end dates, SA status (active, pending start, pending stop, stopped), NEM enrollment flag, demand response program enrollment, and applicable tariff version. Sourced from Oracle CC&B Service Agreement / SAP IS-U Contract. Core entity linking customer, metering, and billing domains.
products.reference: CC&B Service Agreement / SAP IS-U Contract

attributes.name: customer_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service agreement. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Service Agreement / SAP IS-U Contract Account

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that owns this service agreement. Links the service agreement to the billing account.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Account / SAP IS-U Contract Account

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical service location (premise) where energy is delivered under this service agreement.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Premise / SAP IS-U Installation

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Service agreements are assigned to profit centers for revenue recognition, margin tracking by service type/commodity, and regulatory reporting. Required for rate case cost studies, FERC Form 1 reporti

attributes.name: service_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service point (meter location) associated with this service agreement. Links to the physical delivery point.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Service Point / SAP IS-U Device Location

attributes.name: tariff_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.tariff_schedule. Business justification: Service agreements specify the exact tariff schedule governing service terms, rates, and charges. rate_schedule_code is denormalized. Critical for rate engine, billing, and ensuring regulatory complia

attributes.name: autopay_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment is enabled for this service agreement. True if bills are automatically paid from a bank account or credit card, false otherwise. Reduces collection risk and improves cash flow.
attributes.references: PUC Payment Processing Rules / NACHA ACH Standards

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the monthly billing cycle to which this service agreement is assigned. Determines meter read schedule and bill generation timing. Examples: 01 (cycle 1, read days 1-3), 15 (cycle 15, read days 14-16). Used for workload balancing and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Billing Cycle / SAP IS-U Billing Schedule

attributes.name: budget_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service agreement is enrolled in a budget billing program that levelizes monthly payments based on historical usage. True if enrolled, false otherwise. Budget billing smooths seasonal variation in energy costs.
attributes.references: PUC Consumer Protection Rules / Utility Budget Billing Tariffs

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Type of energy commodity delivered under this service agreement. Electric for electricity service, gas for natural gas service, dual fuel for combined electric and gas service at the same premise.

attributes.name: contracted_demand_kw
attributes.description: Maximum demand capacity contracted by the customer, measured in kilowatts. Used for demand-based billing and capacity planning. Applicable to commercial and industrial customers with demand charges. Null for residential and energy-only rate schedules.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts / PUC Tariff Demand Provisions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service agreement record was first created in the system. Represents initial data capture, which may precede the service start date for pending agreements.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Audit Fields / SAP IS-U Change Documents

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Credit score of the account holder at the time of service agreement initiation. Used for deposit determination and credit risk assessment. Typically FICO score range 300-850. May be null if credit check was waived or not performed.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) / PUC Deposit Rules

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: Security deposit amount collected from the customer to establish or maintain service. Based on credit score and estimated usage. Zero if no deposit required. Held in trust and refunded after satisfactory payment history or service termination.
attributes.references: PUC Deposit Rules / Utility Credit and Collection Policies

attributes.name: deposit_status
attributes.description: Current status of the security deposit. Not required if customer qualified for no-deposit service. Collected if deposit is held. Refunded if returned to customer. Applied to balance if used to offset unpaid charges. Forfeited if customer defaulted and deposit was retained.
attributes.references: PUC Deposit Rules / Utility Credit and Collection Policies

attributes.name: dr_program_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of DR program codes in which this service agreement is enrolled. Examples: CPP (critical peak pricing), PTR (peak time rebate), DLC (direct load control), BIP (base interruptible program). Empty if not enrolled in any DR programs.
attributes.references: FERC Order 745 / ISO DR Program Manuals

attributes.name: dr_program_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service agreement is enrolled in one or more demand response programs. True if enrolled in any DR program, false otherwise. DR programs provide incentives for load curtailment during peak demand periods.
attributes.references: FERC Order 745 / NERC Demand Response Standards

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when service delivery and billing ceased under this service agreement. Null for active agreements. Populated when service is stopped, suspended, or cancelled. Used for churn analysis and final billing.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts / PUC Service Termination Rules

attributes.name: estimated_annual_usage_kwh
attributes.description: Estimated annual energy consumption for this service agreement in kilowatt-hours. Used for rate comparison, budget billing calculations, and load forecasting. Based on historical usage, premise characteristics, or customer-provided estimates. Null for gas-only service agreements.
attributes.references: EIA-861 Reporting / Utility Load Forecasting Standards

attributes.name: estimated_annual_usage_therms
attributes.description: Estimated annual natural gas consumption for this service agreement in therms. One therm equals 100,000 BTU. Used for rate comparison, budget billing calculations, and supply planning. Based on historical usage or premise characteristics. Null for electric-only service agreements.
attributes.references: EIA-176 Reporting / AGA Gas Measurement Standards

attributes.name: ev_charging_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service agreement is designated for electric vehicle charging service. True if the premise has registered EV charging equipment or is on an EV-specific rate schedule, false otherwise. Used for EV program tracking and grid planning.
attributes.references: FERC Docket RM22-12 / State EV Tariff Filings

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this service agreement record. Tracks data currency for change data capture and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Audit Fields / SAP IS-U Change Documents

attributes.name: life_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise has registered life support or medical baseline equipment that requires continuous electric service. True if life support equipment is registered, false otherwise. Provides special protections against service disconnection and priority restoration during outages.
attributes.references: PUC Consumer Protection Rules / ADA Requirements

attributes.name: load_profile_type
attributes.description: Standard load profile classification used for non-interval metered customers in settlement and forecasting. Represents typical consumption patterns for customer class. Used by MDMS for load research and unmetered consumption estimation.
attributes.references: NERC Load Modeling Standards / ISO Load Profiling Guidelines

attributes.name: low_income_assistance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service agreement is enrolled in a low-income energy assistance program (e.g., CARE, FERA, LIHEAP). True if enrolled in any low-income assistance program, false otherwise. Provides discounted rates and additional protections for qualifying low-income customers.
attributes.references: LIHEAP Act / State PUC Low-Income Assistance Programs

attributes.name: medical_baseline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer qualifies for medical baseline allowance providing additional energy allocation at lower rates for medical equipment. True if enrolled in medical baseline program, false otherwise. Distinct from life support flag; medical baseline provides rate relief while life support provides disconnection protection.
attributes.references: CPUC Medical Baseline Rules / State PUC Medical Allowance Programs

attributes.name: meter_read_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which meter readings are collected for billing purposes. Monthly for standard residential/commercial, bimonthly for some rural areas, quarterly for seasonal accounts, on-demand for special reads, AMI daily for advanced metering infrastructure with interval data collection.
attributes.references: PUC Metering Standards / ANSI C12.1 Metering Standards

attributes.name: nem_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service agreement is enrolled in a net energy metering program for distributed energy resources (typically rooftop solar). True if enrolled, false otherwise. NEM customers receive credits for excess generation exported to the grid.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222 / State NEM Tariffs / PURPA Section 210

attributes.name: nem_program_type
attributes.description: Specific NEM program version or variant under which the customer is enrolled. NEM 1.0/2.0/3.0 represent successive tariff generations with different compensation structures. VNEM is virtual net metering for multi-tenant properties. Aggregate NEM allows multiple meters under one NEM agreement. None if not enrolled in NEM.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff Decisions / CPUC NEM Rulings

attributes.name: paperless_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted for electronic bill delivery instead of paper statements. True if enrolled in paperless billing, false if paper bills are mailed. Reduces operational costs and environmental impact.
attributes.references: PUC Consumer Communication Rules / E-SIGN Act

attributes.name: rate_class
attributes.description: High-level customer rate classification for regulatory reporting and revenue allocation. Residential for single-family and multi-family homes, commercial for small/medium business, industrial for large manufacturing and processing facilities, agricultural for farms and irrigation, street lighting for municipal lighting, public authority for government facilities.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts / NARUC Rate Design Guidelines

attributes.name: sa_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the service agreement. Used in customer communications and billing statements.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B SA ID / SAP IS-U Contract

attributes.name: sa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the service agreement. Active indicates service is being delivered and billed. Pending start indicates future-dated service initiation. Pending stop indicates scheduled service termination. Stopped indicates service has been terminated. Suspended indicates temporary service hold. Cancelled indicates agreement was voided before activation.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B SA Status / SAP IS-U Contract Status

attributes.name: sa_status_reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason code or description explaining the current SA status. Examples: customer request, move out, non-payment disconnection, seasonal disconnect, construction delay, regulatory hold. Provides operational context for status transitions.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Status Reason Codes / SAP IS-U Reason Codes

attributes.name: sa_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service agreement based on service characteristics. Standard for typical residential/commercial service, net metering for DER customers, demand response for DR program participants, interruptible for curtailable load, standby for backup service, street lighting for municipal lighting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts / PUC Tariff Classifications

attributes.name: service_phase
attributes.description: Electrical phase configuration of the service. Single phase for residential and small commercial, three phase for larger commercial and industrial loads requiring balanced power delivery. Not applicable for gas-only service agreements.

attributes.name: service_voltage
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level at which electric service is delivered to the customer premise. Measured in volts. Determines equipment requirements and rate applicability. Common values: 120/240V (residential), 480V (small commercial), 4.16kV-34.5kV (primary distribution), 69kV+ (transmission). Not applicable for gas-only service agreements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 120|240|480|4160|12470|34500|69000|115000|138000|230000|345000|500000|765000 — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE C84.1 Voltage Standards / ANSI C84.1

attributes.name: special_read_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service agreement requires special meter reading procedures outside the standard billing cycle. True if special read is required (e.g., for move-in/move-out, disputed bills, or high-bill investigations), false for standard cycle reads.
attributes.references: PUC Metering Standards / Utility Meter Reading Procedures

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when service delivery and billing commenced under this service agreement. Represents the effective date of the contractual obligation to provide energy service. Used for tenure calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts / PUC Service Initiation Rules

attributes.name: tariff_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current tariff version became effective for this service agreement. Used to determine applicable rates for billing periods and to track rate case impacts.
attributes.references: PUC Rate Case Orders / FERC Tariff Effective Date Rules

attributes.name: tariff_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the tariff book or rate schedule effective for this service agreement. Tracks regulatory-approved rate changes over time. Format varies by utility (e.g., 2024-01, v5.2, AL-123). Used to ensure correct rate application and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: PUC Tariff Filing Requirements / FERC Rate Schedule Versioning

attributes.name: third_party_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has designated a third party to receive duplicate notifications regarding service disconnection and payment issues. True if third party notification is active, false otherwise. Provides additional consumer protection for vulnerable customers.
attributes.references: PUC Consumer Protection Rules / Third Party Notification Requirements

products.name: contact
products.description: Contact record for individuals associated with a party or account — including primary account holders, co-applicants, authorized third parties, landlords, and property managers. Stores contact name, relationship type (self, spouse, property manager, third-party authorized, emergency contact), preferred contact method (phone, email, SMS, mail), phone numbers, email address, mailing address (if different from premise), and do-not-contact flags. Distinct from party (which owns legal identity) — contact owns reachability and relationship context for a person in a specific role on an account. Sourced from Salesforce E&U Cloud Contact object and CC&B Person entity. Supports outage notification, collections contact, and regulatory communication requirements.
products.reference: Salesforce Contact / CC&B Person

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contact record. Primary key for the contact entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account this contact is associated with. Enables linking contact to service agreements and billing relationships.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (person or organization) that this contact record represents. Links to the party master entity to establish legal identity ownership.

attributes.name: alternate_email_address
attributes.description: Secondary email address for the contact. Provides redundancy for critical electronic communications.

attributes.name: alternate_phone
attributes.description: Secondary telephone number for reaching the contact. Used as backup for critical communications when primary phone is unavailable.

attributes.name: alternate_phone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the alternate phone number. Determines appropriate calling hours and communication protocols.

attributes.name: authorization_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the contact's authorization to act on behalf of the account expires or was revoked. Nullable for indefinite authorizations. Required for third-party authorization compliance.

attributes.name: authorization_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the contact's authorization to act on behalf of the account became effective. Required for third-party authorization compliance under state PUC regulations.

attributes.name: contact_role
