attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Bidding activity is managed by trading/scheduling departments with budget accountability. Cost center enables tracking of bid strategy costs, market participation expenses, and departmental performanc

attributes.name: demand_response_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Demand Response (DR) or Demand-Side Management (DSM) program under which this bid is submitted, if applicable. Links demand response curtailment offers to the specific program enrollment. Null for supply-side bids. Supports DR program performance tracking and FERC Order 745 compliance.
attributes.references: FERC Order 745; State PUC DR Program Rules

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: FK to generation.generating_unit.generating_unit_id — Links wholesale market bids to physical generation units — required for bid-to-dispatch reconciliation, market settlement verification, and generation portfolio optimization.

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_master. Business justification: Energy bids for specific generation assets require linkage to validate bid parameters against asset technical capabilities (ramp rates, min/max MW), coordinate with planned maintenance outages, and re

attributes.name: participant_registration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal market participant or counterparty entity submitting this bid. Represents the utility's registered market participant identity with the RTO/ISO. Fulfills the PARTY_REFERENCE category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) contract under which this bid is submitted, if applicable. Links the bid to a specific bilateral contract position. Null for bids not associated with a PPA. Supports IRP resource adequacy analysis and contract position tracking.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; GAAP ASC 842

attributes.name: pricing_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) pricing node or bus at which this bid is submitted. Pricing nodes are defined by the RTO/ISO and determine the applicable LMP for settlement. Links to the pricing node reference product.

attributes.name: resource_generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generating unit, load resource, or virtual resource associated with this bid. Links to the asset or resource master record (e.g., a generation unit registered with the RTO/ISO). Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE / resource reference for this transaction.

attributes.name: ancillary_service_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of ancillary service being offered when bid_type = 'ancillary'. Null for non-ancillary bids. Values align with RTO/ISO ancillary service product definitions (e.g., regulation up/down, spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regulation_up|regulation_down|spinning_reserve|non_spinning_reserve|supplemental_reserve|voltage_support|black_start — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; NERC BAL-001; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: bid_curve_segment_count
attributes.description: The number of price-quantity segments in the bid curve for this offer. Most RTO/ISO markets allow multi-segment step-function bids (e.g., up to 10 segments in PJM). A value of 1 indicates a single-price, single-quantity bid. Used to understand bid complexity and for validation against market rules.

attributes.name: bid_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: The offer or bid price in US dollars per Megawatt-Hour ($/MWh) for the first or single segment of the bid curve. For multi-segment bids, this represents the marginal cost or price at the first step. Confidential as it reflects the utility's internal cost and pricing strategy. Core MONETARY_TRIPLET / QUANTITATIVE_RESULT field for this transaction.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: bid_quantity_mw
attributes.description: The total quantity of energy or capacity offered or bid in Megawatts (MW) for this bid record. For supply offers, this is the maximum generation capacity offered. For demand bids, this is the load reduction or consumption quantity. Core quantitative field for market scheduling and settlement.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: bid_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known bid or offer identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO upon submission. Used to correlate internal records with the market operator's confirmation and settlement systems (e.g., MISO, PJM, CAISO bid ID). This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category field for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff Rules

attributes.name: bid_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the bid as returned by the RTO/ISO or tracked internally. 'submitted' = sent to market operator; 'accepted' = cleared by the market; 'rejected' = not accepted by the market operator; 'partially_accepted' = portion of bid quantity cleared; 'withdrawn' = retracted before market close; 'expired' = submission window closed without action. This is the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category field for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.

attributes.name: bid_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the bid or offer submitted to the market. 'energy' = standard energy supply or demand bid; 'ancillary' = ancillary services (regulation, spinning reserve, etc.); 'capacity' = capacity market obligation; 'virtual' = virtual transaction (INC/DEC/UTC — note: virtual bids may warrant a dedicated product at ECM scope); 'demand_response' = Demand Response (DR) curtailment offer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: energy|ancillary|capacity|virtual|demand_response|export|import — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Order 745; FERC Order 719; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: bid_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the bid, incremented each time the bid is amended or resubmitted prior to market close. Version 1 is the original submission. Used to track bid revisions and ensure the latest version is used for settlement and reporting.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Market Tariff; FERC Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: capacity_market_obligation_mw
attributes.description: The capacity obligation in Megawatts (MW) associated with this bid in the capacity market (e.g., PJM RPM, MISO Planning Resource Auction). Represents the committed capacity the resource must provide to meet resource adequacy requirements. Null for non-capacity bids.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Capacity Market Tariff; NERC Resource Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: cleared_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: The Locational Marginal Price (LMP) or market clearing price in $/MWh at which this bid was settled by the RTO/ISO. Populated after market clearing results are received. Used for revenue calculation and settlement reconciliation. Confidential as it reflects market settlement financials.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO LMP Settlement Rules

attributes.name: cleared_quantity_mw
attributes.description: The quantity of energy or capacity in Megawatts (MW) that was accepted and cleared by the RTO/ISO market. May be less than bid_quantity_mw for partially accepted bids. Null if the bid was rejected or not yet processed. Used for settlement reconciliation and dispatch scheduling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this energy bid record was first created in the internal system (Silver Layer). Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. May differ from submission_timestamp if the bid was staged internally before submission.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: The primary fuel or energy source type of the generating resource associated with this bid. Used for regulatory reporting (EPA, DOE), Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance tracking, and Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: natural_gas|coal|nuclear|hydro|wind|solar|oil|storage|geothermal|biomass|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act; DOE EIA Reporting; RPS Compliance

attributes.name: interval_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise end timestamp of the bid interval. Used with interval_start_timestamp to define the exact scheduling window for sub-hourly market intervals. Null for standard hourly bids where operating_hour is sufficient.

attributes.name: interval_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise start timestamp of the bid interval, supporting sub-hourly (e.g., 5-minute or 15-minute) market intervals used in RTM and some ancillary service markets. Provides finer granularity than operating_hour for real-time and sub-hourly market participation.
attributes.references: FERC Order 825 (5-minute settlement); RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: lmp_congestion_component
attributes.description: The congestion component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in $/MWh, reflecting transmission congestion costs at the pricing node. A negative value indicates the node benefits from congestion (sink node). Used for transmission planning and congestion cost analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO LMP Decomposition Rules

attributes.name: lmp_energy_component
attributes.description: The energy component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in $/MWh, representing the system marginal cost of energy at the pricing node. LMP is decomposed into energy, congestion, and loss components per FERC and RTO/ISO settlement rules. Used for granular settlement analysis and IRP cost modeling.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO LMP Decomposition Rules

attributes.name: lmp_loss_component
attributes.description: The marginal loss component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in $/MWh, reflecting the cost of transmission losses at the pricing node. Used with energy and congestion components to reconcile total LMP for settlement and cost allocation.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO LMP Decomposition Rules

attributes.name: market_submission_deadline
attributes.description: The RTO/ISO-defined deadline timestamp by which bids must be submitted for the target operating date and market type. Used to assess whether the bid was submitted on time and for compliance monitoring against market participation rules.

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether this bid was submitted to the Day-Ahead Market (DAM) or Real-Time Market (RTM). DAM bids are submitted the prior day for next-day scheduling; RTM bids are submitted for the current operating hour or interval. Core classification for market settlement and reporting.

attributes.name: maximum_capacity_mw
attributes.description: The maximum generation or load capacity in Megawatts (MW) available for this bid. Represents the upper physical limit of the resource's capability for the bid interval. Must not exceed the resource's registered capacity with the RTO/ISO.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: minimum_load_mw
attributes.description: The minimum generation output in Megawatts (MW) that the resource must operate at if committed by the market. Reflects the physical operating constraint of the generating unit (e.g., minimum stable load for a thermal unit). Used in unit commitment optimization and market clearing algorithms.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: must_run_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resource associated with this bid has a must-run designation (True), meaning it must be dispatched for reliability or contractual reasons regardless of economic merit. Must-run status affects market clearing and settlement treatment by the RTO/ISO.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: no_load_cost_usd_per_hr
attributes.description: The fixed operating cost in US dollars per hour incurred when the generating unit is online but producing at zero or minimum output. Submitted as part of the bid for unit commitment cost optimization by the RTO/ISO. Confidential as it reflects internal cost structure.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, comments, or annotations related to this bid. May include reasons for bid amendments, special dispatch instructions, or coordination notes with the RTO/ISO or internal trading desk. Not used for structured data.

attributes.name: operating_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which the energy bid is intended to deliver or consume energy. For DAM bids, this is the next-day operating date. For RTM bids, this is the current operating date. Used for scheduling, settlement, and regulatory reporting alignment.

attributes.name: operating_hour
attributes.description: The hour-ending (HE) or hour-beginning (HB) interval of the operating date for which this bid applies. Expressed as an integer 1–24 (or 0–23 depending on RTO/ISO convention). Used in conjunction with operating_date to identify the specific scheduling interval.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Market Tariff; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: ramp_rate_mw_per_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ramp Rate in Megawatts per Minute (MW/min)
attributes.description: The rate at which the generating resource can increase or decrease output, expressed in Megawatts per minute (MW/min). Submitted as part of the bid to inform the RTO/ISO's unit commitment and dispatch optimization. Critical for ancillary service eligibility and real-time dispatch.

attributes.name: rec_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the energy associated with this bid is eligible to generate Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) under applicable state Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) programs. True for qualifying renewable resources (wind, solar, hydro, etc.). Used for RPS compliance tracking and REC inventory management.
attributes.references: State RPS Regulations; DOE REC Tracking Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code or message returned by the RTO/ISO when a bid is rejected or partially accepted. Null for accepted bids. Used for operational troubleshooting, bid strategy refinement, and regulatory compliance review. Values are RTO/ISO-specific and may vary by market operator.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Market Tariff; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: rto_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The confirmation or acknowledgment number returned by the RTO/ISO system upon successful receipt of the bid submission. Serves as the external system receipt reference for audit and dispute resolution purposes.

attributes.name: rto_iso_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization / Independent System Operator (RTO/ISO) Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) to which this bid was submitted. Determines the applicable market rules, tariff, and settlement procedures. Essential for multi-RTO utilities operating across market boundaries. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|MISO|CAISO|NYISO|ISONE|SPP|ERCOT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: self_schedule_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bid is a self-schedule (True) or an economic bid (False). Self-schedules are submitted at a price that ensures dispatch regardless of market clearing price (e.g., must-run or must-take resources such as nuclear or contracted renewables). Economic bids compete on price in the market.

attributes.name: settlement_amount_usd
attributes.description: The calculated settlement value in US dollars for this bid, derived from cleared_quantity_mw multiplied by cleared_price_per_mwh for the interval. Represents the financial obligation or revenue for this bid record. Confidential as it reflects wholesale market financial exposure. Supports FERC market-based rate reporting and revenue management.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; GAAP ASC 606; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: startup_cost_usd
attributes.description: The cost in US dollars to start up the generating unit from cold, warm, or hot state, as submitted in the bid. Used by the RTO/ISO in unit commitment optimization to determine the economic dispatch order. Confidential as it reflects internal cost structure.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the bid or offer was submitted to the RTO/ISO market system. Represents the principal real-world business event time (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category). Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Critical for market deadline compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this energy bid record was last modified in the internal system. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Tracks amendments, status updates, or corrections applied after initial creation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Record Retention Requirements

products.name: dispatch_award
products.description: Transactional record for generation unit dispatch schedules and commitment instructions awarded by the RTO/ISO following DAM and RTM market clearing. Captures scheduled MW by interval (5-minute or hourly), operating point (economic minimum/maximum), ramp rate limits, unit commitment status (committed, decommitted, self-scheduled), start-up cost ($), no-load cost ($/hr), associated LMP pricing node, and dispatch instruction timestamp. Links generation assets to their awarded market schedules and supports real-time operations coordination with SCADA/EMS for dispatch execution.
products.reference: NERC BAL-001 / RTO/ISO Security-Constrained Economic Dispatch

attributes.name: dispatch_award_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each dispatch award record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the dispatch_award data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete RTO/ISO market clearing event awarding a generation unit a scheduled MW commitment for a specific market interval.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: capacity_obligation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capacity market obligation (e.g., PJM RPM, MISO Planning Resource Auction) associated with this dispatch award, if applicable. Links energy dispatch awards to capacity commitments for resource adequacy compliance and IRP reporting. Null if no capacity obligation applies.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Capacity Market Tariff; State PUC IRP Requirements

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Dispatch operations are managed by specific departments (generation operations, trading desk) with cost accountability for fuel, O&M, and operational expenses. Enables cost allocation and profitabilit

attributes.name: energy_bid_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating market bid or offer submitted by the utility to the RTO/ISO that resulted in this dispatch award. Links the award back to the bid strategy and offer parameters for settlement verification and FERC market-based rate compliance auditing.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; FERC Order 697; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: fuel_delivery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.fuel_delivery. Business justification: Real-time dispatch decisions require fuel availability confirmation. Links generation dispatch awards to actual fuel deliveries for operational reconciliation, heat rate validation, cost-to-serve calc

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generation asset (power plant unit) awarded this dispatch schedule. Links the market award to the physical generation resource in the asset management system (Oracle WAM or IBM Maximo). Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE / MASTER_RESOURCE link for this transaction.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards; FERC EQR Reporting

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_master. Business justification: Dispatch awards must link to physical generation asset for operational coordination with maintenance schedules, validation of dispatch feasibility against asset status, actual generation measurement v

attributes.name: participant_registration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the registered market participant entity (Power and Utilities or its trading subsidiary) that submitted the bid and received this dispatch award from the RTO/ISO. Required for FERC market-based rate authority tracking and settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; FERC Order 697

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) contract position associated with this dispatch award, if the generation is sourced from a contracted third-party resource. Links wholesale procurement contracts to awarded dispatch schedules for contract position management and FERC market-based rate compliance. Null for utility-owned generation.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; FERC Order 697; State PUC IRP Requirements

attributes.name: pricing_node_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Locational Marginal Price (LMP) Pricing Node ID
attributes.description: Reference to the RTO/ISO pricing node (bus or aggregate node) at which the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) is calculated for this dispatch award. Determines the settlement price applicable to the awarded MW schedule. Critical for LMP-based revenue settlement.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000; RTO/ISO OATT; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: rto_iso_id
attributes.description: FK to market.rto_iso

attributes.name: ancillary_service_mw
attributes.description: The Megawatt (MW) capacity awarded for ancillary service obligations (e.g., spinning reserve, regulation) associated with this dispatch award. Distinct from scheduled_mw which represents energy dispatch. Null or zero when ancillary_service_type is NONE. Used for NERC reliability compliance and RTO/ISO ancillary service settlement.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; NERC BAL-002; NERC BAL-003; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: ancillary_service_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether this dispatch award includes an ancillary service obligation in addition to or instead of energy dispatch. NONE = energy-only dispatch; REG_UP = regulation up (frequency regulation upward); REG_DOWN = regulation down; SPIN_RES = spinning reserve; NON_SPIN_RES = non-spinning reserve; VOLT_SUPPORT = voltage support / reactive power. Required for FERC ancillary services tariff compliance and NERC reliability standard reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; NERC BAL-002; NERC BAL-003; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: award_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known transaction identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO market clearing system (e.g., CAISO, PJM, MISO) for this specific dispatch instruction or schedule award. Used for reconciliation with RTO/ISO settlement statements and FERC market-based rate filings. Maps to the dispatch instruction ID in ABB or GE Energy Management System.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; NERC BAL-002; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: award_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the dispatch award. AWARDED = RTO/ISO has cleared and issued the dispatch instruction; CONFIRMED = generation unit operator has acknowledged the award; EXECUTING = unit is actively generating per the schedule; COMPLETED = interval has passed and generation was delivered; CANCELLED = award was rescinded prior to execution; SUPERSEDED = replaced by a revised dispatch instruction in the same interval.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-002; FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: award_version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this dispatch award record, incremented each time the RTO/ISO issues a revised dispatch instruction for the same generation unit and interval. Version 1 is the initial award; higher versions represent resettlements or corrections. Used to identify the most current award and track instruction revisions.

attributes.name: commitment_status
attributes.description: Indicates how the generation unit was committed for this dispatch award. COMMITTED = unit was committed by the RTO/ISO through the market clearing process; DECOMMITTED = unit was previously committed but released; SELF_SCHEDULED = utility submitted a self-schedule outside the competitive market; MUST_RUN = unit designated as must-run by the RTO/ISO for reliability; RELIABILITY_MUST_RUN = unit committed for reliability reasons outside normal market dispatch.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-002; FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dispatch award record was first captured in the Silver layer lakehouse, reflecting when the RTO/ISO market clearing result was ingested from the source system (ABB or GE EMS / RTO/ISO market interface). Audit timestamp for data lineage and ETL reconciliation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; SOX Section 404; GAAP

attributes.name: dispatch_instruction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset) at which the RTO/ISO issued the dispatch instruction or schedule award to the generation unit operator. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transaction. Used for real-time operations coordination with SCADA/EMS and for FERC compliance audit trails. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; NERC BAL-002; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: economic_max_mw
attributes.description: The maximum Megawatt (MW) output level at which the generation unit can operate economically, as submitted in the unit's market offer and recognized in this dispatch award. Defines the upper bound of the unit's dispatchable operating range. Used by the RTO/ISO dispatch algorithm and SCADA/EMS for real-time control.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff; NERC BAL-002

attributes.name: economic_min_mw
attributes.description: The minimum Megawatt (MW) output level at which the generation unit can operate economically, as submitted in the unit's market offer and recognized in this dispatch award. Defines the lower bound of the unit's dispatchable operating range. Used by the RTO/ISO dispatch algorithm and SCADA/EMS for real-time control.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff; NERC BAL-002

attributes.name: ems_dispatch_confirmation_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Management System (EMS) Dispatch Confirmation ID
attributes.description: The confirmation or acknowledgment identifier generated by the ABB or GE Energy Management System (EMS) when the dispatch instruction was received and confirmed for execution. Provides the audit trail linking the market award to the real-time SCADA/EMS dispatch execution record. Used for operations coordination and post-event reliability analysis.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-002; NERC EOP-011; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: The primary fuel type used by the generation unit for this dispatch award. Drives heat rate calculations, fuel cost recovery (Fuel Adjustment Clause / FAC), emissions reporting to EPA, and RPS compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NATURAL_GAS|COAL|NUCLEAR|HYDRO|WIND|SOLAR|OIL|BIOMASS|GEOTHERMAL|STORAGE|CHP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98; FERC EQR; DOE EIA-860

attributes.name: generation_technology
attributes.description: The generation technology classification of the dispatched unit. CT = Combustion Turbine; CC = Combined Cycle; STEAM = steam turbine (coal/gas/nuclear); HYDRO = hydroelectric; WIND = wind turbine; SOLAR_PV = photovoltaic; SOLAR_THERMAL = concentrating solar; STORAGE = battery or pumped hydro storage. Used for IRP resource adequacy modeling and FERC EQR reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CT|CC|STEAM|NUCLEAR|HYDRO|WIND|SOLAR_PV|SOLAR_THERMAL|STORAGE|CHP|GEOTHERMAL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC EQR Reporting; DOE EIA-860; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: ghg_emissions_rate_lbs_per_mwh
attributes.business_glossary_term: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions Rate (lbs per MWh)
attributes.description: The greenhouse gas (GHG) CO2-equivalent emissions rate in pounds per Megawatt-Hour (lbs/MWh) for the generation unit at this dispatch level. Used for EPA GHG compliance reporting, state environmental regulatory filings, and corporate sustainability accounting. Null for zero-emission resources.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98; EPA Clean Air Act; DOE EIA-923

attributes.name: heat_rate_btu_per_kwh
attributes.description: The thermal efficiency of the generation unit expressed as British Thermal Units (BTU) consumed per kilowatt-hour (kWh) of electricity generated, as applicable to this dispatch award. Used for fuel cost calculation, Fuel Adjustment Clause (FAC) recovery, EPA GHG emissions estimation, and IRP resource modeling. Applicable to thermal units; null for renewables.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98; FERC EQR; DOE EIA-923

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the dispatch interval in minutes. Typical values are 5 (RTM five-minute dispatch), 15 (15-minute market), or 60 (DAM hourly schedule). Drives MW-to-MWh energy quantity calculations for settlement and generation accounting.

attributes.name: interval_end_timestamp
attributes.description: End date and time of the market dispatch interval for which the MW schedule is awarded. Defines the close of the operating window. For RTM typically 5 minutes after interval_start_timestamp; for DAM typically 60 minutes after. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff; NERC BAL-002

attributes.name: interval_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Start date and time of the market dispatch interval for which the MW schedule is awarded. For RTM this is typically a 5-minute interval; for DAM this is typically an hourly interval. Combined with interval_end_timestamp defines the precise operating window. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff; NERC BAL-002

attributes.name: is_reliability_dispatch
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dispatch award was issued for reliability reasons (True) rather than economic dispatch (False). Reliability dispatches may occur outside normal market clearing to maintain grid stability per NERC reliability standards. Affects cost recovery treatment and FERC compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-002; NERC EOP-011; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: is_renewable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispatched generation unit qualifies as a renewable resource (True) under applicable state Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) or federal definitions. Drives Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) tracking, RPS compliance reporting to state PUCs, and GHG emissions accounting.
attributes.references: State RPS Regulations; EPA GHG Reporting Rule; DOE REC Standards

attributes.name: is_self_scheduled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the generation unit was self-scheduled by the utility (True) rather than dispatched through the competitive market clearing process (False). Self-scheduled units are committed at the utility's discretion outside the RTO/ISO economic dispatch stack. Affects settlement treatment and FERC market-based rate reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: lmp_congestion_component_usd_per_mwh
attributes.description: The congestion component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in USD/MWh, reflecting the cost of transmission constraints between the pricing node and the reference bus. Negative values indicate the node benefits from congestion. Critical for transmission planning and FERC OATT compliance analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000; FERC OATT; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: lmp_energy_component_usd_per_mwh
attributes.description: The energy component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in USD/MWh, representing the system-wide marginal cost of energy at the reference bus. One of three LMP components (energy, congestion, loss) published by the RTO/ISO. Used for granular settlement analysis and IRP resource adequacy modeling.

attributes.name: lmp_loss_component_usd_per_mwh
attributes.description: The marginal loss component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in USD/MWh, reflecting the incremental cost of transmission losses between the pricing node and the reference bus. Used for settlement reconciliation and transmission loss accounting per FERC OATT requirements.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000; FERC OATT; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: lmp_usd_per_mwh
attributes.description: The Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in US Dollars per Megawatt-Hour ($/MWh) at the associated pricing node for this dispatch interval, as published by the RTO/ISO following market clearing. Composed of energy, congestion, and loss components. Primary settlement price for the awarded MW schedule. Sensitive market pricing data.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000; FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO OATT; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Identifies the wholesale energy market in which this dispatch award was cleared. DAM = Day-Ahead Market; RTM = Real-Time Market; HASP = Hour-Ahead Scheduling Process; RUC = Reliability Unit Commitment; CAISO_15MIN = 15-Minute Market. Determines settlement rules and pricing methodology applicable to the award. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAM|RTM|HASP|RUC|CAISO_15MIN|ELMP|SCED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff; NERC BAL-002

attributes.name: no_load_cost_usd_per_hr
attributes.description: The fixed operating cost in US Dollars per hour ($/hr) incurred to keep the generation unit synchronized and online at zero net output, as submitted in the market offer. Recovered through RTO/ISO no-load cost compensation. Sensitive commercial cost data used in IRP and FERC rate case filings.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: operating_date
attributes.description: The calendar date (in the RTO/ISO operating day definition, typically midnight-to-midnight local prevailing time) on which this dispatch award is scheduled to be executed. Used for daily settlement reconciliation, IRP resource adequacy reporting, and FERC EQR filings. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: FERC EQR Reporting; RTO/ISO Market Tariff; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: ramp_rate_down_mw_per_min
attributes.description: The maximum rate in Megawatts per minute (MW/min) at which the generation unit can decrease its output, as recognized in this dispatch award. Constrains how quickly the unit can respond to downward dispatch instructions. Used for SCADA/EMS real-time control and RTO/ISO reliability dispatch.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-002; NERC BAL-003; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: ramp_rate_up_mw_per_min
attributes.description: The maximum rate in Megawatts per minute (MW/min) at which the generation unit can increase its output, as recognized in this dispatch award. Constrains how quickly the unit can respond to upward dispatch instructions from the RTO/ISO or SCADA/EMS. Critical for frequency regulation and ancillary services compliance.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-002; NERC BAL-003; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: rec_quantity
attributes.description: The number of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) generated or associated with this dispatch award, where one REC represents one MWh of renewable electricity generation. Applicable only when is_renewable = True. Used for RPS compliance tracking, REC registry reporting, and state PUC regulatory filings.
attributes.references: State RPS Regulations; NERC GATS; EPA Green Power Partnership

attributes.name: scheduled_mw
attributes.description: The awarded generation output in Megawatts (MW) that the generation unit is scheduled to produce during the dispatch interval, as determined by the RTO/ISO market clearing engine. This is the primary quantitative fact of the dispatch award. Used for real-time SCADA/EMS dispatch execution, settlement, and NERC reliability compliance.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-002; FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff

attributes.name: settlement_amount_usd
attributes.description: The gross settlement amount in US Dollars ($) for this dispatch award, calculated as scheduled_mw × (interval_duration_minutes / 60) × lmp_usd_per_mwh plus applicable start-up and no-load cost recovery. Represents the revenue or cost obligation for the awarded interval. Used for financial settlement reconciliation with the RTO/ISO and GAAP revenue recognition.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: startup_cost_usd
attributes.description: The total start-up cost in US Dollars ($) associated with committing this generation unit for the dispatch award, as submitted in the market offer. Includes fuel, labor, and equipment costs incurred to bring the unit from cold/warm/hot standby to minimum load. Recovered through RTO/ISO start-up cost compensation mechanisms. Sensitive commercial cost data.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Market Tariff; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dispatch award record was last modified in the Silver layer lakehouse, such as when a revised dispatch instruction or settlement correction was applied. Used for change data capture, audit trails, and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; GAAP

products.name: lmp_price
products.description: Transactional record storing Locational Marginal Prices (LMP) published by the RTO/ISO for each pricing node (pnode) and settlement interval. Captures LMP components: energy component, congestion component, and loss component (all in $/MWh), market type (DAM/RTM), interval start/end timestamps, and pnode identifier. Foundational for settlement calculations, hedging analysis, and transmission congestion management.
products.reference: FERC Order 888 / RTO/ISO LMP Methodology

attributes.name: lmp_price_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each LMP price record in the silver layer. Primary key for the lmp_price data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete published price event from the RTO/ISO for a specific pricing node and settlement interval.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: lmp_pricing_node_id
attributes.description: FK to market.pricing_node

attributes.name: primary_lmp_pricing_node_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the pricing node (pnode) at which the LMP is published by the RTO/ISO. A pnode represents a specific electrical bus or aggregation point on the transmission grid where energy prices are calculated. Used to join to the pnode master reference for geographic and network context.

attributes.name: congestion_component_per_mwh
attributes.description: The congestion component of the LMP in US dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh), reflecting the cost of transmission congestion at this pricing node relative to the reference bus. A positive value indicates the node is import-constrained; a negative value indicates export-constrained. Critical for transmission congestion management and FTR/CRR hedging analysis.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: congestion_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of transmission congestion affecting this pricing node: IMPORT (node is import-constrained, positive congestion component), EXPORT (node is export-constrained, negative congestion component), or UNCONSTRAINED (no binding transmission constraint). Supports FTR/CRR portfolio management and transmission congestion hedging strategy.

attributes.name: control_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Balancing Authority Area (BAA) or control area within which this pricing node is located, as defined by NERC. Used for inter-area settlement, OATT compliance reporting, and NERC reliability reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this LMP price record was first ingested and created in the Databricks silver layer data product, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and ETL pipeline monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the LMP price values (e.g., USD for US Dollar, CAD for Canadian Dollar for cross-border markets). Ensures unambiguous interpretation of all monetary price components in multi-currency market contexts.

attributes.name: data_feed_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific RTO/ISO data feed, API endpoint, or file type from which this LMP record was sourced (e.g., PJM_DA_LMP, CAISO_RTM_LMP_5MIN). Supports data lineage tracking, feed monitoring, and troubleshooting of price data gaps or anomalies.

attributes.name: energy_component_per_mwh
attributes.description: The energy component of the LMP in US dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh), representing the system-wide marginal cost of energy at the reference bus. This component is uniform across all nodes in the market and reflects the cost of the marginal generating unit dispatched to serve load.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the settlement interval in minutes (e.g., 60 for hourly DAM, 5 for RTM 5-minute intervals, 15 for 15-minute RTM intervals). Enables correct MWh energy quantity calculations when multiplying power (MW) by interval duration.

attributes.name: interval_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The end date and time of the settlement interval for which this LMP is applicable, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Together with interval_start_timestamp, defines the precise settlement window. Used to validate interval completeness and detect gaps in price data.

attributes.name: interval_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The start date and time of the settlement interval for which this LMP is applicable, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). For DAM, this is typically the top of the hour; for RTM, this may be a 5-minute or 15-minute interval start. Foundational for interval-level settlement and congestion analysis.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; RTO/ISO Tariff; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: is_binding_constraint
attributes.description: Indicates whether a transmission constraint was binding during this settlement interval at or affecting this pricing node (True = binding constraint active; False = no binding constraint). A binding constraint causes non-zero congestion component values and is critical for transmission congestion management and FTR/CRR settlement analysis.

attributes.name: is_holiday
attributes.description: Indicates whether the operating date falls on a recognized market holiday as defined by the RTO/ISO or applicable tariff (True = holiday; False = non-holiday). Holiday periods typically follow off-peak pricing rules and affect demand response program eligibility and TOU rate calculations.

attributes.name: is_price_cap_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RTO/ISO applied a market price cap or floor to this LMP during the settlement interval (True = price cap or floor was applied; False = price cleared within normal bounds). Price caps are regulatory limits set by FERC to prevent market manipulation. Relevant for settlement dispute analysis and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Order 719; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: lmp_total_per_mwh
attributes.description: The total Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in US dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh) for this pricing node and settlement interval, as published by the RTO/ISO. Equals the sum of the energy component, congestion component, and loss component. The primary price used for wholesale energy settlement calculations.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: lmp_version
attributes.description: Version label or identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO to distinguish between different published versions of LMP data for the same operating interval (e.g., 'v1', 'v2', or a timestamp-based version string). Used alongside revision_number to uniquely identify the authoritative price record for settlement and audit purposes.

attributes.name: load_zone_code
attributes.description: The RTO/ISO-defined load zone or pricing zone code to which this pricing node belongs. Load zones aggregate individual bus nodes for zonal settlement and load-serving entity (LSE) obligations. Used for zonal LMP analysis, capacity market obligations, and TOU rate design.

attributes.name: loss_component_per_mwh
attributes.description: The marginal loss component of the LMP in US dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh), representing the cost of marginal transmission losses at this pricing node relative to the reference bus. Reflects the incremental cost of delivering an additional MWh to this node accounting for line losses.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: market_day
attributes.description: The market operating day (yyyy-MM-dd) as defined by the RTO/ISO, which may differ from the calendar date for intervals near midnight due to market day boundary conventions. Used for market settlement period alignment and day-ahead vs. real-time reconciliation.

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether this LMP was published in the Day-Ahead Market (DAM) or the Real-Time Market (RTM). DAM prices are forward-looking hourly prices cleared the day before delivery; RTM prices are five-minute or hourly prices cleared during the operating hour. Critical for settlement calculations and hedging analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; FERC OATT; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: operating_date
attributes.description: The calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd) of the operating day to which this LMP belongs. Used for daily aggregation, settlement period alignment, and day-ahead vs. real-time comparison reporting. Derived from interval_start_timestamp but stored explicitly for query performance.

attributes.name: operating_hour
attributes.description: The hour ending (HE) of the operating day (1–24) to which this settlement interval belongs. Standard RTO/ISO convention for identifying the delivery hour. Used for hourly aggregation, TOU rate alignment, and peak/off-peak classification.

attributes.name: peak_period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the settlement interval into a peak period category based on the applicable tariff or market definition: ON_PEAK (high-demand hours, typically weekday daytime), OFF_PEAK (low-demand hours, nights and weekends), SUPER_PEAK (highest demand hours for CPP or TOU rates), or SHOULDER (transitional hours). Used for TOU rate analysis, demand response program evaluation, and IRP resource adequacy studies.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; PUC Tariff; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: price_cap_type
attributes.description: Type of price cap or floor applied to this LMP when is_price_cap_applied is True. OFFER_CAP indicates the offer cap was binding; PRICE_FLOOR indicates the minimum price floor was applied; SCARCITY_PRICING indicates emergency scarcity pricing was triggered; NONE indicates no cap was applied. Used for market monitoring and regulatory reporting to FERC.
attributes.references: FERC Order 719; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: price_quality_flag
attributes.description: Data quality indicator for this LMP record as assessed by the utility's market data management or EMS platform. VALID = price passed all validation checks; SUSPECT = price flagged for review due to anomalous value; INVALID = price failed validation and should not be used for settlement; ESTIMATED = price was estimated due to missing source data; MISSING = no price was received for this interval.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this LMP price record indicating its settlement finality. PRELIMINARY prices are published shortly after the interval; FINAL prices are the binding settlement values after RTO/ISO validation; REVISED prices reflect corrections to previously published values; ESTIMATED prices are used when actual data is unavailable. Drives which records are used in financial settlement.

attributes.name: publish_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the RTO/ISO officially published or released this LMP price record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the business event time of price publication. Used to track data latency, validate timeliness of price feeds, and support audit trails for settlement disputes.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number assigned by the RTO/ISO or the utility's MDMS/market system to track successive corrections to a published LMP for the same pnode and interval. A value of 0 or 1 indicates the initial publication; higher values indicate subsequent revisions. Used to identify the most current authoritative price for settlement.

attributes.name: rto_iso_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization / Independent System Operator (RTO/ISO) Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) that published this LMP. Determines the market rules, settlement procedures, and tariff framework applicable to this price record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|CAISO|MISO|NYISO|ISONE|ERCOT|SPP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Seasonal classification of the operating date for this LMP record (SUMMER, WINTER, SPRING, FALL) based on the utility's or RTO/ISO's tariff-defined seasonal boundaries. Used for seasonal price analysis, capacity market seasonal obligations, and IRP resource adequacy modeling.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; PUC Tariff; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: settlement_period
attributes.description: Identifies the settlement billing period in which this LMP is used: INITIAL (first pass settlement shortly after the operating day), FINAL (binding settlement after all data is validated, typically 60 days post-operating day), or RESETTLEMENT (corrected settlement due to data errors or disputes). Determines which price version is used in financial settlement statements.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by the source RTO/ISO market system or the utility's market data management platform (e.g., ABB or GE Energy Management System, or the RTO/ISO API response record ID). Enables traceability back to the originating system for audit, reconciliation, and dispute resolution purposes.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this LMP price record was last modified in the Databricks silver layer, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated when price revisions, quality flag changes, or settlement period reclassifications are applied. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

products.name: settlement_statement
products.description: Header-level transactional record for wholesale market settlement statements issued by the RTO/ISO covering DAM, RTM, capacity, and ancillary service charges and credits. Captures settlement run type (initial, resettlement, true-up, final), billing period, statement version number, total charges ($), total credits ($), net settlement amount, market participant ID, RTO/ISO identifier, payment due date, and statement publication date. Individual charge and credit details are decomposed in settlement_line_item. Serves as the SSOT for wholesale market financial settlement reconciliation and supports FERC EQR and Form 1 reporting.
products.reference: FERC EQR / RTO/ISO Settlement Tariff

attributes.name: settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the wholesale market settlement statement record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.capex_project. Business justification: Market settlements for generation assets under construction (CWIP) must be tracked against the capital project for AFUDC calculation, capitalization decisions, and rate base treatment. Essential for p

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Market settlement costs must be allocated to specific cost centers for management accounting and regulatory cost allocation. This FK formalizes the relationship and enables cost center validation. The

attributes.name: cost_recovery_mechanism_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.cost_recovery_mechanism. Business justification: Wholesale market costs recovered through fuel adjustment clauses and purchased power riders. Links actual settlement costs to regulatory cost recovery mechanisms for rate adjustment calculations.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Market settlement statements must post to specific GL accounts for financial reporting. This FK formalizes the relationship and enables automated GL posting validation. The settlement_statement table

attributes.name: participant_registration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the market participant entity representing the utility company in the wholesale energy market. Corresponds to the registered market participant account with the RTO/ISO.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) contract associated with this settlement statement, if the settlement relates to a bilateral PPA position rather than a spot market transaction. Nullable for pure spot market settlements.
attributes.references: FERC EQR; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: pricing_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary settlement point (pricing node, hub, or load zone) at which energy volumes on this statement are settled. Determines the applicable LMP for energy charge/credit calculations.
attributes.references: FERC EQR; RTO/ISO Nodal Pricing Protocols

attributes.name: prior_statement_settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding settlement statement version for the same billing period and market type. Enables version lineage tracking and delta analysis between resettlement runs.

attributes.name: prudency_docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.docket. Business justification: Wholesale market settlement costs are subject to regulatory prudency review in rate cases. Links market costs to regulatory proceedings for cost recovery approval and reasonableness determination.

attributes.name: prudency_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.prudency_review. Business justification: Large wholesale market costs subject to regulatory prudency review. Links market settlement expenses to prudency proceedings for reasonableness determination and cost recovery approval.

attributes.name: rate_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.rate_case. Business justification: Wholesale market settlement costs flow into rate case revenue requirements. Links actual market costs to retail rate proceedings for fuel adjustment clause and purchased power cost recovery.

attributes.name: rto_iso_id
attributes.description: FK to market.rto_iso

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor_invoice. Business justification: Market settlements for tolling agreements, capacity payments, or generation services often correspond to vendor invoices. Enables three-way matching between market settlement, vendor invoice, and serv

attributes.name: ancillary_service_charges_usd
attributes.description: Charges for ancillary services procured from the RTO/ISO, including regulation, spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, and reactive power. Supports O&M cost allocation and FERC Form 1 Schedule 321.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; NERC BAL-001; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: ancillary_service_credits_usd
attributes.description: Revenues received for ancillary services provided to the RTO/ISO, including regulation, spinning reserve, and demand response. Supports revenue disaggregation for FERC Form 1 and IRP analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; NERC BAL-001; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the settlement billing period covered by this statement. Together with billing_period_start_date defines the settlement window for charge and credit line items.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the settlement billing period covered by this statement. For DAM/RTM, typically a single operating day; for capacity markets, may span a month or season.

attributes.name: capacity_charges_usd
attributes.description: Charges assessed for capacity market obligations, including capacity deficiency penalties or capacity purchases from the RTO/ISO capacity auction. Supports resource adequacy cost tracking for IRP filings.

attributes.name: capacity_credits_usd
attributes.description: Revenues received for capacity resources cleared in the RTO/ISO capacity auction. Supports resource adequacy revenue tracking and PPA valuation for IRP filings.

attributes.name: congestion_credits_usd
attributes.description: Credits received from Congestion Revenue Rights (CRR) or Financial Transmission Rights (FTR) held by the market participant, offsetting congestion costs in the LMP settlement. Supports hedging effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; OATT; LMP Settlement Protocols

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement statement record was first ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer from the source RTO/ISO system or internal market operations system. Supports data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this settlement statement. Typically 'USD' for North American RTO/ISO markets. Included to support multi-currency scenarios for cross-border markets (e.g., IESO in Canada).

attributes.name: dispute_amount_usd
attributes.description: Dollar amount under formal dispute with the RTO/ISO for this settlement statement. May be a subset of the net_settlement_amount_usd. Populated only when is_disputed = True. Supports contingent liability disclosure for SOX and GAAP.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 450; SOX Section 404; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: dispute_deadline_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date by which the market participant may file a formal dispute or request for resettlement with the RTO/ISO for this statement. Derived from RTO/ISO tariff dispute windows; tracked to prevent forfeiture of dispute rights.

attributes.name: energy_charges_usd
attributes.description: Portion of total charges attributable to energy (MWh) purchases in the DAM or RTM, settled at Locational Marginal Price (LMP). Supports disaggregated cost analysis for IRP and FERC EQR reporting.

attributes.name: energy_credits_usd
attributes.description: Portion of total credits attributable to energy (MWh) sales in the DAM or RTM, settled at Locational Marginal Price (LMP). Supports revenue disaggregation for IRP and FERC EQR reporting.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USofA) account code applicable to this settlement statement (e.g., Account 555 for Purchased Power, Account 447 for Sales for Resale). Required for FERC Form 1 and EQR regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: is_disputed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility has filed a formal dispute with the RTO/ISO for this settlement statement. True = active dispute filed; False = no dispute. Triggers dispute tracking workflow and suspends payment processing for disputed amounts.

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Classifies the wholesale market segment covered by this settlement statement. DAM = Day-Ahead Market; RTM = Real-Time Market; capacity = capacity obligation market; ancillary_services = regulation, spinning reserve, etc.; transmission = transmission congestion or OATT charges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAM|RTM|capacity|ancillary_services|transmission|REC — promote to reference product if additional market types are added]

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount_usd
attributes.description: Net financial obligation for this settlement statement in US dollars, calculated as total_credits_usd minus total_charges_usd. A positive value indicates a net receipt (credit to utility); a negative value indicates a net payment owed to the RTO/ISO. Primary figure for treasury and FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; GAAP ASC 606; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for market operations staff to record internal annotations, reconciliation observations, or dispute correspondence references associated with this settlement statement. Not transmitted to the RTO/ISO.

attributes.name: operating_day
attributes.description: The specific RTO/ISO operating day (midnight-to-midnight) to which this settlement statement applies. For DAM and RTM settlements, this is a single calendar date. For multi-day statements (capacity, ancillary), this field represents the primary operating day or is set to the billing_period_start_date.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which payment was made to or received from the RTO/ISO for this settlement statement. Distinct from payment_due_date; used to calculate late payment penalties and for cash flow reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Calendar date by which the net settlement amount must be paid to or received from the RTO/ISO. Drives cash flow forecasting, treasury operations, and late-payment penalty exposure.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_ref
attributes.description: External payment transaction reference number or ACH/wire transfer confirmation number associated with the settlement of this statement. Populated upon payment execution. Supports treasury reconciliation with SAP S/4HANA accounts payable/receivable.

attributes.name: resettlement_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the reason for resettlement or true-up, as provided by the RTO/ISO. Examples include meter data correction, LMP recalculation, capacity obligation adjustment, or ancillary service reallocation. Populated only for statement_run_type values of 'resettlement' or 'true_up'.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this settlement statement was sourced. 'RTO_ISO_PORTAL' = direct RTO/ISO market portal feed; 'EMS' = ABB or GE Energy Management System; 'ERP' = SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud; 'MANUAL' = manually entered by market operations staff.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO to uniquely identify this settlement statement. Used for reconciliation with the RTO/ISO portal and FERC EQR filings.

attributes.name: statement_publication_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the RTO/ISO published and made this settlement statement available to market participants. This is the principal real-world business event timestamp — the moment the financial obligation became known to the utility.

attributes.name: statement_run_type
attributes.description: Indicates the settlement run cycle that produced this statement. 'initial' is the first pass estimate; 'resettlement' reflects corrections after initial; 'true_up' applies final meter data adjustments; 'final' is the binding, non-revisable settlement. Drives financial posting and dispute eligibility windows.

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the settlement statement within the utility's internal reconciliation workflow. 'published' = received from RTO/ISO; 'under_review' = internal validation in progress; 'disputed' = formal dispute filed with RTO/ISO; 'accepted' = validated and approved for payment; 'paid' = payment executed; 'closed' = fully settled and archived.

attributes.name: statement_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the settlement statement issued by the RTO/ISO for the same billing period and run type. Increments with each resettlement or correction. Version 1 is the original issuance.

attributes.name: total_charges_usd
attributes.description: Gross sum of all charge line items on this settlement statement in US dollars. Represents amounts owed by the market participant to the RTO/ISO for energy purchases, capacity obligations, ancillary service charges, and transmission fees.

attributes.name: total_credits_usd
attributes.description: Gross sum of all credit line items on this settlement statement in US dollars. Represents amounts owed to the market participant by the RTO/ISO for energy sales, capacity revenues, ancillary service revenues, and congestion credits.

attributes.name: total_energy_volume_mwh
attributes.description: Net energy volume in Megawatt-Hours (MWh) settled on this statement, representing the algebraic sum of all DAM and RTM energy positions. Positive = net purchase; negative = net sale. Supports FERC EQR quantity reporting.

attributes.name: transmission_charges_usd
attributes.description: Charges for transmission service, congestion, and OATT-related fees assessed on this settlement statement. Includes congestion component of LMP and transmission loss charges.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement statement record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer, such as when a status change, dispute flag, or payment date was recorded. Supports change data capture and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: weighted_avg_lmp_usd_per_mwh
attributes.description: Volume-weighted average Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in USD per MWh across all energy positions settled on this statement. Supports market cost benchmarking, IRP analysis, and FERC EQR price reporting.

products.name: ancillary_service_award
products.description: Transactional record for ancillary service awards received from the RTO/ISO, covering regulation (up/down), spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, and voltage support. Captures service type, awarded MW, clearing price ($/MW), performance score, deployment events, and associated settlement amounts. Supports NERC reliability compliance and ancillary service revenue tracking.
products.reference: NERC BAL-002 / FERC Order 755 (Frequency Regulation Compensation)

attributes.name: ancillary_service_award_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ancillary service award record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: capacity_market_auction_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the capacity market auction (e.g., PJM RPM, MISO Planning Resource Auction) associated with this award, if applicable. Populated for capacity-market-sourced ancillary obligations; null for DAM/RTM awards.

attributes.name: capacity_resource_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generation unit, demand response resource, or storage asset that was awarded the ancillary service obligation. Links to the asset or resource master record.
attributes.references: NERC Glossary of Terms; FERC Order 841

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_master. Business justification: Ancillary service awards must link to physical asset providing regulation, spinning reserve, or other services for operational feasibility validation against asset capabilities, real-time performance

attributes.name: participant_registration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the utility's registered market participant entity that submitted the ancillary service offer and received this award from the RTO/ISO.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) contract under which this ancillary service award is fulfilled, if the resource is a contracted third-party asset. Null for utility-owned resources.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; GAAP ASC 842

attributes.name: pricing_node_id
attributes.description: The RTO/ISO-assigned pricing node or location identifier (e.g., LMP node, pnode) associated with the resource providing the ancillary service. Used for Locational Marginal Price (LMP) settlement and transmission constraint analysis.

attributes.name: rto_iso_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization / Independent System Operator (RTO/ISO) ID
attributes.description: Reference to the RTO/ISO entity (e.g., PJM, MISO, CAISO, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE) that issued this ancillary service award. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction.

attributes.name: award_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known award confirmation number or transaction identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO for this ancillary service award. Used for reconciliation with RTO/ISO settlement statements and FERC compliance reporting.

attributes.name: award_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ancillary service award. 'awarded' = RTO/ISO has issued the award; 'confirmed' = utility has acknowledged; 'settled' = financial settlement completed; 'disputed' = under dispute resolution; 'cancelled' = award rescinded; 'expired' = obligation period elapsed without settlement.

attributes.name: award_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the RTO/ISO issued the ancillary service award to the market participant. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction record.

attributes.name: awarded_mw
attributes.description: The quantity of capacity in megawatts (MW) awarded by the RTO/ISO for the specified ancillary service type and operating interval. This is the primary quantitative fact of the award.

attributes.name: clearing_price_per_mw
attributes.description: The market clearing price in US dollars per megawatt ($/MW) at which the ancillary service was procured by the RTO/ISO. Used for settlement calculation and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: control_area_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the balancing authority area or control area within the RTO/ISO footprint where the ancillary service obligation applies. Used for geographic segmentation of reliability obligations and NERC compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NERC Glossary of Terms; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ancillary service award record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC record retention requirements

attributes.name: deployed_mw
attributes.description: Actual megawatts delivered by the resource during deployment events within the obligation period. May differ from awarded_mw if the resource was partially deployed or experienced a forced outage. Used for performance score calculation and NERC compliance.

attributes.name: deployment_event_count
attributes.description: Number of times the ancillary service resource was actually deployed (called upon) by the RTO/ISO during the obligation period. A count of zero indicates the resource was held in reserve but not activated. Supports NERC reliability compliance reporting.

attributes.name: dispute_reference_number
attributes.description: RTO/ISO or internal dispute tracking number if this award is under settlement dispute. Populated only when settlement_status is 'disputed'. Supports dispute resolution workflow and FERC complaint tracking.
attributes.references: FERC Rules of Practice and Procedure; OATT dispute resolution provisions

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ancillary service award was procured in the Day-Ahead Market (DAM), Real-Time Market (RTM), or a forward capacity market auction.

attributes.name: nerc_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ancillary service award and its associated performance met all applicable NERC reliability standards (e.g., BAL-001, BAL-002) for the obligation period. Used for NERC compliance reporting and audit trails.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001; NERC BAL-002; NERC EOP-005

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: Final net settlement amount in US dollars after applying performance adjustments to the base settlement amount (settlement_amount + performance_adjustment_amount). Represents the actual revenue recognized for this award.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; FERC Order 755; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: obligation_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the ancillary service obligation period ends. Together with obligation_start_timestamp, defines the full obligation window for availability and performance measurement.

attributes.name: obligation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the ancillary service obligation period begins. Defines the start of the window during which the resource must be available and responsive.

attributes.name: offer_price_per_mw
attributes.description: The price in US dollars per megawatt ($/MW) at which the utility submitted its ancillary service offer into the market. Compared against clearing_price_per_mw for margin analysis and offer strategy review.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: offered_mw
attributes.description: The quantity of capacity in megawatts (MW) that the utility originally offered into the ancillary service market. Compared against awarded_mw to assess offer acceptance rate and market clearing outcomes.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: operating_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the ancillary service obligation is to be performed. This is the principal real-world event date for the award, distinct from the award issuance timestamp.

attributes.name: operating_hour
attributes.description: The hour-ending (HE) interval (1–24) within the operating date for which the ancillary service award applies. Used for sub-daily granularity in settlement and dispatch scheduling.

attributes.name: performance_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar adjustment applied to the base settlement amount based on the resource's performance score. Positive values indicate performance bonuses; negative values indicate penalties for under-performance. Required for FERC Order 755 pay-for-performance regulation compliance.

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Numeric performance score assigned by the RTO/ISO reflecting the resource's compliance with the ancillary service obligation during the operating interval. Scores typically range from 0.0 to 1.0 (or 0–100 per RTO convention). Impacts performance-based settlement adjustments and NERC compliance metrics.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001; NERC BAL-002; FERC Order 755

attributes.name: rec_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resource providing this ancillary service is eligible to generate Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) for the energy delivered during deployment events. Supports RPS compliance tracking.
attributes.references: State RPS regulations; DOE REC tracking standards

attributes.name: response_time_minutes
attributes.description: Actual response time in minutes from RTO/ISO dispatch signal to full MW delivery by the resource. Compared against the service type's required response time (e.g., 10 minutes for spinning reserve) for performance evaluation and NERC compliance.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-002; NERC BAL-001; IEEE Std 1547

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ancillary service awarded by the RTO/ISO. Regulation up/down provides automatic generation control (AGC) response; spinning reserve is synchronized capacity available within 10 minutes; non-spinning reserve is offline capacity available within 10 minutes; voltage support and reactive power maintain grid voltage stability; black start enables grid restoration.
