[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regulation_up|regulation_down|spinning_reserve|non_spinning_reserve|voltage_support|black_start|reactive_power — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001; NERC BAL-002; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: The gross settlement amount in US dollars payable to the utility for this ancillary service award, calculated as awarded_mw multiplied by clearing_price_per_mw for the obligation period. Supports ancillary service revenue tracking and FERC settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: settlement_period
attributes.description: The RTO/ISO-defined settlement period identifier (e.g., 'DAM-2024-01-15', 'RTM-2024-01-15-HE14') to which this award belongs. Used for batch settlement reconciliation and financial close processes.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO tariff settlement provisions

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the financial settlement for this award. 'pending' = awaiting RTO/ISO settlement run; 'preliminary' = initial settlement issued; 'final' = settlement finalized; 'resettled' = corrected after initial settlement; 'disputed' = under formal dispute with RTO/ISO.

attributes.name: source_system_award_code
attributes.description: The native award identifier from the originating energy management or market operations system (e.g., ABB or GE Energy Management System, or RTO/ISO OASIS portal). Enables traceability back to the operational system of record for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ancillary service award record was last modified in the data platform, such as after a resettlement, performance score update, or dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC record retention requirements

products.name: rec_inventory
products.description: Master record tracking Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) inventory positions. Captures REC vintage year, fuel type (solar, wind, hydro, biomass), generating unit ID, state of issuance, registry account (WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM-GATS), REC status (available, retired, transferred, reserved), quantity (MWh), and RPS compliance program association. Supports state RPS compliance and voluntary renewable procurement reporting.
products.reference: WREGIS / NEPOOL GIS / PJM-GATS REC Registry Standards

attributes.name: rec_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each REC inventory position record in the Power and Utilities wholesale energy market data product. Serves as the primary key for the silver-layer lakehouse table.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; PJM-GATS Operating Agreement; NEPOOL GIS Protocols

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: REC inventory demonstrates compliance with renewable portfolio standards. Links banked renewable energy certificates to RPS obligations for compliance verification and shortfall avoidance.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generating unit or facility that produced the energy underlying these RECs. Links to the asset management generating unit master record for capacity, fuel type, and location details.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; NERC Generating Unit Registry; EIA Form 860

attributes.name: irp_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.irp_submission. Business justification: REC inventory demonstrates renewable portfolio compliance in integrated resource plan filings. Links renewable energy certificates to IRP submissions for RPS compliance reporting and planning verifica

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_master. Business justification: REC inventory must link to generating asset for eligibility verification against state RPS programs, vintage validation from asset in-service date, fuel type confirmation, capacity verification, and a

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) contract under which these RECs were procured, if applicable. Links to the PPA contract master record for counterparty, pricing, and term details. Null for self-generated RECs or spot market purchases.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; State PUC PPA Approval Orders; IRP Resource Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: rps_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the state Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance program with which this REC inventory position is associated. Null if the RECs are held for voluntary renewable procurement rather than mandatory compliance.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Tariff Filings; DOE RPS Program Registry

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date on which these RECs were acquired by the Power and Utilities, whether through self-generation, PPA delivery, or market purchase. Used for vintage tracking, compliance period assignment, and financial accounting.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; State PUC RPS Compliance Reporting; GAAP ASC 350

attributes.name: capacity_mw
attributes.description: The nameplate generating capacity of the renewable generating unit in Megawatts (MW). Used to verify REC issuance volumes against expected generation output and for IRP resource adequacy analysis.
attributes.references: EIA Form 860; FERC Form 1; NERC Generating Unit Registry

attributes.name: compliance_period_year
attributes.description: The regulatory compliance period year (typically a calendar year) to which these RECs are applied for state RPS obligation fulfillment. A single REC inventory position may be designated to a compliance period that differs from its vintage year depending on state banking and carry-forward rules.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Compliance Rules; NARUC RPS Tracking Standards

attributes.name: cost_per_rec
attributes.description: The unit acquisition cost per REC in U.S. dollars at the time of purchase or contract execution. Used for financial accounting, IRP cost analysis, and rate case cost recovery filings. Confidential as it reflects contract pricing strategy.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 350; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; State PUC Rate Case Cost Recovery Rules

attributes.name: counterparty_name
attributes.description: The name of the counterparty from whom these RECs were purchased or to whom they were transferred. Applicable for market purchases and bilateral transfers. Confidential as it reveals commercial relationships and contract counterparties.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; State PUC RPS Compliance Reporting; GAAP ASC 850 Related Party Disclosures

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this REC inventory record was first created in the Power and Utilities data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FERC Record Retention Requirements; GAAP Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: eligibility_state
attributes.description: The two-letter U.S. state postal abbreviation for the state RPS compliance program for which these RECs have been certified as eligible. May differ from state_of_issuance when a generator is certified for out-of-state RPS programs. Null if RECs are held for voluntary procurement only.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Eligibility Rules; NARUC RPS Tracking Standards; DOE RPS Program Registry

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which these RECs expire and are no longer eligible for use in RPS compliance or voluntary procurement claims. Expiration rules vary by state and registry; many states impose a 2–5 year expiration window from the vintage year.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Rules; WREGIS Operating Rules; NEPOOL GIS Protocols

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: The renewable energy fuel or technology type of the generating unit that produced the energy underlying these RECs. Determines eligibility for specific state RPS tiers and voluntary green power programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: solar|wind|hydro|biomass|geothermal|landfill_gas|ocean|municipal_solid_waste — promote to reference product if additional fuel types are required]
attributes.references: EIA Form 860 Fuel Type Codes; State PUC RPS Eligibility Rules; WREGIS Fuel Type Classification

attributes.name: generation_facility_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the renewable energy generating facility or plant that produced the electricity underlying these RECs. Used for reporting, audit, and stakeholder communication purposes.
attributes.references: EIA Form 860; FERC Form 1; WREGIS Generator Registration

attributes.name: is_banked
attributes.description: Indicates whether these RECs are being held (banked) for use in a future compliance period beyond the current year (True) or are designated for the current compliance period (False). Banking eligibility and duration limits vary by state RPS program.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Banking Rules; NARUC RPS Tracking Standards

attributes.name: is_self_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether these RECs were generated by a generating unit owned or operated by the Power and Utilities (True) or procured from a third-party generator or market (False). Distinguishes owned renewable generation from purchased RECs for IRP and RPS compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Self-Generation Rules; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; IRP Resource Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: market_price_per_rec
attributes.description: The current or most recently observed market price per REC in U.S. dollars for the applicable fuel type, vintage, and state. Used for mark-to-market valuation, IRP resource adequacy analysis, and voluntary procurement benchmarking. Confidential as it reflects market position.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; State PUC IRP Filing Requirements; GAAP ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Region
attributes.description: The NERC reliability region in which the generating facility is located. Used to determine registry jurisdiction and RPS eligibility for cross-regional REC transactions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WECC|SERC|RFC|MRO|NPCC|TRE|FRCC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NERC Regional Entity Boundaries; FERC Order 693; State PUC RPS Geographic Eligibility Rules

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, compliance annotations, or special handling instructions associated with this REC inventory position. Used by energy market analysts and compliance staff to document exceptions, pending actions, or regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether these RECs are held for mandatory state RPS compliance obligations, voluntary renewable procurement commitments (e.g., green tariff programs, corporate renewable PPAs), or both purposes.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Rules; EPA Green Power Partnership; DOE Voluntary Green Power Procurement Guidelines

attributes.name: quantity_mwh
attributes.description: The number of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) in this inventory position, expressed in Megawatt-Hours (MWh). One REC represents one MWh of electricity generated from a qualifying renewable resource. This is the principal quantitative fact for the inventory record.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; EPA Green Power Partnership; State PUC RPS Rules; EIA Renewable Energy Reporting

attributes.name: rec_serial_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned unique serial number or certificate identifier issued by the registry (WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, or PJM-GATS) for this REC lot. Used for tracking, transfer, and retirement transactions within the registry system. Format varies by registry.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules Section 5; PJM-GATS Certificate Numbering Standard; NEPOOL GIS Protocols

attributes.name: rec_source
attributes.description: The procurement channel or source through which these RECs were obtained. 'owned_generation' for RECs from Power and Utilities-owned renewable assets; 'ppa' for RECs delivered under a Power Purchase Agreement; 'spot_market' for RECs purchased on the open market; 'bilateral_trade' for negotiated bilateral transfers; 'green_tariff_program' for RECs associated with a utility green tariff offering.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; State PUC RPS Procurement Rules; IRP Resource Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: rec_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the REC inventory position. 'available' indicates RECs are unencumbered and eligible for use; 'retired' indicates RECs have been permanently surrendered for compliance or voluntary claim; 'transferred' indicates RECs have been sold or conveyed to another party; 'reserved' indicates RECs are earmarked for a specific compliance obligation or transaction; 'pending' indicates a registry transaction is in process; 'cancelled' indicates RECs have been invalidated.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; NEPOOL GIS Protocols; PJM-GATS Operating Agreement; State PUC RPS Rules

attributes.name: registry_platform
attributes.description: The renewable energy certificate tracking registry platform in which this inventory position is recorded. WREGIS (Western Renewable Energy Generation Information System) serves the Western Interconnection; NEPOOL GIS serves New England; PJM-GATS serves the PJM footprint; NAR (North American Renewables Registry), M-RETS (Midwest Renewable Energy Tracking System), and NC-RETS (North Carolina Renewable Energy Tracking System) serve other regions.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; NEPOOL GIS Protocols; PJM-GATS Operating Agreement; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: registry_transaction_code
attributes.description: The transaction identifier assigned by the registry platform (WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM-GATS) for the most recent registry action (issuance, transfer, retirement, or cancellation) affecting this inventory position. Used for registry audit trail and reconciliation.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; NEPOOL GIS Protocols; PJM-GATS Operating Agreement

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which these RECs were permanently retired in the registry for compliance or voluntary claim purposes. Populated only when rec_status is 'retired'. Retirement is an irreversible registry action that prevents double-counting.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; NEPOOL GIS Protocols; PJM-GATS Operating Agreement; State PUC RPS Compliance Rules

attributes.name: retirement_purpose
attributes.description: The stated purpose for which these RECs were retired in the registry. 'rps_compliance' for mandatory state RPS obligation fulfillment; 'voluntary_claim' for voluntary renewable energy claims; 'green_tariff' for utility green tariff program customers; 'net_energy_metering' for NEM program accounting; 'other' for miscellaneous retirement purposes. Null if rec_status is not 'retired'.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Compliance Rules; EPA Green Power Partnership; FERC NEM Tariff Rules; NARUC RPS Tracking Standards

attributes.name: rps_tier
attributes.description: The RPS compliance tier classification for these RECs under the applicable state RPS program. Many states have tiered RPS structures that prioritize newer or specific technology types (e.g., Tier 1 for new in-state solar/wind, Tier 2 for older or out-of-state resources). 'not_applicable' for voluntary procurement RECs.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Tariff Filings; NARUC RPS Tracking Standards

attributes.name: state_of_issuance
attributes.description: The two-letter U.S. state postal abbreviation for the state in which the generating unit is located and where the RECs were issued. State of issuance determines eligibility for specific state RPS compliance programs, as most states require RECs to originate from generators within defined geographic boundaries or interconnection regions.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Eligibility Rules; WREGIS Operating Rules; NEPOOL GIS Protocols; NARUC RPS Tracking Standards

attributes.name: technology_class
attributes.description: The specific renewable energy technology classification of the generating unit, providing sub-category detail within the fuel_type. Used for RPS tier eligibility determination and voluntary procurement product differentiation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: photovoltaic|concentrated_solar|onshore_wind|offshore_wind|run_of_river|pumped_storage|anaerobic_digestion|dedicated_biomass|landfill_gas_engine|geothermal_flash|geothermal_binary — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EIA Form 860 Technology Codes; State PUC RPS Technology Eligibility Rules; WREGIS Generator Registration

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: The total acquisition cost for this REC inventory position in U.S. dollars, calculated as quantity_mwh multiplied by cost_per_rec at time of acquisition. Stored as a raw financial fact for accounting and rate case purposes. Confidential as it reflects contract pricing.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 350; FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Case Cost Recovery Rules; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: The date on which these RECs were transferred to another registry account or counterparty. Populated only when rec_status is 'transferred'. Used for chain-of-custody tracking and audit.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; NEPOOL GIS Protocols; PJM-GATS Operating Agreement

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this REC inventory record was most recently modified in the Power and Utilities data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data reconciliation, and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FERC Record Retention Requirements; GAAP Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: vintage_month
attributes.description: The calendar month (1–12) within the vintage year in which the electricity underlying these RECs was generated. Provides sub-annual granularity for seasonal generation tracking and registry reconciliation.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; NEPOOL GIS Protocols; PJM-GATS Operating Agreement

attributes.name: vintage_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the electricity underlying these RECs was generated. Vintage year is a critical eligibility criterion for state RPS compliance programs, as many states restrict the use of RECs to those generated within a defined vintage window (e.g., current year or prior two years).
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Rules; WREGIS Operating Rules; NEPOOL GIS Protocols

products.name: rec_transaction
products.description: Transactional record for REC transfers, retirements, and purchases. Captures transaction type (transfer, retirement, purchase, sale), transaction date, quantity (MWh), counterparty, registry transfer confirmation number, price ($/REC), compliance program (RPS, voluntary), and associated PPA contract reference. Provides audit trail for RPS compliance filings with state PUCs.
products.reference: State RPS Compliance Rules / WREGIS Operating Procedures

attributes.name: rec_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each REC transaction record in the Power and Utilities wholesale energy market data product. Serves as the primary key for all REC transfer, retirement, purchase, and sale events.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: REC transactions fulfill renewable portfolio standard compliance obligations. Links renewable energy credit procurement to specific RPS mandates for compliance tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: REC trading is managed by specific business units (renewable energy group, wholesale trading desk) with P&L responsibility. Cost center enables profitability analysis, budget tracking, and performance

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generation asset (power plant or renewable facility) that produced the energy underlying the RECs in this transaction. Supports traceability from REC to source generation unit for IRP resource adequacy analysis.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards; State RPS Eligibility Rules

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: REC sales and purchases are financial transactions requiring GL posting for revenue/expense recognition, inventory valuation, and FERC reporting. Essential for proper accounting of renewable energy cr

attributes.name: irp_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.irp_submission. Business justification: REC procurement transactions support renewable targets in integrated resource plans. Links REC acquisitions to IRP filings for demonstrating renewable portfolio strategy execution and compliance.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) contract under which this REC transaction was executed. Links the REC transaction to the originating bilateral energy procurement or sale contract. Nullable for spot-market or registry-only transactions not tied to a PPA.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; State PUC Tariff Filings

attributes.name: primary_rec_registry_account_id
attributes.description: Power and Utilities's account identifier within the REC registry (e.g., WREGIS account number, M-RETS organization ID). Used to identify the Power and Utilities's registry account as the source or destination of the REC transfer. Required for registry reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; M-RETS Operating Procedures

attributes.name: rider_charge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.rider_charge. Business justification: REC procurement costs recovered through renewable energy riders. Links renewable energy credit transactions to specific tariff riders for cost recovery and rate calculation.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: REC purchases often involve vendors as brokers or intermediaries. Links REC procurement to vendor master for payment processing, 1099 reporting, diversity spend tracking, and consolidated vendor perfo

attributes.name: wholesale_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty entity (buyer, seller, or registry participant) involved in this REC transaction. Used for counterparty exposure reporting and RPS compliance audit trails submitted to state PUCs.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; State RPS Program Rules

attributes.name: broker_name
attributes.description: Name of the energy broker or intermediary that facilitated this REC transaction, if applicable. Null for direct bilateral transactions or registry self-transfers. Used for broker relationship management and fee reconciliation.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; State PUC Tariff Filings

attributes.name: certificate_serial_end
attributes.description: Ending serial number of the REC certificate block transferred or retired in this transaction, as assigned by the REC registry. Together with certificate_serial_start, defines the complete range of individual REC certificates covered by this transaction for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; M-RETS Operating Procedures; NAR Program Rules

attributes.name: certificate_serial_start
attributes.description: Starting serial number of the REC certificate block transferred or retired in this transaction, as assigned by the REC registry. REC registries assign unique serial numbers to each MWh certificate. The range from certificate_serial_start to certificate_serial_end defines the exact certificates involved.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; M-RETS Operating Procedures; NAR Program Rules

attributes.name: compliance_program
attributes.description: The regulatory or voluntary compliance program under which this REC transaction is being executed. 'RPS' indicates state Renewable Portfolio Standard obligation; 'voluntary' indicates green power or corporate sustainability purchase; 'federal_clean_energy' indicates federal clean energy standard compliance; 'CHP' indicates Combined Heat and Power (CHP) program; 'other' for non-standard programs.
attributes.references: State RPS Program Rules; DOE Voluntary Green Power Programs; EPA Green Power Partnership

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this REC transaction record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer data product, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements for SOX financial controls and FERC market-based rate record retention.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Record Retention Requirements; GAAP Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this REC transaction record (e.g., USD for US Dollars). Power and Utilities operates primarily in USD; this field supports multi-currency PPA arrangements with international counterparties.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: energy_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the renewable energy generation technology that produced the electricity underlying the RECs. Many state RPS programs have technology-specific carve-outs (e.g., solar carve-outs) that require RECs from specific generation types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: solar|wind|hydro|geothermal|biomass|landfill_gas|other_renewable — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: State RPS Eligibility Rules; DOE Renewable Energy Technology Classifications; WREGIS Fuel Type Codes

attributes.name: generation_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the renewable generation facility (power plant) that produced the electricity underlying the RECs. Used for RPS eligibility verification and registry certificate traceability. Corresponds to the facility name registered in the applicable REC registry.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; State RPS Eligibility Rules; FERC EQR Reporting

attributes.name: generation_facility_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (USPS abbreviation) for the state in which the renewable generation facility is located. Many state RPS programs restrict eligible RECs to facilities located within the state or within a defined geographic region (e.g., in-state, regional grid).
attributes.references: State RPS Eligibility Rules; NERC Regional Entity Boundaries; USPS State Abbreviations

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross monetary value of the REC transaction before any adjustments, fees, or discounts, calculated as quantity_mwh multiplied by price_per_rec. Expressed in US Dollars (USD). Used for revenue recognition, financial settlement, and FERC market-based rate reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: is_bundled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RECs in this transaction are bundled with the underlying electricity delivery (True) or are unbundled certificates traded separately from the physical energy (False). Bundled RECs are typically associated with PPA deliveries; unbundled RECs are traded independently in the REC market. Affects RPS eligibility in some states.
attributes.references: State RPS Eligibility Rules; DOE REC Guidance; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: is_eligible_for_rps
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RECs in this transaction have been verified as eligible for the applicable state Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance program (True) or are ineligible/unverified (False). Eligibility is determined by generation technology, vintage year, facility location, and registry certification.
attributes.references: State RPS Program Rules; State PUC RPS Compliance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary value of the REC transaction after deducting transaction fees from the gross amount, expressed in US Dollars (USD). Represents the actual cash settlement obligation between counterparties. Used for accounts payable/receivable posting in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, special conditions, or operational notes associated with this REC transaction. Used by energy traders and compliance analysts to document non-standard terms, dispute details, or regulatory correspondence references.

attributes.name: price_per_rec
attributes.description: Contracted or market price per REC in US Dollars (USD). Represents the unit price agreed upon between counterparties for purchase or sale transactions. Null for retirement-only or internal transfer transactions with no financial consideration. Sensitive commercial pricing data.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; GAAP ASC 606; State PUC Tariff Filings

attributes.name: quantity_mwh
attributes.description: Number of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) involved in this transaction, expressed in Megawatt-Hours (MWh). One REC represents one MWh of electricity generated from a qualifying renewable resource. This is the principal quantitative fact for the transaction.
attributes.references: DOE REC Definition; WREGIS Operating Rules; State RPS Program Rules

attributes.name: registry_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation number issued by the REC registry (e.g., WREGIS, M-RETS, NAR) upon successful processing of the REC transfer or retirement. Serves as the authoritative audit trail reference for RPS compliance filings with state PUCs and FERC market-based rate reporting.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; M-RETS Operating Procedures; State PUC RPS Compliance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: registry_name
attributes.description: Name of the REC tracking registry through which this transaction was processed. Different RTOs and regions use different registries: WREGIS (Western US), M-RETS (Midwest), NAR (North American Renewables Registry), NEPOOL-GIS (New England), PJM-GATS (PJM region), ERCOT (Texas). Determines applicable operating rules and transfer confirmation procedures.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; M-RETS Operating Procedures; NEPOOL-GIS Operating Rules; PJM GATS Manual

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which RECs were permanently retired in the registry for compliance or voluntary purposes. Populated only for transactions of type 'retirement'. Critical for RPS compliance period determination in state PUC filings.
attributes.references: State RPS Program Rules; WREGIS Operating Rules; M-RETS Operating Procedures

attributes.name: rps_compliance_year
attributes.description: The RPS compliance obligation year to which this REC transaction is applied. State PUC RPS programs require utilities to demonstrate compliance by retiring sufficient RECs for each annual compliance period. Populated for RPS-type transactions; null for voluntary transactions.
attributes.references: State RPS Program Rules; State PUC Annual RPS Compliance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: rto_iso_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization / Independent System Operator (RTO/ISO) Region
attributes.description: The Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) region in which the generation facility is located. Determines applicable market rules, registry requirements, and RPS eligibility criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|PJM|MISO|ERCOT|NYISO|ISO-NE|SPP|WECC|non-RTO — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000; NERC Regional Entity Boundaries; State RPS Geographic Eligibility Rules

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which financial settlement for the REC transaction was completed, including payment exchange between counterparties. May differ from transaction_date for forward or deferred settlement arrangements. Used for revenue recognition and GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: trade_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Bilateral trade confirmation number exchanged between Power and Utilities and the counterparty at the time of deal execution, prior to registry transfer. Distinct from the registry_confirmation_number which is issued by the registry post-transfer. Used for pre-settlement reconciliation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; EEI Master Power Purchase and Sale Agreement

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event date on which the REC transaction was executed or agreed upon between counterparties. Used as the primary date for RPS compliance period assignment and FERC market-based rate reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; State RPS Compliance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: transaction_fee
attributes.description: Registry or broker fees assessed on this REC transaction, expressed in US Dollars (USD). Includes WREGIS, M-RETS, or NAR registry transfer fees and any applicable brokerage commissions. Deducted from gross amount to derive net settlement amount.
attributes.references: WREGIS Fee Schedule; M-RETS Fee Schedule; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this REC transaction, formatted as REC-{YYYY}-{sequence}. Used in counterparty communications, registry submissions, and regulatory filings with state PUCs. Corresponds to the transaction reference number in the REC registry system.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; M-RETS Operating Procedures; NAR Program Rules

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the REC transaction workflow. 'pending' indicates awaiting registry confirmation; 'confirmed' indicates registry transfer acknowledged; 'settled' indicates financial settlement complete; 'retired' indicates RECs permanently retired for compliance; 'cancelled' indicates transaction voided; 'disputed' indicates counterparty or registry dispute in progress.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; State RPS Compliance Program Rules

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the REC transaction by its business purpose. 'transfer' indicates a registry account-to-account transfer; 'retirement' indicates permanent retirement of RECs for RPS or voluntary compliance; 'purchase' indicates acquisition of RECs from a counterparty; 'sale' indicates disposition of RECs to a counterparty.
attributes.references: WREGIS Operating Rules; State RPS Program Rules; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this REC transaction record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer data product, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to detect record changes for downstream incremental processing and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: vintage_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the electricity underlying the RECs was generated. REC vintage is a critical eligibility criterion for state RPS compliance programs — many states restrict eligible RECs to those generated within a specific vintage window.
attributes.references: State RPS Eligibility Rules; WREGIS Operating Rules; DOE REC Guidance

products.name: transmission_right
products.description: Master record for financial transmission rights (FTRs) and transmission congestion contracts (TCCs) held by the utility for congestion hedging. Captures right type (FTR obligation, FTR option, TCC, ARR/auction revenue right), source pricing node, sink pricing node, MW quantity, path direction, auction round, term (monthly, seasonal, annual, long-term), acquisition cost ($), current mark-to-market value ($), and expiration date. Each FTR references source and sink pricing nodes for path definition. Used to hedge transmission congestion costs between generation and load delivery points and manage LMP basis spread exposure in the wholesale market portfolio.
products.reference: FERC Order 888 / RTO/ISO FTR Auction Rules (PJM/MISO/ISO-NE)

attributes.name: transmission_right_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each financial transmission right or transmission congestion contract record held by the utility. Primary key for the transmission_right data product.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.capex_project. Business justification: FTR/CRR acquisitions may be linked to transmission capital projects for cost recovery analysis and rate base treatment. Enables tracking of transmission investment hedging strategy and regulatory cost

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Transmission rights are managed by specific departments (transmission planning, wholesale trading) with budget accountability. Cost center enables tracking of FTR/CRR portfolio costs, hedging effectiv

attributes.name: cost_recovery_mechanism_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.cost_recovery_mechanism. Business justification: Transmission hedging costs (FTR/CRR) recovered through specific riders. Links financial transmission rights to regulatory cost recovery mechanisms for congestion cost recovery.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wholesale energy trading portfolio or book to which this transmission right is assigned. Enables aggregation of FTR/TCC positions by portfolio for risk management, P&L reporting, and IRP resource adequacy analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; IRP Standards

attributes.name: primary_transmission_pricing_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source pricing node that defines the injection point of the FTR/TCC path. The LMP at the source node is used in congestion settlement calculations. Corresponds to the generation or injection location in the RTO nodal model.

attributes.name: prudency_docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.docket. Business justification: Transmission rights (FTR/CRR) acquisition costs are subject to regulatory prudency review. Links hedging instruments to regulatory proceedings for cost recovery approval and reasonableness determinati

attributes.name: rto_iso_id
attributes.description: FK to market.rto_iso

attributes.name: source_pnode_pricing_node_id
attributes.description: FK to market.pricing_node

attributes.name: transmission_pricing_node_id
attributes.description: FK to market.pricing_node

attributes.name: wholesale_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the RTO/ISO or secondary market counterparty from whom this transmission right was acquired or to whom it may be transferred. For primary auction acquisitions, the counterparty is typically the RTO/ISO itself.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: The total cost paid by the utility to acquire this transmission right at auction, expressed in US dollars. A positive value indicates a premium paid; a negative value indicates revenue received (counter-flow FTRs may have negative acquisition costs). Used for portfolio cost basis tracking and FERC market-based rate reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; GAAP ASC 815 — Derivatives and Hedging

attributes.name: acquisition_method
attributes.description: Indicates how the transmission right was obtained. PRIMARY_AUCTION indicates acquisition through the RTO/ISO annual or monthly FTR auction. SECONDARY_MARKET indicates purchase from another market participant. BILATERAL indicates a negotiated bilateral transfer. ALLOCATION indicates the right was allocated by the RTO/ISO (e.g., ARR conversion).

attributes.name: auction_clearing_price
attributes.description: The price per MW at which this transmission right cleared in the RTO/ISO FTR auction, expressed in dollars per megawatt ($/MW). Used to calculate total acquisition cost and benchmark against secondary market prices.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; RTO/ISO FTR Auction Rules

attributes.name: auction_round
attributes.description: Identifies the specific RTO/ISO FTR auction round in which this transmission right was acquired (e.g., 'PJM-2024-ANN-R1', 'MISO-2024-MON-JAN'). Used to trace the right back to its originating auction event for audit and portfolio analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; RTO/ISO FTR Auction Rules

attributes.name: auction_year
attributes.description: The planning year (four-digit calendar year) associated with the FTR auction in which this right was acquired. Used for portfolio grouping, annual budget reporting, and IRP resource adequacy analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; IRP Resource Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: congestion_zone_sink
attributes.description: The congestion zone or load zone designation at the sink end of the transmission right path, as defined by the RTO/ISO. Used for zone-level aggregation and LMP basis spread exposure analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; RTO/ISO Zonal Pricing Tariff

attributes.name: congestion_zone_source
attributes.description: The congestion zone or load zone designation at the source end of the transmission right path, as defined by the RTO/ISO. Used for zone-level aggregation and basis risk analysis when nodal-level detail is not required.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; RTO/ISO Zonal Pricing Tariff

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this transmission right record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FERC Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: cumulative_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The total net congestion settlement revenue or cost received or paid to date for this transmission right since its effective date, expressed in US dollars. Positive values indicate net revenue received; negative values indicate net payments made. Supports portfolio performance tracking and FERC reporting.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the transmission right becomes effective and eligible for congestion settlement. Marks the beginning of the right's term as defined in the RTO/ISO auction award.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; RTO/ISO FTR Tariff Provisions

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the transmission right expires and is no longer eligible for congestion settlement. After this date the right has no further financial obligation or entitlement.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; RTO/ISO FTR Tariff Provisions

attributes.name: ferc_market_rate_auth_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Market-Based Rate Authority Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transmission right position is reportable under the utility's FERC market-based rate authority. True indicates the position must be included in FERC Electric Quarterly Report (EQR) filings and market power screens.
attributes.references: FERC Order 697 — Market-Based Rate Authority; FERC EQR Reporting

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: Accounting designation of the transmission right under GAAP ASC 815. CASH_FLOW_HEDGE designates the right as hedging variability in future cash flows from LMP congestion exposure. FAIR_VALUE_HEDGE designates it as hedging changes in fair value of a recognized asset or liability. ECONOMIC_HEDGE indicates the right provides economic offset but does not qualify for hedge accounting. SPECULATIVE indicates the right is held for trading or arbitrage purposes.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 815 — Derivatives and Hedging; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: irp_resource_adequacy_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) Resource Adequacy Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transmission right is counted as part of the utility's IRP resource adequacy portfolio for regulatory planning purposes. True indicates the right is included in IRP transmission hedging strategy; False indicates it is held for other purposes (e.g., speculative or short-term trading).
attributes.references: State PUC IRP Requirements; DOE IRP Guidelines

attributes.name: last_settlement_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which a congestion settlement payment was processed for this transmission right by the RTO/ISO. Used to confirm settlement currency and identify rights with outstanding or delayed settlements.

attributes.name: lmp_basis_spread
attributes.description: The expected or realized LMP congestion price differential between the sink and source pricing nodes, expressed in dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh). Represents the basis spread this right is intended to hedge. Used in portfolio risk analytics and IRP congestion cost modeling.

attributes.name: mark_to_market_value
attributes.description: The current fair market value of the transmission right expressed in US dollars, based on the most recent secondary market prices or RTO/ISO valuation. Used for financial reporting under GAAP ASC 815 fair value accounting and portfolio risk management.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 815 — Derivatives and Hedging; FERC Order 681

attributes.name: mtm_valuation_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the mark-to-market value was last calculated or updated. Required for financial reporting to confirm the currency of the fair value estimate.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 815 — Derivatives and Hedging; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: mw_quantity
attributes.description: The capacity quantity of the transmission right expressed in megawatts (MW). Represents the notional MW amount for which the holder receives or pays the congestion component of LMP between source and sink nodes. Determines the settlement payment magnitude.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; RTO/ISO FTR Auction Rules

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing supplementary information about the transmission right, such as special auction conditions, regulatory filing references, portfolio strategy rationale, or operational constraints not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: right_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO auction system or internal portfolio management system to uniquely identify this FTR or TCC instrument. Used for reconciliation with RTO settlement statements.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; PJM/MISO/CAISO FTR Auction Rules

attributes.name: right_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the directional flow of the transmission right along the source-to-sink path. FORWARD denotes flow from source pricing node to sink pricing node. COUNTER denotes the reverse direction, used for counter-flow FTRs that hedge congestion in the opposite direction.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; PJM Manual 06 — Financial Transmission Rights

attributes.name: right_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transmission right instrument. FTR_OBLIGATION entitles the holder to receive or pay the congestion component of LMP between source and sink. FTR_OPTION provides the right but not the obligation to collect congestion revenue. TCC (Transmission Congestion Contract) is the NYISO equivalent. ARR (Auction Revenue Right) is a pre-cursor entitlement used in some RTO markets to participate in FTR auctions.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; NERC Glossary of Terms

attributes.name: term_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the duration class of the transmission right as defined by the RTO/ISO auction structure. MONTHLY rights are acquired in monthly auctions. SEASONAL rights span a defined seasonal period. ANNUAL rights cover a full planning year. LONG_TERM rights extend beyond one year and are subject to long-term FTR auction rules under FERC Order 681.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; FERC Order 712 — Long-Term FTRs

attributes.name: transfer_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transmission right is eligible for transfer or sale in the secondary market under applicable RTO/ISO tariff rules. True indicates the right may be transferred; False indicates it is non-transferable (e.g., certain ARR allocations).
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; RTO/ISO FTR Tariff Provisions

attributes.name: transmission_right_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the transmission right. ACTIVE indicates the right is within its effective term and eligible for settlement. EXPIRED indicates the term has ended. CANCELLED indicates the right was terminated prior to expiration. PENDING indicates the right has been awarded but not yet effective. SURRENDERED indicates the holder voluntarily returned the right to the RTO.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; RTO/ISO FTR Tariff Provisions

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this transmission right record was most recently modified in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to detect stale records and support incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FERC Record Retention Requirements

products.name: pricing_node
products.description: Reference master for all RTO/ISO pricing nodes (pnodes), aggregated pricing nodes (APnodes), load zones, and hub nodes relevant to the utility's market participation. Captures pnode ID, pnode name, pnode type (generator bus, load zone, hub, interface), RTO/ISO affiliation, associated substation or bus, effective date range, and geographic coordinates. Foundational reference for LMP price lookups, FTR path definitions, and bid location mapping.
products.reference: RTO/ISO Pnode Registry (PJM / MISO / ISO-NE / CAISO)

attributes.name: pricing_node_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the pricing node record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this master resource entity.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff Schedules

attributes.name: apnode_pricing_node_id
attributes.description: The RTO/ISO-assigned identifier of the aggregated pricing node (APNode) that groups this generator bus node for scheduling and settlement purposes. APNodes are used in CAISO and similar markets to aggregate multiple generator buses under a single scheduling point. Null for non-generator-bus node types.
attributes.references: CAISO Tariff Section 27; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: hub_node_id
attributes.description: The RTO/ISO-assigned identifier of the virtual trading hub node associated with this pricing node. Hub nodes (e.g., PJM Western Hub, CAISO NP15 Hub) serve as reference points for bilateral contract pricing and FTR settlement. Null for non-hub node types.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; RTO/ISO Tariff; CAISO Business Practice Manual

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Pricing nodes at generation interconnection points or major substations must link to physical asset locations for LMP analysis, congestion cost allocation, transmission planning studies, and spatial c

attributes.name: ancillary_services_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing node is eligible to provide ancillary services (regulation up/down, spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, voltage support) in the RTO/ISO market. Used for ancillary services bid mapping and capacity obligation tracking.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; NERC BAL-001; RTO/ISO Ancillary Services Tariff

attributes.name: bus_number
attributes.description: The electrical bus number in the transmission network model (power flow model) corresponding to this pricing node. Used in SCADA/EMS systems (ABB or GE Energy Management System) for state estimation, contingency analysis, and LMP decomposition into energy, congestion, and loss components.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 399; NERC MOD-032; ABB/GE EMS Network Model

attributes.name: capacity_market_zone
attributes.description: The capacity market zone or locational deliverability area (LDA) designation assigned by the RTO/ISO for capacity market obligations and auctions (e.g., PJM MAAC, EMAAC; NYISO Zone J; ISO-NE NEMA). Used for resource adequacy analysis in the IRP and capacity auction bid preparation.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; PJM Manual 18; NYISO Installed Capacity Manual; ISO-NE Tariff

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which this pricing node is located (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Relevant for cross-border interface nodes and international transmission interconnections.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FERC OATT; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: dam_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing node is eligible for Day-Ahead Market (DAM) bid submission and settlement. True for nodes that can participate in the DAM; False for nodes restricted to real-time or ancillary services markets only.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO DAM Tariff; CAISO Business Practice Manual for Market Operations

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pricing node became effective and eligible for LMP settlement and market participation. Defines the start of the node's active period for historical LMP price lookups and FTR path eligibility. Aligns with RTO/ISO market effective date conventions.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; RTO/ISO Market Operations Manual; CAISO Business Practice Manual

attributes.name: ems_node_code
attributes.description: The node identifier in the ABB or GE Energy Management System (EMS) network model corresponding to this pricing node. Used for state estimation, contingency analysis, and real-time LMP decomposition into energy, congestion, and loss components.
attributes.references: ABB/GE EMS Network Model; NERC MOD-032; FERC Order 693

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pricing node ceased to be effective. Null for currently active nodes. Used to support slowly changing dimension (SCD) logic in the Silver Layer and to bound historical LMP settlement lookups to the node's valid period.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; RTO/ISO Market Operations Manual; Databricks Lakehouse SCD Type 2

attributes.name: ftr_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing node is eligible as a source or sink point for Financial Transmission Rights (FTR) path definitions. FTR eligibility is required for congestion hedging in the utility's wholesale market portfolio.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681; RTO/ISO FTR Auction Manual; PJM Manual 06

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: The primary fuel type of the generation resource associated with this pricing node when node type is generator_bus. Used for RPS compliance tracking, GHG emissions reporting, REC eligibility determination, and IRP resource mix analysis. Null for load zone, hub, and interface node types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: natural_gas|nuclear|coal|hydro|wind|solar|oil|geothermal|storage|biomass|waste|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA eGRID; RPS State Regulations; FERC Form 1; DOE EIA Form 860

attributes.name: ghg_emissions_factor
attributes.description: The greenhouse gas emissions factor in metric tons of CO2 equivalent per megawatt-hour (tCO2e/MWh) for the generation resource at this pricing node. Used for GHG emissions reporting to the EPA, state environmental regulators, and internal carbon accounting. Null for non-generator node types.
attributes.references: EPA eGRID; EPA 40 CFR Part 75; California AB 32; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: gis_feature_code
attributes.description: The ESRI ArcGIS feature identifier for the spatial representation of this pricing node in the utility's GIS network dataset. Enables spatial joins for transmission planning, outage impact analysis, and LMP geographic visualization.
attributes.references: ESRI ArcGIS Network Dataset; IEEE Std 1366; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: installed_capacity_mw
attributes.description: The nameplate or installed generation capacity in megawatts (MW) associated with this pricing node when node type is generator_bus. Used for capacity market obligation calculations, resource adequacy assessments in the IRP, and NERC reliability reporting. Null for load zone, hub, and interface node types.
attributes.references: NERC MOD-025; FERC Form 1; DOE EIA Form 860; RTO/ISO Capacity Market Manual

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: WGS84 decimal degree latitude of the pricing node's physical location. Used for geographic visualization in ESRI ArcGIS, spatial analysis of congestion patterns, and mapping of LMP heat maps for IRP and transmission planning studies.
attributes.references: WGS84 (EPSG:4326); ESRI ArcGIS Spatial Reference; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: lmp_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the LMP reference price (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency environments for cross-border nodes and international market participation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: lmp_reference_price
attributes.description: The most recently published or baseline reference LMP in dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh) for this pricing node. Serves as a reference value for contract pricing, FTR valuation, and IRP resource adequacy analysis. Not a real-time or interval value — use the lmp_interval_data product for time-series LMP data.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO LMP Settlement Manual; CAISO OASIS

attributes.name: load_zone_code
attributes.description: The RTO/ISO-assigned load zone identifier to which this pricing node belongs or aggregates into. Load zones are used for zonal LMP settlement, capacity market obligations, and demand response program administration. Null for hub and interface node types.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Tariff; FERC Order 888; PJM Manual 27

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: WGS84 decimal degree longitude of the pricing node's physical location. Used in conjunction with latitude for geographic visualization, spatial congestion analysis, and GIS-based transmission planning in ESRI ArcGIS.
attributes.references: WGS84 (EPSG:4326); ESRI ArcGIS Spatial Reference; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: market_region
attributes.description: The sub-regional market area or control zone within the RTO/ISO to which this pricing node belongs (e.g., CAISO NP15, SP15, ZP26; PJM PSEG zone; MISO Zone 7). Used for zonal LMP aggregation, load forecasting, and congestion analysis.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Tariff; FERC OATT; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: nerc_balancing_authority
attributes.description: The NERC-registered Balancing Authority (BA) area code responsible for maintaining load-generation balance at this pricing node's location (e.g., CISO, PJM, MISO). Required for NERC reliability reporting, FERC Form 714 submissions, and transmission planning studies.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001; NERC Reliability Standards; FERC Form 714

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pricing node. Active nodes are eligible for LMP settlement and bid submission. Inactive or retired nodes are retained for historical settlement reference only.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Market Operations Manual; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special market conditions, or configuration remarks associated with this pricing node. Used by market operations staff to document node-specific considerations such as pending RTO/ISO reclassifications, temporary suspension reasons, or FTR path restrictions.

attributes.name: pnode_code
attributes.description: The externally-assigned unique identifier for this pricing node as published by the RTO/ISO (e.g., CAISO, PJM, MISO, ERCOT). This is the business-facing key used in market settlement systems, LMP price lookups, and bid submissions. Maps to the pnode_id field in RTO/ISO market data feeds.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO OATT Tariff; CAISO Business Practice Manual for Market Operations

attributes.name: pnode_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the pricing node as designated by the RTO/ISO. Used in market reports, settlement statements, and bid location mapping. Examples include generator bus names, load zone names, and hub designations.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Market Participant Guide; FERC OATT

attributes.name: pnode_owner_type
attributes.description: Classifies the ownership relationship of the utility to this pricing node. Utility-owned nodes correspond to the utility's own generation or load assets; third-party nodes are associated with counterparty assets relevant to PPA or bilateral contracts; RTO virtual nodes are hub or interface constructs with no physical owner; jointly-owned nodes reflect shared transmission assets.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; FERC Form 1; PPA Contract Terms

attributes.name: pnode_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing node by its functional role in the wholesale market. Generator bus nodes represent individual generation injection points; load zone nodes represent aggregated load areas; hub nodes are virtual trading points; interface nodes represent inter-regional tie points; aggregated pnodes (APnodes) aggregate multiple generator buses for scheduling purposes.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; CAISO Tariff Section 27; PJM Manual 27

attributes.name: rec_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the generation resource at this pricing node is eligible to generate Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) for RPS compliance. Applicable only to generator_bus node types with qualifying renewable fuel types (wind, solar, hydro, geothermal, biomass).
attributes.references: State RPS Regulations; WREGIS; NEPOOL GIS; PJM-EIS GATS; DOE EERE

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this pricing node record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SCD Type 2 history management. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards; SOX Section 404; GAAP

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this pricing node record was most recently updated in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards; SOX Section 404; GAAP

attributes.name: rtm_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing node is eligible for Real-Time Market (RTM) dispatch and settlement. True for nodes participating in the RTM; False for nodes limited to DAM or forward market products only.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO RTM Tariff; CAISO Business Practice Manual for Market Operations

attributes.name: rto_iso_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization / Independent System Operator (RTO/ISO) Code
attributes.description: Identifies the RTO or ISO that administers this pricing node and publishes its LMP prices. Determines which market rules, settlement procedures, and tariff provisions apply. Essential for multi-RTO utilities to partition market data by jurisdiction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|PJM|MISO|ERCOT|NYISO|ISO-NE|SPP|WECC — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000; NERC Reliability Standards; DOE Energy Information Administration

attributes.name: scada_point_code
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI or GE Proficy historian tag identifier for the real-time telemetry point associated with this pricing node. Enables linkage between the market pricing node and real-time SCADA measurements for dispatch verification, settlement validation, and operational analytics.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; GE Proficy Historian; NERC CIP-007; FERC Order 693

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system from which this pricing node record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse and ETL reconciliation. RTO_* codes indicate direct feeds from RTO/ISO market data APIs; INTERNAL_EMS indicates the utility's own EMS network model. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RTO_CAISO|RTO_PJM|RTO_MISO|RTO_ERCOT|RTO_NYISO|RTO_ISONE|RTO_SPP|INTERNAL_EMS — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage; ETL Framework Standards; FERC Market Data Reporting

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation (USPS standard) indicating the state jurisdiction in which this pricing node is physically located. Used for state PUC regulatory reporting, RPS compliance tracking, and jurisdictional cost allocation.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; NARUC Regulatory Reporting; State PUC Tariff Filings

attributes.name: substation_code
attributes.description: The utility's internal substation or bus identifier to which this pricing node is physically associated. Links the market pricing node to the physical grid asset in the GIS and EAM systems (ESRI ArcGIS, Oracle WAM/IBM Maximo). Used for FTR path definitions and outage impact analysis.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 693; NERC FAC-001; ESRI ArcGIS Network Dataset

attributes.name: transmission_owner_code
attributes.description: The FERC-registered identifier or internal code of the transmission owner responsible for the physical transmission facilities at this pricing node. Used for OATT cost allocation, transmission service requests, and FERC Form 1 regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; FERC Form 1; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: voltage_kv
attributes.description: The nominal operating voltage level in kilovolts (kV) at this pricing node's associated bus. Distinguishes transmission-level nodes (e.g., 115 kV, 230 kV, 500 kV) from distribution-level injection points. Used in network model validation and FTR eligibility determination.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 141; NERC FAC-001; FERC OATT

products.name: participant_registration
products.description: Reference master for the utility's own registered market participant identities across multiple RTOs/ISOs. Captures participant ID assigned by each RTO/ISO, market registration type (load-serving entity, generator owner, transmission owner, marketer), FERC market-based rate docket number, registration effective date, and active market products authorized (energy, capacity, ancillary services, FTR). Supports FERC compliance and multi-RTO market operations.
products.reference: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority / RTO/ISO Market Registration

attributes.name: participant_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each market participant registration record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Serves as the primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: ancillary_services_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility is authorized to offer ancillary services (regulation, spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, reactive power) in the RTO/ISO market under this registration.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; NERC Reliability Standards; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: capacity_market_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility is authorized to participate in the capacity market (e.g., PJM RPM, MISO Planning Resource Auction) under this registration. True if authorized for capacity obligations and auctions.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff; NERC Resource Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: collateral_requirement_usd
attributes.description: The total collateral amount in US dollars required by the RTO/ISO to cover the utility's market exposure under this registration. Determined by the RTO/ISO based on credit rating, market activity, and unsecured credit limits.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Tariff; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this participant registration record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer record management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: The credit rating assigned by the credit rating agency to the utility entity for purposes of satisfying RTO/ISO collateral and credit requirements. Determines unsecured credit limits and collateral posting obligations in the market.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Tariff; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: The credit rating agency that issued the credit rating used to satisfy the RTO/ISO credit and collateral requirements for market participation. RTO/ISOs require participants to demonstrate creditworthiness.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Tariff; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: dam_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility is authorized to submit bids and offers in the Day-Ahead Market (DAM) under this registration. Supports scheduling and financial settlement for next-day energy positions.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or doing-business-as name used by the utility in market operations, if different from the legal entity name. May appear on market communications and RTO/ISO portals.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the market participant registration became effective and the utility was authorized to participate in the RTO/ISO market. Aligns with the RTO/ISO acceptance date and FERC authorization.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: energy_market_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility is authorized to participate in the energy market (Day-Ahead Market and Real-Time Market) under this registration. True if authorized for energy bids and offers.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: ferc_mbr_authorization_date
attributes.description: The date on which FERC granted market-based rate authority to the utility under the referenced docket number. Establishes the legal basis for wholesale energy market participation.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; 18 CFR Part 35

attributes.name: ferc_mbr_docket_number
attributes.description: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission docket number associated with the utility's market-based rate authorization. Format follows FERC docket numbering convention (e.g., ER22-1234-000). Required for FERC compliance, rate case management, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; 18 CFR Part 35

attributes.name: ferc_mbr_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: FERC Market-Based Rate (MBR) Authorization Expiration Date
attributes.description: The date on which the FERC market-based rate authorization expires and must be renewed. Null if the authorization is indefinite. Supports regulatory compliance monitoring and renewal workflow triggers.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; 18 CFR Part 35

attributes.name: ftr_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility is authorized to hold and trade Financial Transmission Rights (FTRs) in the RTO/ISO market under this registration. FTRs are used to hedge against congestion costs in LMP-based markets.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; OATT; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: irp_resource_adequacy_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) Resource Adequacy Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this market participant registration is associated with resource adequacy obligations under the utility's Integrated Resource Plan (IRP). True if the registration supports IRP-tracked capacity commitments.
attributes.references: State PUC IRP Requirements; NERC Resource Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: last_amended_date
attributes.description: The date on which the market participant registration was most recently amended or updated with the RTO/ISO or FERC. Tracks the currency of the registration and triggers compliance review workflows.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the utility entity as registered with the RTO/ISO and on file with FERC. Must match the name on the FERC market-based rate authorization and RTO/ISO membership agreement.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: lse_load_zone
attributes.description: The RTO/ISO-designated load zone associated with the utility's load-serving entity registration. Determines the applicable zonal LMP for load settlement and capacity market obligations. Applicable when participant_type includes load_serving_entity.

attributes.name: market_region
attributes.description: The geographic market region or zone within the RTO/ISO footprint where the utility is registered to participate (e.g., PJM-WEST, MISO-Central, CAISO-NP15). Relevant for Locational Marginal Price (LMP) settlement and capacity market zone assignments.

attributes.name: membership_agreement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the utility executed the RTO/ISO membership or participation agreement. Establishes the contractual start of the market relationship.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Tariff; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: membership_agreement_number
attributes.description: The agreement or contract number assigned by the RTO/ISO for the utility's membership or participation agreement. Serves as the binding contractual reference for market participation rights and obligations.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Tariff; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: nerc_function_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of NERC functional entity registration codes applicable to this participant (e.g., BA=Balancing Authority, TO=Transmission Owner, GO=Generator Owner, LSE=Load-Serving Entity, DP=Distribution Provider). Supports NERC compliance reporting and reliability standard applicability determination.
attributes.references: NERC Rules of Procedure; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: nerc_registered_entity_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned by the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) to the utility as a registered reliability entity (e.g., Transmission Operator, Balancing Authority, Generator Operator). Links market participation to NERC reliability compliance obligations.
attributes.references: NERC Rules of Procedure; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: oatt_filing_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT) Filing Date
attributes.description: The date on which the utility filed its Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT) with FERC, establishing the terms and conditions for transmission service. Relevant for transmission owner registrations.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; FERC Order 890; 18 CFR Part 35

attributes.name: participant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the utility's role in the wholesale energy market as registered with the RTO/ISO. Determines which market products and services the participant is authorized to transact. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: load_serving_entity|generator_owner|transmission_owner|marketer|power_marketer|distribution_utility|combined_utility — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; OATT; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person responsible for market operations and RTO/ISO communications under this registration. Used for regulatory correspondence, market notices, and settlement dispute communications.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the utility responsible for market operations and RTO/ISO communications under this registration. Used for regulatory correspondence and RTO/ISO notifications.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person responsible for market operations and RTO/ISO communications under this registration.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: rec_tracking_program
attributes.description: The REC tracking registry or program in which the utility is enrolled under this market registration for tracking and retiring Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) to demonstrate RPS compliance (e.g., GATS, M-RETS, WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GATS|MRETS|WREGIS|NEPOOL-GIS|PJM-GATS|ERCOT-REC|NAR — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
