attributes.references: State PUC RPS Regulations; DOE Renewable Energy Standards; EPA Green Power Partnership

attributes.name: registration_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing supplementary information about the market participant registration, including special conditions, regulatory caveats, pending amendments, or operational notes relevant to market compliance and operations.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the market participant registration with the RTO/ISO. Active indicates full market participation rights; suspended indicates temporary restriction; terminated indicates the registration has been withdrawn or revoked.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the regulatory affairs contact responsible for FERC filings and compliance activities associated with this market registration.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; 18 CFR Part 35

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the regulatory affairs contact responsible for FERC filings, rate case management, and PUC compliance activities associated with this market registration. May differ from the primary market operations contact.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; 18 CFR Part 35

attributes.name: rps_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this market participant registration is associated with Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance activities, including Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) tracking and procurement.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Regulations; DOE Renewable Energy Standards

attributes.name: rtm_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility is authorized to participate in the Real-Time Market (RTM) under this registration. Supports real-time dispatch, imbalance settlement, and deviation management.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: rto_iso_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code identifying the Regional Transmission Organization or Independent System Operator with which this registration is held. Used as a denormalized reference for reporting and filtering without requiring a join to the RTO/ISO reference table. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|MISO|CAISO|ERCOT|NYISO|ISO-NE|SPP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rto_iso_participant_code
attributes.description: The unique participant identifier assigned by the specific RTO/ISO to the utility as a registered market participant. This is the externally-known business identifier used in all market communications, bid submissions, and settlement statements with the RTO/ISO (e.g., PJM participant ID, CAISO SCID). Essential for FERC compliance and market operations.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The U.S. state(s) in which the utility holds a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) and is subject to state Public Utility Commission (PUC) jurisdiction. Relevant for aligning market participation with state-level regulatory obligations and IRP requirements.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the market participant registration was terminated or is scheduled to terminate. Null for active, open-ended registrations. Used for historical tracking and FERC compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: unsecured_credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: The maximum unsecured credit limit in US dollars extended by the RTO/ISO to the utility under this registration, based on credit rating and financial standing. Amounts above this limit require collateral posting.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Tariff; FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this participant registration record was most recently updated in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: virtual_bidding_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility is authorized to submit virtual bids (increment offers / decrement bids) in the Day-Ahead Market under this registration. Virtual bidding is used for financial arbitrage between DAM and RTM prices.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Authority; RTO/ISO Tariff

products.name: settlement_line_item
products.description: Transactional detail record for individual charge and credit line items within an RTO/ISO wholesale market settlement statement. Captures charge type (energy, capacity, ancillary service, uplift, OATT, revenue sufficiency guarantee, make-whole payment), charge code, billing determinant (MW, MWh), rate ($/MWh or $/MW-day), line amount ($), pricing node, settlement interval, market product, and GL account mapping. Each line item references its parent settlement statement. Essential for shadow settlement verification, dispute resolution, FERC Form 1 Schedule 2 reporting, and granular GL posting of wholesale market costs and revenues.

attributes.name: settlement_line_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the settlement line item record. Primary key for the settlement line item entity.

attributes.name: capacity_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the capacity market obligation associated with this settlement line item. Links capacity charges and credits to specific auction commitments and delivery obligations.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the generation or demand response resource associated with this settlement line item. Identifies the physical or virtual asset that generated the charge or credit.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Each settlement line item must post to a specific GL account for financial statement preparation and FERC reporting. Core accounting integration for revenue recognition, expense matching, and regulato

attributes.name: original_line_item_settlement_line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the original settlement line item that this record adjusts or replaces. Creates an audit trail for resettlements and dispute adjustments.

attributes.name: participant_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the wholesale market participant responsible for this settlement line item. Identifies the counterparty for the transaction.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the PPA contract associated with this settlement line item. Links wholesale market settlements to bilateral contract positions for hedge accounting and portfolio management.

attributes.name: pricing_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the pricing node (pnode) where the energy or service was delivered or received. Links settlement charges to specific locations in the transmission grid for LMP-based settlement.

attributes.name: rto_iso_id
attributes.description: FK to market.rto_iso

attributes.name: settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent settlement statement. Each line item belongs to exactly one settlement statement issued by the RTO/ISO.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for any adjustment to the original settlement line item. Documents meter data corrections, tariff interpretation changes, or dispute resolutions that trigger resettlement.

attributes.name: ancillary_service_type
attributes.description: Type of ancillary service for which this line item applies. Identifies the specific grid reliability service procured or provided (regulation, reserves, voltage support, black start capability).

attributes.name: billing_determinant_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the billing determinant (MW, MWh, MW-day, or other unit) used to calculate the line item charge. Represents the volume of energy, capacity, or service delivered or consumed.

attributes.name: billing_determinant_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the billing determinant quantity. Specifies whether the charge is based on energy (MWh), capacity (MW), demand (MW-day), or reactive power (MVAR).

attributes.name: charge_code
attributes.description: Detailed RTO/ISO-specific charge code identifying the exact settlement product or service. Maps to the ISO tariff schedule and enables granular GL posting and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: charge_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the charge or credit line item. Provides business context for the settlement transaction and supports audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: High-level category of the settlement charge or credit. Classifies the line item into major wholesale market product categories for financial reporting and analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: energy|capacity|ancillary_service|transmission|congestion|loss|uplift|make_whole_payment|revenue_sufficiency_guarantee|oatt_charge|administrative_fee|penalty|credit_adjustment — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement line item record was first created in the lakehouse. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the line amount. Typically USD for U.S. RTOs/ISOs, CAD for Canadian markets, or MXN for Mexican markets.

attributes.name: dispute_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number for any dispute filed against this settlement line item. Links to the RTO/ISO dispute resolution process and tracks contested charges through adjudication.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for regulatory reporting. Classifies the line item into standardized FERC accounts for Schedule 2 (Purchased Power) and other FERC Form 1 schedules.

attributes.name: line_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount for this settlement line item. Calculated as billing determinant quantity multiplied by rate per unit, plus any adjustments. Positive values represent charges; negative values represent credits.

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent settlement statement. Used for ordering and referencing specific charges or credits within the statement.

attributes.name: line_item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the settlement line item. Tracks whether the charge is preliminary, final, under dispute, or has been adjusted through resettlement.

attributes.name: lmp_congestion_component
attributes.description: Congestion component of the Locational Marginal Price. Reflects the cost of transmission constraints and is used to allocate congestion charges and Financial Transmission Rights (FTR) revenues.

attributes.name: lmp_energy_component
attributes.description: Energy component of the Locational Marginal Price used in settlement calculation. Represents the marginal cost of serving the next increment of load at the pricing node, excluding congestion and losses.

attributes.name: lmp_loss_component
attributes.description: Loss component of the Locational Marginal Price. Represents the marginal cost of electrical losses in the transmission system between the pricing node and the system reference bus.

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Wholesale market in which the transaction occurred. Distinguishes between Day-Ahead Market (DAM), Real-Time Market (RTM), capacity auctions, and ancillary services markets.

attributes.name: operating_date
attributes.description: Operating day for which the settlement charge or credit applies. Used for daily aggregation and reporting of wholesale market costs and revenues.

attributes.name: operating_hour
attributes.description: Operating hour (0-23) within the operating date. Supports hourly settlement analysis and peak/off-peak cost allocation.

attributes.name: rate_per_unit
attributes.description: Unit rate applied to the billing determinant to calculate the line item amount. Expressed in currency per unit (e.g., USD per MWh, USD per MW-day). May represent LMP, capacity clearing price, or ancillary service rate.

attributes.name: rec_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the energy associated with this settlement line item is eligible for Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) generation. Supports RPS compliance tracking and REC inventory management.

attributes.name: settlement_interval_end_timestamp
attributes.description: End timestamp of the settlement interval to which this line item applies. Defines the conclusion of the operating period for the settled transaction.

attributes.name: settlement_interval_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Start timestamp of the settlement interval to which this line item applies. Defines the beginning of the operating period for energy, capacity, or ancillary service delivery.

attributes.name: settlement_period
attributes.description: Settlement period identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO. Typically formatted as YYYYMM or a billing cycle code. Used to group line items into monthly or periodic settlement runs.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier from the RTO/ISO settlement system. Enables reconciliation between the utility internal settlement database and the ISO published settlement data.

attributes.name: statement_run_type
attributes.description: Type of settlement run that produced this line item. Distinguishes between initial settlements, final settlements, resettlements due to meter data corrections, and dispute adjustments.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement line item record was last modified. Tracks changes through resettlement cycles and dispute resolution processes.

attributes.name: netting_settlement_line_item_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on settlement_line_item (netting_settlement_line_item_id)

products.name: rto_iso
products.description: Master reference table for rto_iso. Referenced by rto_iso_id.

attributes.name: rto_iso_id
attributes.description: Primary key for rto_iso

attributes.name: ancillary_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RTO/ISO operates markets for ancillary services such as regulation, spinning reserves, and non-spinning reserves.

attributes.name: api_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RTO/ISO provides programmatic API access for market data retrieval.

attributes.name: capacity_market_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RTO/ISO operates a capacity market for resource adequacy obligations.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for market operations and participant support inquiries.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for market operations and participant support inquiries.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RTO/ISO master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_publication_lag_hours
attributes.description: Typical lag time in hours between market operations and public data availability for LMP, load, and generation data.

attributes.name: day_ahead_market_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RTO/ISO operates a day-ahead energy market for forward commitment and scheduling.

attributes.name: ferc_approved_date
attributes.description: Date when FERC granted approval for the RTO/ISO to operate as a market operator.

attributes.name: financial_transmission_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RTO/ISO offers financial transmission rights or congestion revenue rights for hedging congestion costs.

attributes.name: geographic_footprint
attributes.description: Description of the geographic territory covered by the RTO/ISO, typically listing states or provinces within the service area.

attributes.name: headquarters_address
attributes.description: Physical address of the RTO/ISO headquarters office.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City where the RTO/ISO headquarters is located.

attributes.name: headquarters_country
attributes.description: Country where the RTO/ISO headquarters is located. Typically USA or CAN for North American markets.

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the RTO/ISO headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: State or province where the RTO/ISO headquarters is located.

attributes.name: lmp_pricing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RTO/ISO uses locational marginal pricing methodology for energy settlement.

attributes.name: market_monitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the independent market monitor responsible for oversight and reporting on market performance and participant behavior.

attributes.name: market_participant_portal_url
attributes.description: Web address for the RTO/ISO market participant portal used for bid submission, scheduling, and settlement access.

attributes.name: market_settlement_currency
attributes.description: Currency used for financial settlement of energy transactions. Typically USD for US markets, CAD for Canadian markets.

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Classification of the market operator type: RTO (Regional Transmission Organization), ISO (Independent System Operator), or Non-RTO for bilateral markets.

attributes.name: member_utilities_count
attributes.description: Number of utility companies that are members or participants in the RTO/ISO.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the Regional Transmission Organization or Independent System Operator.

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.description: NERC regional entity jurisdiction where the RTO/ISO primarily operates. Used for reliability coordination and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special considerations regarding the RTO/ISO operations, market structure, or data integration requirements.

attributes.name: oasis_url
attributes.description: Web address for the RTO/ISO OASIS system providing transmission availability and reservation information.

attributes.name: operational_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the RTO/ISO ceased market operations, if applicable. Null for active operators.

attributes.name: operational_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the RTO/ISO began market operations and settlement activities.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the RTO/ISO in the wholesale energy market.

attributes.name: peak_load_mw
attributes.description: Historical peak demand load in megawatts served by the RTO/ISO footprint. Used for capacity planning and resource adequacy analysis.

attributes.name: population_served_millions
attributes.description: Estimated population in millions served by utilities within the RTO/ISO footprint.

attributes.name: real_time_market_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RTO/ISO operates a real-time energy market for balancing and dispatch.

attributes.name: rto_iso_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the RTO/ISO in market systems and regulatory filings. Examples: PJM, CAISO, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP, ERCOT.

attributes.name: settlement_cycle_days

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Governs procurement of materials, equipment, fuel, and services for utility operations. Manages vendor/contractor master records, purchase orders, contracts, inventory management, warehousing, and logistics for generation fuel, T&D equipment, and O&M supplies. Integrates with ERP (SAP S/4HANA) for procurement-to-pay and supports CAPEX project material management and storm restoration logistics.
domains.references: ISM Procurement Standards, GAAP Inventory Accounting

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all vendors, suppliers, and contractors engaged by the utility for procurement of materials, equipment, fuel, and services. Captures vendor identity, classification (material supplier, fuel supplier, T&D contractor, generation services, professional services, IT vendor), tax identifiers (EIN/TIN), remittance addresses, payment terms (Net 30/45/60), preferred currency, bank details for EFT, diversity classification (MBE/WBE/SBE/SDVOB), OSHA safety rating (EMR), insurance certificate status and expiration, bonding capacity, prequalification status, and SAP S/4HANA vendor master number (LFA1). Serves as the SSOT for vendor identity across procurement-to-pay workflows, contractor safety management, and supplier diversity reporting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master (LFA1/LFB1)

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor record. Primary key.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor bank account number for EFT payment processing. Encrypted at rest and in transit per PCI DSS standards.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution holding the vendor's account for Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) payments.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number for the vendor's bank. Used for ACH and wire transfer payments.

attributes.name: bonding_capacity_usd
attributes.description: Maximum dollar value of performance and payment bonds the vendor can secure from surety. Critical for large CAPEX construction projects (transmission lines, substations, generation plant construction). Expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Primary classification of vendor by service or product category. Material supplier provides T&D equipment and O&M supplies; fuel supplier provides coal, natural gas, or uranium for generation; T&D contractor performs transmission and distribution construction and maintenance; generation services provides plant O&M and outage support; professional services includes engineering, legal, and consulting; IT vendor provides software, hardware, and technology services.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or doing-business-as name if different from legal name. Used for operational communications and invoice matching.

attributes.name: diversity_classification
attributes.description: Supplier diversity certification status. Minority Business Enterprise (MBE), Women Business Enterprise (WBE), Small Business Enterprise (SBE), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business (SDVOB), or other diversity designations. Supports regulatory supplier diversity reporting and corporate social responsibility goals. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mbe|wbe|sbe|sdvob|dbe|lgbtbe|vbe|none — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number for vendor identity verification, credit assessment, and supplier risk management.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_status
attributes.description: Status of the vendor's certificate of insurance (COI) demonstrating required liability, workers compensation, and other coverage. Current indicates valid coverage on file; expired triggers procurement hold; pending indicates renewal in process.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the vendor's current certificate of insurance. Monitored for proactive renewal to avoid procurement disruption.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor record was most recently updated. Audit field for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase order, invoice, or payment transaction with the vendor. Used to identify inactive vendors for master data cleanup.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the vendor organization as registered with governing authorities. Used for contract execution, tax reporting, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified the vendor record. Supports audit trail and accountability for master data changes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional vendor information, special handling instructions, performance notes, or procurement restrictions not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: osha_emr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Experience Modification Rate (EMR)
attributes.description: OSHA Experience Modification Rate (EMR) reflecting the vendor's workplace safety record. EMR below 1.0 indicates better-than-average safety performance; above 1.0 indicates higher incident rates. Used for contractor prequalification and risk assessment for T&D and generation services contractors.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for remitting payment to the vendor. Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) and Automated Clearing House (ACH) are standard for recurring payments; wire transfer for large or urgent payments; check for vendors without electronic banking; credit card for small purchases.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the vendor. Net 30/45/60/90 indicates payment due within that number of days from invoice date; 2/10 Net 30 offers 2% discount if paid within 10 days, otherwise net 30.

attributes.name: preferred_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for vendor invoicing and payment (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Determines currency for purchase orders and remittance.

attributes.name: prequalification_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor's prequalification status expires and must be renewed. Typically annual or biennial review cycle.

attributes.name: prequalification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has completed and passed the utility's prequalification process for technical capability, financial stability, safety record, and regulatory compliance. Prequalified vendors are eligible for competitive bidding on major projects.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary vendor contact for purchase order acknowledgments, invoice inquiries, and operational coordination.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the vendor organization for procurement and operational communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the primary vendor contact.

attributes.name: remittance_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for vendor payment remittance. Used for check mailing and correspondence.

attributes.name: remittance_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for vendor payment remittance (suite, floor, building).

attributes.name: remittance_city
attributes.description: City for vendor payment remittance address.

attributes.name: remittance_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for vendor payment remittance address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: remittance_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for vendor payment remittance address.

attributes.name: remittance_state
attributes.description: State or province code for vendor payment remittance address. Two-letter US state code or equivalent.

attributes.name: since_date
attributes.description: Date the vendor relationship was established and the vendor record was first created in the system. Used for vendor tenure analysis and relationship management.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) for the vendor. Required for IRS Form 1099 reporting and tax compliance.

attributes.name: vendor_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the vendor as recorded in SAP S/4HANA vendor master (LFA1-LIFNR). Used in procurement-to-pay workflows, purchase orders, and invoice processing.

attributes.name: vendor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor relationship. Active vendors are approved for procurement; prequalified vendors have passed initial screening but not yet transacted; suspended vendors are temporarily blocked due to performance or compliance issues; disqualified vendors are permanently barred; pending approval vendors are under review.

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Categorization of vendor by transaction type. Goods vendors supply materials and equipment; services vendors provide labor, consulting, or professional services; goods and services vendors provide both.

attributes.name: w9_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRS Form W-9 On File Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a current IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification) is on file for the vendor. Required for 1099 reporting and tax compliance.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Public website URL for the vendor organization. Used for vendor research, catalog access, and due diligence.

products.name: material_master
products.description: Enterprise catalog of all procurable materials, equipment, and spare parts used across generation, T&D, and gas infrastructure operations. Captures material number, description, material group, unit of measure, hazardous material classification, UNSPSC commodity code, lead time, reorder point, safety stock level, standard cost, and storage class. Aligned with SAP MM material master (MARA/MARC) and supports CAPEX project BOM management and storm restoration kitting. Distinct from the asset domain's physical asset records — this is the catalog definition, not the installed asset instance.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Material Master (MARA/MARC/MARD)

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material master record. Primary key for the material catalog.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Hazmat materials have specific regulatory obligations for storage, handling, labeling, and reporting under EPA and OSHA regulations. Material master records must reference applicable compliance obliga

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Inventory management classification based on consumption value and criticality. A-items are high-value/high-usage; C-items are low-value/low-usage. Used for cycle counting and reorder prioritization.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure for inventory and procurement transactions. Examples: EA (each), FT (feet), LB (pounds), GAL (gallons), TON (tons), KWH (kilowatt-hours), MCF (thousand cubic feet).

attributes.name: batch_managed_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material requires batch-level tracking for quality control, traceability, and expiration management.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the material master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deletion_indicator
attributes.description: Flag marking the material for deletion. Materials flagged for deletion cannot be used in new transactions but remain for historical reporting.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material meets environmental regulations and sustainability standards (e.g., RoHS, REACH, EPA requirements).
attributes.references: EPA Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA), EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the material including packaging. Used for transportation planning and freight cost calculation.

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: Department of Transportation hazard class for hazardous materials (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 2 Gases). Null for non-hazardous materials.
attributes.references: PHMSA Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR Part 173)

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material is classified as hazardous and requires special handling, storage, and transportation procedures per OSHA and PHMSA regulations.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (29 CFR 1910.1200), PHMSA Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR)

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the material master record was last updated. Used for data governance and change tracking.

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Extended technical description providing detailed specifications, usage instructions, or technical characteristics of the material.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer or producer of the material.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original equipment manufacturer part number used for cross-referencing, warranty claims, and technical support.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short textual description of the material, equipment, or spare part. Used for display in purchase orders, work orders, and inventory transactions.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Hierarchical grouping code used for procurement analytics, vendor assignment, and inventory segmentation. Examples include transformers, cables, meters, coal, natural gas, safety equipment.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique material identifier used across procurement, inventory, and work management systems. Aligns with SAP material number or equivalent ERP material code.

attributes.name: material_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material in the catalog. Active materials are available for procurement; obsolete materials are phased out; restricted materials require special authorization.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the material distinguishing between raw materials, spare parts, equipment, consumables, fuel, services, and trading goods. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|spare_part|equipment|consumable|fuel|service|trading_good — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Upper inventory limit used to prevent overstocking and optimize warehouse space utilization.

attributes.name: moving_average_price
attributes.description: Weighted average cost per unit recalculated with each goods receipt. Used for materials valued at moving average price.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master (MBEW-VERPR), GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: Planning strategy code defining how the material is replenished (e.g., reorder point planning, forecast-based planning, consumption-based planning).

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the material excluding packaging. Used for technical specifications and load calculations.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time_days
attributes.description: Expected lead time in days from purchase order creation to goods receipt. Used for MRP planning and project material scheduling.

attributes.name: plant_specific_status
attributes.description: Material status at the plant or warehouse level, allowing different availability across locations (e.g., active at one plant, restricted at another).

attributes.name: price_control_indicator
attributes.description: Defines the valuation method for the material: standard cost or moving average price.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is procured externally from vendors, produced/transferred internally, or both.

attributes.name: purchase_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure used for procurement and purchase order creation. May differ from base UOM when materials are purchased in bulk (e.g., purchased by pallet but stocked by each).

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or procurement team responsible for sourcing this material. Used for workload distribution and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Inventory level threshold that triggers automatic replenishment. When stock falls below this level, a purchase requisition is generated.

attributes.name: safety_stock_level
attributes.description: Minimum inventory buffer maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Critical for storm restoration and emergency response materials.

attributes.name: serial_number_profile
attributes.description: Configuration code defining serial number management requirements. Used for high-value equipment and assets requiring individual tracking.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum storage duration in days before the material expires or degrades. Critical for chemicals, lubricants, and perishable materials.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard unit cost used for inventory valuation, project costing, and financial reporting. Updated periodically through cost roll-up processes.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master (MBEW-STPRS), GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: storage_class
attributes.description: Warehouse storage classification defining storage conditions and location requirements (e.g., indoor, outdoor, climate-controlled, hazmat-certified).

attributes.name: unspsc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Standard Products and Services Code (UNSPSC)
attributes.description: Eight-digit commodity classification code used for spend analytics, supplier discovery, and regulatory reporting. Aligns with global procurement standards.

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Accounting classification code that determines the general ledger accounts for inventory postings (e.g., raw materials, spare parts, fuel inventory).

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Physical volume of the material used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume (e.g., CFT for cubic feet, M3 for cubic meters, GAL for gallons).

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for weight fields (e.g., LB for pounds, KG for kilograms, TON for tons).

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Authoritative transactional record for all purchase orders issued to vendors for materials, equipment, fuel, and services. Captures PO number, PO type (standard, blanket, framework, service), vendor reference, plant/delivery location, requested delivery date, total PO value, currency, payment terms, incoterms, approval status, SAP S/4HANA document number, and associated cost object (WBS element for CAPEX, cost center for OPEX). Supports procurement-to-pay cycle from requisition through goods receipt and invoice verification.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Purchase Order (EKKO/EKPO)

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order record. Primary key for the purchase order entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Purchase orders are issued against cost center budgets for budget control and encumbrance accounting. Budget managers approve POs against their cost center allocations, fundamental to utility procurem

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.docket. Business justification: Rate case proceedings and prudency reviews require PO documentation for capital expenditure justification. Regulatory audits trace approved rate base investments back to procurement records. Essential

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement specialist or purchasing agent responsible for this PO. Links to employee master record.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: PO encumbrances post to GL accounts for commitment accounting and funds reservation. Required for accurate available budget calculations and preventing over-commitment of budgeted funds in utility fin

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_contract. Business justification: Purchase orders can be created as releases against procurement contracts (blanket POs, fuel contracts). Currently denormalized as contract_number (STRING). Adding procurement_contract_id FK enables co

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or contractor providing the materials, equipment, fuel, or services. Links to vendor master record in ERP system.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the purchase order received final authorization from the approving authority based on delegation of authority matrix and spending thresholds.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the manager or executive who provided final approval for this purchase order based on spending authority limits.

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the procurement specialist responsible for this purchase order. Denormalized for reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date the purchase order was cancelled before fulfillment. Used for tracking procurement process failures and vendor performance issues.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for purchase order cancellation (e.g., project cancelled, vendor unable to deliver, duplicate order, budget cut). Supports root cause analysis for procurement process improvement.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date the purchase order was administratively closed after all goods receipts, invoice verifications, and payments were completed. Marks the end of the procurement-to-pay cycle.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity code in the ERP system representing the utility company or subsidiary issuing the purchase order. Used for financial consolidation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase order record was first created in the ERP system. Audit trail for procurement cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the purchase order monetary values. Typically USD for US-based utilities, but may vary for international procurement or fuel hedging contracts.

attributes.name: delivery_address
attributes.description: Full physical address for material delivery or service performance location. May differ from plant master address for field construction or emergency restoration sites.

attributes.name: erp_document_number
attributes.description: Native document identifier from SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud. Provides traceability to source system for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: Shipping, transportation, or logistics charges associated with material delivery. May be vendor-charged or utility-arranged depending on incoterms.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether goods receipt posting is required for this PO. True for materials requiring inventory management and quality inspection; false for services and direct-charge items.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between buyer and seller for transportation and delivery. Critical for imported equipment and international fuel procurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether invoice verification is required before payment. Supports three-way match control (PO, goods receipt, invoice) for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update to the purchase order record. Tracks changes to quantities, prices, delivery dates, or status throughout the procurement lifecycle.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Commodity classification or material category for purchased items (e.g., transformers, conductors, natural gas, coal, IT hardware, professional services). Used for spend analytics and category management.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms negotiated with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, Net 45, 2/10 Net 30). Defines due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master Payment Terms

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Destination facility, power plant, substation, service center, or warehouse where materials or services will be delivered or performed. Links to asset location master.

attributes.name: po_date
attributes.description: Date the purchase order was created and issued to the vendor. Establishes the contractual commitment date and payment terms baseline.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the purchase order. Unique document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud for procurement tracking and vendor communication.

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the purchase order in the procurement-to-pay workflow. Tracks progression from creation through goods receipt and final closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|issued|partially_received|fully_received|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order based on procurement strategy. Standard for one-time purchases, blanket for recurring material releases, framework for long-term agreements, service for labor/consulting, contract for multi-year commitments.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Urgency classification for procurement processing and vendor expediting. Emergency and critical priorities used for storm restoration and forced outage response.

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date committed by the vendor for delivery or service completion. Used for supplier performance tracking and expediting follow-up.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Specialized procurement team or category management group responsible for specific material classes or vendor relationships (e.g., generation fuel, T&D equipment, IT services).

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for procurement activities. Typically aligned with business unit, region, or legal entity for centralized or decentralized procurement models.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the utility requires materials or services to be delivered. Drives vendor lead time planning and expediting priorities for outage restoration or project schedules.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Source purchase requisition document number that originated this PO. Provides traceability from internal demand to external procurement.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific warehouse, yard, or inventory storage area within the plant where materials will be received and stocked.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax, use tax, or value-added tax (VAT) applicable to the purchase order based on jurisdiction and material tax classification.

attributes.name: total_po_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the purchase order including all line items, before taxes and freight. Represents the committed spend amount for budget tracking and vendor payment.

attributes.name: total_po_value_with_tax
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Purchase Order (PO) Value with Tax
attributes.description: Grand total of the purchase order including base value, taxes, and freight. Represents the maximum payment obligation to the vendor.

attributes.name: vendor_site_code
attributes.description: Specific vendor location or branch code for multi-site suppliers. Identifies the remit-to address and payment processing location.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Project work breakdown structure element for CAPEX purchases tied to capital projects (new generation capacity, transmission line construction, substation upgrades). Enables AFUDC calculation and asset capitalization.

products.name: po_line_item
products.description: Individual line-item detail within a purchase order, representing a specific material, equipment item, or service quantity and price. Captures line number, material reference (linked to material_master for stock items), ordered quantity, unit of measure, unit price, net value, delivery schedule date, account assignment category (cost center for OPEX, WBS element for CAPEX, asset number for direct capitalization), goods receipt indicator, and service entry sheet flag for service POs. Enables granular tracking of multi-line POs for T&D equipment procurement, generation fuel orders, and O&M supply requisitions. Supports three-way match at line level and CAPEX/OPEX cost allocation.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA PO Item (EKPO)

attributes.name: po_line_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order line item. Primary key for the po_line_item product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - EKPO table

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_master. Business justification: Capital equipment purchases must link to asset master for AFUDC calculation, depreciation start date, regulatory asset base inclusion, and FERC account classification. Utilities capitalize equipment a

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the material master record for stock items. Links to the specific material, equipment, or supply being procured (e.g., transformers, conductors, generation fuel, meters, tools). Null for service-only line items.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_contract. Business justification: PO line items can be release orders against blanket purchase agreements or fuel supply contracts. This FK links the release to the master contract, enabling contract spend tracking, quantity commitmen

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent purchase order header. Links this line item to its containing purchase order document.

attributes.name: account_assignment_category
attributes.description: Category code that determines how the line item cost will be allocated in the financial system. K=Cost Center (OPEX), A=Asset (direct capitalization), P=Project/WBS Element (CAPEX), F=Order (internal order), N=Network (project network). Critical for proper CAPEX/OPEX classification and regulatory cost recovery.

attributes.name: confirmation_control_key
attributes.description: Control key that determines whether and how the vendor must confirm the purchase order line item. Used for critical or long-lead-time materials (e.g., large transformers, generation turbines) where vendor acknowledgment of delivery dates is required before proceeding.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code for OPEX account assignment (when account_assignment_category = K). Identifies the organizational unit responsible for the expense, such as a generation plant O&M cost center, T&D maintenance cost center, or administrative department.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this line item record was first created in the system. Represents the initial capture of the line item as part of the purchase order creation process. Used for audit trail and procurement cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit price and net value. Typically USD for U.S. utilities, but may vary for international procurement or cross-border fuel purchases.

attributes.name: deletion_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this line item has been marked for deletion. True if the line item is logically deleted (soft delete) but retained for audit trail. False for active line items. Deleted line items are excluded from goods receipt and invoice processing.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Scheduled delivery date for this line item. Represents the date by which the material or service is expected to be delivered or performed. Critical for generation fuel delivery schedules, storm restoration material logistics, and CAPEX project material planning.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for financial posting. Determines the expense or asset account to which the line item cost will be posted. For utilities, this includes accounts for fuel inventory, materials and supplies, construction work in progress (CWIP), and O&M expenses per the FERC Uniform System of Accounts.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a goods receipt (GR) is required for this line item. True for material line items that require physical receipt confirmation. False for service line items or limit items where goods receipt is not applicable. Used to control three-way match logic (PO-GR-Invoice).

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Incoterms code defining the delivery terms and transfer of risk between buyer and seller (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). Determines who pays for shipping, insurance, and customs, and when title transfers. Critical for fuel procurement and international equipment purchases.

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named location associated with the Incoterms code (e.g., port of shipment, destination facility). Specifies the geographic point where risk and cost responsibility transfer per the Incoterms agreement.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Category of the line item that determines procurement processing rules. Standard=normal material procurement, Consignment=vendor-owned inventory, Subcontracting=material provided to vendor for processing, Service=service procurement with service entry sheet, Limit=value-based item without quantity, Text=informational text line.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the purchase order. Determines the ordering and position of this line item within the parent PO document.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the line item. Open=awaiting delivery, Partially_received=some quantity received, Fully_received=all quantity received, Invoiced=invoice posted, Closed=administratively closed, Cancelled=line item cancelled. Drives procurement workflow and three-way match processing.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original equipment manufacturer (OEM) part number for the material. Critical for T&D equipment and generation spare parts where OEM specifications must be maintained for warranty, safety, and regulatory compliance. Used for asset management and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material or service being procured. For stock materials, this typically mirrors the material master description. For non-stock items and services, this is a free-text description entered at line creation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this line item record was last modified. Captures changes to quantity, price, delivery date, or other line item attributes. Used for change tracking and procurement audit compliance.

attributes.name: net_value
attributes.description: Total net value of this line item, calculated as ordered_quantity multiplied by unit_price, before taxes and additional charges. This is the base procurement cost for this line item and is used for three-way match validation and cost allocation to CAPEX or OPEX accounts.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material or service ordered on this line item. Expressed in the unit of measure specified in the uom field. For materials, this is the physical quantity (e.g., 100 meters of cable, 5 transformers). For services, this may represent hours, days, or service units.

attributes.name: over_delivery_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by which the delivered quantity may exceed the ordered quantity without requiring approval. For example, 5.00 allows up to 5% over-delivery. Used to accommodate normal shipping variances while controlling excess inventory and cost overruns.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Plant or facility code where the material will be received or the service will be performed. For utilities, this may represent a generation plant, service center, warehouse, or regional operations center. Links to the organizational structure for inventory management and cost allocation.

attributes.name: requisitioner_name
attributes.description: Name of the employee or department that originated the purchase requisition leading to this PO line item. Used for procurement tracking, approval workflow, and accountability for material and service requests.

attributes.name: service_entry_sheet_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a service entry sheet is required for this line item. True for service line items where service performance must be confirmed before invoice approval. False for material line items. Used for contractor labor, engineering services, and maintenance services.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Service Entry Sheet

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Storage location code within the plant where the material will be stocked upon receipt. Used for warehouse management and inventory tracking of T&D equipment, generation spare parts, and O&M supplies. Null for direct-to-project deliveries or service line items.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code that determines the applicable sales tax, use tax, or VAT treatment for this line item. Tax treatment varies by jurisdiction, material type (e.g., fuel may be tax-exempt), and account assignment (CAPEX vs OPEX). Used for invoice verification and tax reporting.

attributes.name: under_delivery_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage by which the delivered quantity may fall short of the ordered quantity without requiring follow-up action. For example, 2.00 allows up to 2% under-delivery. Used to close line items with minor shortages without administrative burden.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit of measure for this line item. Expressed in the currency specified in the currency_code field. For materials, this is the negotiated or catalog price per unit. For services, this is the rate per service unit (e.g., hourly rate for contractor labor).

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the ordered quantity. Standard utility procurement units include EA (each), M (meter), FT (foot), GAL (gallon), TON (ton), HR (hour), KWH (kilowatt-hour), MCF (thousand cubic feet), BBL (barrel) for fuel oil, and service-specific units.

attributes.name: vendor_material_number
attributes.description: Vendor's own material or catalog number for the item being procured. Used for cross-reference between the utility's material master and the vendor's product catalog. Facilitates order processing and invoice reconciliation with vendor systems.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: WBS element code for CAPEX project account assignment (when account_assignment_category = P). Links the line item to a specific capital project such as a transmission line upgrade, substation expansion, generation plant construction, or AMI deployment project. Enables project cost tracking and AFUDC calculation.

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Transactional record capturing the physical receipt of materials and equipment at a utility warehouse, storeroom, or project site against a purchase order. Records GR document number, posting date, PO reference, PO line item reference, delivery note number, vendor packing slip reference, received quantity, unit of measure, receiving storage location (linked to warehouse), movement type (101 standard receipt to unrestricted stock, 103 GR to blocked/quality inspection stock, 105 release from quality inspection), quality inspection required flag, inspection outcome (accepted, rejected, partially accepted), batch/lot number for traceable materials, and receiving plant. Triggers inventory stock position update and initiates the three-way match process (PO–GR–invoice) in SAP S/4HANA. Critical for CAPEX project material tracking, storm restoration supply chain verification, and inventory valuation posting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Goods Receipt (MKPF/MSEG, Movement Type 101)

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the goods receipt transaction. Primary key for the goods receipt record in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CAPEX project if the goods receipt is for project-specific materials. Links to capital project tracking for T&D infrastructure upgrades, generation plant construction, or major asset installations.

attributes.name: compliance_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_event. Business justification: Hazmat and fuel receipts trigger environmental compliance tracking. Spills, quality violations, and storage incidents during receiving must be documented for EPA and state reporting. Links material mo

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Goods receipts charge actual material costs to cost centers for budget consumption tracking. Essential for converting PO encumbrances to actual expenses and tracking cost center spend against budget i

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Goods receipts post to GL accounts for inventory valuation (asset accounts) or direct expense recognition. Required for three-way match (PO-GR-Invoice), inventory accounting, and FERC plant accounting

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_master. Business justification: Receiving capital equipment triggers asset capitalization, installation tracking, and in-service date determination for depreciation and rate base. Utilities must link goods receipts to asset records

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the item received. Links to the material catalog for T&D equipment, generation fuel, or O&M supplies.

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.meter. Business justification: Three-way match process: PO → goods receipt → meter installation. Utilities receive serialized meters into inventory and must track which specific meter was received against which PO. Critical for ass

attributes.name: po_line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.po_line_item. Business justification: Goods receipts are posted against specific PO line items, not just the header. Currently denormalized as po_line_item_number (INT). Adding po_line_item_id FK enables precise 3-way matching (PO line →

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this goods receipt is posted. Links to the originating procurement document.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor master record from whom the materials were received. Links to the supplier providing the goods.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse. Business justification: Goods receipts are physically received at specific warehouses. Currently denormalized as storage_location_code and plant_code. Adding warehouse_id FK normalizes receiving location and enables warehous

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work order if the goods receipt is for maintenance or operational work. Links to asset management work order for O&M supplies or equipment repairs.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number assigned to the received materials for traceability. Critical for materials requiring batch management such as chemicals, fuels, or serialized equipment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the goods receipt record was first created in the ERP system. Audit field for data lineage and record creation tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the valuation amount. Typically USD for US-based utilities.

attributes.name: delivery_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt completes the delivery for the purchase order line item. True if no further deliveries are expected; false if partial delivery with more to come.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Delivery note or shipment document number provided by the vendor. Used to match physical delivery documentation with the goods receipt.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date on the goods receipt document itself, typically the date the physical receipt occurred. May differ from posting date if there is a delay in system entry.

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known goods receipt document number generated by the ERP system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: gr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt transaction. Posted indicates the GR is complete and inventory updated; pending inspection indicates quality hold; reversed indicates the GR was cancelled or corrected.

attributes.name: inspection_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the quality inspection process. Accepted materials move to unrestricted stock; rejected materials are returned to vendor or scrapped; partially accepted materials are split between accepted and rejected quantities.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the goods receipt record was last updated in the ERP system. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code indicating the nature of the goods receipt. Common types: 101 (GR to unrestricted stock), 103 (GR to blocked/quality inspection stock), 105 (release from quality inspection), 161 (return delivery to vendor), 501 (receipt without PO).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by receiving personnel regarding the goods receipt. May include observations about packaging condition, discrepancies, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: over_delivery_tolerance_exceeded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received quantity exceeds the over-delivery tolerance defined in the purchase order. True if the receipt quantity is beyond acceptable limits and requires approval.

attributes.name: packing_slip_reference
attributes.description: Vendor packing slip or bill of lading reference number. Provides traceability to the vendors shipping documentation.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the goods receipt was posted in the ERP system. Determines the accounting period for inventory valuation and financial posting.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received materials require quality inspection before being released to unrestricted stock. True if inspection is mandatory per material master or vendor agreement.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material physically received and recorded in this goods receipt transaction. Used for inventory stock position update and three-way match.

attributes.name: receiving_person_name
attributes.description: Name of the warehouse or storeroom personnel who physically received and verified the materials. Provides accountability for the receipt transaction.

attributes.name: receiving_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the materials were physically received at the storage location. Captures the actual receipt event time for logistics and supply chain analytics.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the reversal transaction if this goods receipt was reversed. Links to the correcting GR document for audit trail.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt has been reversed or cancelled. True if the GR was subsequently reversed due to error, return to vendor, or other correction.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number for individually tracked equipment or materials. Used for high-value assets such as transformers, meters, or specialized T&D equipment requiring unique identification.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stock status after goods receipt. Unrestricted stock is available for use; blocked stock is held pending inspection or resolution; quality inspection stock is under testing; restricted stock has usage limitations.

attributes.name: under_delivery_tolerance_exceeded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received quantity is below the under-delivery tolerance defined in the purchase order. True if the receipt quantity is insufficient and requires follow-up.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the received quantity. Common utility units include EA (each), FT (feet), M (meters), KG (kilograms), GAL (gallons), TON (tons), MCF (thousand cubic feet), THERM (heat energy unit), KWH (kilowatt-hour), MWH (megawatt-hour). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|FT|M|KG|LB|GAL|L|TON|MCF|THERM|KWH|MWH — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: Total valuation amount for the goods receipt in the local currency. Calculated as received quantity multiplied by the material price from the purchase order. Posted to inventory and accounts payable.

products.name: procurement_contract
products.description: Master record for long-term supply agreements, blanket purchase agreements, fuel supply contracts, and framework contracts with vendors. Captures contract number, contract type (quantity contract, value contract, fuel PPA, service agreement), validity period, total contract value, minimum/maximum quantity commitments, price escalation clauses, fuel index linkage (e.g., Henry Hub for gas), renewal terms, and SAP outline agreement document number. Distinct from regulatory contracts (owned by regulatory domain) and customer service agreements (owned by customer domain).
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Outline Agreement (EKKO contract type)

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the procurement contract record. Primary key for the procurement contract entity.

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.docket. Business justification: Long-term fuel and equipment contracts require regulatory approval in rate cases and CPCN applications. Contracts are exhibits in regulatory filings. Prudency reviews examine contract terms and pricin

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or contractor party to this procurement contract. Links to vendor master record in ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system for payment terms, contact information, and performance history.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal amendments executed against this contract. High amendment counts may indicate scope creep, pricing volatility, or contract management challenges. Used for contract performance analysis and vendor relationship assessment.

attributes.name: base_price
attributes.description: Initial unit price or rate established at contract execution. For fuel contracts, may represent the base commodity price before index adjustments. For equipment, the negotiated unit price. For services, the hourly or daily rate. Subject to escalation clauses and index linkage adjustments over contract life.

attributes.name: commodity_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of goods or services covered by this contract. Examples include generation fuel (coal, natural gas, nuclear fuel), T&D equipment (transformers, conductors, poles), fleet services (vehicles, maintenance), IT hardware, professional services, or construction services. Used for spend analytics and category management.

attributes.name: contract_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the procurement contract received final internal authorization and was approved for execution. May represent board approval for high-value contracts, executive approval, or procurement authority approval depending on contract value and organizational delegation of authority.

attributes.name: contract_document_repository_path
attributes.description: File path or URL to the executed contract document and amendments in the enterprise document management system. Enables quick access to full contract terms for legal review, audit, or dispute resolution. May reference SharePoint, SAP DMS (Document Management System), or dedicated contract management system.

attributes.name: contract_execution_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was signed by both utility and vendor, making it legally binding. May differ from effective start date if contract includes a future commencement provision. Used for contract age analysis and audit trail.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the procurement contract. Used for vendor communication, invoice reconciliation, and cross-system reference. May follow organizational numbering schemes or SAP outline agreement document number format.

attributes.name: contract_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the utility employee responsible for managing this procurement contract. Typically a procurement specialist, category manager, or fuel supply manager. Accountable for contract performance monitoring, renewal negotiations, and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the procurement contract. Draft indicates contract under negotiation; pending approval awaiting internal authorization; active indicates contract in force and available for release; suspended temporarily halted; expired past validity period; terminated ended before expiration; closed completed and archived. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|expired|terminated|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement contract based on commitment structure. Quantity contract commits to specific volumes; value contract commits to dollar amounts; fuel PPA (Power Purchase Agreement) for generation fuel supply; service agreement for O&M (Operations and Maintenance) services; blanket PO (Purchase Order) for recurring purchases; framework agreement for multi-year supply arrangements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this procurement contract record was first created in the system. Represents initial data capture, which may precede contract negotiation completion. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for contract financial terms. Typically USD for domestic utility operations; may include CAD, MXN, or EUR for cross-border procurement or international equipment suppliers.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the procurement contract expires and is no longer available for new purchase order releases. Nullable for evergreen or open-ended contracts. May trigger renewal evaluation or contract closeout procedures.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) Contract Recognition

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the procurement contract becomes legally binding and available for purchase order release. Marks the beginning of the contract validity period.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) Contract Recognition

attributes.name: fuel_index_linkage
attributes.description: Specific commodity price index used for fuel contract price adjustments. Examples include Henry Hub natural gas spot price, NYMEX futures, regional coal price indices, or uranium spot price. Enables pass-through of commodity price volatility and aligns contract pricing with market conditions. Applicable primarily to generation fuel supply contracts.
