attributes.name: insurance_requirements
attributes.description: Contractually mandated insurance coverage the vendor must maintain. Typically includes general liability, workers compensation, professional liability (for service contracts), and automobile liability. May specify minimum coverage amounts and require utility to be named as additional insured. Critical for risk transfer and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent contract amendment or modification. Amendments may adjust pricing, quantities, scope, or terms. Nullable if no amendments have been executed. Used for contract change tracking and version control.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this procurement contract record. Captures updates to status, pricing, quantities, or any other contract attribute. Used for change tracking and data freshness assessment.

attributes.name: maximum_quantity_commitment
attributes.description: Contractually allowed maximum purchase quantity over the contract period. Protects vendor from unlimited demand and utility from supply shortages. Common in fuel supply contracts and equipment framework agreements. Nullable for open-ended service agreements.

attributes.name: minimum_quantity_commitment
attributes.description: Contractually obligated minimum purchase quantity over the contract period. Common in fuel supply contracts (e.g., minimum annual MCF (Thousand Cubic Feet) of natural gas or tons of coal) and equipment blanket orders. Failure to meet minimum may trigger penalties or price adjustments. Nullable for value contracts or service agreements without quantity commitments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional contract information, special conditions, negotiation history, or operational notes. May capture unique contract provisions, vendor relationship context, or procurement strategy rationale not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment schedule and conditions. Examples include Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30 (2% discount if paid within 10 days), progress payments for construction contracts, or milestone-based payments for project services. Impacts cash flow management and vendor relationship.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee
attributes.description: Contractual performance commitments and associated remedies. May include delivery time guarantees, quality specifications, service level agreements (SLAs), equipment performance warranties, or fuel quality specifications (BTU content, sulfur content). Defines vendor accountability and utility recourse for non-performance.

attributes.name: price_escalation_clause
attributes.description: Description of contractual price adjustment mechanism over time. May reference inflation indices (CPI, PPI), commodity indices (Henry Hub for natural gas, coal price indices), labor rate adjustments, or fixed annual percentage increases. Critical for multi-year contract cost forecasting and budget planning.

attributes.name: price_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for pricing. Examples include per MCF for natural gas, per ton for coal, per MWh for power, per each for equipment, per hour for labor services. Must align with quantity unit of measure for accurate cost calculation.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer group or category team responsible for this contract. Examples include generation fuel team, substation equipment team, fleet services team, or IT procurement team. Used for workload distribution and specialized procurement expertise.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit within the utility responsible for procurement activities under this contract. May represent corporate procurement, generation fuel procurement, T&D (Transmission and Distribution) materials, or regional procurement centers. Aligns with SAP purchasing organization structure.

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for quantity commitments and releases. Examples include MCF (Thousand Cubic Feet) or BCF (Billion Cubic Feet) for natural gas, tons for coal, MWh (Megawatt-Hour) for purchased power, each for equipment units, or hours for service contracts. Must align with vendor invoicing and inventory management units.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Contractual obligations for vendor compliance with utility industry regulations. May include NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) requirements for cyber security, OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) safety standards, EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) environmental regulations, or state PUC (Public Utility Commission) procurement rules. Ensures vendor activities do not create regulatory risk for utility.
attributes.references: NERC, FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission), EPA, OSHA, State PUC Regulations

attributes.name: renewal_terms
attributes.description: Contractual provisions for contract extension or renewal. May specify automatic renewal unless notice given, option periods with defined pricing, or requirement for renegotiation. Includes notice period requirements (e.g., 90 days prior to expiration) and conditions for renewal pricing adjustments.

attributes.name: sap_outline_agreement_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA system document number for the outline agreement (contract or scheduling agreement) record. Enables integration between procurement contract master data and SAP MM (Materials Management) purchase order release, goods receipt, and invoice verification processes. Critical for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system traceability.

attributes.name: termination_clause
attributes.description: Contractual provisions allowing early termination by either party. May include termination for convenience (with notice period and penalties), termination for cause (vendor non-performance, safety violations), force majeure provisions, or change-in-law provisions. Critical for risk management and contract flexibility.

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: Maximum financial commitment under this contract in USD (United States Dollars). For value contracts, represents the spending limit; for quantity contracts, represents estimated total value based on committed quantities and unit prices. Used for budget planning, spend tracking, and contract authority approval thresholds.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) Contract Valuation

products.name: inventory_stock
products.description: Real-time and period-end inventory stock position for materials held at utility warehouses, field storerooms, and generation plant stores. Tracks material reference (linked to material_master), storage location (linked to warehouse), unrestricted stock quantity, quality inspection stock, blocked stock, in-transit stock, reserved quantity (backed by material_reservation transactions), issued quantity (backed by goods_issue transactions), consignment stock, reorder point breach flag, safety stock breach flag, last physical inventory count date, and inventory valuation amount at standard or moving average cost. Supports O&M spare parts availability, storm restoration pre-positioning, CAPEX project material staging, and year-end physical inventory reconciliation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM inventory management (MARD/MSKU/MBEW). Stock position is updated by goods_receipt (increase), goods_issue (decrease), stock_transfer (rebalance), and material_reservation (commitment).
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Inventory Management (MARD/MSKU)

attributes.name: inventory_stock_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory stock position record. Primary key for the inventory_stock product.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record. Links to the material_master product to identify the specific material (spare part, equipment, fuel, consumable) held in inventory.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or storage location where the material is physically held. Links to the warehouse product to identify the facility (central warehouse, field storeroom, generation plant stores).

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC inventory classification based on consumption value or criticality. A = high-value/high-turnover items requiring tight control; B = moderate-value items; C = low-value/low-turnover items; X = unclassified or new materials. Used for cycle count frequency and inventory management strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MARC-ABCIN / inventory management best practices

attributes.name: blocked_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material blocked from use due to quality issues, damage, obsolescence, or regulatory hold. Material in this status cannot be issued and may require disposition (scrap, return to vendor, rework).

attributes.name: consignment_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material held on consignment from a vendor. Material is physically at the utility location but remains vendor-owned until consumed. Common for high-value spare parts and generation fuel.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory stock position record was first created in the system. Typically corresponds to the first goods receipt at this storage location for this material.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration or shelf-life end date for perishable or time-sensitive materials (chemicals, lubricants, safety equipment, medical supplies). Material should not be issued after this date. Null for non-perishable materials.

attributes.name: in_transit_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently in transit between storage locations or from vendor to warehouse. Material in this status is owned but not yet physically available at the destination location. Tracked via stock transfer orders.

attributes.name: issued_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of material issued from this stock position during the current period. Backed by goods_issue transactions. Used for consumption tracking and inventory turnover analysis.

attributes.name: last_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods issue transaction that decreased stock at this location. Used for inventory turnover analysis and obsolescence detection.

attributes.name: last_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt transaction that increased stock at this location. Used for inventory aging analysis and slow-moving stock identification.

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count (cycle count or annual inventory) performed for this material at this location. Used for inventory accuracy tracking and audit compliance. Regulatory requirements may mandate minimum count frequency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM ISEG-BUDAT / SOX inventory controls

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this inventory stock position record. Updated by goods receipt, goods issue, stock transfer, physical inventory, or reservation transactions. Used for data freshness validation and change tracking.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or vendor lot/batch number for lot-managed materials. Used for traceability, quality control, and recall management. Critical for generation fuel, chemicals, and safety equipment. May be null for non-lot-managed materials.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Maximum stock quantity threshold for this material at this location. Used to prevent overstocking and optimize working capital. Replenishment orders target this level. Breach indicates potential excess inventory.

attributes.name: moving_average_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Moving average cost per unit of measure for this material. Recalculated with each goods receipt based on actual purchase prices. Used for inventory valuation when moving average costing method is applied. Confidential business financial data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MBEW-VERPR / GAAP inventory valuation

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: Three-character code identifying the MRP controller or inventory planner responsible for managing replenishment and stock levels for this material. Used for workload distribution and accountability.

attributes.name: physical_inventory_variance_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity difference between system book stock and physical count from the last inventory count. Positive values indicate physical surplus; negative values indicate shortage. Used for inventory accuracy metrics and shrinkage analysis.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the utility plant or operational facility to which this inventory stock position belongs (generation plant, service center, operations hub).

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how this material is procured. External = purchased from vendors; internal = manufactured or transferred from other plants; both = can be procured either way. Drives replenishment logic.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently held in quality inspection status. Material in this status cannot be issued until quality control approval is received. Common for critical spare parts and generation fuel deliveries.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum stock level threshold that triggers automatic replenishment. When unrestricted stock falls below this level, a purchase requisition or stock transfer request is generated. Set based on lead time and consumption rate.

attributes.name: reorder_point_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the current unrestricted stock quantity has fallen below the reorder point threshold. True indicates replenishment action is required. Used for inventory exception reporting and automated procurement triggers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM inventory management logic

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material reserved for specific work orders, CAPEX projects, or planned maintenance activities. Reserved stock is committed but not yet issued. Backed by material_reservation transactions.

attributes.name: safety_stock
attributes.description: Minimum buffer stock level maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Safety stock is not intended for normal consumption and breach indicates critical shortage risk. Critical for storm restoration materials and generation spare parts.

attributes.name: safety_stock_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the current unrestricted stock quantity has fallen below the safety stock threshold. True indicates critical shortage condition requiring immediate attention. Triggers escalated replenishment and potential emergency procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM inventory management logic

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator for special stock types that require separate tracking. Project = stock allocated to specific CAPEX projects; sales_order = stock for specific customer orders; consignment = vendor-owned stock; returnable_packaging = containers/pallets; pipeline = in-transit between locations; subcontractor = stock at contractor site; none = standard stock. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: project|sales_order|consignment|returnable_packaging|pipeline|subcontractor|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: standard_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of measure for this material. Used for inventory valuation when standard costing method is applied. Represents the planned or budgeted cost per unit. Confidential business financial data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MBEW-STPRS / GAAP inventory valuation

attributes.name: stock_determination_group
attributes.description: Four-character code used for automatic stock determination logic in goods issue processes. Groups materials with similar characteristics for automated picking and allocation rules.

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the stock position. Available = normal stock levels; low_stock = below reorder point; out_of_stock = zero unrestricted quantity; excess = above maximum level; obsolete = material no longer used; inactive = location no longer stocking this material.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM inventory management logic

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: High-level categorization of stock ownership and purpose. Own = utility-owned unrestricted stock; consignment = vendor-owned stock at utility location; returnable_packaging = containers requiring return; project = stock allocated to specific projects.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the specific storage location within the warehouse (e.g., bin, aisle, zone). Used for physical inventory management and picking operations.

attributes.name: total_inventory_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the unrestricted stock quantity at this location, calculated as unrestricted_stock_quantity multiplied by the applicable cost per unit (standard or moving average). Used for balance sheet reporting and working capital analysis. Confidential business financial data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MBEW-SALK3 / GAAP inventory valuation

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for all quantity fields in this stock position record (e.g., EA for each, FT for feet, GAL for gallons, TON for tons). Aligns with the material master base UOM.

attributes.name: unrestricted_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material available for unrestricted use and issue. This is the freely available stock that can be issued to work orders, projects, or consumption without restrictions. Measured in the material base unit of measure (UOM).

attributes.name: valuation_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (standard cost, moving average cost, total valuation). Typically USD for US-based utilities.

products.name: warehouse
products.description: Master record for all utility warehouse facilities, field storerooms, and generation plant stores used for material storage and distribution. Captures warehouse number, warehouse name, facility type (central warehouse, field storeroom, generation plant store, mobile storm unit), physical address, GIS coordinates, storage capacity (sq ft, pallet positions), climate control capability, hazmat storage certification, responsible plant code, and operational status. Supports logistics planning for T&D equipment staging and storm restoration pre-positioning.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Warehouse Management (T001L storage location)

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the warehouse facility. Primary key for the warehouse master record.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Warehouses storing hazmat or PCB equipment must track facility-level compliance obligations (EPA storage permits, fire codes, OSHA safety requirements). Real process: facility compliance audits and pe

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the warehouse facility including street number and name. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building number, suite, or unit designation. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: backup_power_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility has backup power generation capability (e.g., diesel generator, battery storage) to maintain operations during grid outages. Critical for facilities supporting emergency restoration.

attributes.name: building_year
attributes.description: Year the warehouse facility was originally constructed. Used for asset age analysis and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the warehouse facility is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: climate_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility has climate control capabilities (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) required for temperature-sensitive materials and equipment.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for warehouse facility communications. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the warehouse facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code for tracking Operating Expenditure (OPEX) and Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) associated with warehouse operations. Used for financial reporting and budget management.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the warehouse facility is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the warehouse facility record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the warehouse facility ceased operations or was decommissioned. Null for currently active facilities.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the warehouse facility became operational and available for material storage and distribution.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warehouse facility based on its operational purpose and scope. Central warehouses serve as primary distribution hubs, field storerooms support local Transmission and Distribution (T&D) operations, generation plant stores support power plant Operations and Maintenance (O&M), mobile storm units provide emergency restoration logistics, and yards support outdoor equipment staging.

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system
attributes.description: Type of fire suppression system installed in the warehouse facility. Required for insurance compliance and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) safety standards.

attributes.name: hazmat_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the hazardous materials storage certification. Facilities must maintain current certification to store regulated substances.

attributes.name: hazmat_certification_number
attributes.description: Official certification number issued by regulatory authority for hazardous materials storage. Required for facilities storing regulated substances under Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) regulations.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility is certified for storage of hazardous materials including transformer oil, sulfur hexafluoride (SF6), and other regulated substances. Certification required by Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA).

attributes.name: inventory_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the inventory management system or Warehouse Management System (WMS) used at this facility. Supports integration with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud) for procurement-to-pay processes.

attributes.name: last_renovation_year
attributes.description: Year of the most recent major renovation or upgrade to the warehouse facility. Used for asset condition assessment and capital planning.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the warehouse facility record was most recently modified. Used for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the warehouse facility in decimal degrees. Used for Geographic Information System (GIS) mapping, logistics routing, and storm restoration planning. Integrates with ESRI ArcGIS for spatial analysis.

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the lease agreement for leased warehouse facilities. Used for contract management and facility planning. Null for owned facilities.

attributes.name: loading_docks
attributes.description: Number of loading docks available at the warehouse facility for receiving and shipping materials. Used for logistics capacity planning and delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the warehouse facility in decimal degrees. Used for Geographic Information System (GIS) mapping, logistics routing, and storm restoration planning. Integrates with ESRI ArcGIS for spatial analysis.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual responsible for day-to-day operations of the warehouse facility. Business reference, not direct Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the warehouse facility (e.g., Monday-Friday 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM). Used for logistics planning and material delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the warehouse facility. Active facilities are fully operational, inactive facilities are temporarily closed, seasonal facilities operate during specific periods (e.g., storm season), under construction facilities are being built or renovated, and decommissioned facilities are permanently closed.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of warehouse facility ownership. Owned facilities are utility-owned assets, leased facilities are under rental agreements, and third-party logistics facilities are operated by external vendors. Impacts financial reporting and Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) versus Operating Expenditure (OPEX) classification.

attributes.name: pallet_positions
attributes.description: Number of standard pallet positions available in the warehouse facility. Used for inventory capacity planning and material staging for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) projects and storm restoration.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the warehouse facility address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: responsible_plant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational plant or operating unit responsible for managing the warehouse facility. Used for cost allocation and operational accountability in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Physical security classification of the warehouse facility. Standard facilities have basic access controls, enhanced facilities have additional monitoring and restricted access, and critical infrastructure facilities have maximum security measures required by North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) standards.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the warehouse facility is located. Uses standard postal abbreviations.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Total indoor storage capacity of the warehouse facility measured in square feet. Used for capacity planning and inventory allocation decisions.

attributes.name: storm_staging_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility is designated and equipped for pre-positioning materials and equipment for storm restoration events. Critical for emergency response planning and System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) performance.

attributes.name: twenty_four_seven_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility provides 24-hour, 7-day-per-week access for emergency storm restoration and critical outage response. Essential for Outage Management System (OMS) integration and Demand Response (DR) program support.

attributes.name: warehouse_name
attributes.description: Official name of the warehouse facility used for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: warehouse_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the warehouse facility used in operational systems and documentation. Typically assigned by Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud) for procurement and inventory management.

attributes.name: yard_storage_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility has outdoor yard storage for large Transmission and Distribution (T&D) equipment such as transformers, poles, and cable reels.

attributes.name: yard_storage_capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Total outdoor yard storage capacity measured in square feet. Used for planning storage of large Transmission and Distribution (T&D) equipment and Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) project materials.

products.name: stock_transfer
products.description: Transactional record for inter-plant and inter-warehouse material movements within the utility's supply network. Covers transfers between central warehouse and field storerooms, storm restoration emergency stock pre-positioning and deployment, generation plant consumable replenishment, and mutual aid material loans to/from neighboring utilities during major events. Captures transfer order number, sending warehouse (FK to warehouse), receiving warehouse (FK to warehouse), material reference (FK to material_master), transfer quantity, unit of measure, movement type (301 plant-to-plant transfer, 311 storage-location-to-storage-location transfer, 303 plant-to-plant in two steps), transport mode (company truck, common carrier, emergency helicopter), carrier name, requested transfer date, actual shipment date, actual receipt date, completion status (open, in-transit, received, cancelled), and mutual aid tracking reference for inter-utility loans. Enables real-time visibility into material logistics across the utility service territory and supports FEMA reimbursement documentation for storm restoration material movements.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Stock Transfer Order (Movement Type 301/351)

attributes.name: stock_transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock transfer transaction. Primary key for the stock transfer record.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the capital project for which material is being transferred. Links stock transfers to CAPEX construction projects for Work in Progress (WIP) tracking and Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) capitalization.
attributes.references: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: compliance_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_event. Business justification: Transfers of hazmat or regulated materials may trigger compliance events (spills during transport, improper handling, documentation violations). Real process: incident tracking for EPA and DOT reporti

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the material master record being transferred. References the specific item, equipment, fuel, or supply being moved between locations.

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.meter. Business justification: Utilities track individual serialized meter movements between warehouses for asset accountability, especially during storm staging, mutual aid operations, and regional inventory balancing. Critical fo

attributes.name: receiving_warehouse_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or storage location to which material is being transferred. References the destination facility in the utility supply network.

attributes.name: sending_warehouse_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or storage location from which material is being transferred. References the originating facility in the utility supply network.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the maintenance or construction work order for which material is being transferred. Links stock transfers to preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, or emergency restoration work orders in Oracle WAM or IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which material was physically received at the destination location. Captures the actual goods receipt date for inventory reconciliation and completion tracking.

attributes.name: actual_shipment_date
attributes.description: Date on which material was physically shipped or issued from the sending location. Captures the actual goods movement date for inventory and logistics tracking.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number of the material being transferred. Enables traceability for quality control, warranty tracking, and recall management of generation plant consumables and T&D equipment.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the transportation carrier or logistics provider handling the material movement. May be internal utility fleet or external common carrier.
attributes.references: Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals (CSCMP)

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which the transfer transaction is charged. Used for internal cost allocation and departmental expense tracking for O&M material movements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stock transfer record was first created in the system. Audit timestamp for record creation tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the valuation amount. Typically USD for US-based utilities but supports multi-currency operations for international utilities.

attributes.name: issuing_person_name
attributes.description: Name of the utility employee who issued the material from the sending location. Provides accountability for goods issue and inventory control.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stock transfer record was last updated. Audit timestamp for tracking changes to transfer status, quantities, or other attributes.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code classifying the nature of the stock transfer. 301=plant-to-plant transfer in one step, 311=storage-location-to-storage-location transfer within same plant, 303=plant-to-plant transfer in two steps (issue from sending plant), 305=plant-to-plant transfer receipt, 309=material-to-material transfer.

attributes.name: mutual_aid_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for inter-utility mutual aid material loans during major storm events or emergencies. Tracks material borrowed from or loaned to neighboring utilities for Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) reimbursement documentation.
attributes.references: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Public Assistance Program

attributes.name: mutual_aid_utility_name
attributes.description: Name of the external utility involved in the mutual aid material transfer. Identifies the lending or borrowing utility for inter-utility material loan tracking and settlement.
attributes.references: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Public Assistance Program

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for the stock transfer. Emergency and critical priorities are used for storm restoration material deployments and generation plant critical consumable replenishment.
attributes.references: Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals (CSCMP)

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when material was received at the destination warehouse. Enables calculation of transit time and supports real-time inventory visibility.

attributes.name: receiving_person_name
attributes.description: Name of the utility employee who physically received the material at the destination location. Provides accountability for goods receipt and inventory control.

attributes.name: receiving_plant_code
attributes.description: ERP plant code for the destination facility. Identifies the generation plant, service center, or operational facility to which material is being transferred.

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location
attributes.description: Storage location code within the receiving plant or warehouse. Identifies the specific storeroom, bin, or inventory zone where material will be received.

attributes.name: requested_transfer_date
attributes.description: Date on which the material transfer was requested or scheduled to occur. Represents the planned transfer date for logistics planning and coordination.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the reversal transaction if this stock transfer was reversed. Links to the correcting entry for audit trail and inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this stock transfer has been reversed or cancelled. True if the transfer was reversed due to error correction or material return.

attributes.name: sending_plant_code
attributes.description: ERP plant code for the originating facility. Identifies the generation plant, service center, or operational facility from which material is being transferred.

attributes.name: sending_storage_location
attributes.description: Storage location code within the sending plant or warehouse. Identifies the specific storeroom, bin, or inventory zone from which material is issued.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the specific material unit being transferred. Used for high-value serialized assets such as transformers, meters, or specialized equipment requiring individual tracking.

attributes.name: shipment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when material was issued from the sending warehouse. Provides granular tracking for time-sensitive transfers such as storm restoration emergency deployments.

attributes.name: shipping_document_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the shipping document or bill of lading accompanying the material transfer. Used for carrier tracking and proof of shipment.
attributes.references: Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals (CSCMP)

attributes.name: storm_event_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the storm or emergency event driving the stock transfer. Links emergency material pre-positioning and deployment to specific named storms or major outage events for restoration cost tracking.
attributes.references: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Public Assistance Program

attributes.name: transfer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the stock transfer. Captures special handling instructions, condition observations, or other relevant information for logistics and receiving personnel.

attributes.name: transfer_order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the stock transfer order. Externally-known reference number used in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP for tracking material movements between locations.

attributes.name: transfer_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material being transferred from sending to receiving location. Measured in the unit of measure specified for the material.

attributes.name: transfer_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the business reason for the stock transfer. Examples include stock balancing, project material allocation, emergency restoration, planned maintenance support, or mutual aid deployment.

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stock transfer. Tracks progression from order creation through shipment, receipt, and completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Method of transportation used for the stock transfer. Includes utility-owned vehicles, third-party carriers, emergency air transport for storm restoration, and mutual aid logistics.
attributes.references: Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals (CSCMP)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the transfer quantity. Examples include EA (each), FT (feet), GAL (gallons), TON (tons), KWH (kilowatt-hours), MCF (thousand cubic feet), or other standard utility material units.

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the material being transferred. Calculated based on material standard cost or moving average price for financial inventory accounting and CAPEX project material tracking.

products.name: purchase_requisition
products.description: Internal request document initiating the procurement process for materials, equipment, or services before a purchase order is issued. Captures requisition number, requisition type (standard material, service, fuel, emergency/storm), requested material reference (linked to material_master for cataloged items) or free-text description for non-catalog items, quantity, unit of measure, required delivery date, estimated unit price and total value, requesting cost center (OPEX) or WBS element (CAPEX), approval workflow status (created, pending approval, approved, rejected, converted to PO), assigned buyer/purchasing group, priority indicator (normal, urgent, emergency), and conversion-to-PO reference. Supports the procure-to-pay process from demand identification through PO creation in SAP S/4HANA. Originated by field operations, maintenance planners, project managers, and generation plant staff.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Purchase Requisition (EBAN)

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase requisition record. Primary key for the purchase requisition entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Purchase Requisition Master

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Purchase requisitions originate from cost centers and require cost center manager approval against budget. First step in budget authorization workflow, essential for budget control and procurement aut

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Requisitions specify GL accounts for budget checking and eventual posting. Required for validating budget availability at requisition stage and ensuring proper account coding flows through to PO and i

attributes.name: primary_purchase_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cataloged material master record for standard inventory items. Populated for requisitions requesting materials from the enterprise material catalog. Null for non-catalog or free-text service requisitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_contract. Business justification: Purchase requisitions can reference existing procurement contracts for pricing and vendor selection. Currently denormalized as contract_reference_number (STRING). Adding procurement_contract_id FK ena

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order that was created from this requisition after approval. Null if the requisition has not yet been converted to a PO or was cancelled.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Purchase Order Reference

attributes.name: requester_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the person who created the requisition. Links to the human capital management system for organizational hierarchy and approval routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Module - Personnel Number

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Suggested or assigned vendor for fulfilling this requisition. May be pre-populated by the requester based on preferred supplier relationships or assigned by the purchasing group during PO creation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Vendor Master

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the requisition received final approval and became eligible for conversion to a purchase order. Null if not yet approved.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Release Date

attributes.name: approval_workflow_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the approval workflow instance routing this requisition through the release strategy. Tracks the multi-level approval process based on requisition value thresholds and organizational hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Release Strategy

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the manager or authorized approver who granted final approval for the requisition. Null if requisition is still pending approval or was rejected.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Release Approver

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase requisition record was first created in the system. Represents the initiation of the procurement demand.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Creation Date/Time

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated price and total value. Typically USD for US-based utility operations.

attributes.name: estimated_total_value
attributes.description: Total estimated value of the requisition line, calculated as requested quantity multiplied by estimated unit price. Used for approval threshold determination and budget commitment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Requisition Value

attributes.name: estimated_unit_price
attributes.description: Estimated or budgeted price per unit of measure for the requested item or service. Used for budget validation and purchase order creation. May be based on historical pricing, catalog rates, or requester estimate.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Valuation Price

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update to the requisition record. Tracks changes to quantity, delivery date, status, or other requisition attributes during the approval and procurement workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Change Date/Time

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code representing the physical location or operational facility where the material or service will be delivered and used. May represent a generation plant, service center, warehouse, or district office.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Plant Master

attributes.name: po_conversion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved requisition was converted into a purchase order by the purchasing group. Marks the transition from internal demand to external vendor commitment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - PO Creation Date

attributes.name: priority_indicator
attributes.description: Urgency classification for the requisition. Normal for standard procurement lead times, urgent for expedited processing, emergency for immediate operational needs (e.g., equipment failure), critical for safety or regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Requisition Priority

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or purchasing group code assigned to process this requisition and convert it to a purchase order. Represents the procurement team responsible for sourcing, vendor selection, and contract negotiation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Purchasing Group Master

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the requisition was rejected during the approval workflow. Captures business justification for denial such as budget unavailability, duplicate request, or insufficient justification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Rejection Text

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material or service units requested in this requisition line. Expressed in the unit of measure specified in the unit_of_measure field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Requisition Quantity

attributes.name: requester_department
attributes.description: Organizational department or functional area of the requester. Examples include Generation Operations, Transmission Maintenance, Distribution Field Services, Gas Operations, or Capital Projects.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Module - Organizational Unit

attributes.name: requester_name
attributes.description: Name of the employee or contractor who created the purchase requisition. Typically a field operations supervisor, maintenance planner, project manager, or generation plant staff member.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Requisition Creator

attributes.name: required_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the requested material or service must be delivered to meet operational or project schedule requirements. Used for procurement planning and vendor lead time evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Delivery Date

attributes.name: requisition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments providing additional context, special instructions, or business justification for the requisition. May include technical specifications, delivery instructions, or project background.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Item Text

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the purchase requisition document. Externally visible requisition number used for tracking and reference in procurement workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Purchase Requisition Document Number

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the purchase requisition in the approval and procurement workflow. Tracks progression from initial creation through approval gates to conversion into a purchase order or rejection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|pending_approval|approved|rejected|converted_to_po|cancelled|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Requisition Release Strategy

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase requisition based on the nature of the procurement request. Standard material for cataloged inventory items, service for contracted labor or professional services, fuel for generation plant coal/gas/oil purchases, emergency for urgent unplanned needs, storm restoration for outage recovery materials, and capital project for CAPEX-funded equipment and construction materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Requisition Type Configuration

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Storage location within the plant where the material will be received and stocked. Represents a warehouse, yard, or inventory staging area. Applicable only for material requisitions, not services.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Storage Location Master

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the requested quantity. EA for each/piece, FT for feet of cable or pipe, GAL for gallons of liquid, LB for pounds, TON for tons of coal or equipment weight, KWH/MWH for energy, MCF/THERM for natural gas, HR/DAY for service labor time. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|FT|GAL|LB|TON|KWH|MWH|MCF|THERM|HR|DAY|EACH — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Unit of Measure Master

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure element identifier for CAPEX (capital expenditure) project-related requisitions. Links the requisition to a specific capital project phase or deliverable for project cost tracking and AFUDC calculation. Mutually exclusive with cost center for OPEX items.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module - WBS Element

products.name: vendor_invoice
products.description: Transactional record for vendor invoices received for materials, equipment, fuel, and services procured by the utility. Captures invoice number, vendor reference, invoice date, posting date, gross invoice amount, tax amount, currency, payment due date, three-way match status (PO–GR–invoice), payment block reason, and SAP FI document number. Drives accounts payable processing and supports CAPEX/OPEX cost allocation. Distinct from customer-facing invoices owned by the billing domain.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Logistics Invoice Verification (RBKP/RSEG)

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor invoice record. Primary key for the vendor invoice product.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CAPEX project if the invoice is for capital equipment or construction. Used for work-in-progress (WIP) tracking and asset capitalization.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Vendor invoices are charged to cost centers for budget tracking, variance analysis, and departmental cost allocation. Essential for monthly budget-to-actual reporting and cost center manager accountab

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.docket. Business justification: Capital project invoices under regulatory review must be linked to rate case or CPCN dockets. Prudency reviews examine actual costs vs. estimates. Invoices are evidence in cost recovery proceedings.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Every vendor invoice posts to a GL account per GAAP and FERC accounting requirements. Required for financial statement preparation, FERC Form 1/2 reporting, and audit trail from invoice to general led

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.goods_receipt. Business justification: Vendor invoices must link to goods receipts for 3-way match (PO → GR → Invoice). Currently denormalized as delivery_note_number (STRING). Adding goods_receipt_id FK enables automated 3-way matching, q

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this invoice is being verified. Required for three-way match (PO-GR-Invoice).

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor master record from whom materials, equipment, fuel, or services were procured.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance or construction work order if the invoice is for services or materials related to asset maintenance or project work.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was approved for payment. Marks completion of invoice verification and approval workflow.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the person who approved the invoice for payment. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Company code representing the legal entity within the utility that is responsible for this invoice. Used for multi-entity financial consolidation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor invoice record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice amount. Typically USD for domestic US utility operations.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Cash discount or early payment discount amount available if payment is made within discount period.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice document was received by the utility. Used for document control and audit trail.

attributes.name: duplicate_invoice_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this invoice has been identified as a potential duplicate of a previously processed invoice. True if duplicate detected.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Duplicate Invoice Check

attributes.name: fi_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI document number assigned when the invoice is posted to the general ledger. Links invoice to financial accounting entries.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the invoice was posted. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the invoice was posted. Used for financial period reporting and year-end closing.

attributes.name: gross_invoice_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before any deductions or adjustments. Includes line item amounts and freight charges.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the vendor issued the invoice. Used for aging analysis and payment term calculation.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the invoice contents or purpose. Provides additional context for invoice review and approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Header Text

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Vendor-assigned invoice number as printed on the invoice document. Business identifier for external reference and three-way matching.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor invoice in the accounts payable workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|blocked|posted|paid|cancelled|disputed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification Status

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type. Determines accounting treatment and workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Document Type

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor invoice record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: net_invoice_amount
attributes.description: Net payable amount after applying taxes, discounts, and adjustments. Amount to be paid to vendor.

attributes.name: payment_block_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether payment is blocked pending resolution of discrepancies or approval. True if payment is blocked.

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why payment is blocked (e.g., price variance, quantity variance, missing approval, duplicate invoice).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Block Reason

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date payment was made to the vendor. Used for cash flow reporting and vendor payment history.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is due to the vendor per payment terms. Calculated from invoice date plus payment term days.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which payment will be made to the vendor. Determines payment processing workflow.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Payment document number or check number assigned when payment is executed. Links invoice to payment transaction.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms agreed with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Determines due date and discount eligibility.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Plant or facility code where the materials or services were received. Links invoice to operational location.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was posted to the financial accounting ledger. Determines the fiscal period for financial reporting.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: FI document number of the reversal document if this invoice was reversed. Links to the reversing entry.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this invoice has been reversed or cancelled. True if invoice was reversed.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the invoice. Includes sales tax, use tax, and other applicable taxes.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match verification comparing purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice. Indicates whether invoice can be approved for payment.

attributes.name: vendor_reference_number
attributes.description: Vendor's internal reference number or order confirmation number cited on the invoice. Used for vendor inquiry and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from vendor payment per tax regulations. Reduces net payment to vendor.

products.name: fuel_delivery
products.description: Transactional record capturing physical delivery of generation fuel (natural gas, coal, oil, nuclear fuel) to generation plant sites. Records delivery ticket number, fuel type, delivery date and time, delivered quantity (MCF for gas, tons for coal, barrels for oil), unit of measure, BTU content or heat rate, delivery point (plant and tank/pipeline tie-in), carrier/transporter, contract reference, and quality certificate number. Supports fuel inventory management, heat rate calculations, and FAC (Fuel Adjustment Clause) regulatory reporting.
products.reference: FERC Form 423 / EIA-923 Fuel Receipt and Cost

attributes.name: fuel_delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel delivery transaction. Primary key for the fuel delivery record.

attributes.name: compliance_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_event. Business justification: Fuel quality violations, delivery incidents, and sulfur/ash content exceedances are compliance events. Real-world process: tracking fuel specification violations and environmental incidents at generat

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Fuel deliveries are charged to generation plant cost centers for fuel expense tracking and heat rate analysis. Essential for generation cost accounting, FERC Form 1 fuel statistics, and plant-level pr

attributes.name: emissions_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.emissions_report. Business justification: Fuel deliveries are source data for emissions calculations. BTU content, sulfur content, and quantity delivered feed directly into EPA emissions reports. Essential for CEMS data validation and quarter

attributes.name: fuel_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master fuel supply contract governing this delivery. Links to the contract that defines pricing, terms, and delivery obligations.

attributes.name: fuel_generation_plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generation facility receiving the fuel delivery. Identifies the power plant site where fuel is delivered.

attributes.name: fuel_plant_id
attributes.description: FK to generation.plant.plant_id — Traces fuel deliveries to generation facilities — required for fuel cost allocation, FAC cost recovery filings, and fuel inventory reconciliation at each plant.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Fuel deliveries post to fuel inventory or fuel expense GL accounts per FERC Uniform System of Accounts (Account 151 for inventory, 501 for expense). Required for regulatory reporting and financial sta

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Fuel deliveries are executed against purchase orders. Currently denormalized as purchase_order_number (STRING). Adding purchase_order_id FK enables proper linkage to PO terms, pricing, and vendor. Rem

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or transporter master record for the carrier. Links to the supplier managing fuel logistics.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse. Business justification: Fuel deliveries are received at utility warehouses or generation plant fuel storage facilities. The storage_location_code should be normalized to warehouse_id FK. Warehouse table contains storage_loca

attributes.name: ash_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of ash residue by weight in coal deliveries. Affects combustion efficiency and waste disposal requirements.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number assigned to the delivered fuel for traceability. Enables tracking of fuel quality and usage by delivery batch.

attributes.name: btu_content
attributes.description: Heat energy content of the delivered fuel measured in BTU per unit. Critical for heat rate calculations and energy conversion efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fuel delivery record was first created in the system. Audit timestamp for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this delivery record. Typically USD for US utility operations.

attributes.name: delivered_quantity
attributes.description: Physical quantity of fuel delivered in the specified unit of measure. Core measurement for inventory management and billing.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the fuel was physically delivered to the generation plant site. Principal business event date for the transaction.

attributes.name: delivery_notes
attributes.description: Free-text comments or special instructions related to the fuel delivery. Captures operational details, exceptions, or delivery conditions.

attributes.name: delivery_point_code
attributes.description: Specific location identifier within the generation plant where fuel was delivered. May reference a storage tank, pipeline tie-in, or receiving dock.

attributes.name: delivery_point_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the physical delivery location within the plant site. Provides operational context for the delivery point code.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fuel delivery transaction. Tracks the delivery from scheduling through final acceptance or rejection.

attributes.name: delivery_ticket_number
attributes.description: External delivery ticket or bill of lading number issued by the carrier or transporter. Serves as the business identifier for the physical delivery event.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the fuel delivery was completed and accepted at the plant. Used for time-of-delivery pricing and scheduling reconciliation.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivered fuel meets environmental quality standards and emissions compliance requirements. True if compliant with EPA and state regulations.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fuel commodity delivered. Categorizes the energy source type for generation operations.

attributes.name: heat_rate_mmbtu_per_unit
attributes.description: Million BTU per unit of measure for the delivered fuel. Used in generation efficiency calculations and Fuel Adjustment Clause (FAC) reporting.

attributes.name: inspection_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the fuel quality inspection or lab analysis. Determines whether the delivery is accepted for use or rejected for non-conformance.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether quality inspection or lab testing is required before the fuel can be used in generation. True if inspection is mandatory per contract terms.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Vendor invoice number associated with this fuel delivery. Links the physical delivery to accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fuel delivery record was most recently updated. Audit timestamp for tracking record changes.

attributes.name: moisture_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of moisture by weight in solid fuel deliveries. Impacts effective heat content and storage handling requirements.

attributes.name: origin_location
attributes.description: Geographic source or production location of the delivered fuel. May reference a mine, well field, refinery, or supply basin.

attributes.name: pipeline_receipt_point
attributes.description: Named receipt point on the natural gas pipeline system where gas entered the utility's system. Used for gas delivery tracking and tariff application.

attributes.name: quality_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the fuel quality assurance certificate or lab analysis report accompanying the delivery. Documents compliance with contract specifications.

attributes.name: receiving_person_name
attributes.description: Name of the plant operations or warehouse staff member who accepted and verified the fuel delivery on site.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: Originally planned or contracted delivery date. Used to track on-time delivery performance and schedule variance.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of sulfur by weight in the delivered fuel. Critical for environmental compliance and emissions calculations under EPA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Title IV

attributes.name: total_delivery_cost
attributes.description: Total cost for the fuel delivery including base fuel cost and transportation charges. Represents the complete delivered cost for accounting and rate recovery.

attributes.name: transportation_cost
attributes.description: Separate transportation or freight charges for delivering the fuel to the plant site. May be billed separately from commodity cost.

attributes.name: transporter_duns_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transporter Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) Number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet unique identifier for the transportation company. Provides standardized carrier identification for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit used to quantify the delivered fuel. MCF for natural gas, tons for coal, barrels for oil, assemblies for nuclear fuel.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Contract price per unit of measure for the delivered fuel. Used for invoice validation and Fuel Adjustment Clause (FAC) cost recovery calculations.

products.name: vendor_performance
products.description: Periodic evaluation record tracking vendor and contractor performance against delivery, quality, safety, and compliance KPIs over a defined assessment period. Captures evaluation period (quarterly, annual, or per-project), vendor reference, evaluating buyer or contract manager, on-time delivery rate, material rejection rate, invoice accuracy rate, OSHA recordable incident rate and Experience Modification Rate (EMR) for contractor field crews, safety compliance score, environmental compliance incidents, diversity spend percentage, overall weighted performance rating (1-5 scale with configurable weighting: 30% delivery, 25% quality, 25% safety, 10% invoice accuracy, 10% diversity), corrective action plan status, and preferred vendor list eligibility flag. Supports vendor qualification decisions, contract renewal negotiations, bid evaluation scoring, and supplier diversity program reporting. Evaluated quarterly for strategic suppliers and per-project for major T&D construction and generation outage contractors. Distinct from vendor master (which captures static identity and classification) — this product captures time-series performance measurement.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Evaluation (ME61/ME6B)

attributes.name: vendor_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor performance evaluation record.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement manager or director who approved the final performance evaluation. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CAPEX project if this is a project-based evaluation for major T&D construction or generation outage work. Null for periodic evaluations.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Contractor safety and environmental performance is tracked against specific OSHA and EPA obligations. Real process: vendor OSHA EMR scores and environmental incidents are evaluated against regulatory

attributes.name: evaluator_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the buyer, contract manager, or procurement specialist who conducted the performance evaluation.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_contract. Business justification: Vendor performance evaluations are often conducted at the contract level (e.g., annual fuel supply contract performance review). This FK links the evaluation to the contract being assessed, enabling c

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Vendor performance evaluations can be tied to specific purchase orders (especially for project-based procurement or large capital equipment orders). This enables PO-level performance tracking and link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or contractor being evaluated in this performance assessment.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the performance evaluation was formally approved by management. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: bid_evaluation_score_adjustment
attributes.description: Adjustment factor (positive or negative) applied to future bid evaluation scores based on historical performance. High performers receive positive adjustments; poor performers receive negative adjustments.

attributes.name: contract_renewal_recommendation
attributes.description: Evaluator's recommendation regarding contract renewal or continuation based on the performance assessment. Used in contract renewal negotiations.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the vendor must complete the corrective action plan. Null if no CAP is required.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a corrective action plan (CAP) is required due to performance deficiencies identified in this evaluation. True if CAP is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_status
attributes.description: Current status of the corrective action plan if one was required. Tracks whether the vendor has submitted, is implementing, or has completed the required improvements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this vendor performance evaluation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the total spend amount (e.g., USD for US Dollar).

attributes.name: delivery_weight_percentage
attributes.description: The weighting percentage applied to on-time delivery performance in the overall performance rating calculation. Default is 30.00%.

attributes.name: diversity_spend_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the vendor's subcontractor spend or workforce that qualifies under the utility's supplier diversity program (minority-owned, women-owned, veteran-owned, small business). Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: diversity_weight_percentage
attributes.description: The weighting percentage applied to diversity spend performance in the overall performance rating calculation. Default is 10.00%.

attributes.name: emr_score
attributes.description: The Experience Modification Rate (EMR) for the contractor, a multiplier used by insurance companies to price workers' compensation premiums. A score of 1.0 is average; below 1.0 indicates better-than-average safety performance; above 1.0 indicates worse-than-average. Critical for field service contractors.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_incidents
attributes.description: Count of environmental compliance violations or incidents (spills, emissions exceedances, permit violations) attributed to the vendor during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the performance evaluation was completed and recorded.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from the evaluator providing additional context, highlighting specific incidents, commendations, or concerns not captured in quantitative metrics.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the performance evaluation period.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the performance evaluation period (quarterly, annual, or project-specific).

attributes.name: evaluation_status
