attributes.name: superseded_by_rider_rider_charge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the rider_charge_id that supersedes this rider. Null if this rider is current or was not replaced by another rider.

attributes.name: afudc_rate_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Rate Percentage
attributes.description: AFUDC rate percentage applied to deferred balances or work-in-progress costs recovered through this rider. Null if AFUDC does not apply.

attributes.name: annual_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum annual revenue that may be collected through this rider, if a regulatory cap is imposed. Null for uncapped riders.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority (PUC or FERC) approved this rider charge through a commission order.

attributes.name: approval_order_number
attributes.description: Commission order number or docket decision reference that authorized this rider charge. Links to the regulatory approval record.

attributes.name: balance_as_of_date
attributes.description: Date as of which the current_balance was calculated. Updated with each true-up filing or monthly reconciliation.

attributes.name: charge_basis
attributes.description: Unit of measure or calculation method for applying the rider charge: per kilowatt-hour (kWh), per thousand cubic feet (MCF) of gas, per therm, per kilowatt (kW) of demand, fixed monthly amount, or percentage of base tariff charges.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rider charge record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the rate value (typically USD for U.S. utilities).

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance of costs to be recovered or refunded through this rider. Positive values indicate under-recovery; negative values indicate over-recovery requiring refund.

attributes.name: current_rate_value
attributes.description: The currently effective rate value for this rider charge, expressed in the unit specified by charge_basis (e.g., 0.012345 dollars per kWh, 2.50 dollars per month). Updated through regulatory true-up filings.

attributes.name: customer_class_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer classes to which this rider applies (e.g., residential, commercial, industrial, street_lighting). Determines billing applicability by rate schedule.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rider charge becomes effective and begins to be applied to customer bills. Corresponds to the regulatory approval order effective date.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rider charge expires or is scheduled to be superseded. Null for riders with indefinite duration subject to periodic true-up.

attributes.name: ferc_account_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Number
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts number for the regulatory asset, liability, or revenue account associated with this rider (e.g., Account 182.3 for regulatory assets).

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the utility filed the tariff rider application or true-up filing with the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code in the utility's chart of accounts to which rider revenues and costs are posted.
attributes.references: GAAP and FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: interest_accrual_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether interest accrues on the deferred balance of this rider. True if interest is calculated on under-recovered or over-recovered amounts.

attributes.name: interest_rate_pct
attributes.description: Annual interest rate percentage applied to deferred balances, if interest accrual is enabled. Typically based on the utility's weighted average cost of capital (WACC) or a regulatory-specified rate.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Level of regulatory jurisdiction governing this rider: federal (FERC), state (PUC), or municipal.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code for the state regulatory jurisdiction (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Null for federal or multi-state riders.

attributes.name: last_true_up_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent true-up filing or rate adjustment for this rider. Used to track compliance with regulatory true-up schedules.

attributes.name: next_true_up_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next true-up filing or rate adjustment. Null for riders without periodic true-up requirements.

attributes.name: rate_base_treatment
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs recovered through this rider are included in rate base, excluded from rate base, or deferred as a regulatory asset/liability.

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: Method by which costs are recovered: current recovery (costs collected as incurred), deferred recovery (costs accumulated and recovered over time), or refund (over-collected amounts returned to customers).

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_liability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rider creates a regulatory asset (under-recovery), regulatory liability (over-recovery), or neither (current recovery with no deferral).

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority that approved this rider (e.g., California Public Utilities Commission, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission).

attributes.name: rider_charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rider charge. Active riders are applied to customer bills; pending riders await regulatory approval; expired riders are no longer in effect.

attributes.name: rider_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the rider or surcharge within the utility's tariff structure (e.g., FAC, RPS, INFRA, DSM). Used as the business identifier for rate engine processing.

attributes.name: rider_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the rider's purpose, cost recovery mechanism, and regulatory basis. Includes information on the types of costs recovered and the calculation methodology.

attributes.name: rider_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the rider or surcharge as it appears on customer bills and in regulatory filings (e.g., Fuel Adjustment Clause, Renewable Portfolio Standard Surcharge, Infrastructure Investment Rider).

attributes.name: rider_type

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of utility service to which this rider applies: electric, natural gas, or dual fuel (both electric and gas).

attributes.name: tariff_schedule_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the base tariff schedule(s) to which this rider applies. May be a single schedule number or a comma-separated list for riders applicable across multiple schedules.

attributes.name: total_authorized_amount
attributes.description: Total cumulative amount authorized for recovery through this rider over its lifetime (e.g., total project cost for a CIAC recovery rider). Null for ongoing riders without a fixed total.

attributes.name: true_up_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the rider rate is recalculated and adjusted based on actual costs versus forecasted costs (e.g., monthly for FAC, annual for infrastructure riders).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rider charge record was last modified. Updated with each true-up filing, rate change, or status update.

products.name: compliance_calendar
products.description: Master record for each regulatory deadline, milestone, or scheduled event the utility must track across all jurisdictions and regulatory bodies. Captures deadline type (filing due date, compliance evidence submission, rate case milestone, IRP update cycle, annual report due date, NERC audit window, EPA reporting deadline, PHMSA inspection window), associated docket or compliance obligation reference, jurisdiction, regulatory body, responsible internal party, original due date, extended due date (if granted), completion status, days-to-deadline alert threshold, and escalation contact. Links to docket for proceeding-related deadlines and to compliance_obligation for compliance-driven deadlines. Serves as the centralized deadline management registry that regulatory affairs teams use daily to ensure no filing or compliance deadline is missed — the operational heartbeat of the regulatory department.

attributes.name: compliance_calendar_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each regulatory deadline, milestone, or scheduled compliance event tracked by the utility. Primary key for the compliance calendar registry.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compliance obligation record that drives this deadline, if the deadline is compliance-driven (e.g., NERC audit window, EPA reporting deadline, PHMSA inspection window).

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory docket or proceeding associated with this deadline, if the deadline is proceeding-related (e.g., rate case milestone, CPCN application deadline, IRP submission due date).

attributes.name: filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.filing. Business justification: Compliance calendar events track specific filing deadlines (e.g., 'File quarterly NERC compliance report by 2024-04-15'). Each calendar event can reference the specific filing record it tracks. This c

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier for the individual assigned primary accountability for this compliance deadline. Links to the workforce or human capital management system.

attributes.name: alert_status
attributes.description: Current state of the alert mechanism for this deadline. Indicates whether an alert has been triggered, escalated to management, or acknowledged by the responsible party.

attributes.name: alert_threshold_days
attributes.description: The number of days before the effective due date at which an alert or notification should be triggered to the responsible party and escalation contact. Configurable per deadline type and risk level.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the filing, submission, or compliance action was completed and submitted to the regulatory body. Null if the deadline has not yet been met.

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Current status of the compliance deadline indicating whether the obligation has been met, is in progress, or has been missed. Drives operational workflow and escalation logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|in_progress|completed_on_time|completed_late|missed|waived|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: compliance_domain
attributes.description: The functional domain or category of compliance to which this deadline belongs (e.g., reliability standards, environmental reporting, safety inspections, financial filings, cybersecurity audits, rate regulation). Enables domain-specific reporting and resource planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reliability|environmental|safety|financial|operational|cybersecurity|rate_regulation|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: The confirmation or tracking number provided by the regulatory body upon successful submission of the filing or compliance evidence. Serves as proof of timely submission.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compliance calendar record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: days_to_deadline
attributes.description: Calculated number of calendar days remaining until the effective due date. Negative values indicate the deadline has passed. Used to trigger alerts and prioritize work queues.

attributes.name: deadline_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of regulatory deadline or milestone being tracked. Determines the nature of the obligation and the required action by the utility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: filing_due_date|compliance_evidence_submission|rate_case_milestone|irp_update_cycle|annual_report_due_date|audit_window|inspection_window|testimony_deadline|tariff_filing_deadline|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: effective_due_date
attributes.description: The current operative deadline date that the utility must meet. Equals extended_due_date if an extension was granted, otherwise equals original_due_date. This is the date used for alert calculations and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: escalation_contact
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the escalation contact or manager to be notified if the deadline is at risk of being missed or if issues arise during compliance preparation.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the compliance deadline or milestone (e.g., 'Q1 FERC Form 1 Filing', 'Annual NERC CIP Audit', 'Rate Case Testimony Submission', 'IRP Update Cycle 2024').

attributes.name: event_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, instructions, special conditions, or internal notes related to this compliance deadline. Captures information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique identifier or tracking number for this compliance calendar event, used for internal reference and communication across regulatory affairs teams.

attributes.name: extended_due_date
attributes.description: The revised deadline date if an extension has been granted by the regulatory body. Null if no extension has been requested or approved. This becomes the operative deadline when populated.

attributes.name: extension_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory body formally approved the extension request. Null if no extension was granted.

attributes.name: extension_granted_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the regulatory body has approved the extension request. True if the extension was granted and extended_due_date has been populated.

attributes.name: extension_request_date
attributes.description: The date on which the utility submitted a formal request for deadline extension to the regulatory body. Null if no extension has been requested.

attributes.name: extension_requested_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the utility has formally requested an extension of the original deadline from the regulatory body. True if an extension request has been submitted.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction or geographic scope to which this deadline applies (e.g., federal, state-specific, multi-state, RTO/ISO region). Identifies the legal and geographic boundaries of the compliance obligation.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code identifying the specific state jurisdiction for state-level regulatory deadlines (e.g., CA for California PUC, NY for New York PSC). Null for federal or multi-state deadlines.

attributes.name: next_occurrence_date
attributes.description: For recurring deadlines, the date of the next scheduled occurrence after the current effective due date. Used for forward planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: original_due_date
attributes.description: The initial statutory or regulatory deadline date as established by the governing body or regulatory order. This date does not change even if extensions are granted.

attributes.name: penalty_exposure_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial penalty or fine exposure (in USD) if this deadline is missed or the compliance obligation is not met. Used for risk assessment and prioritization. Null if no specific penalty is defined.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business-assigned priority classification for this compliance deadline based on regulatory impact, penalty exposure, and strategic importance. Drives resource allocation and management attention.

attributes.name: recurrence_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which this compliance deadline recurs, if recurrence_indicator is true. Defines the cadence for automatic generation of future deadline instances. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|biennial|ad_hoc — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: recurrence_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a recurring compliance deadline (e.g., quarterly FERC filings, annual NERC audits) or a one-time event (e.g., specific rate case milestone, CPCN application deadline). True for recurring events.

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: The regulatory authority or governing body to which this deadline applies (e.g., Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC), North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC), State Public Utility Commission (PUC), Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA)). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FERC|NERC|PUC|EPA|DOE|PHMSA|OSHA|state_commission|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_standard_ref
attributes.description: Citation or reference to the specific regulatory standard, rule, or statute that establishes this deadline (e.g., NERC CIP-007-6, EPA 40 CFR Part 75, FERC Order 1000, state tariff section). Provides legal traceability.

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal business unit, department, or individual responsible for ensuring this deadline is met (e.g., 'Regulatory Affairs', 'Compliance Manager', 'Rate Case Team', 'Environmental Compliance Officer').

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of utility service to which this compliance deadline applies (electric generation/transmission/distribution, natural gas distribution, combined services). Enables service-specific compliance tracking.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: The method or channel by which the compliance filing or evidence must be submitted to the regulatory body (e.g., electronic filing portal, email, physical mail, hand delivery).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compliance calendar record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on compliance_calendar (parent_compliance_calendar_id)

attributes.name: penalty_rate

attributes.name: program_code

attributes.name: program_description

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Official name of the renewable portfolio standard program as filed with the regulatory commission.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RPS program indicating its operational state and regulatory standing.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the RPS program based on regulatory mandate and structure.

attributes.name: rec_trading_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program permits trading or purchasing of renewable energy certificates to meet compliance obligations.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or commission that oversees and enforces the RPS program requirements.

attributes.name: reporting_deadline_date
attributes.description: Annual deadline date by which RPS compliance reports must be filed with the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the utility must submit RPS compliance reports to the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: target_mwh
attributes.description: Absolute renewable energy procurement target expressed in megawatt-hours for the compliance period.

attributes.name: target_percentage
attributes.description: Mandated percentage of total retail electricity sales that must be sourced from renewable energy resources under this RPS program.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: successor_rps_program_id

products.name: corrective_action_plan
products.description: Master reference table for corrective_action_plan. Referenced by corrective_action_plan_id.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for corrective_action_plan

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Corrective action plans are created to remediate violations of specific compliance obligations (NERC standard violations, RPS shortfalls, emissions exceedances). This FK links the CAP to the obligatio

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory docket or proceeding under which this corrective action plan was filed or required.

attributes.name: violation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying violation, non-compliance finding, or audit exception that triggered this corrective action plan.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which all corrective actions were completed and verified, marking closure of the plan.

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Actual total cost in USD incurred to implement the corrective action plan, tracked upon completion.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the corrective action plan was approved by the regulatory authority or internal governance body, authorizing implementation.

attributes.name: closure_notes
attributes.description: Final notes or comments documenting the closure of the corrective action plan, including any lessons learned or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: cost_recovery_mechanism
attributes.description: The regulatory mechanism or tariff rider through which costs associated with the corrective action plan may be recovered from ratepayers (e.g., Fuel Adjustment Clause (FAC), Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC), deferred accounting).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this corrective action plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_amount
attributes.description: Projected total cost in USD to implement all corrective actions, including capital expenditures, operational expenses, consulting fees, and internal labor.

attributes.name: extension_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the regulatory authority granted an extension to the original target completion date.

attributes.name: extension_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an extension to the target completion date has been requested from the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: internal_audit_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the internal audit report or compliance assessment that identified the deficiency requiring corrective action.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this corrective action plan record was most recently modified or updated.

attributes.name: milestone_count
attributes.description: Total number of discrete milestones or action items defined within the corrective action plan.

attributes.name: milestones_completed_count
attributes.description: Number of milestones that have been completed and verified as of the current reporting date.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty in USD assessed by the regulatory authority for the underlying violation, which may be mitigated or waived based on corrective action plan completion.

attributes.name: penalty_mitigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether successful completion of the corrective action plan resulted in reduction or waiver of the assessed penalty.

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Overall completion percentage of the corrective action plan, calculated as (milestones_completed_count / milestone_count) * 100.

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the corrective actions, remediation steps, process improvements, and controls to be implemented to address the identified deficiency or violation.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the corrective action plan, typically assigned by the regulatory body or internal compliance system.

attributes.name: plan_owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the individual or team responsible for day-to-day management and execution of the corrective action plan.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the corrective action plan indicating its stage in the regulatory review and implementation process.

attributes.name: plan_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title or name of the corrective action plan summarizing the remediation focus.

attributes.name: prudency_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the corrective action plan costs are subject to a prudency review by the regulatory commission to determine cost recovery eligibility.

attributes.name: recurrence_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the likelihood that the underlying violation or non-compliance issue will recur after corrective actions are implemented.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The governing body or regulatory agency that mandated or is overseeing the corrective action plan (e.g., FERC, state PUC, NERC, EPA).

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the formal regulatory filing or submission that included or documented this corrective action plan.

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: The internal department, business unit, or functional area responsible for executing and completing the corrective action plan.

attributes.name: responsible_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the executive or officer accountable for ensuring the corrective action plan is completed and compliance is restored.

attributes.name: revised_completion_date
attributes.description: Updated target completion date following approval of an extension or plan modification by the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal root cause analysis was conducted to identify the underlying systemic issues that led to the violation.

attributes.name: root_cause_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the root cause analysis findings identifying the fundamental reasons for the non-compliance or deficiency.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the underlying violation or finding as determined by the regulatory authority or internal risk assessment.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the corrective action plan was formally submitted to the regulatory authority or internal compliance office for review.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned or mandated date by which all corrective actions must be completed and compliance fully restored.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the corrective actions were verified as complete and effective by the designated verification authority.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method or process used to verify completion and effectiveness of corrective actions (e.g., internal audit, third-party assessment, regulatory inspection, self-certification).

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the verification process indicating whether corrective actions have been validated as effective.

attributes.name: parent_corrective_action_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on corrective_action_plan (parent_corrective_action_plan_id)

products.name: violation
products.description: Master reference table for violation. Referenced by violation_id.

attributes.name: violation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for violation

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility has filed an appeal or contest of the violation finding or penalty.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: The final outcome of the appeal process, if an appeal was filed.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific asset or equipment involved in the violation event.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory body officially closed the violation case after successful mitigation or penalty resolution.

attributes.name: corrective_action_summary
attributes.description: Summary of corrective actions taken or planned to prevent recurrence of the violation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the violation record was first created in the compliance management system.

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Number of customers impacted by the violation event, if applicable.

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the violation was first identified or discovered by the utility or regulatory body.

attributes.name: docket_number
attributes.description: Official docket or case number assigned by the regulatory body for tracking the violation proceeding.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the generation, transmission, or distribution facility where the violation occurred.

attributes.name: impact_description
attributes.description: Description of the actual or potential impact of the violation on system reliability, safety, environment, or customers.

attributes.name: mitigation_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which all mitigation activities were completed and verified.

attributes.name: mitigation_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which corrective actions must be completed to remedy the violation.

attributes.name: mitigation_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the formal mitigation plan submitted to address the violation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments related to the violation, mitigation, or regulatory interactions.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the utility formally notified the regulatory body of the violation.

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: The date on which the violation actually occurred or the non-compliance event took place.

attributes.name: outage_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of any service outage caused by the violation, measured in minutes.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty assessed by the regulatory body for the violation, in US dollars.

attributes.name: penalty_currency
attributes.description: Currency code for the penalty amount. Utility operates in US dollars.

attributes.name: penalty_paid_date
attributes.description: The date on which the assessed penalty was paid to the regulatory body.

attributes.name: public_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the violation has been publicly disclosed or reported in regulatory filings.

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: The governing authority or regulatory commission that identified or has jurisdiction over the violation.

attributes.name: repeat_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a repeat violation of the same standard within the lookback period.

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: The internal department or business unit responsible for the area where the violation occurred.

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or manager accountable for oversight of the violated standard or process.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis
attributes.description: Detailed findings from the root cause analysis investigation conducted to understand why the violation occurred.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the underlying root cause of the violation.

attributes.name: self_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the violation was self-reported by the utility (true) or discovered by the regulatory body (false).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Assessed severity of the violation based on impact to safety, reliability, or compliance.

attributes.name: standard_code
attributes.description: The specific regulatory standard, rule, or tariff provision that was violated (e.g., NERC CIP-007, EPA CAA Section 111).

attributes.name: standard_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the regulatory standard or requirement that was violated.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the violation in the compliance management process.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the violation record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: violation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the violation, including circumstances, root cause, and impact.

attributes.name: violation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique violation tracking number assigned by the utility or regulatory body.

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the violation based on the regulatory domain affected.

attributes.name: related_violation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on violation (related_violation_id)

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Manages financial planning, general ledger, cost accounting, budgeting, and financial reporting. Tracks CAPEX and OPEX, ROE and ROI metrics, EBITDA, depreciation, and regulatory accounting per FERC Uniform System of Accounts. Supports rate case cost-of-service studies, SOX compliance, and GAAP financial statement preparation.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master record for organizational cost centers used to allocate and track OPEX and CAPEX across the utility's functional units (generation, transmission, distribution, gas, corporate). Aligned with SAP S/4HANA cost center master and FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) organizational hierarchy. Captures cost center code, description, responsible manager, functional area, plant/location assignment, and active status. Serves as the foundational dimension for all financial reporting and cost-of-service studies.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Master / FERC USoA Organizational Unit

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cost center record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for all financial allocation and reporting joins.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: cost_center has profit_center attribute (STRING). profit_center is the master for profit centers. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full profit center details (name, responsible_manager

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Primary SAP activity type (LSTAR) associated with this cost center, representing the unit of output or service produced (e.g., labor hours, machine hours, kWh generated). Used for internal activity allocation, cost rate calculation, and transfer pricing between cost centers in the utility's controlling model.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-ACT Activity Type Master

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate or distribute costs from this cost center to other cost objects (e.g., direct activity allocation, assessment cycle, distribution cycle, statistical key figure). Governs how shared service and overhead costs are spread across generation, T&D, and customer service functions for cost-of-service studies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct|indirect_activity|statistical_key_figure|assessment|distribution|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Allocation; FERC USoA Allocation Methods; NARUC Cost Allocation Manual

attributes.name: annual_capex_budget
attributes.description: Approved annual CAPEX budget amount for this cost center in the controlling area currency. Supports capital program tracking, AFUDC eligibility assessment, WIP monitoring, and rate base additions reporting to PUCs and FERC.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Planning; FERC USoA Plant Accounts; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: annual_opex_budget
attributes.description: Approved annual OPEX budget amount for this cost center in the controlling area currency. Used for budget vs. actual variance reporting, rate case cost-of-service studies, and PBR performance tracking. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA CO planning versions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Planning; FERC USoA; PBR Regulatory Framework

attributes.name: budget_fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year (YYYY) for which the annual OPEX and CAPEX budget amounts are applicable. Aligns with the utility's SAP fiscal year variant and regulatory test year used in rate case filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Fiscal Year; FERC Rate Case Test Year

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP Business Area (GSBER) representing a distinct operational segment of the utility (e.g., electric operations, gas operations, unregulated). Used for cross-company-code reporting and supports regulatory separation of electric and gas operations as required by state PUC accounting orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area; State PUC Accounting Orders

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center primarily accumulates Capital Expenditures (CAPEX), Operating Expenditures (OPEX), or a mix of both. Critical for regulatory accounting, rate base determination, and FERC USoA plant account vs. expense account mapping. Supports AFUDC calculation eligibility and WIP tracking.
attributes.references: FERC USoA 18 CFR Part 101; GAAP ASC 360; SOX

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP Company Code (BUKRS) representing the legal entity to which this cost center is assigned. Aligns with the utility's GAAP reporting entity and FERC jurisdictional entity for rate case and regulatory reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Integration; GAAP ASC 810; FERC USoA

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area (KOKRS) to which this cost center belongs. Defines the organizational unit within which cost accounting is performed. Typically maps to the utility's legal entity or consolidated reporting entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: SAP cost center category code (KOSAR) classifying the type of cost center (e.g., E=Production/Operations, F=Overhead, H=Overhead, I=Investment, etc.). Determines which activity types and statistical key figures can be posted and controls planning behavior in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Cost Center Category

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the cost center within the SAP S/4HANA controlling area. Matches the SAP KOSTL field and is used in all FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) cost allocations, rate case filings, and general ledger postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: cost_center_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this cost center within the organizational hierarchy (e.g., 1=Division, 2=Department, 3=Work Group). Supports hierarchical drill-down in financial reporting and budget consolidation processes.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the cost center as maintained in SAP S/4HANA (KTEXT field). Used in financial reports, budget variance analyses, and cost-of-service studies submitted to state Public Utility Commissions (PUCs) and FERC.

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center in SAP S/4HANA. 'active' = open for postings; 'inactive' = temporarily closed; 'locked' = blocked for new postings (SAP lock indicator); 'pending_approval' = awaiting activation; 'archived' = historically closed and no longer in use. Controls whether financial transactions can be posted to this cost center.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Lock Indicator; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: SAP cost element group associated with this cost center, grouping related primary and secondary cost elements (G/L accounts) for planning, budgeting, and reporting. Supports OPEX and CAPEX segregation required for FERC USoA account mapping.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center master record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA). Supports audit trail requirements for SOX Section 404 internal controls and data governance lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost center's controlling area currency (e.g., USD). Defines the currency in which budgets, actuals, and plan values are recorded and reported for this cost center.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling Area Currency

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department code to which this cost center belongs, as defined in the utility's HR and finance organizational structure (SuccessFactors/Workday). Supports headcount and labor cost allocation reporting and aligns with the utility's organizational chart for management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Management; SuccessFactors/Workday HCM

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: SAP Asset Accounting depreciation area code associated with assets assigned to this cost center. Defines the depreciation rules (GAAP book, FERC regulatory, tax) applied to utility plant assets tracked under this cost center. Supports FERC-prescribed depreciation rates and GAAP ASC 360 asset accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Accounting; FERC USoA Depreciation Accounts; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: energy_commodity
attributes.description: Identifies whether this cost center supports electric operations, gas operations, both, or neither (corporate/shared services). Required for regulatory separation of electric and gas utility operations per state PUC accounting orders and FERC USoA commodity-specific account mapping.
attributes.references: FERC USoA 18 CFR Part 101 (Electric) and 18 CFR Part 201 (Gas); State PUC Accounting Orders

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: Primary FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) account code to which costs accumulated in this cost center are mapped for regulatory reporting. Required for FERC Form 1 (electric) and FERC Form 2 (gas) annual report filings. Enables direct traceability from cost center to regulatory account.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts 18 CFR Part 101 (Electric); 18 CFR Part 201 (Gas)

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP Fiscal Year Variant (PERIV) assigned to this cost center's controlling area, defining the fiscal year calendar (e.g., K4 = calendar year Jan-Dec). Ensures correct period assignment for budget planning and actual cost postings in regulatory and GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Primary utility functional area served by this cost center, aligned with FERC Uniform System of Accounts functional classifications (e.g., generation, transmission, distribution). Drives cost allocation to FERC accounts and supports cost-of-service studies for rate cases filed with PUCs and FERC. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: generation|transmission|distribution_electric|distribution_gas|metering|customer_service|corporate|regulatory|finance|it|hr — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101; NARUC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: gl_account_group
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger account group associated with this cost center, defining the range of G/L accounts (FERC USoA accounts) that can be posted. Ensures that only appropriate expense and capital accounts are used for each functional area, supporting GAAP and FERC regulatory accounting integrity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Account Group; FERC USoA; GAAP

attributes.name: headcount_plan
attributes.description: Approved planned headcount (number of full-time equivalent positions) assigned to this cost center for the current budget year. Used for labor cost planning, workforce analytics, and rate case labor cost justification in cost-of-service studies filed with PUCs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR-CO Integration; SuccessFactors/Workday Workforce Planning

attributes.name: hierarchy_area
attributes.description: Node within the SAP standard cost center hierarchy (KHINR) to which this cost center belongs. Defines the organizational rollup path for management reporting, budget consolidation, and cost-of-service study aggregations aligned with the utility's organizational structure.

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cost center master record in SAP S/4HANA. Used for incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse pipeline and SOX change management audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents; Databricks ETL

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Physical location or service territory code associated with this cost center. For field operations cost centers, maps to a geographic service district or substation area. Supports geographic cost allocation, T&D cost-of-service studies, and GIS-based reporting via ESRI ArcGIS integration.
attributes.references: ESRI ArcGIS GIS Network; FERC USoA Geographic Allocation

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Extended narrative description of the cost center's business purpose, scope of activities, and organizational context. Supports regulatory documentation and rate case cost-of-service study narratives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP Plant (WERKS) or physical facility/location to which this cost center is primarily assigned. For generation cost centers, maps to a specific power plant. For T&D cost centers, maps to a service territory or operating district. Supports asset-level cost tracking in conjunction with Oracle WAM or IBM Maximo EAM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance (PM); FERC USoA Plant Accounts

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: SAP Profit Center (PRCTR) to which this cost center is assigned for internal management reporting and segment profitability analysis. Supports GAAP segment reporting disclosures (ASC 280) and internal ROE/ROI analysis by business segment (electric, gas, corporate).

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Indicates the regulatory jurisdiction governing costs accumulated in this cost center. 'FERC' = subject to FERC wholesale/transmission regulation; 'state_puc' = subject to state Public Utility Commission retail rate regulation; 'both' = dual jurisdiction; 'non_regulated' = unregulated activities. Critical for cost allocation in rate cases and FERC Form 1/2 reporting.
attributes.references: FERC 18 CFR Part 101; State PUC Tariff and Rate Case Rules; NARUC

attributes.name: responsible_manager_code
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the manager accountable for the cost center's budget and expenditures, as maintained in SAP S/4HANA (VERAK field) and synchronized with SuccessFactors or Workday HCM. Used for budget approval workflows, variance reporting, and SOX internal control accountability assignments.

attributes.name: responsible_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the manager responsible for this cost center's budget and financial performance. Displayed in financial reports, budget variance dashboards, and cost-of-service study documentation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA cost center master (VERAK_NAME).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this cost center master record originates (e.g., SAP S/4HANA client/system ID). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer and enables reconciliation between the lakehouse and the ERP system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA System Landscape; Databricks Data Lineage

attributes.name: sox_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is within scope for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Section 404 internal controls over financial reporting. SOX-relevant cost centers require documented controls, segregation of duties, and periodic management testing as part of the utility's annual SOX compliance program.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element associated with this cost center for capital project cost tracking. Links cost center CAPEX accumulation to specific capital projects in SAP PS (Project System), supporting AFUDC calculation, WIP reporting, and CIAC tracking for regulatory rate base purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Project System; FERC USoA Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) Accounts; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: work_order_settlement_profile
attributes.description: SAP settlement profile (ABCPROFIL) defining how maintenance and capital work order costs are settled to this cost center from Oracle WAM or IBM Maximo work orders integrated via SAP PM. Governs CAPEX vs. OPEX treatment of maintenance activities for regulatory accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Settlement; FERC USoA Maintenance Accounts

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which this cost center is valid and open for financial postings in SAP S/4HANA (DATAB field). Defines the start of the cost center's active period for budget planning, actual cost accumulation, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Validity Period; FERC USoA

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: Date through which this cost center is valid in SAP S/4HANA (DATBI field). After this date, no new postings are permitted. Nullable for open-ended cost centers. Supports historical cost center management and regulatory period-of-record requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Validity Period; FERC USoA

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on cost_center (parent_cost_center_id)

products.name: gl_account
products.description: General ledger account master aligned to the FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) chart of accounts for regulated electric and gas utilities. Captures account number, account name, FERC account code (e.g., Account 101 – Electric Plant in Service, Account 303 – Miscellaneous Intangible Plant), account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), normal balance indicator, and GAAP classification. Serves as the SSOT for all ledger postings, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1/2 regulatory filings. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud chart of accounts module.
products.reference: FERC Uniform System of Accounts / SAP S/4HANA G/L Account Master

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the general ledger account record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for all ledger postings, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1/2 regulatory filings.

attributes.name: account_description
attributes.description: Extended narrative description of the GL account's purpose, the types of transactions posted to it, and any special accounting treatment required. Provides guidance to accountants and auditors on proper account usage. Sourced from the SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud account master long text field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Oracle ERP Cloud Chart of Accounts; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA)

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: The account group in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud that controls the number range and field selection for this GL account (e.g., 'UTIL_PLANT' for utility plant accounts, 'OPEX' for operating expense accounts, 'REVENUE' for revenue accounts). Used in chart-of-accounts governance and ERP configuration management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Oracle ERP Cloud Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The official descriptive name of the GL account as defined in the chart of accounts (e.g., 'Electric Plant in Service', 'Miscellaneous Intangible Plant', 'Operation and Maintenance Expense'). Used in financial statements, rate case filings, and FERC Form 1/2 schedules.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known chart-of-accounts number assigned to this GL account in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud. Used as the primary business identifier for ledger postings, journal entries, and cross-system reconciliation. Aligns with the FERC Uniform System of Accounts numbering scheme (e.g., 101, 303, 408).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: account_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated display name for the GL account used in reports, dashboards, and ERP screen labels where space is limited. Sourced from the SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud short description field on the chart of accounts master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Oracle ERP Cloud Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account in the chart of accounts. Active accounts accept journal entry postings; inactive accounts are retained for historical reporting but do not accept new postings; blocked accounts are temporarily locked pending review; pending_approval accounts are newly created and awaiting chart-of-accounts governance approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Oracle ERP Cloud Chart of Accounts; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification within the account_type that provides finer segmentation for financial reporting (e.g., 'current asset', 'non-current asset', 'operating revenue', 'non-operating expense', 'long-term liability', 'retained earnings'). Used in GAAP balance sheet and income statement sub-classifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: current_asset|non_current_asset|current_liability|non_current_liability|operating_revenue|non_operating_revenue|operating_expense|non_operating_expense|retained_earnings|paid_in_capital — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 205; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA)

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental financial statement classification of the GL account per GAAP: asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense. Drives balance sheet vs. income statement placement and is used in FERC Form 1/2 schedule mapping and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 205; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA)

attributes.name: afudc_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is eligible for Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) capitalization. AFUDC represents the cost of debt and equity funds used to finance construction projects and is capitalized to utility plant per FERC USoA guidelines. Applicable to CWIP accounts and certain capital project cost accounts.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) Account 107; GAAP ASC 835-20 (Capitalization of Interest)

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Classifies the GL account as a capital expenditure (CAPEX) account, operating expenditure (OPEX) account, or both. CAPEX accounts feed the utility plant and work-in-progress (WIP) schedules; OPEX accounts feed the income statement. Essential for AFUDC calculations, rate base determination, and IRP financial modeling.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); GAAP ASC 360 (Property, Plant and Equipment)

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_code
attributes.description: The chart-of-accounts identifier in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud to which this GL account belongs (e.g., 'UTIL' for the utility operating company chart, 'CORP' for the corporate holding company chart). Supports multi-entity financial consolidation and intercompany eliminations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Oracle ERP Cloud Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: ciac_account_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contribution in Aid of Construction (CIAC) Account Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account records Contributions in Aid of Construction (CIAC) — cash or property contributed by customers or developers to fund utility infrastructure extensions. CIAC reduces rate base and is tracked separately per FERC USoA Account 271 and state PUC requirements.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) Account 271; State PUC CIAC Rules

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The ERP company code (legal entity identifier) in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud to which this GL account is assigned. Represents the regulated utility operating company or holding company entity for which GAAP financial statements and FERC annual reports are prepared.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure; FERC Form 1/2 Entity Identification

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: The SAP Controlling (CO) cost element category assigned to this GL account, indicating how costs flow through the cost accounting module. Primary cost elements represent costs originating from Financial Accounting (FI); secondary cost elements represent internal allocations and settlements. Used in O&M cost allocation studies for rate cases.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this GL account master record was first created in the source ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud). Used for chart-of-accounts audit trail, SOX change management controls, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which this GL account is maintained (e.g., 'USD' for US Dollar). Utility companies operating in the US maintain accounts in USD; multinational holding companies may maintain accounts in multiple currencies. Drives currency translation in financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP ASC 830 (Foreign Currency Matters)

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this GL account was deactivated and made unavailable for new journal entry postings. Null for currently active accounts. Historical balances remain accessible for reporting after deactivation. Used in chart-of-accounts governance and period-end close validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Oracle ERP Cloud Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: depreciation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is an accumulated depreciation or depreciation expense account. True for FERC accounts 108 (Accumulated Provision for Depreciation of Electric Utility Plant) and equivalent gas accounts. Used to identify accounts included in depreciation rate studies filed with state PUCs.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this GL account became effective and available for use in the chart of accounts. Marks the start of the account's valid period for journal entry postings. Used in period-end close processes to validate that postings are made to accounts active during the posting period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Oracle ERP Cloud Chart of Accounts; GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) account code mapped to this GL account (e.g., 101 for Electric Plant in Service, 303 for Miscellaneous Intangible Plant, 408 for Taxes Other Than Income Taxes). Mandatory for FERC Form 1 (electric) and FERC Form 2 (gas) regulatory filings. A single internal GL account may map to one FERC account code.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Parts 101 and 201

attributes.name: ferc_account_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Description
attributes.description: The official FERC USoA description for the mapped FERC account code. Provides the regulatory definition of allowable charges to this account as prescribed by FERC 18 CFR Parts 101 and 201. Used in rate case cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1/2 narrative disclosures.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Parts 101 and 201

attributes.name: ferc_form_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Form Reference
attributes.description: Identifies which FERC annual report form this account populates: FERC Form 1 (Major Electric Utilities), FERC Form 2 (Major Natural Gas Companies), FERC Form 1-F (Non-Major Electric Utilities), both (for common accounts), or not_applicable for accounts not reported to FERC. Drives automated FERC regulatory reporting extraction.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 (18 CFR Part 141); FERC Form 2 (18 CFR Part 260)

attributes.name: financial_statement_version
attributes.description: The financial statement version (FSV) code in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud that governs how this account is presented in GAAP financial statements (e.g., 'GAAP_UTIL' for GAAP utility financial statements, 'FERC_F1' for FERC Form 1 reporting). Supports multi-GAAP and regulatory reporting from a single chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Statement Version; FERC Form 1; GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: functional_class
attributes.description: The FERC USoA functional classification of the account within the utility function (e.g., generation, transmission, distribution, customer accounts, administrative and general). Used to allocate costs in rate case cost-of-service studies and to populate FERC Form 1/2 functional expense schedules.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Parts 101 and 201

attributes.name: gaap_classification
attributes.description: The GAAP financial statement line-item classification for this account (e.g., 'Utility Plant', 'Accumulated Depreciation', 'Long-Term Debt', 'Operating Revenues – Electric', 'Operation Expense – Fuel'). Maps the account to the specific line in GAAP-compliant financial statements filed with the SEC and state PUCs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: utility_plant|accumulated_depreciation|regulatory_asset|regulatory_liability|operating_revenue|operation_expense|maintenance_expense|depreciation_expense|income_tax|long_term_debt|common_equity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 980 (Regulated Operations); GAAP ASC 205; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: income_tax_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is an income tax account (current or deferred). True for FERC accounts 408 (Taxes Other Than Income Taxes), 409 (Income Taxes), 410/411 (Deferred Income Taxes). Used in SOX tax provision controls and rate case income tax normalization studies.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); GAAP ASC 740 (Income Taxes); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this GL account master record was most recently modified in the source ERP system. Tracks changes to account attributes such as status, FERC mapping, or posting controls. Used in SOX change management controls and incremental ETL processing for the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: line_item_display
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items posted to this GL account are stored and displayable in the ERP system for audit and drill-down purposes. When True, auditors and financial analysts can view each individual posting. Required for SOX audit trail completeness on high-risk accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: naruc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Regulatory Utility Commissioners (NARUC) Account Code
attributes.description: The NARUC Uniform System of Accounts code mapped to this GL account for state PUC regulatory reporting. State PUCs may require NARUC-aligned account codes that differ slightly from FERC USoA codes. Used in state annual report filings and state rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: NARUC Uniform System of Accounts for Electric and Gas Utilities

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account's normal (expected) balance is a debit or credit per double-entry bookkeeping rules. Assets and expenses carry a debit normal balance; liabilities, equity, and revenues carry a credit normal balance. Used by the ERP posting engine to detect out-of-balance conditions and in SOX journal entry controls.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 205; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA)

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account uses open item management in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud, meaning individual line items remain open until cleared by a matching offsetting entry. Typically enabled for clearing accounts, bank accounts, and GR/IR (Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt) accounts. Supports accounts receivable and accounts payable reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Oracle ERP Cloud Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: parent_account_number
attributes.description: The account number of the parent/summary GL account in the chart-of-accounts hierarchy. Enables roll-up of detailed accounts into summary accounts for financial statement presentation and FERC Form 1/2 schedule aggregation. Null for top-level summary accounts.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); SAP S/4HANA Financial Statement Version

attributes.name: plant_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a utility plant account subject to FERC plant-in-service reporting, depreciation schedules, and rate base inclusion. True for accounts in the FERC 100-series (Electric Plant) and 200-series (Gas Plant). Used to filter accounts for AFUDC capitalization and depreciation rate studies.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101 (Accounts 101–107); GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct journal entry postings are permitted to this GL account. False for summary/group accounts that only aggregate child accounts and do not accept direct postings. Sourced from the SAP S/4HANA account master 'Post Automatically Only' or Oracle ERP Cloud 'Allow Posting' flag.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Oracle ERP Cloud Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: rate_base_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether balances in this GL account are eligible for inclusion in the utility's rate base for rate case cost-of-service studies filed with FERC or state PUCs. Rate base typically includes net utility plant in service, working capital allowances, and regulatory assets. Used in PBR and traditional cost-of-service rate case models.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); State PUC Rate Case Guidelines; NARUC

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) in SAP S/4HANA, meaning postings are made automatically from subledger modules (Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Asset Accounting) and direct manual postings are restricted. Critical for SOX subledger-to-general-ledger reconciliation controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_liability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account represents a regulatory asset or regulatory liability recognized under GAAP ASC 980 (Regulated Operations). Regulatory assets/liabilities arise from rate-regulated accounting deferrals approved by FERC or state PUCs (e.g., deferred fuel costs, storm damage deferrals, pension regulatory assets).
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 980 (Regulated Operations); FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA)

attributes.name: source_system_account_code
attributes.description: The native account identifier as stored in the originating ERP system (SAP S/4HANA GL account number or Oracle ERP Cloud natural account segment value). Enables traceability from the Databricks Silver Layer record back to the source system for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; Oracle ERP Cloud Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: sox_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is within scope for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Section 404 internal controls over financial reporting. SOX-relevant accounts require documented controls, periodic testing, and management certification. Sourced from the SOX scoping assessment maintained by the internal audit and finance compliance teams.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SEC Release No. 33-8238; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax relevance category for this GL account in the ERP system, indicating whether the account is subject to sales/use tax, gross receipts tax, or is tax-exempt. Used in automated tax determination during invoice processing and in state PUC gross receipts tax reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: taxable_input|taxable_output|exempt|not_relevant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Configuration; State PUC Gross Receipts Tax Regulations

attributes.name: utility_function
attributes.description: Identifies whether the GL account is associated with the electric utility function, gas utility function, common/shared services, or other non-utility operations. Critical for cost-of-service studies in rate cases, FERC Form 1 (electric) vs. FERC Form 2 (gas) filing segregation, and state PUC jurisdictional separation of revenues and expenses.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Parts 101 and 201; NARUC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: wip_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a Work in Progress (WIP) / Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) account (FERC Account 107 – Construction Work in Progress – Electric, or equivalent gas account). WIP accounts accumulate capital project costs before transfer to plant-in-service upon project completion. Used in AFUDC calculation and capital project tracking.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) Account 107; GAAP ASC 360

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Header record for every general ledger posting made in the utilitys ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud). Captures journal entry number, posting date, fiscal period, fiscal year, document type (standard, accrual, reversal, intercompany, recurring, statistical), posting key, total debit amount, total credit amount, currency, reference document, source module (FI, CO, MM, PM, SD), posting user, approval status, and reversal indicator. Supports GAAP financial statement preparation, SOX internal controls (segregation of duties audit trail, dual-approval enforcement), and FERC regulatory accounting. Each journal entry header links to one or more line items captured in journal_entry_line. Balanced entry validation (total debits = total credits) is enforced at this level.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Journal Entry / Oracle ERP Cloud Subledger Accounting

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry header record in the general ledger. Primary key for the journal_entry data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary cost center associated with this journal entry header, representing the organizational unit responsible for the costs (e.g., generation plant, transmission operations, distribution district, customer service). Supports FERC cost-of-service studies and rate case OPEX allocation.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: journal_entry has fiscal_year and fiscal_period attributes. financial_period is the master for fiscal periods. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full period metadata. fiscal_year and fi

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center associated with this journal entry, representing a business segment for internal profitability reporting (e.g., electric distribution, gas distribution, generation). Supports segment reporting under GAAP ASC 280 and FERC jurisdictional cost separation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 280; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: recurring_template_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the recurring entry template in the ERP system that generated this journal entry. Populated only when is_recurring = True. Enables traceability from posted entries back to the template for maintenance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Work Breakdown Structure element for CAPEX project postings. Links journal entries to capital projects for AFUDC calculation, WIP tracking, and asset capitalization. Populated for capital expenditure entries; null for OPEX entries. Supports FERC CIAC and AFUDC regulatory accounting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA PS Module

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state of the journal entry indicating whether it has been reviewed and authorized by a second approver per SOX dual-approval controls. Values: pending (awaiting review), approved (authorized for posting), rejected (returned for correction), not_required (below materiality threshold or auto-approved). Critical for segregation-of-duties audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the journal entry was approved by the designated approver. Used for SOX dual-approval audit trail and period-close timeliness reporting. Null when approval_status is pending or not_required.

attributes.name: approver_user_code
attributes.description: ERP system user ID of the individual who approved this journal entry under the dual-approval SOX control framework. Distinct from posting_user_id to enforce segregation of duties. Null when approval is not required or entry is pending approval.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Alphanumeric assignment field used for sorting and grouping journal entries in account line item displays and financial reports. Often populated with a customer account number, asset number, or billing period for quick identification. Corresponds to ZUONR in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this journal entry represents a capital expenditure (CAPEX) to be capitalized as a utility plant asset or an operating expenditure (OPEX) to be expensed in the current period. Critical for FERC rate base determination, GAAP ASC 360 asset capitalization, and PUC rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 360; NARUC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which open items in this journal entry were cleared (matched and closed) against a payment or offsetting document. Populated when posting_status = cleared. Used for aging analysis and cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 210; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
