attributes.description: Document number of the clearing entry that matched and closed open items associated with this journal entry (e.g., payment clearing against an invoice). Populated when posting_status = cleared. Supports accounts receivable and accounts payable reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 210; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character ERP company code identifying the legal entity or organizational unit within the utility that owns this journal entry (e.g., electric subsidiary, gas subsidiary, holding company). Used for intercompany elimination and FERC entity-level reporting. Corresponds to BUKRS in SAP FI.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency of this journal entry (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Required for multi-currency consolidation and FERC reporting. Most utility domestic entries will be USD; intercompany or PPA entries may use foreign currencies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 830; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original business transaction or source document (e.g., invoice date, contract date) that triggered this journal entry. May differ from posting_date for accruals or late postings. Corresponds to BLDAT in SAP FI.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 250; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric document number assigned by the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud) at the time of posting. Used by accountants and auditors to locate and reference a specific journal entry. Corresponds to BELNR in SAP FI or Document Number in Oracle GL.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: document_type_code
attributes.description: Two-character ERP document type code that classifies the nature of the journal entry (e.g., SA=General Ledger, AA=Asset Posting, KR=Vendor Invoice, DR=Customer Invoice, AB=Accounting Document, ZP=Payment Clearing). Controls number range assignment and account type permissibility. Corresponds to BLART in SAP FI. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|AA|KR|DR|AB|ZP|RV|WA|ML|RE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 210

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this journal entry record was first created in the ERP system. Used for SOX audit trail and segregation-of-duties reporting. Represents RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED per canonical attribute requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the journal entry indicating its functional purpose: standard (normal operational posting), accrual (period-end estimate), reversal (correction of prior entry), intercompany (cross-entity elimination), recurring (template-based periodic posting), or statistical (non-financial cost allocation). Drives GAAP presentation and FERC regulatory accounting treatment.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 420; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: Primary FERC Uniform System of Accounts code associated with this journal entry header (e.g., Account 101 for Steam Production Plant, Account 303 for Transmission Plant, Account 364 for Distribution Plant). Drives FERC Form 1 and Form 2 regulatory reporting. May be derived from line items but captured at header for summary reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (1–16) within the fiscal year in which this journal entry is posted. Periods 1–12 represent calendar months; periods 13–16 are special closing periods used for year-end adjustments. Corresponds to MONAT in SAP FI.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this journal entry is recorded (e.g., 2024). Used for annual financial statement preparation, FERC Form 1 reporting, and SOX period-close controls. Corresponds to GJAHR in SAP FI.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the utility functional area to which this journal entry is attributed for cost-of-service and rate case analysis: GEN (Generation), TRN (Transmission), DST (Electric Distribution), GAS (Gas Distribution), CUS (Customer Service), ADM (Administrative and General), REG (Regulatory), FIN (Finance). Supports FERC jurisdictional cost separation and PUC rate case filings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GEN|TRN|DST|GAS|CUS|ADM|REG|FIN — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description of the journal entry provided by the posting user, summarizing the business purpose or nature of the transaction (e.g., 'Q3 2024 Transmission Line Depreciation Accrual', 'October AMI Meter Installation CAPEX'). Used for search, audit review, and financial reporting narrative. Corresponds to BKTXT in SAP FI.

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry involves a transaction between two legal entities within the utility holding company structure (e.g., electric subsidiary billing gas subsidiary for shared services). True for intercompany entries requiring elimination in consolidated financial statements per GAAP ASC 810.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry was generated from a recurring entry template (e.g., monthly depreciation, lease accruals, fixed O&M allocations). True when generated from a recurring template; False for manually created entries. Supports automated period-close processes.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 420; SAP S/4HANA FI Recurring Entries

attributes.name: is_reversed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry has been reversed by a subsequent offsetting entry. True when a reversal document exists; False otherwise. Used to exclude reversed entries from financial statement balances and to identify correction activity for SOX audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp of the most recent modification to this journal entry header record. Used for SOX change-tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail completeness. Represents RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED per canonical attribute requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: ledger_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the accounting ledger in which this entry is recorded. In SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal, 0L is the leading ledger (GAAP), while parallel ledgers (1L, 2L) may capture FERC regulatory accounting or IFRS. Ensures correct financial statement presentation per applicable accounting framework.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal

attributes.name: line_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of journal entry line items (debit and credit legs) associated with this header record. Used for data completeness validation, balanced-entry checks, and identifying complex multi-line entries requiring additional review. Supports SOX control monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the company code local currency (functional currency) in which amounts are also recorded. Supports multi-currency translation for consolidated GAAP financial statements and FERC Form 1 reporting. Corresponds to WAERS for local currency in SAP FI.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger and affects account balances. Determines the fiscal period assignment. Distinct from the document date (transaction date) and entry date (system capture date). Corresponds to BUDAT in SAP FI.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 250; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the journal entry in the ERP workflow: draft (in preparation), parked (saved but not posted), held (temporarily suspended), posted (committed to GL), reversed (offset entry created), or cleared (open items matched). Supports SOX period-close controls and dual-approval enforcement.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: posting_user_code
attributes.description: ERP system user ID of the individual who created and posted this journal entry. Essential for SOX segregation-of-duties controls, audit trail completeness, and detection of unauthorized postings. Corresponds to USNAM in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this journal entry to the originating business document (e.g., vendor invoice number, purchase order number, work order number, billing document number, rate case docket number). Enables drill-through from GL to source transaction for audit and reconciliation. Corresponds to XBLNR in SAP FI.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The posting date of the reversing journal entry. Used to determine the fiscal period in which the reversal is recorded. Populated only when is_reversed = True. Supports accrual reversal scheduling and period-close management.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 250; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the reversing journal entry that offsets this entry. Populated only when is_reversed = True. Enables audit trail linkage between original and reversal entries for GAAP error correction and SOX controls. Corresponds to STBLG in SAP FI.

attributes.name: source_module
attributes.description: The ERP functional module that originated this journal entry: FI (Financial Accounting), CO (Controlling/Cost Accounting), MM (Materials Management), PM (Plant Maintenance/Asset Management), SD (Sales and Distribution), PS (Project System for CAPEX/WIP), HR (Human Resources), RE (Real Estate). Supports cross-module reconciliation and FERC cost-of-service allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FI|CO|MM|PM|SD|PS|HR|RE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Module Architecture; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all credit line item amounts for this journal entry in the transaction currency. Must equal total_debit_amount for a balanced entry per double-entry bookkeeping. Used for balanced-entry validation, GAAP financial statement preparation, and FERC regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 210; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: total_credit_amount_local
attributes.description: Sum of all credit line item amounts translated into the company code local currency (functional currency). Used for domestic financial statement preparation and FERC regulatory reporting when transaction currency differs from local currency.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 830; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all debit line item amounts for this journal entry in the transaction currency. Must equal total_credit_amount for a balanced entry per double-entry bookkeeping. Used for balanced-entry validation, GAAP financial statement preparation, and FERC regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 210; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: total_debit_amount_local
attributes.description: Sum of all debit line item amounts translated into the company code local currency (functional currency). Used for domestic financial statement preparation and FERC regulatory reporting when transaction currency differs from local currency.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 830; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner entity involved in this journal entry. Populated only when is_intercompany = True. Used for intercompany reconciliation and elimination in consolidated GAAP financial statements. Corresponds to VBUND in SAP FI.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Line-item detail for each general ledger journal entry posting. Captures line number, GL account, cost center, WBS element, functional area, debit/credit indicator, amount in transaction currency, amount in company code currency, tax code, profit center, segment, and business area. Enables granular cost allocation, FERC account-level reporting, and SOX-compliant audit trails at the individual posting level. One-to-many relationship with journal_entry header.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item / Oracle ERP Cloud Journal Line

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry line item in the general ledger. Primary key for this record in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG Table; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: journal_entry_line has fiscal_year and fiscal_period attributes. financial_period is the master for fiscal periods. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full period metadata (period_name,

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.gl_account

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header record. Establishes the one-to-many relationship between the header and its line items. Corresponds to SAP BKPF-BELNR (Accounting Document Number) surrogate key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF/BSEG; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: SAP account type for this posting line: A=Asset, D=Customer (Debtor), K=Vendor (Creditor), M=Material, S=GL Account. Determines the subledger integration and reporting classification. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-KOART.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-KOART; GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: amount_company_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item translated into the company code's local currency (e.g., USD). Used for consolidated financial statements, FERC reporting, and SOX-compliant audit trails. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-DMBTR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-DMBTR; GAAP ASC 830; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: amount_transaction_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item expressed in the transaction currency. Positive for debits, negative for credits (or vice versa per system convention). Corresponds to SAP BSEG-WRBTR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-WRBTR; GAAP ASC 830; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: SAP fixed asset number when this line item relates to an asset acquisition, depreciation, or retirement posting. Links to the asset accounting subledger for utility plant-in-service tracking. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-ANLN1.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA — BSEG-ANLN1; FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 101-107; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Free-form assignment field used to link this posting to a source document reference such as a customer account number, contract number, or payment reference. Supports open item management and clearing. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-ZUONR.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP business area for cross-company-code segment reporting, enabling balance sheet and P&L reporting by business segment (e.g., electric utility, gas utility, unregulated). Corresponds to SAP BSEG-GSBER.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-GSBER; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Classifies this posting as a capital expenditure (CAPEX) or operating expenditure (OPEX). Critical for utility rate base determination, regulatory cost-of-service studies, and FERC plant accounting. Drives the distinction between plant-in-service additions and expense recognition.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); GAAP ASC 360; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which this open item was cleared (matched against a payment or offsetting entry). Null if the item remains open. Used for DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) analysis and collections reporting. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-AUGDT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-AUGDT; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing transaction that offset this open item (e.g., payment clearing an invoice). Null if the item is still open. Supports accounts receivable/payable reconciliation and aging analysis. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-AUGBL.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-AUGBL; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity or regulated utility subsidiary to which this posting belongs. Used for entity-level financial reporting and FERC jurisdictional separation. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-BUKRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG-BUKRS; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: company_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code's local currency (typically USD for US utilities). Used for consolidated financial reporting. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-PSWSL.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-PSWSL

attributes.name: customer_number
attributes.description: SAP customer (debtor) account number when this line item relates to a customer receivable posting (e.g., utility bill revenue recognition). Links to the accounts receivable subledger. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-KUNNR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR — BSEG-KUNNR; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting to the GL account. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping and ensures journal entry balance. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-SHKZG.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-SHKZG; GAAP ASC 230; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document (invoice, contract, work order) that triggered this journal entry line. May differ from posting date for accruals and retroactive adjustments. Corresponds to SAP BKPF-BLDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF-BLDAT; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code mapped to this GL posting line. Required for FERC Form 1 (electric) and FERC Form 2 (gas) annual report filings. Enables regulatory cost-of-service studies and rate case preparation. Distinct from the internal GL account code.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101 and 201); FERC Form 1 and Form 2

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (1–16 in SAP, where 13–16 are special closing periods) within the fiscal year for this posting. Drives period-end close reporting, monthly P&L, and regulatory period reporting. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-MONAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG-MONAT; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this journal entry line is posted. Used for annual financial reporting, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1 annual report preparation. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-GJAHR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG-GJAHR; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP functional area classifying the business function of this posting (e.g., generation, transmission, distribution, customer service, administration). Supports functional cost reporting required for FERC cost-of-service studies and rate case filings. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-FKBER.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-FKBER; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Free-text description of this individual posting line providing context for the transaction (e.g., 'Q3 fuel adjustment accrual', 'Substation transformer replacement CAPEX'). Supports SOX audit trail and financial statement footnote preparation. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-SGTXT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-SGTXT; SOX Section 302 and 404

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the parent journal entry, used to order and uniquely identify each posting line within a document. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-BUZEI (Line Item Number).

attributes.name: open_item_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item remains open (uncleared) in the GL. True = open item pending clearing; False = item has been cleared. Drives accounts receivable/payable aging reports and collections workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG Open Item Management; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: SAP internal order number for overhead cost collection, capital investment orders, or maintenance orders. Used to accumulate costs for specific projects or activities before settlement to cost centers or WBS elements. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-AUFNR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — BSEG-AUFNR; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the operational facility (generation plant, service center, substation) associated with this posting. Enables plant-level cost analysis and asset-level CAPEX/OPEX tracking. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-WERKS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PM Module — BSEG-WERKS; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this line item is posted to the general ledger, determining the accounting period assignment. Critical for period-end close, accrual cutoff, and FERC regulatory reporting. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-BUDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG-BUDAT; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit SAP posting key that determines the account type, debit/credit side, and field status for this line item (e.g., 40=GL debit, 50=GL credit, 01=customer invoice, 31=vendor invoice). Corresponds to SAP BSEG-BSCHL.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity associated with this line item when the posting relates to a quantity-based transaction (e.g., MWh of energy purchased, MCF of gas consumed, number of meters installed). Corresponds to SAP BSEG-MENGE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-MENGE; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., MWh for energy, MCF for gas, EA for each/count, HR for hours). Aligns with utility industry standard units for energy and gas accounting. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-MEINS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MWh|kWh|MCF|Therm|MW|kW|EA|HR|M3|GJ — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-MEINS; AGA; IEEE; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number (e.g., vendor invoice number, purchase order number, work order number) that originated this posting. Enables cross-system traceability from GL to source transaction. Corresponds to SAP BKPF-XBLNR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF-XBLNR; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Identifies the regulatory jurisdiction applicable to this posting: FERC (federal jurisdiction for transmission and wholesale), STATE (state PUC jurisdiction for distribution and retail), BOTH (dual jurisdiction), or UNREGULATED (non-regulated activities). Supports jurisdictional cost separation required for rate case filings.
attributes.references: FERC (18 CFR); State PUC Tariff Regulations; NARUC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the reversing or reversed journal entry. Populated when reversal_indicator is True, enabling traceability between original and reversing entries for SOX audit and period-close reconciliation. Corresponds to SAP BKPF-STBLG.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF-STBLG; SOX Section 302 and 404

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is part of a reversal document (True) or an original posting (False). Reversal entries are critical for period-end accrual management and SOX audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF-STBLG; SOX Section 302 and 404; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Financial reporting segment assigned to this line item for GAAP segment disclosures (e.g., regulated electric, regulated gas, unregulated). Supports GAAP ASC 280 segment reporting requirements in annual financial statements. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-SEGMENT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-SEGMENT; GAAP ASC 280 Segment Reporting

attributes.name: source_ledger_code
attributes.description: Identifies the source ledger or subledger from which this posting originated (e.g., 0L=Leading Ledger, 2L=IFRS Ledger, US=US GAAP Ledger). Supports parallel accounting for GAAP and regulatory reporting. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-RLDNR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-RLDNR; GAAP ASC 205; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: SAP special GL indicator identifying non-standard postings such as down payments (A), guarantees (B), or bill of exchange (W). Used to segregate special transactions in balance sheet reporting. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-UMSKZ.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-UMSKZ; GAAP ASC 210

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount calculated for this line item in company code currency. Includes applicable sales tax, use tax, or gross receipts tax. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-WMWST.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX — BSEG-WMWST; IRS; State PUC Tax Regulations

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code assigned to this line item determining applicable tax rates and tax account postings (e.g., sales tax, use tax, gross receipts tax). Required for tax compliance reporting and regulatory filings. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-MWSKZ.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX — BSEG-MWSKZ; IRS Tax Code; State PUC Tax Regulations

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the original transaction (e.g., USD for domestic, CAD for cross-border Canadian operations). Corresponds to SAP BSEG-WAERS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG-WAERS

attributes.name: vendor_number
attributes.description: SAP vendor (creditor) account number when this line item relates to a vendor payable posting. Links to the accounts payable subledger for vendor balance and aging reporting. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-LIFNR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP — BSEG-LIFNR; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: Project WBS element code for CAPEX postings, enabling capital project cost tracking, AFUDC calculation, and WIP balance management. Critical for utility plant accounting and rate base determination. Corresponds to SAP BSEG-PS_PSP_PNR (WBS Element).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module — BSEG-PS_PSP_PNR; FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 107 (Construction Work in Progress)

products.name: capex_project
products.description: Master record for capital expenditure projects tracked under the utilitys capital program. Captures WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) element, project number, project description, asset class, FERC plant account (e.g., Account 101 Electric Plant in Service, Account 107 Construction Work in Progress), project type (transmission, distribution, generation, gas, IT, environmental/compliance), authorized capital budget, AFUDC (Allowance for Funds Used During Construction) eligibility flag and accrual rate, CIAC (Contribution in Aid of Construction) indicator and amount, project manager, in-service date target, actual in-service date, project status (planned, approved, in-progress, complete, closed, cancelled), and blanket vs. specific project indicator. Supports CAPEX tracking, rate base calculations, CWIP balance reporting, regulatory plant additions reporting, and capital program prioritization. Blanket projects represent recurring capital programs (e.g., annual pole replacement) while specific projects represent discrete capital investments.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) / FERC Account 107 CWIP / AFUDC

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the capital expenditure project record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the capex_project data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: capex_project has cost_center attribute (STRING). cost_center is the master for cost centers. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full cost center details (name, responsible_manager, func

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Capital projects must be assigned to service territory locations for geographic cost allocation, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and project portfolio management. Replaces denormalized function

attributes.name: rate_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory rate case in which this capital project's costs are included for rate base recovery. Links capital investment to the regulatory docket for cost-of-service studies and plant additions testimony.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Filing Requirements; FERC Rate Case Procedures

attributes.name: actual_cost_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative actual capital expenditures incurred on the project to date, expressed in US dollars. Sourced from the ERP cost collection against the WBS element. Used for CWIP balance reporting, budget variance analysis, and capital program tracking.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: actual_in_service_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the capital project assets were placed in service and transferred from CWIP to plant in service accounts. Triggers AFUDC cessation, depreciation commencement, and inclusion in rate base. Null until the project reaches in-service status.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: afudc_accrued_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Accrued Amount
attributes.description: Cumulative AFUDC amount capitalized to the project to date, expressed in US dollars. Represents the financing cost of construction capitalized per FERC accounting rules. Included in the total project cost and rate base upon in-service. Null if afudc_eligible is False.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); GAAP ASC 980-835

attributes.name: afudc_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this capital project is eligible for Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) accrual (True) or not (False). AFUDC represents the cost of financing construction and is capitalized to the project per FERC accounting rules. Eligibility is determined by project type, duration, and regulatory authorization.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); GAAP ASC 980-835

attributes.name: afudc_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Accrual Rate
attributes.description: AFUDC accrual rate applied to the project's CWIP balance to calculate the monthly AFUDC capitalization, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.075000 for 7.5%). Rate is set by the utility's regulatory accounting policy and approved by FERC or state PUC. Null if afudc_eligible is False.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); GAAP ASC 980-835

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Asset class designation that categorizes the type of utility plant asset being constructed or acquired (e.g., Overhead Lines, Underground Cable, Transformers, Meters, Gas Mains, Buildings, IT Equipment). Aligns with Oracle WAM or IBM Maximo asset class hierarchy and FERC plant account groupings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: overhead_lines|underground_cable|transformers|meters|gas_mains|buildings|it_equipment|generation_equipment|substation_equipment|vehicles — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; Oracle WAM / IBM Maximo Asset Class

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capital budget for this project was formally authorized through the utility's capital appropriations approval process. Marks the transition from planned to approved status and enables commitment of funds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module; Utility Capital Appropriations Policy

attributes.name: authorized_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total capital budget amount authorized by the utility's capital appropriations process for this project, expressed in US dollars. Represents the approved spending ceiling for the project. Used for capital program tracking, variance analysis, and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module

attributes.name: capex_opex_split_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) vs Operating Expenditure (OPEX) Split Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total project costs classified as capital expenditure (CAPEX) versus operating expenditure (OPEX), expressed as the CAPEX percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Supports GAAP capitalization policy compliance and regulatory cost classification for rate case filings.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: ciac_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contribution in Aid of Construction (CIAC) Amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of Contribution in Aid of Construction (CIAC) received or expected for this project, expressed in US dollars. Reduces the utility's net capital investment and rate base. Null if ciac_indicator is False.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); GAAP ASC 980; IRS Revenue Ruling 2007-31

attributes.name: ciac_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contribution in Aid of Construction (CIAC) Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this capital project involves a Contribution in Aid of Construction (CIAC) from a customer or developer (True) or not (False). CIAC represents funds or assets contributed by third parties to fund utility infrastructure extensions. Affects rate base treatment and tax accounting under GAAP and FERC rules.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); GAAP ASC 980; IRS Revenue Ruling 2007-31

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capital project was formally closed in the ERP system, finalizing all cost postings and completing the CWIP-to-plant transfer. Null until the project reaches closed status.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP or ERP cost center code associated with the sponsoring department for this capital project. Used for cost allocation, departmental CAPEX reporting, and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capital project record was first created in the source ERP system (SAP PS or Oracle Projects), in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module

attributes.name: cwip_account
attributes.description: FERC Account 107 (Electric) or Account 105 (Gas) Construction Work in Progress sub-account code used to accumulate project costs prior to in-service date. Supports CWIP balance reporting for rate case filings and regulatory plant additions schedules.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: depreciation_rate
attributes.description: Annual straight-line depreciation rate applied to the capital project assets upon in-service, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.033333 for 3.33% / 30-year life). Determined by the utility's FERC-approved or PUC-approved depreciation study by asset class. Null until the project is placed in service.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); GAAP ASC 360; State PUC Depreciation Study Approvals

attributes.name: estimated_cost_at_completion
attributes.description: Current forecast of total project cost at completion, expressed in US dollars. Reflects the project manager's latest estimate incorporating actual costs to date plus remaining work. Supports capital program forecasting and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module

attributes.name: ferc_plant_account
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Plant Account
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts plant account number to which the completed capital project will be classified upon in-service (e.g., Account 101 Electric Plant in Service, Account 107 Construction Work in Progress, Account 303 Miscellaneous Intangible Plant, Account 350 Land and Land Rights - Transmission). Critical for regulatory accounting, rate base calculations, and FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the capital project is primarily budgeted and tracked (e.g., 2024). Used for annual capital program reporting, budget cycle alignment, and year-over-year CAPEX trend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module; GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: is_blanket_project
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a blanket capital project (True) or a specific discrete capital project (False). Blanket projects represent recurring capital programs (e.g., annual pole replacement, annual meter deployment) that aggregate multiple small work orders under a single project authorization. Specific projects represent discrete capital investments with defined scope and budget.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module; Utility Capital Program Management

attributes.name: justification_category
attributes.description: Primary business justification category for the capital investment. Used for capital program portfolio analysis and regulatory prudency demonstrations. Values: reliability (grid or system reliability improvement), safety (worker or public safety), regulatory_compliance (mandated by FERC, PUC, EPA, NERC, PHMSA, or OSHA), growth (customer growth or load growth), replacement (end-of-life asset replacement), efficiency (operational efficiency improvement), environmental (environmental remediation or GHG reduction). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reliability|safety|regulatory_compliance|growth|replacement|efficiency|environmental — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards; PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations; State PUC Capital Prudency Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capital project record was most recently modified in the source ERP system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports change tracking, SOX audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module

attributes.name: nerc_reliability_standard
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reliability Standard
attributes.description: NERC reliability standard (e.g., FAC-001, TPL-001, PRC-005) that mandates or drives this capital project, if applicable. Null if the project is not driven by a NERC compliance requirement. Supports regulatory compliance reporting and capital prudency documentation.

attributes.name: plant_addition_amount
attributes.description: Final gross plant addition amount recorded to the FERC plant in service account upon project close-out and in-service transfer, expressed in US dollars. Represents the capitalized cost of the asset placed in service, net of any CIAC. Used for FERC Form 1 plant additions schedule and rate base calculations.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1 Schedule of Plant Additions

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking of the capital project within the utility's annual capital program, used for capital budget allocation and deferral decisions. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Assigned during the annual capital planning cycle.
attributes.references: Utility Capital Program Management; IRP (Integrated Resource Plan)

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Name of the capital program or portfolio under which this project is grouped (e.g., 'Grid Modernization Program', 'Gas Main Replacement Program', 'AMI Deployment Program'). Supports capital program-level reporting and strategic investment tracking.
attributes.references: Utility Capital Program Management; IRP (Integrated Resource Plan)

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the capital project scope, including the work to be performed, assets to be installed or replaced, and business justification. Supports rate case cost-of-service studies and regulatory reporting to PUCs and FERC.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module

attributes.name: project_manager
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the project manager responsible for delivering the capital project on time and within budget. Used for accountability tracking, capital program reporting, and escalation routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module; Oracle WAM / IBM Maximo

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Short human-readable name or title of the capital expenditure project (e.g., 'Substation 12 Transformer Replacement', 'Annual Pole Replacement Program FY2024'). Used in dashboards, capital program reports, and regulatory plant additions filings.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric project identifier assigned by the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system (e.g., SAP PS WBS element or Oracle Project number). Used for cross-system reference, regulatory filings, and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: project_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which capital project activities (design, procurement, or construction) formally commenced. Used for project duration tracking, AFUDC accrual period calculation, and capital program scheduling.

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capital expenditure project. Drives capital program prioritization, CWIP balance reporting, and regulatory plant additions reporting. Values: planned (identified but not yet authorized), approved (capital budget authorized), in_progress (construction or implementation underway), complete (work finished, pending close-out), closed (fully closed and placed in service or written off), cancelled (project terminated prior to completion).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the capital project by utility business segment. Used for capital program segmentation, regulatory reporting, and rate base allocation. Values: transmission (high-voltage bulk electric infrastructure), distribution (last-mile electric delivery), generation (power plant assets), gas (natural gas pipeline and distribution), it (information technology infrastructure), environmental_compliance (environmental or regulatory compliance investments).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Capital Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Regulatory jurisdiction governing the capital project for rate base and cost recovery purposes. Values: ferc (subject to FERC jurisdiction, e.g., transmission assets), state_puc (subject to state Public Utility Commission jurisdiction, e.g., distribution assets), both (dual jurisdiction), exempt (not subject to rate regulation).
attributes.references: FERC (18 CFR); State PUC Tariff and Rate Case Rules

attributes.name: revised_budget_amount
attributes.description: Most recent revised authorized budget amount reflecting approved budget amendments or change orders since original authorization. Null if no revisions have been approved. Supports capital program variance reporting and rate case prudency reviews.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module

attributes.name: service_territory
attributes.description: Geographic service territory or operating division within which the capital project is located (e.g., Northern Region, Southern Region, Metro District). Used for geographic capital program analysis and regulatory jurisdiction reporting.
attributes.references: State PUC Service Territory Definitions; ESRI ArcGIS GIS

attributes.name: sox_control_relevant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this capital project is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal controls over financial reporting (True) or not (False). SOX-relevant projects require documented approval workflows, segregation of duties, and audit trail maintenance per SOX Section 302 and 404 requirements.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Sections 302 and 404; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: sponsoring_department
attributes.description: Name or code of the utility business department or organizational unit sponsoring and accountable for the capital project (e.g., Transmission Engineering, Distribution Operations, Gas Operations, IT). Used for capital program allocation and departmental CAPEX reporting.

attributes.name: target_in_service_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the capital project assets are expected to be placed in service and transferred from Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) to plant in service accounts. Drives capital program scheduling, AFUDC cessation planning, and regulatory plant additions forecasting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure element code that hierarchically organizes the capital project within the utility's capital program. Aligns with SAP PS WBS element or Oracle Projects task structure for cost collection and CWIP balance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

products.name: capex_expenditure
products.description: Transactional record of actual capital expenditures charged to a CAPEX project or WBS element. Captures expenditure date, amount, expenditure type (labor, materials, contractor, overhead, AFUDC accrual), purchase order reference, vendor, cost center, GL account, FERC plant account, capitalization status (WIP vs. placed-in-service), and approval reference. Enables tracking of spend against authorized capital budget, supports CWIP (Construction Work in Progress) balance reporting, and feeds the fixed asset capitalization process upon project completion.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Investment Management / FERC CWIP Account 107

attributes.name: capex_expenditure_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each capital expenditure transaction record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Internal Object Numbering; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authorized capital project or WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) element to which this expenditure is charged. Links the expenditure to the approved capital budget authorization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS (Project System); FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: capex_expenditure has fiscal_year and fiscal_period attributes. financial_period is the master for fiscal periods. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full period metadata. fiscal_year an

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.gl_account

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset or asset-under-construction to which this expenditure will be capitalized upon project completion. Null while the project is in Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) status.
attributes.references: Oracle WAM; IBM Maximo Asset Management; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Capital expenditures often involve specific materials (transformers, poles, cable, meters) that must be tracked for asset records, warranty management, and FERC plant accounting. Links capex spend to

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.purchase_order

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or contractor who supplied materials or services for this capital expenditure. Sourced from the ERP vendor master (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM (Materials Management); Oracle ERP Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work order (from Oracle WAM or IBM Maximo) under which the capital work was performed. Connects the financial expenditure to the physical asset maintenance or construction activity.
attributes.references: Oracle WAM; IBM Maximo Work Order Management

attributes.name: afudc_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of AFUDC accrued on this capital expenditure for the applicable period. Calculated as expenditure balance multiplied by the AFUDC rate. Capitalized to the asset cost basis and recovered through depreciation in rates.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 107; GAAP ASC 835-20; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: afudc_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Rate
attributes.description: The AFUDC rate applied to this expenditure for the period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.075 for 7.5%). AFUDC represents the cost of financing construction and is capitalized to the asset cost basis per FERC regulations and GAAP ASC 835-20.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 107; GAAP ASC 835-20; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the capital authorization document (e.g., Capital Appropriation Request, Board Resolution, or CPCN number) that approved this expenditure. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FERC CPCN Requirements; Internal Capital Authorization Policy

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the individual who approved this capital expenditure transaction. Required for SOX internal controls documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; Internal Capital Authorization Policy

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the utility asset type being constructed or acquired. Drives FERC plant account assignment and depreciation rate selection. Values align with FERC Uniform System of Accounts plant categories.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The approved capital budget amount for the project or WBS element at the time of this expenditure. Used for budget-to-actual variance analysis and capital spend tracking against authorized CAPEX.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; FERC Form 1; Internal Capital Authorization Policy

attributes.name: capitalization_status
attributes.description: Current capitalization lifecycle state of this expenditure. 'wip' indicates the cost is in Construction Work in Progress (CWIP); 'placed_in_service' indicates the asset has been capitalized to the fixed asset register; 'expensed' indicates the cost was reclassified as OPEX; 'reversed' indicates a correcting entry; 'pending_review' indicates awaiting capitalization determination.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 107 (CWIP)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital expenditure record was first created in the source system or ingested into the Silver layer. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the expenditure amounts (e.g., USD). Power and Utilities operates primarily in USD; this field supports multi-currency ERP configurations and foreign contractor invoices.

attributes.name: expenditure_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of the capital expenditure in USD before any adjustments. Represents the base cost charged to the CAPEX project for this transaction line. Used for CWIP balance tracking and budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: expenditure_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the capital expenditure was incurred or the cost was recognized. This is the principal business event date used for CWIP balance reporting and period-end close.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 835-20 (AFUDC); FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: expenditure_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the capital expenditure, including the nature of work performed, materials procured, or services rendered. Provides context for audit review, rate case cost justification, and asset capitalization documentation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; SOX Section 404; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: expenditure_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this capital expenditure transaction, typically sourced from the ERP system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA document number or Oracle ERP Cloud transaction number). Used for cross-system traceability and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Oracle ERP Cloud Project Costing

attributes.name: expenditure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the capital expenditure. Drives cost allocation and capitalization treatment. Values: labor (internal workforce), materials (equipment and supplies), contractor (third-party services), overhead (allocated indirect costs), afudc_accrual (Allowance for Funds Used During Construction accrual), other.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 835-20 (AFUDC)

attributes.name: ferc_plant_account
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Plant Account
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts plant account number (e.g., Account 310-399 for Electric Plant in Service, Account 107 for CWIP) to which this expenditure is classified. Required for FERC Form 1 regulatory reporting and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal accounting period (month number, 1-12) within the fiscal year in which this expenditure is posted. Used for monthly CAPEX tracking, period-end close reconciliation, and management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle ERP Cloud General Ledger; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this capital expenditure is recorded. Used for annual CAPEX budget tracking, FERC Form 1 annual reporting, and year-over-year capital spend analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; GAAP ASC 250; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: The physical or logical functional location code (from Oracle WAM, IBM Maximo, or ESRI ArcGIS GIS system) identifying where the capital work is being performed. Examples: substation identifier, transmission line segment, distribution circuit, gas pipeline segment.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Functional Location; ESRI ArcGIS Network Dataset; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The vendor invoice number associated with this capital expenditure. Used for accounts payable matching, audit trail, and dispute resolution. Sourced from the ERP accounts payable module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; Oracle ERP Cloud Payables; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_afudc_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expenditure qualifies for AFUDC accrual under FERC regulations and GAAP ASC 835-20. True if the expenditure is part of a qualifying construction project with a construction period exceeding the AFUDC threshold.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 107; GAAP ASC 835-20

attributes.name: is_capitalized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expenditure has been formally capitalized to the fixed asset register (True) or remains in CWIP or has been expensed (False). Used to filter capitalized vs. in-progress costs for balance sheet reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net capital expenditure amount after adjustments, credits, or reversals (expenditure_amount + tax_amount minus any credits). Represents the final capitalized cost contribution of this transaction to the project.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: placed_in_service_date
attributes.description: The date on which the constructed or acquired asset was placed in service and transferred from CWIP (Construction Work in Progress) to the fixed asset register. Triggers the start of depreciation and AFUDC cessation. Null while the project remains in WIP status.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expenditure was posted to the General Ledger (GL) in the ERP system. May differ from expenditure_date due to period-end accruals or late postings. Used for financial period reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 250; SAP S/4HANA FI General Ledger

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units (hours, units of material, etc.) associated with this capital expenditure. For labor expenditures, represents hours worked. For materials, represents units procured. Used for unit cost analysis and project cost benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS; Oracle ERP Cloud Project Costing

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Indicates the regulatory jurisdiction governing this capital expenditure for rate recovery purposes. 'ferc' for FERC-jurisdictional transmission assets, 'state_puc' for state-regulated distribution assets, 'both' for dual-jurisdiction assets, 'non_regulated' for unregulated capital.
attributes.references: FERC (18 CFR Part 101); State PUC Regulations; NARUC

attributes.name: service_territory
attributes.description: The utility service territory or operating division where the capital expenditure is incurred. Used for jurisdictional cost allocation in rate cases filed with state Public Utility Commissions (PUCs) and FERC.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Case Filing Requirements; NARUC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this capital expenditure record was sourced. Used for data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Oracle ERP Cloud; Oracle WAM; IBM Maximo

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier from the source operational system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA accounting document number, Oracle ERP Cloud expenditure item ID). Enables traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle ERP Cloud Project Costing; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Sales or use tax amount associated with this capital expenditure, if applicable. Capitalized taxes are included in the cost basis of the asset per GAAP. Reported separately for tax compliance and rate case cost-of-service studies.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the expenditure quantity (e.g., hours for labor, each for equipment units, feet/miles for cable or pipeline, kVA or MW for electrical equipment). Used for unit cost benchmarking and project cost analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hours|each|feet|miles|kva|mw|lbs|tons|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; IEEE Standard Units; AGA Measurement Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital expenditure record was last modified in the source system or updated in the Silver layer. Used for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 250; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The specific WBS element code within the capital project hierarchy to which this expenditure is charged. Provides granular cost tracking within a multi-phase or multi-component capital project.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS (Project System); PMI PMBOK

products.name: budget
products.description: Annual and multi-year financial budget record for the utility, organized by cost center, GL account, functional area, and fiscal period. Captures budget version (original, revised, forecast, long-range plan), budget type (OPEX/O&M, CAPEX, revenue), fiscal year, period-level budget amounts, total approved budget amount, variance threshold percentage, budget owner, and approval status. Supports monthly budget-vs-actual variance reporting, financial planning cycles, rate case cost-of-service test year development, PBR (Performance-Based Ratemaking) target-setting, and board-level capital program approval. Each budget record represents a unique combination of version, type, cost center, and GL account for a fiscal year. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO-PA) or Oracle ERP Cloud Budgetary Control module.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Budgeting / Oracle ERP Cloud Budgetary Control

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each budget record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Each record represents a unique combination of budget version, budget type, cost center, GL account, and fiscal year. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA CO-PA or Oracle ERP Cloud Budgetary Control module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO-PA); Oracle ERP Cloud Budgetary Control

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.capex_project

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this budget record. Cost centers represent organizational units (e.g., Generation Operations, T&D Maintenance, Customer Service) used for OPEX and CAPEX allocation in FERC Uniform System of Accounts reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: budget has fiscal_year and fiscal_period attributes. financial_period is the master for fiscal periods. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full period metadata (period dates, status, etc

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger account associated with this budget record. GL accounts are structured per FERC Uniform System of Accounts (e.g., Account 401 for Revenue, Account 500-series for O&M expenses, Account 100-series for utility plant CAPEX).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 980

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: allocation_factor
attributes.description: The proportional allocation factor (0.000000 to 1.000000) used to distribute shared or common costs across jurisdictions, functional areas, or cost centers in rate case cost-of-service studies. Derived from FERC-approved or PUC-approved allocation methodologies (e.g., plant ratio, revenue ratio, customer count).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; PUC Cost Allocation Methodology; NARUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget record received formal approval (yyyy-MM-dd). Marks the start of the authorized budget execution period. Used for SOX audit trail, board resolution documentation, and rate case filing timelines.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 270; PUC Rate Case Filing Requirements

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the budget record in the approval lifecycle. 'draft' indicates budget under preparation; 'pending_approval' indicates submitted for management or board review; 'approved' indicates authorized for execution; 'rejected' indicates returned for revision; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a revised version.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Control Framework (COSO); PUC Rate Case Filing

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: The total board- or management-approved budget amount in USD for this cost center, GL account, and fiscal year combination. Represents the authorized spending or revenue target. Used as the baseline for budget-vs-actual variance analysis and rate case test year cost-of-service calculations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 270; FERC Form 1; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the executive or board member who formally approved this budget record. Required for SOX audit trail and internal control documentation. For CAPEX budgets, may reference the Capital Expenditure Committee or Board of Directors approval.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Control Framework (COSO)

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: The utility asset category for CAPEX budget records (e.g., Generation Plant, Transmission Lines, Distribution Substation, Gas Pipeline, Smart Meter/AMI, IT Infrastructure). Aligns with FERC plant account classifications for regulatory depreciation and rate base inclusion. Null for OPEX budget records.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (Electric Plant Accounts 301–399; Gas Plant Accounts 101–399); GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the budget record. 'opex' covers O&M operating expenditures; 'capex' covers capital expenditures for utility plant additions; 'revenue' covers projected rate revenues; 'depreciation' covers regulatory depreciation expense budgets; 'regulatory' covers rate case and compliance cost budgets. Aligns with FERC Uniform System of Accounts classification.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 360; PBR Target-Setting Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget record was first created in the source system or ingested into the Silver Layer lakehouse (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for SOX audit trail and data governance lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Control Framework (COSO)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency reporting for utilities with cross-border operations or international PPAs. Typically USD for domestic U.S. utility operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP ASC 830 (Foreign Currency)

attributes.name: depreciation_rate_pct
attributes.description: The annual regulatory depreciation rate (as a percentage) applied to CAPEX budget records for utility plant additions. Established by PUC-approved depreciation studies. Used to calculate budgeted depreciation expense for rate case cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1 reporting. Null for OPEX budget records.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; PUC Depreciation Study Approval; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget record expires or is superseded (yyyy-MM-dd). For annual budgets, typically the last day of the fiscal year. For multi-year long-range plans, may extend 3–10 years. Nullable for open-ended rolling forecasts.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 270; FERC Form 1; IRP (Integrated Resource Plan) Filing

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this budget record becomes effective and spending or revenue targets are active (yyyy-MM-dd). Typically the first day of the fiscal year or the effective date of a mid-year budget revision. Used for temporal budget validity tracking.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 270; FERC Form 1; PUC Rate Case Test Year

attributes.name: energy_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether this budget record pertains to electric or gas utility operations, or a specific generation fuel type. Required for FERC jurisdictional cost separation between electric and gas operations, and for RPS (Renewable Portfolio Standard) compliance cost tracking.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FERC Form 1 (Electric); FERC Form 2 (Gas); RPS Compliance Reporting

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts account number (e.g., 401, 500, 101) mapped to this budget record. Required for FERC Form 1 annual report filing and rate case cost-of-service studies. Enables regulatory cost allocation between electric plant, O&M, and revenue accounts.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month number 1–12) within the fiscal year for which this budget amount is recorded. Enables monthly budget-vs-actual variance reporting and period-level financial planning cycles in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 270; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA Period Accounting

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this budget record applies (e.g., 2025). Used for annual budget cycle management, rate case test year identification, and multi-year capital program planning. Aligns with the utility's regulatory fiscal year as filed with the PUC and FERC.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; GAAP ASC 270; PUC Rate Case Filing Requirements

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The business functional area associated with this budget record (e.g., Generation, Transmission, Electric Distribution, Gas Distribution, Customer Service, Corporate). Used for cost-of-service allocation in rate case studies and FERC jurisdictional separation of costs between electric and gas operations.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Uniform System of Accounts; PUC Cost-of-Service Allocation

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative field for budget analysts to document assumptions, drivers, variance explanations, or special circumstances associated with this budget record. Supports rate case workpaper documentation and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Control Framework (COSO)

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the manager or director responsible for this budget record (e.g., Director of Generation Operations, VP of T&D). Accountable for budget execution, variance explanations, and SOX attestation of financial controls for their cost center.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Control Framework (COSO)

attributes.name: pbr_target_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget record is associated with a PBR (Performance-Based Ratemaking) performance target or incentive mechanism established by the PUC. True = linked to a PBR metric (e.g., SAIDI, SAIFI, customer satisfaction); False = standard budget record.
attributes.references: PUC PBR Order; NARUC Performance-Based Ratemaking Guidelines

attributes.name: period_amount
attributes.description: The budget amount allocated to the specific fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year, in USD. Supports monthly budget-vs-actual variance reporting and cash flow planning. The sum of all period amounts for a fiscal year should equal the approved_amount for annual budget records.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 270; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA Period Accounting

attributes.name: planning_cycle
attributes.description: Identifies the financial planning cycle that produced this budget record. 'annual' is the primary year-end budget cycle; 'mid_year_review' is the formal mid-year reforecast; quarterly forecasts (q1–q3) are rolling updates; 'long_range' covers multi-year IRP and capital program planning cycles.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 270; FERC Form 1; IRP Filing Requirements

attributes.name: prior_year_actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual expenditure or revenue recorded in the prior fiscal year for the same cost center and GL account combination, in USD. Used as a baseline reference for budget development, trend analysis, and rate case historical test year comparisons filed with the PUC.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; GAAP ASC 270; PUC Rate Case Historical Test Year

attributes.name: rate_case_test_year_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget record is designated as part of the rate case test year cost-of-service study submitted to the PUC or FERC. True = this record is included in the test year filing; False = standard budget record not designated for rate case use.
attributes.references: PUC Rate Case Filing Requirements; FERC Form 1; NARUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction to which this budget record is allocated (e.g., FERC, State PUC name, Unregulated). Used for jurisdictional cost separation in rate case filings, FERC Form 1 reporting, and allocation of shared costs between regulated and unregulated business segments.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; PUC Rate Case Filing; NARUC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The natural key or document number from the originating source system (e.g., SAP CO document number, Oracle budget line ID). Used for data lineage, reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the ERP source system, and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX IT General Controls (ITGC); Data Governance Lineage Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this budget record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse. Typical sources include SAP S/4HANA CO-PA, Oracle ERP Cloud Budgetary Control, Hyperion Planning, or Anaplan for financial planning.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework; SOX IT General Controls (ITGC)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
