attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy

attributes.name: cpcn_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) Reference Number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) application supported by this cost-of-service study, if applicable. Links the cost justification to the capital project authorization for major infrastructure investments.
attributes.references: State PUC CPCN Requirements; FERC Certificate Regulations 18 CFR Part 157

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost-of-service study record was first created in the system. Supports SOX audit trail requirements and record lineage tracking. This is the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this cost-of-service study. Typically USD for US utility rate cases. Included to support multi-currency reporting and GAAP financial statement alignment.

attributes.name: debt_ratio_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the capital structure represented by long-term debt, used in the WACC calculation. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 48.0000 for 48%). Together with equity_ratio_pct must sum to 100%.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy

attributes.name: depreciation_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense included in the revenue requirement for the test year, calculated using depreciation rates approved by the regulatory authority applied to the depreciable plant in service. Expressed in US dollars. Corresponds to FERC Account 403.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 403; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the new rates derived from this cost-of-service study become effective for customer billing. May be subject to refund if rates are later adjusted by the regulatory authority.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; State PUC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: equity_ratio_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the capital structure represented by equity, used in the WACC calculation. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 52.0000 for 52%). Determined by the utility's actual or hypothetical capital structure as accepted by the regulatory authority.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy

attributes.name: existing_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Current annual revenue collected under existing rates at the time of the rate case filing. The difference between revenue_requirement_amount and existing_revenue_amount represents the revenue deficiency or excess (rate increase or decrease needed). Expressed in US dollars.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cost-of-service study was formally filed with the regulatory authority (PUC or FERC). This is the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Triggers statutory review timelines and suspension periods.
attributes.references: FERC Rules of Practice and Procedure 18 CFR Part 385; State PUC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost-of-service study within the rate case workflow. Tracks progression from internal preparation through regulatory submission and disposition. This is the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.
attributes.references: NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy; State PUC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: functionalization_method
attributes.description: Primary functional category used to classify utility costs in this study per FERC Uniform System of Accounts: production, transmission, distribution, customer, or general/administrative. Drives cost allocation to customer classes and rate design. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production|transmission|distribution|customer|general — promote to reference product if multi-function studies require line-level detail]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy

attributes.name: income_tax_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total income tax expense (federal and state) included in the revenue requirement, calculated on the allowed return on equity component of the rate base. Expressed in US dollars. Includes adjustments for accumulated deferred income taxes (ADIT).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts Accounts 408-410; GAAP ASC 740; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: irp_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) submission that this cost-of-service study supports, if applicable. Connects long-term resource planning cost projections to the rate case revenue requirement.
attributes.references: State PUC IRP Requirements; DOE Energy Policy Act

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation identifying the state PUC jurisdiction for this filing (e.g., CA, TX, NY). Null if the filing is exclusively with FERC. Used to apply state-specific regulatory accounting rules and tariff structures.
attributes.references: NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy; State PUC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost-of-service study is filed with a state Public Utility Commission (PUC), the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC), or both (dual jurisdiction). Determines applicable regulatory accounting standards and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: om_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total Operations and Maintenance (O&M) expense included in the revenue requirement for the test year, covering labor, materials, and contracted services for operating and maintaining generation, transmission, and distribution assets. Expressed in US dollars.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts Accounts 500-598; GAAP ASC 980

attributes.name: pbr_target_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost-of-service study includes Performance-Based Ratemaking (PBR) performance targets or incentive mechanisms as part of the rate design. True if PBR metrics (e.g., SAIDI, SAIFI, customer satisfaction) are incorporated into the revenue requirement or rate structure.
attributes.references: State PUC PBR Orders; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy

attributes.name: prepared_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the regulatory analyst or financial professional responsible for preparing this cost-of-service study. Supports SOX accountability and regulatory filing certification requirements. This is the PARTY_REFERENCE for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FERC Rules of Practice and Procedure

attributes.name: property_tax_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total property and other taxes (excluding income taxes) included in the revenue requirement for the test year. Expressed in US dollars. Corresponds to FERC Account 408.1.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 408.1; GAAP ASC 980

attributes.name: rate_base_amount
attributes.description: Total rate base as determined in this cost-of-service study, representing the net investment on which the utility is entitled to earn a return. Includes net plant in service, working capital, and other allowable investments, less accumulated depreciation and deferred taxes. Expressed in US dollars.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy; GAAP ASC 980

attributes.name: revenue_deficiency_amount
attributes.description: Net difference between the total revenue requirement and existing revenues. A positive value indicates a revenue deficiency (rate increase needed); a negative value indicates a revenue surplus (rate decrease). Expressed in US dollars. This is the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment/net component.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy

attributes.name: revenue_requirement_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue requirement calculated in this cost-of-service study, representing the total amount the utility is authorized to collect from customers to recover its costs and earn a fair return. Expressed in US dollars. This is the primary MONETARY_TRIPLET gross amount for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy; GAAP ASC 980

attributes.name: settlement_reached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rate case associated with this cost-of-service study was resolved through a negotiated settlement agreement among the utility, regulatory staff, and intervening parties, rather than a fully litigated proceeding.
attributes.references: FERC Rules of Practice and Procedure 18 CFR Part 385; State PUC Settlement Procedures

attributes.name: study_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the scope, purpose, and key assumptions of this cost-of-service study. Includes summary of major cost drivers, significant adjustments from prior rate case, and any unusual items requiring regulatory explanation.
attributes.references: FERC Rules of Practice and Procedure; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy

attributes.name: study_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this cost-of-service study, used in regulatory filings and cross-referenced in dockets. Typically formatted as a combination of jurisdiction code, year, and sequence (e.g., CA-GRC-2024-001). This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.
attributes.references: NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy; State PUC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate case type for which this cost-of-service study is prepared. Determines the applicable regulatory framework, tariff schedules, and cost allocation methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: general_rate_case|transmission_rate_case|gas_rate_case|distribution_rate_case|limited_rate_case — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy; State PUC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: study_version
attributes.description: Version number of this cost-of-service study, incremented when the study is revised during the regulatory proceeding (e.g., in response to data requests, settlement negotiations, or updated actuals). Version 1 is the initial filing; subsequent versions reflect amendments.
attributes.references: FERC Rules of Practice and Procedure 18 CFR Part 385; State PUC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: test_year_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the test year used as the basis for cost-of-service calculations. Together with test_year_start_date, defines the 12-month test period. May be historical (fully known actuals) or projected (future test year with estimates).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy

attributes.name: test_year_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the test year (historical or projected) used as the basis for cost-of-service calculations. The test year is the 12-month period whose costs and revenues form the foundation of the revenue requirement determination.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy

attributes.name: test_year_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test year is based on historical actuals, a projected future period, or a hybrid combining historical data with known and measurable adjustments. Affects the level of regulatory scrutiny and the types of adjustments permitted.
attributes.references: NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy; State PUC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost-of-service study record was last modified. Supports SOX audit trail and change management tracking. This is the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.

attributes.name: wacc_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) Percentage
attributes.description: Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) used to determine the overall allowed rate of return on rate base, blending the cost of debt and equity weighted by their respective proportions in the capital structure. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 7.2500 for 7.25%).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy; GAAP ASC 980

attributes.name: working_capital_amount
attributes.description: Working capital allowance included in rate base, representing the utility's investment in cash, materials, supplies, and prepayments needed to operate the business between billing cycles. Expressed in US dollars.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; NARUC Utility Regulatory Policy

products.name: financial_period
products.description: Reference master for fiscal periods and fiscal years used across the utilitys financial reporting calendar. Captures fiscal period number (1-12 plus adjustment periods 13-16), fiscal year, calendar month start and end dates, period status (open, closed, locked, future), period type (regular, adjustment, year-end closing, special), and controlling area. Governs which periods are open for journal entry posting, controls period-end and year-end close workflows, ensures consistent fiscal period alignment across GL, asset accounting, cost controlling, and regulatory reporting modules. Critical for SOX compliance — period lock controls prevent unauthorized postings to closed periods. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI fiscal year variant configuration or Oracle ERP Cloud accounting calendar.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant / Oracle ERP Cloud Accounting Calendar

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fiscal period record in the financial reporting calendar. Primary key for the financial_period data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; Oracle ERP Cloud Accounting Calendar

attributes.name: prior_year_period_financial_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corresponding fiscal period in the prior year, enabling year-over-year financial comparisons in regulatory filings, earnings reports, and rate case testimony. For example, Period 3 FY2024 links to Period 3 FY2023.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; GAAP ASC 270; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: accrual_cutoff_date
attributes.description: The last date by which accrual journal entries (unbilled revenue, fuel cost accruals, O&M accruals, AFUDC accruals) must be posted to be included in this fiscal period's financial results. May differ from calendar_end_date when the utility's close schedule allows a grace period for late accruals. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 420; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA Financial Closing Cockpit

attributes.name: budget_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period has an approved operating budget loaded in the financial planning system. True = budget data available for variance analysis; False = no budget loaded. Supports CAPEX/OPEX budget vs. actual variance reporting and rate case cost-of-service analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 270; SAP S/4HANA BPC Budget Planning; PUC Rate Case Cost-of-Service

attributes.name: calendar_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this fiscal period ends (inclusive). Defines the boundary for accruals, revenue recognition cut-offs, and period-end close procedures. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; GAAP ASC 270; Oracle ERP Cloud Accounting Calendar

attributes.name: calendar_month
attributes.description: The calendar month number (1–12) corresponding to this fiscal period. For regular periods, this aligns with the calendar month. For adjustment periods (13–16), this retains the calendar month of the base period to which adjustments are attributed. Supports alignment with AMI billing cycles and meter read schedules.
attributes.references: Oracle ERP Cloud Accounting Calendar; SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: calendar_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this fiscal period begins (inclusive). Used to align fiscal period boundaries with calendar-month meter reads, billing cycles, energy market settlement dates, and regulatory reporting windows. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; GAAP ASC 270; Oracle ERP Cloud Accounting Calendar

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: The four-digit calendar year corresponding to this fiscal period. May differ from fiscal_year for utilities operating on a non-calendar fiscal year (e.g., April–March). Required for aligning fiscal periods with calendar-year regulatory reporting and energy market settlement calendars.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; Oracle ERP Cloud Accounting Calendar

attributes.name: close_workflow_status
attributes.description: Tracks the current state of the period-end or year-end close workflow for this fiscal period. 'not_started' = close activities not yet initiated; 'in_progress' = close tasks underway; 'completed' = all close tasks finished; 'approved' = controller/CFO sign-off obtained; 'failed' = close workflow encountered errors requiring remediation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 250; SAP S/4HANA Financial Closing Cockpit

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code or Oracle ERP legal entity identifier for which this fiscal period is defined. Utilities with separate regulated subsidiaries (e.g., electric utility vs. gas utility) maintain distinct company codes with potentially independent period open/close controls for regulatory ring-fencing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: The SAP Controlling (CO) area or Oracle ERP ledger set identifier to which this fiscal period applies. A controlling area groups company codes for cost controlling, internal orders, and profit center accounting. Utilities with multiple regulated entities (electric vs. gas) may operate under separate controlling areas with distinct period open/close schedules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling Area Configuration; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fiscal period record was first created in the financial system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud). Provides an audit trail for period configuration changes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Change Document; Oracle ERP Cloud Audit Trail

attributes.name: days_in_period
attributes.description: The total number of calendar days in this fiscal period (derived from calendar_start_date and calendar_end_date). Used for daily rate proration in billing, depreciation calculations, fuel cost accruals, and energy generation output normalization. Stored explicitly to avoid runtime date arithmetic in reporting queries.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 360 Depreciation; Utility Billing Rate Proration

attributes.name: depreciation_run_status
attributes.description: Indicates the status of the periodic depreciation calculation run for utility plant assets in this fiscal period. 'not_run' = depreciation not yet calculated; 'in_progress' = depreciation run executing; 'completed' = calculated but not yet posted; 'posted' = depreciation journal entries posted to the GL. Critical for CAPEX tracking and FERC plant account reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA); FERC Uniform System of Accounts Plant Accounts; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: ferc_reporting_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Reporting Year
attributes.description: The FERC reporting year to which this fiscal period's financial data is attributed for FERC Form 1 (electric) and FERC Form 2 (gas) annual report submissions. May differ from fiscal_year for utilities with non-calendar fiscal years. Ensures correct period-to-FERC-filing alignment for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 (18 CFR Part 141); FERC Form 2 (18 CFR Part 260); FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (1–4) to which this period belongs. Derived from period_number but stored explicitly to support quarterly financial reporting, quarterly FERC filings, and quarterly earnings disclosures without requiring runtime computation.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; GAAP ASC 270; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The four-digit fiscal year to which this period belongs (e.g., 2024). May differ from the calendar year when the utility operates on a non-calendar fiscal year variant. Used for annual financial reporting, FERC Form 1 submissions, and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: The fiscal year variant code from SAP S/4HANA (e.g., 'K4' for calendar-year variant, 'V3' for April–March) or equivalent accounting calendar identifier from Oracle ERP Cloud. Determines the mapping between fiscal periods and calendar months. Essential for multi-entity utilities operating under different fiscal calendars.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant Configuration; Oracle ERP Cloud Accounting Calendar

attributes.name: intercompany_elimination_status
attributes.description: Tracks whether intercompany transaction eliminations have been completed for this fiscal period in consolidated financial statements. Relevant for utilities with multiple regulated subsidiaries (electric, gas, unregulated affiliates). 'not_required' = single-entity utility; 'pending' = eliminations not yet processed; 'completed' = eliminations posted.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810 Consolidation; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting

attributes.name: is_adjustment_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a special adjustment period (periods 13–16) used for post-close audit adjustments, regulatory accounting entries, or tax provision postings that must be segregated from regular operating period activity. True = adjustment period; False = regular period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: is_open_for_asset_posting
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open for Asset Accounting Posting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset accounting sub-ledger is open for depreciation runs, asset acquisitions, retirements, and transfers in this fiscal period. Utilities carry significant CAPEX in generation, transmission, and distribution assets; asset accounting periods may close independently from the GL. True = asset postings permitted; False = blocked.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA); FERC Uniform System of Accounts Plant Accounts; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: is_open_for_co_posting
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost controlling module is open for internal order settlements, cost center allocations, and profit center postings in this fiscal period. True = CO postings permitted; False = blocked. Supports OPEX and CAPEX cost allocation for rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; PUC Rate Case Cost-of-Service

attributes.name: is_open_for_gl_posting
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open for General Ledger (GL) Posting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the general ledger module is currently open for journal entry postings in this fiscal period. True = GL postings permitted; False = GL postings blocked. Distinct from asset accounting and cost controlling open flags, as each sub-ledger may have independent open/close timing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period Management; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: is_open_for_mm_posting
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open for Materials Management (MM) Posting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the materials management module is open for goods receipts, inventory movements, and purchase order invoice verifications in this fiscal period. Relevant for utility supply chain — fuel procurement, spare parts, and construction materials. True = MM postings permitted; False = blocked.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Materials Management; GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: is_year_end_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period is a year-end closing period requiring full year-end close procedures including balance carryforward, retained earnings posting, and annual financial statement preparation. True = year-end period; False = regular or interim period.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 270; FERC Form 1 Annual Report; SAP S/4HANA Year-End Closing

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fiscal period record was most recently modified (e.g., status change from open to closed, lock applied). Supports change data capture in the Databricks Silver layer ETL pipeline and SOX audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Change Document; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: ledger_type
attributes.description: Identifies the accounting ledger to which this period definition applies. 'leading' = primary GAAP ledger; 'extension' = parallel ledger for IFRS or tax accounting; 'regulatory' = FERC regulatory accounting ledger. Utilities maintain parallel ledgers to reconcile GAAP financial statements with FERC Uniform System of Accounts regulatory books.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal Ledger; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; GAAP ASC 980

attributes.name: period_close_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fiscal period was officially closed following completion of period-end close procedures (accruals, reconciliations, depreciation runs, allocations). Null if the period has not yet been closed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 250; SAP S/4HANA FI Period Management

attributes.name: period_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about this fiscal period, such as special close instructions, regulatory filing notes, or explanations for non-standard adjustment periods. Used by the financial close team and external auditors for period documentation.

attributes.name: period_lock_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fiscal period was hard-locked, preventing any further postings including adjustments. Represents the final SOX control point after which no unauthorized changes can be made to the period's financial data. Null if the period has not been locked. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Period Lock; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the fiscal period (e.g., 'January 2024', 'Q1 2024 Adjustment', 'Year-End Close 2024'). Used in financial reports, dashboards, and regulatory filings for display purposes.

attributes.name: period_number
attributes.description: The sequential period number within the fiscal year. Regular operating periods are numbered 1 through 12 (monthly). Adjustment and special closing periods are numbered 13 through 16 per SAP S/4HANA fiscal year variant conventions. Controls which posting periods are open in the general ledger, asset accounting, and cost controlling modules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; Oracle ERP Cloud Accounting Calendar; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: period_open_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fiscal period was officially opened for journal entry postings. Provides an audit trail for period lifecycle management and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Period Management

attributes.name: period_short_code
attributes.description: Compact alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the fiscal period in the format YYYY.PPP (e.g., '2024.001' for Period 1 of FY2024, '2024.013' for the first adjustment period). Used as a display key in financial reports, journal entry headers, and regulatory filings where space is constrained.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fiscal period controlling whether journal entry postings are permitted. 'open' = postings allowed; 'closed' = period-end close completed, no new postings; 'locked' = SOX-compliant hard lock preventing any unauthorized postings; 'future' = period not yet reached. Critical SOX internal control — period lock prevents unauthorized retroactive postings to closed periods.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Period Management; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the fiscal period. 'regular' = standard monthly operating period (1-12); 'adjustment' = post-close adjustment period (13-14); 'year_end_closing' = year-end closing period (15); 'special' = utility-specific special posting period (16). Determines which business transactions and journal entry types are permitted during the period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP ASC 270; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: rate_case_test_year_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period falls within the designated test year for an active or pending rate case proceeding before the PUC or FERC. True = period is part of the rate case test year; False = not a test year period. Triggers enhanced cost tracking and cost-of-service study data collection for regulatory testimony.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Procedures; FERC Rate Case Filing Requirements; NARUC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period aligns with a mandatory regulatory reporting deadline (e.g., FERC Form 1 annual filing, quarterly PUC financial reports, NERC reliability reporting). True = regulatory filing due at end of this period; False = no regulatory filing deadline. Triggers regulatory reporting workflow initiation.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; FERC Form 3-Q; State PUC Financial Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: source_system_period_key
attributes.description: The natural key or technical identifier for this fiscal period as it exists in the originating source system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA fiscal year + posting period concatenation '202401', or Oracle ERP Cloud period_name 'Jan-24'). Enables lineage tracing from the Silver layer back to the operational system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period; Oracle ERP Cloud Accounting Calendar; Databricks Data Lineage

attributes.name: sox_certification_status
attributes.description: Tracks the SOX Section 302/404 internal control certification status for this fiscal period. 'not_required' = period not subject to SOX certification (e.g., interim adjustment periods); 'pending' = certification in progress; 'certified' = management certification completed with no material weaknesses; 'exceptions_noted' = material weakness or significant deficiency identified.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; SEC Rules 13a-15 and 15d-15; PCAOB AS 2201

products.name: tax_provision
products.description: Periodic record for income tax provisions, deferred income tax calculations, and Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes (ADIT) balances for the utility. Captures tax provision period, fiscal year, current federal tax expense, current state tax expense, deferred federal tax expense, deferred state tax expense, ADIT balance by timing difference category (accelerated depreciation, regulatory liabilities, pension obligations, storm cost deferrals, excess deferred income taxes — EDIT), federal vs. state tax jurisdiction, effective tax rate, statutory tax rate, permanent and temporary difference reconciliation items, and ITC (Investment Tax Credit) amortization. Supports FERC Form 1 Schedule 272 (Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes), rate base ADIT offset calculations per IRS normalization rules, GAAP ASC 740 income tax accounting, rate case test year tax expense normalization, and Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) excess ADIT amortization tracking. Essential for regulatory accounting where ADIT directly reduces rate base.

attributes.name: tax_provision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax provision record. Primary key.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: tax_provision has fiscal_year and fiscal_period attributes. financial_period is the master for fiscal periods. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full period metadata. fiscal_year and fi

attributes.name: rate_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the associated rate case cost study if this provision is part of test year calculations for a regulatory rate filing.

attributes.name: adit_accelerated_depreciation
attributes.business_glossary_term: ADIT (Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes) - Accelerated Depreciation
attributes.description: Component of ADIT balance attributable to timing differences from accelerated tax depreciation methods versus book depreciation, the largest ADIT category for utilities.

attributes.name: adit_balance
attributes.description: Cumulative balance of Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes at the end of the provision period, representing the net deferred tax liability or asset position that directly reduces rate base in regulatory accounting.

attributes.name: adit_pension_obligations
attributes.business_glossary_term: ADIT (Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes) - Pension Obligations
attributes.description: Component of ADIT balance attributable to timing differences from pension and other post-retirement benefit obligations where book and tax recognition timing differs.

attributes.name: adit_regulatory_liabilities
attributes.business_glossary_term: ADIT (Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes) - Regulatory Liabilities
attributes.description: Component of ADIT balance attributable to regulatory liabilities and deferred revenue items that create temporary differences between book and tax treatment.

attributes.name: adit_storm_cost_deferrals
attributes.business_glossary_term: ADIT (Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes) - Storm Cost Deferrals
attributes.description: Component of ADIT balance attributable to deferred storm restoration costs and other extraordinary event deferrals that create temporary differences.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tax provision was formally approved for posting, establishing the audit trail for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized approver who signed off on this tax provision for posting to the general ledger.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tax provision record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this provision record, typically USD for U.S. utilities.

attributes.name: current_federal_tax_expense
attributes.description: Current period federal income tax expense calculated on taxable income for the provision period, representing taxes payable to the federal government in the current year.

attributes.name: current_state_tax_expense
attributes.description: Current period state income tax expense calculated on taxable income for the provision period, representing taxes payable to state jurisdictions in the current year.

attributes.name: deferred_federal_tax_expense
attributes.description: Deferred federal income tax expense arising from temporary differences between book and tax accounting, representing future tax consequences of events recognized in financial statements.

attributes.name: deferred_state_tax_expense
attributes.description: Deferred state income tax expense arising from temporary differences between book and tax accounting at the state jurisdiction level.

attributes.name: edit_amortization_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: EDIT (Excess Deferred Income Taxes) Amortization Amount
attributes.description: Amount of Excess Deferred Income Taxes amortized during the provision period, flowing back to customers through reduced rates or regulatory liability accounts.

attributes.name: edit_protected_balance
attributes.business_glossary_term: EDIT (Excess Deferred Income Taxes) Protected Balance
attributes.description: Protected portion of Excess Deferred Income Taxes related to public utility property that must be amortized using Average Rate Assumption Method (ARAM) per IRS normalization requirements.

attributes.name: edit_unprotected_balance
attributes.business_glossary_term: EDIT (Excess Deferred Income Taxes) Unprotected Balance
attributes.description: Unprotected portion of Excess Deferred Income Taxes not subject to IRS normalization rules, which can be amortized more quickly to benefit customers.

attributes.name: effective_tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: Effective tax rate percentage calculated as total tax expense divided by pre-tax book income, used for financial statement disclosure and rate case analysis.

attributes.name: excess_deferred_income_taxes
attributes.description: Excess Deferred Income Taxes balance resulting from the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) federal rate reduction from 35% to 21%, requiring amortization back to customers per IRS normalization rules.

attributes.name: federal_tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Federal tax jurisdiction code or identifier, typically IRS or federal tax authority reference for the provision calculation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period number within the fiscal year (1-12 for monthly, 1-4 for quarterly) to which this tax provision applies.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this tax provision applies, used for regulatory reporting and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: itc_amortization_amount
attributes.description: Amount of Investment Tax Credit amortized during the provision period, representing the systematic recognition of ITC benefits over the life of qualifying renewable energy or other eligible assets per IRS normalization rules.

attributes.name: itc_unamortized_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unamortized balance of Investment Tax Credits at the end of the provision period, representing future tax benefits to be recognized over the remaining asset life.

attributes.name: permanent_difference_amount
attributes.description: Total permanent differences between book and tax income that will never reverse, such as non-deductible expenses, tax-exempt income, and meals and entertainment disallowances.

attributes.name: pre_tax_book_income
attributes.description: Pre-tax book income for the provision period per GAAP financial statements, serving as the starting point for the tax provision calculation and effective rate reconciliation.

attributes.name: prepared_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the tax professional or system user who prepared this tax provision calculation.

attributes.name: provision_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the tax provision record, typically following a sequential or period-based numbering scheme for external reference and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: provision_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by this tax provision calculation, typically the last day of a fiscal quarter or year.

attributes.name: provision_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by this tax provision calculation, typically the first day of a fiscal quarter or year.

attributes.name: provision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax provision record indicating its stage in the approval and posting workflow.

attributes.name: provision_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax provision indicating whether it is a regular quarterly provision, annual provision, interim adjustment, amended filing, or year-end true-up calculation.

attributes.name: rate_base_adit_offset
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rate Base ADIT (Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes) Offset
attributes.description: ADIT amount used to reduce rate base in regulatory ratemaking, representing zero-cost capital that reduces the utility's investment base for return calculation purposes.

attributes.name: rate_case_test_year_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator identifying whether this provision period is part of a rate case test year, requiring special normalization and adjustment procedures for regulatory filings.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the senior tax professional or manager who reviewed and validated this tax provision calculation.

attributes.name: state_tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: State tax jurisdiction code or abbreviation identifying the primary state tax authority for this provision, critical for multi-state utilities with apportionment requirements.

attributes.name: statutory_federal_tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: Statutory federal income tax rate percentage in effect for the provision period, currently 21% post-TCJA, used as the baseline for effective rate reconciliation.

attributes.name: statutory_state_tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: Statutory state income tax rate percentage in effect for the provision period in the primary state jurisdiction, used for state tax expense calculation.

attributes.name: taxable_income
attributes.description: Taxable income calculated per Internal Revenue Code for the provision period, after adjusting book income for permanent and temporary differences.

attributes.name: temporary_difference_amount
attributes.description: Total temporary differences between book and tax income that will reverse in future periods, giving rise to deferred tax assets or liabilities.

attributes.name: total_tax_expense
attributes.description: Total income tax expense for the provision period, calculated as the sum of current and deferred federal and state tax expenses.

attributes.name: uncertain_tax_position_reserve
attributes.description: Reserve established for uncertain tax positions under FIN 48 (ASC 740-10) where the utility has taken a tax position that may not be sustained upon examination by tax authorities.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tax provision record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: valuation_allowance
attributes.description: Valuation allowance established against deferred tax assets when it is more likely than not that some portion will not be realized, per GAAP ASC 740 guidance.

attributes.name: prior_period_tax_provision_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on tax_provision (prior_period_tax_provision_id)

products.name: regulatory_deferral
products.description: Master record for regulatory assets and regulatory liabilities recognized under ASC 980 (Regulated Operations) that represent costs or revenues deferred for future rate recovery or refund. Captures deferral type (regulatory asset or regulatory liability), deferral category (storm cost, pension/OPEB, fuel adjustment clause under/over-recovery, environmental remediation, rate case expense, EDIT — Excess Deferred Income Taxes), authorized deferral amount, amortization method, amortization period, remaining unamortized balance, PUC/FERC authorization reference, and deferral status. Supports FERC Form 1 Schedules 232 (Regulatory Assets) and 254 (Regulatory Liabilities), rate case revenue requirement calculations, and GAAP balance sheet presentation under ASC 980.

attributes.name: regulatory_deferral_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory deferral record. Primary key for the regulatory deferral master table.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: regulatory_deferral has cost_center_code attribute. cost_center is the master for cost centers. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full cost center details (name, responsible_manager, fu

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: regulatory_deferral has fiscal_year attribute. financial_period is the master for fiscal periods. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full period metadata (period dates, status, etc.). fi

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: regulatory_deferral has gl_account_code attribute. gl_account is the master for GL accounts. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full account details (account_name, ferc_account_descripti

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: regulatory_deferral has profit_center_code attribute. profit_center is the master for profit centers. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full profit center details (name, responsible_man

attributes.name: rate_case_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the rate case proceeding in which the regulatory deferral was authorized or is being sought for recovery or refund.

attributes.name: accumulated_carrying_charges
attributes.description: Total carrying charges (interest) accumulated on the regulatory deferral balance to date, representing the time value of money on deferred costs or revenues.

attributes.name: accumulated_deferral_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of costs or revenues accumulated in the regulatory deferral account to date, representing the gross balance before any amortization.

attributes.name: amortization_method
attributes.description: Method prescribed by the regulatory authority for amortizing the deferred amount over the recovery period, such as straight-line, declining balance, units of production, levelized, or custom regulatory-approved method.

attributes.name: amortization_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years over which the regulatory deferral is authorized to be amortized and recovered through customer rates or refunded to customers.

attributes.name: annual_amortization_amount
attributes.description: Planned annual amortization amount to be recovered or refunded each year based on the authorized amortization method and period.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority (PUC or FERC) authorized the deferral of costs or revenues for future rate recovery or refund.
attributes.references: FERC Order and PUC Rate Case Decisions

attributes.name: authorized_deferral_amount
attributes.description: Total amount authorized by the regulatory authority for deferral, representing the maximum cost or revenue that may be deferred for future rate recovery or refund.

attributes.name: carrying_charge_rate_pct
attributes.description: Annual percentage rate applied to the unamortized balance to calculate carrying charges (interest) on the regulatory deferral, typically based on the utility's weighted average cost of capital or a regulatory-approved rate.
attributes.references: FERC and PUC Rate Case Methodology

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Company code or legal entity identifier to which the regulatory deferral belongs, supporting multi-entity consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the regulatory deferral record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in the regulatory deferral record. Power and Utilities operates in USD.

attributes.name: deferral_category
attributes.description: Specific category of the regulatory deferral such as storm cost, pension/OPEB, fuel adjustment clause under/over-recovery, environmental remediation, rate case expense, EDIT (Excess Deferred Income Taxes), demand-side management program costs, renewable energy program costs, or other regulatory-approved deferral categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: storm_cost|pension_opeb|fuel_adjustment_clause|environmental_remediation|rate_case_expense|edit|dsm_program|renewable_program|transmission_upgrade|distribution_upgrade|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deferral_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the regulatory deferral, including the nature of the deferred costs or revenues, the business justification, and the regulatory authorization basis.

attributes.name: deferral_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or tracking number assigned to the regulatory deferral for external reference and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: deferral_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory deferral indicating whether it is pending regulatory approval, approved and active, fully amortized, terminated, or suspended.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Accounting Standards

attributes.name: deferral_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deferral as either a regulatory asset (costs deferred for future recovery) or regulatory liability (revenues deferred for future refund to customers).
attributes.references: ASC 980-340 Regulated Operations - Other Assets and Deferred Costs

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory deferral is scheduled to be fully amortized or terminated. Nullable for deferrals with indefinite recovery periods pending future rate proceedings.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the regulatory deferral becomes effective and begins accumulating deferred amounts or commencing amortization.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for the regulatory deferral, typically Account 182.3 (Other Regulatory Assets) or Account 254 (Other Regulatory Liabilities).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the regulatory deferral was established or is currently being amortized, supporting period-based financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: functional_class
attributes.description: Functional classification of the regulatory deferral indicating whether it relates to generation, transmission, distribution, customer service, or administrative and general operations.

attributes.name: is_ferc_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the regulatory deferral must be reported on FERC Form 1 Schedules 232 (Regulatory Assets) or 254 (Regulatory Liabilities).

attributes.name: is_rate_base_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the regulatory deferral balance is included in the utility's rate base for purposes of calculating allowed return on equity (ROE) and revenue requirement.
attributes.references: FERC and PUC Rate Base Methodology

attributes.name: is_sox_relevant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the regulatory deferral is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley Act internal control and audit requirements due to materiality or financial statement impact.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the regulatory deferral, including any regulatory conditions, audit findings, or management commentary.

attributes.name: puc_authorization_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or citation of the PUC order, rate case docket, or FERC order that authorized the regulatory deferral.

attributes.name: recovery_mechanism
attributes.description: Description of the rate mechanism through which the regulatory deferral will be recovered from or refunded to customers, such as base rates, rider, surcharge, fuel adjustment clause, or other regulatory-approved mechanism.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: State or federal regulatory jurisdiction under which the deferral was authorized, such as state PUC code or FERC for interstate transmission.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which the regulatory deferral record originated, typically the ERP financial system or regulatory accounting system.

attributes.name: unamortized_balance
attributes.description: Remaining balance of the regulatory deferral that has not yet been amortized or recovered through rates, representing the current carrying value on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: ASC 980-340 Regulated Operations - Other Assets and Deferred Costs

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the regulatory deferral record was last modified, supporting change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: utility_type
attributes.description: Type of utility service to which the regulatory deferral applies: electric, gas, or combined electric and gas operations.
attributes.references: FERC and State PUC Jurisdictional Classification

attributes.name: originating_regulatory_deferral_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on regulatory_deferral (originating_regulatory_deferral_id)

products.name: regulatory_asset_entry
products.description: Tracks regulatory assets and liabilities in the regulatory asset base (RAB) as reported to PUCs and FERC for rate case proceedings, capturing asset-in-service values, CWIP, and accumulated depreciation by FERC account.

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory asset or liability entry in the regulatory asset base (RAB). Primary key for tracking individual regulatory accounting entries reported to PUCs and FERC.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project that originated this regulatory asset entry, linking the entry to the project authorization, budget, and work breakdown structure (WBS).

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: regulatory_asset_entry has fiscal_year and fiscal_period attributes. financial_period is the master for fiscal periods. Normalizing this reference allows joining to get full period metadata. fiscal_ye

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.gl_account

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying fixed asset in the Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) system when this regulatory entry represents a specific capitalized asset or plant addition.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: rate_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate case proceeding in which this regulatory asset or liability was approved for recovery or refund, linking the entry to the regulatory order and cost-of-service study.

attributes.name: accumulated_amortization
attributes.description: Total cumulative amortization expense recognized to date for this regulatory asset or liability, representing the portion already recovered or refunded through customer rates.

attributes.name: afudc_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Amount
attributes.description: Total AFUDC amount capitalized to this regulatory asset during the construction period, representing the financing cost component added to the asset base.

attributes.name: amortization_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which amortization of the regulatory asset or liability is expected to be fully completed, representing the end of the recovery or refund period.

attributes.name: amortization_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate periodic amortization expense for the regulatory asset or liability, as prescribed by the regulatory commission or approved accounting policy.

attributes.name: amortization_period_months
attributes.description: Total number of months over which the regulatory asset or liability is scheduled to be amortized, as approved by the regulatory commission in the rate case order.

attributes.name: amortization_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which amortization of the regulatory asset or liability begins, marking the commencement of systematic recovery or refund through customer rates.

attributes.name: annual_amortization_amount
attributes.description: Planned annual amortization expense for the regulatory asset or liability, representing the amount to be recovered or refunded each year through customer rates.

attributes.name: carrying_cost_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of carrying costs accrued on the regulatory asset balance for the current period, representing the return component recoverable through rates in addition to amortization.

attributes.name: carrying_cost_rate
attributes.description: Annual percentage rate applied to the unamortized balance of the regulatory asset to calculate carrying costs (return on investment), representing the weighted average cost of capital (WACC) or authorized rate of return.

attributes.name: ciac_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contribution in Aid of Construction (CIAC) Amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of customer or third-party contributions received to offset the cost of this regulatory asset, reducing the net amount included in rate base.

attributes.name: ciac_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contribution in Aid of Construction (CIAC) Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory asset entry includes or is offset by Contribution in Aid of Construction (CIAC) amounts received from customers or third parties to fund capital improvements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory asset entry record was first created in the financial system, supporting audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this entry. Utility operates in USD.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Current unamortized balance of the regulatory asset or liability as of the reporting date, reflecting the remaining amount to be recovered or refunded through future rates.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory asset or liability becomes effective for rate recovery or refund purposes, as specified in the regulatory order or tariff filing.

attributes.name: entry_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the regulatory asset or liability, explaining the nature of the deferred cost or obligation, the business justification, and the regulatory treatment approved by the commission.

attributes.name: entry_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the regulatory asset or liability entry, used for external reporting and cross-referencing in rate case filings and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory asset or liability entry, tracking its progression from initial recording through amortization to retirement or transfer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|pending_approval|approved|amortizing|fully_amortized|retired|transferred — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory accounting entry indicating whether it represents a regulatory asset, regulatory liability, deferred debit, deferred credit, construction work in progress (CWIP), or plant in service.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code identifying the specific plant, asset, or regulatory account classification for this entry. Critical for regulatory reporting and rate case cost-of-service studies.

attributes.name: ferc_account_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Description
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the FERC account code, providing human-readable context for the regulatory accounting classification.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year for which this regulatory entry is reported, supporting period-level financial and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this regulatory asset or liability entry was recognized or is being reported, aligning with the utility's financial reporting calendar.

attributes.name: functional_class
attributes.description: Functional classification of the regulatory asset or liability within utility operations, aligning with FERC functional cost categories for rate base allocation and cost-of-service studies.

attributes.name: is_afudc_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory asset is eligible for accrual of Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC), representing the cost of capital during the construction period.

attributes.name: is_cwip_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entry represents construction work in progress that is eligible for inclusion in rate base before the asset is placed in service, subject to regulatory approval.

attributes.name: is_rate_base_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory asset is eligible for inclusion in the rate base for calculation of allowed return on equity (ROE) and revenue requirement in rate case proceedings.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code identifying the specific state Public Utility Commission (PUC) jurisdiction for state-regulated regulatory assets and liabilities.

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: Original dollar value of the regulatory asset or liability at the time of initial recognition, representing the total amount authorized for recovery or refund before any amortization.

attributes.name: recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory asset or liability was initially recognized in the regulatory accounting records, typically corresponding to the regulatory order or commission approval date.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Level of regulatory authority governing this regulatory asset or liability entry, indicating whether it is subject to federal (FERC), state (PUC), or municipal oversight.

attributes.name: regulatory_order_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory commission issued the order authorizing this regulatory asset or liability, establishing the legal basis for rate recovery or refund.

attributes.name: regulatory_order_number
attributes.description: Official order or docket number issued by the regulatory commission (FERC or state PUC) authorizing the recognition and recovery of this regulatory asset or liability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory asset entry record was last modified, supporting change tracking and audit compliance for regulatory accounting records.

attributes.name: utility_type
attributes.description: Type of utility service to which this regulatory asset or liability applies, distinguishing between electric operations, gas operations, or combined utility functions.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work breakdown structure element linking this regulatory entry to the originating capital project hierarchy for project cost tracking and CAPEX reporting.

attributes.name: prior_period_regulatory_asset_entry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Period Regulatory Asset Entry Id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on regulatory_asset_entry (prior_period_regulatory_asset_entry_id)

products.name: depreciation_study
products.description: Master reference table for depreciation_study. Referenced by depreciation_study_id.

attributes.name: depreciation_study_id
attributes.description: Primary key for depreciation_study

attributes.name: prior_study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous depreciation study that this study supersedes or updates. Nullable for initial studies.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: Total accumulated depreciation reserve for all assets in the study scope as of the study analysis date, measured in US dollars.

attributes.name: actuarial_method
attributes.description: Statistical method used to estimate service life and survivor characteristics of asset groups. Iowa curves are industry standard for utility depreciation studies.

attributes.name: annual_depreciation_expense
attributes.description: Projected annual depreciation expense resulting from the rates recommended in this study, measured in US dollars.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory body officially approved the depreciation study and its recommended rates. Nullable for pending or internal studies.

attributes.name: approval_order_number
attributes.description: Official order or decision number issued by the regulatory body approving the depreciation study. Nullable for unapproved studies.

attributes.name: asset_base_amount
attributes.description: Total gross plant value (original cost) of all assets included in the scope of this depreciation study, measured in US dollars.

attributes.name: average_remaining_life_years
attributes.description: Weighted average remaining service life for existing assets in the study scope, measured in years.

attributes.name: average_service_life_years
attributes.description: Weighted average estimated service life across all asset classes included in the study, measured in years.

attributes.name: consultant_firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the external consulting firm that prepared or assisted with the depreciation study. Nullable if study was performed entirely in-house.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this depreciation study record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Primary depreciation calculation methodology applied in this study. Straight-line is most common for utility assets under FERC guidelines. Remaining life and equal life group methods are used for mass property accounts.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the depreciation rates and parameters from this study become effective for accounting and regulatory purposes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the depreciation study parameters are scheduled to be superseded by a new study. Nullable for studies with indefinite applicability.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the depreciation study was officially filed with the regulatory body. Nullable for internal studies.

attributes.name: filing_docket_number
attributes.description: Official docket or case number assigned by the regulatory body when the depreciation study is filed for approval. Nullable for internal studies not requiring regulatory filing.

attributes.name: gaap_compliance_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the depreciation study methodology and rates comply with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles. True for studies used in GAAP financial reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this depreciation study record was most recently updated in the system.

attributes.name: lead_analyst_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary analyst or actuary responsible for conducting the depreciation study.

attributes.name: net_book_value_amount
attributes.description: Net plant value (gross plant minus accumulated depreciation) for all assets in the study scope, measured in US dollars.

attributes.name: net_salvage_percent
attributes.description: Weighted average net salvage value as a percentage of original cost across all asset classes. Net salvage represents gross salvage minus cost of removal. Can be negative when removal costs exceed salvage value.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to the depreciation study, including any deviations from standard methodology or unique circumstances.

attributes.name: rate_case_docket_number
attributes.description: Docket number of the associated rate case if this study was prepared for rate case purposes. Nullable if not associated with a rate case.

attributes.name: rate_case_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this depreciation study was prepared specifically to support a rate case filing. True if study is part of rate case, false otherwise.

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the specific regulatory agency or commission that has jurisdiction over this depreciation study (e.g., FERC, state public utility commission name).

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Primary regulatory jurisdiction governing this depreciation study. Federal studies follow FERC guidelines, state studies follow public utility commission requirements, and multi-jurisdictional studies address multiple regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: sox_compliance_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this depreciation study was subject to Sarbanes-Oxley internal control requirements and review. True for studies affecting financial statements of publicly traded utilities.

attributes.name: study_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the depreciation study analysis was completed and finalized for submission or approval.

attributes.name: study_documentation_url
attributes.description: File path or URL to the complete depreciation study report and supporting documentation in the document management system.

attributes.name: study_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the depreciation study, typically including the asset class or scope covered.

attributes.name: study_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the depreciation study, typically formatted as DS-YYYY-NNNN where YYYY is year and NNNN is sequence number.

attributes.name: study_scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the asset classes, FERC accounts, and organizational units covered by this depreciation study.

attributes.name: study_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the depreciation study analysis and data collection commenced.

attributes.name: study_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the depreciation study. Tracks progression from initial draft through regulatory approval and implementation.

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Classification of the depreciation study based on scope and purpose. Comprehensive studies cover all asset classes, interim studies update specific parameters, special studies address unique circumstances, rate case studies support regulatory filings, and asset class specific studies focus on particular equipment categories.

attributes.name: prior_depreciation_study_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on depreciation_study (prior_depreciation_study_id)

products.name: journal_entry_template
products.description: Master reference table for journal_entry_template. Referenced by recurring_template_id.

attributes.name: journal_entry_template_id
attributes.description: Primary key for journal_entry_template

attributes.name: superseded_by_template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer template that replaces this template when it is deprecated or archived. Null for current active templates.

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: Primary accounting standard framework that governs the use and structure of this journal entry template.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_code
attributes.description: Reference to the approval workflow configuration that governs the review and authorization process for entries using this template.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the authorized person who approved this template for production use. Null for templates not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry template was approved for production use. Null for templates not yet approved.

attributes.name: auto_reverse_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether journal entries created from this template should automatically generate reversing entries in the subsequent accounting period.

attributes.name: balance_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the template enforces balanced debits and credits, allows unbalanced entries, or relies on system calculation for balancing.

attributes.name: control_objective
attributes.description: Description of the internal control objective this template supports for financial reporting accuracy and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: cost_center_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cost center assignment is mandatory for journal entries created from this template for cost accounting purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry template record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for journal entries created from this template. Typically USD for US utility operations.

attributes.name: default_posting_period
attributes.description: Default accounting period relative to the entry creation date where journal entries from this template should be posted.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this journal entry template is no longer active and should not be used for new journal entries. Null for templates with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this journal entry template becomes active and available for use in creating journal entries.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Business functional area or department that primarily uses this template for their accounting transactions and financial reporting.

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this template is used for intercompany transactions requiring elimination entries during financial consolidation.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who most recently modified this journal entry template record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry template record was most recently modified in the system.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when this template was used to create a journal entry, supporting template usage analysis and archival decisions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to this journal entry template for accounting staff reference.

attributes.name: project_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a project or work order assignment is mandatory for entries using this template to support capital expenditure (CAPEX) tracking.

attributes.name: recurrence_day
attributes.description: Day of the month (1-31) or week (1-7) when recurring journal entries using this template should be posted. Null for non-recurring templates.

attributes.name: recurrence_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this template is intended to be used for recurring journal entries. Null for non-recurring templates.

attributes.name: regulatory_account_class
attributes.description: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) account classification applicable to this template for regulatory reporting and rate case preparation.

attributes.name: requires_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether journal entries created from this template require supervisory approval before posting to the general ledger.

attributes.name: reverse_period_offset
attributes.description: Number of accounting periods after the original entry when the automatic reversing entry should be posted. Null if auto_reverse_flag is false.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the originating system or module that typically generates journal entries using this template for automated posting scenarios.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this template is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley internal control requirements and enhanced audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry template indicating whether it is available for use in creating journal entries.

attributes.name: tax_relevant_flag
